local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryLinaRabbitSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryLinaRabbit @
		Comment = 골드 소모 서브 이벤트 2 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- npc
	self.get_seller = function() return get_character('rabbit_brazier_seller') end

	-- 기믹
	self.get_brazier = function() return get_field_object('rabbit_brazier') end

	-- 화로 가격
	self.brazier_price = 2000
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:enter()
	local seller = self.get_seller()
	character_util.add_listener(seller, self.controller)

	local brazier = self.get_brazier()
	brazier.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:exit()
	local seller = self.get_seller()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(seller, self.controller)

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--- OnEvent
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local seller = self.get_seller()
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, seller) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.selling_brazier, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:selling_brazier()
	local seller = self.get_seller()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(seller, self.controller)

	party_util.align_party(seller.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5),
		'down', 1, 'linear')

	character_util.set_emotion(seller, { name = 'smile' })
	-- 댁에 화로 하나 들여놓으세요. 곧 쌀쌀해집니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(seller, { key = 'short_story_lina_rabbit_1', skip = true })

	-- 선택지: 화로 (2000골드) / 그만둔다.
	local player_choice = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'short_story_lina_rabbit_2', 'mercy' },
		{ 'short_story_lina_rabbit_3' }
	})

	if player_choice == 2 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		-- 감사합니다~ 또 찾아주세요!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(seller, { key = 'short_story_lina_rabbit_4', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_emotion(seller)
		character_util.add_listener(seller, self.controller)
		return
	end

	local gold_table = get_or_create_global_table('stageeventcontrollers/ShortStoryLinaGold')
	if gold_table:get_dollar() < self.brazier_price then
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'short_story_lina_clothing_not_enough', mintotalduration = 1 })

		character_util.remove_emotion(seller)
		character_util.add_listener(seller, self.controller)
		return
	end

	gold_table:remove_dollar_async(self.brazier_price)

	-- 화로 던져 줌
	local brazier = self.get_brazier()
	brazier.Position = seller.Position
	command_util.execute_holdup(seller, brazier, seller.Position, 0.12, false)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.release_hold_object(seller, brazier)
	sp_util.sine_move(brazier,
		{ from = seller.Position + vector(0, 1.1, 0),
		  to = seller.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.75), duration = 0.3, height = 0.3 })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	-- 감사합니다~ 또 찾아주세요!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(seller, { key = 'short_story_lina_rabbit_4', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_emotion(seller)

	quest_util.progress_section(self.controller)
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryLinaRabbitSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryLinaRabbit @
		Comment = ShortStoryLinaRabbit 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.get_signboard = function(index) return get_field_object('rabbit_board_' .. index) end
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BurnEvent), 'on_burn_event')
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BurnEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--- OnEvent
function local_class:on_event(_)
	return false
end

--- BurnEvent
function local_class:on_burn_event(e)
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local signboard = self.get_signboard(i)
		if not self.is_showing_event and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, signboard) then
			self.is_showing_event = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.runaway_rabbit, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:runaway_rabbit()
	self.controller.stop_talking_event = true

	local dog = get_character('rabbit_dog')

	local kids = {}
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local kid = get_character('rabbit_kid_' .. i)
		table.insert(kids, kid)
	end

	local align_pos = field:GetMarker('rabbit_align_pos').position
	camera_util.move(align_pos + vector(0, 0, 3), 1)
	party_util.align_party(align_pos, 'left', 1, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(2)

	character_util.set_direction(kids[1], 'up')
	character_util.normal_jump(kids[1], true)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	-- 아, 이제 안으로 들어갈 수 있다!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kids[1], { key = 'short_story_lina_rabbit_11', skip = true })

	-- 괘, 괜찮아…? 우리가 구해줄게…!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kids[1], { key = 'short_story_lina_rabbit_12', skip = true })

	local dog_stone = get_field_object('rabbit_dog_stone')

	-- 돌 앞으로 이동
	local kid_waypoint = {
		{
			vector(dog_stone.Position.x - 0.4, 0, kids[1].Position.z),
			dog_stone.Position + vector(-0.4, 0, -0.75)
		},
		{
			vector(dog_stone.Position.x + 0.1, 0, kids[2].Position.z),
			dog_stone.Position + vector(0.1, 0, -0.75)
		},
		{
			vector(dog_stone.Position.x - 0.4, 0, kids[3].Position.z),
			dog_stone.Position + vector(-0.4, 0, -1.25)
		},
		{
			vector(dog_stone.Position.x + 0.1, 0, kids[4].Position.z),
			dog_stone.Position + vector(0.1, 0, -1.25)
		}
	}

	local run_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })

	local kid_speed = 5
	character_util.move_waypoint(kids[1], kid_waypoint[1], kid_speed, true)
	character_util.move_waypoint(kids[2], kid_waypoint[2], kid_speed, true)
	character_util.move_waypoint(kids[3], kid_waypoint[3], kid_speed, true)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(kids[4], kid_waypoint[4], kid_speed, true)

	run_sfx:Stop()

	-- 꼬마들 단체 행동
	local kids_func = function(anim, emotion, upper, shake)
		for _, kid in pairs(kids) do
			if anim then
				character_util.remove_anim(kid)
				character_util.set_anim(kid, { name = anim, upper = upper })
			end

			if emotion then
				character_util.remove_emotion(kid)
				character_util.set_emotion(kid, { name = emotion })
			end

			if shake then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
				character_util.shake(kid, 0.04, 0.5)
			end
		end
	end

	kids_func('push', nil, true)

	-- 돌을 미려고 하는 꼬마들
	kids_func(nil, nil, nil, true)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	kids_func(nil, nil, nil, true)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 돌을 밀어내는 연출
	local duration = 0.7
	local time_passed = 0

	local start_pos = {}

	local dist = vector(0, 0, 1)

	for i = 1, 4 do
		start_pos[kids[i]] = kids[i].Position
	end
	start_pos[dog_stone] = dog_stone.Position

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_push_rock_unit_01')

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)

		for _, kid in pairs(kids) do
			local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos[kid], start_pos[kid] + dist, progress)
			kid.Position = cur_pos
		end

		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos[dog_stone], start_pos[dog_stone] + dist, progress)
		dog_stone.Position = cur_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 개를 구출함
	for _, kid in pairs(kids) do
		character_util.remove_anim(kid, true)
		character_util.set_direction(kid, 'right')
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_pet_ordinary_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(dog)
	character_util.set_emotion(dog, { name = 'smile' })

	local dog_waypoint = {
		dog.Position + vector(2, 0, 0),
		dog.Position + vector(1, 0, 0)
	}

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(dog, dog_waypoint, 4)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	kids_func('victory_extra', 'smile')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(dog, nil, 'happy')

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 0)
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryLinaRestaurantSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryLinaRestaurant @
		Comment = ShortStoryLinaRestaurant 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- npc
	self.get_restaurant_owner = function() return get_character('restaurant_owner') end
	self.get_restaurant_waitress = function(index) return get_character('restaurant_waitress_' .. index) end

	-- 기믹
	self.get_restaurant_table = function() return get_field_object('restaurant_table') end
	self.get_star_piece = function() return get_field_object('restaurant_star_piece') end

	-- 마커
	self.get_lina_seat_pos = function() return field:GetMarker('restaurant_lina_seat_pos').position end
	self.get_owner_pos = function() return field:GetMarker('restaurant_owner_pos').position end
	self.get_waitress_pos = function(index) return field:GetMarker('restaurant_waitress_pos_' .. index).position end

	-- 이펙트
	self.get_fx_reward = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_reward') end

	-- 플래터 음식 가격
	self.platter_price = 13000
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_quest_progressed_event')

	local main_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(7000801)
	if main_progress ~= nil and main_progress.InnerProgress > 0 then
		self:restaurant_table_setting()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
	self.get_fx_reward()
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))

	if self.touch_handler then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
		self.touch_handler = nil
	end

	if self.menu_item then
		self.menu_item:ConsumeComplete()
		self.menu_item = nil
	end

	if self.optimized_npcs ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.optimized_npcs)
		self.optimized_npcs = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--- OnEvent
function local_class:on_event(_)
	return false
end

---- InteractEvent
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local restaurant_table = self.get_restaurant_table()
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, restaurant_table) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_table, self, restaurant_table)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- QuestProgressedEvent
function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	if e.QuestId == 7000801 and e.CurrentProgress > 0 then
		self:restaurant_table_setting()
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 테이블 상호작용 시
function local_class:interact_table(restaurant_table)
	restaurant_table.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	local lina = user_party[0]
	local gourry = user_party[1]
	local xellos = user_party[2]
	local eva = user_party[3]

	party_util.align_party(restaurant_table, 'down', 1, 'linear')

	-- 캔터베리 스페셜 위장 폭발 플래터!!
	-- 제한 시간 안에 다 먹을 시 특별한 상품을 드립니다.
	-- 주문비 13000 골드
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'short_story_lina_restaurant_1', mintotalduration = 1 })

	-- 골드가 충분한지 체크
	local gold_table = get_or_create_global_table('stageeventcontrollers/ShortStoryLinaGold')
	if gold_table:get_dollar() < self.platter_price then
		-- 이런, 돈이 부족한 거 같은데?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lina, { key = 'short_story_lina_restaurant_3', skip = true })

		restaurant_table.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		return
	end

	-- 선택지 : 주문한다. / 그만둔다.
	local player_choice = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'short_story_lina_restaurant_4', 'mercy' },
		{ 'short_story_lina_restaurant_5' }
	})

	if player_choice == 2 then
		restaurant_table.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		return
	end

	gold_table:remove_dollar_async(self.platter_price)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local lina_seat_pos = self.get_lina_seat_pos() + vector(0, 0.5, 0)

	-- 파티원 앉을 위치 및 방향
	local party_seat = {}
	party_seat[lina] = {
		pos = lina_seat_pos,
		dir = 'left'
	}
	party_seat[gourry] = {
		pos = lina_seat_pos + vector(-3, 0, 0),
		dir = 'right'
	}
	party_seat[xellos] = {
		pos = lina_seat_pos + vector(-3, 0, 2),
		dir = 'right'
	}
	if eva then
		party_seat[eva] = {
			pos = lina_seat_pos + vector(0, 0, 2),
			dir = 'left'
		}
	end

	-- bgm_transition: Field(bgm_slayers_castletown) -> Event(bgm_slayers_event)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/castletown/audio:bgm_slayers_event', state = 'event' })

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	camera_util.move(restaurant_table.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), 0)

	-- npc 동적 생성
	self.optimized_npcs = load_util.create_optimized_npcs_async({
		zelgadis = 'shortstory_sl_zelgadis',
		amelia = 'shortstory_sl_amelia',
		owner = 'shortstory_sl_chef',
		waitress_1 = 'shortstory_sl_waitress',
		waitress_2 = 'shortstory_sl_waitress'
	})

	local zelgadis = self.optimized_npcs['zelgadis']
	local amelia = self.optimized_npcs['amelia']
	local owner = self.optimized_npcs['owner']
	local waitress_1 = self.optimized_npcs['waitress_1']
	local waitress_2 = self.optimized_npcs['waitress_2']

	-- 메뉴 아이템 추가
	local add_menu_item = function(target, dir)
		local dir_vector = dir == 'left' and vector(-1, 0, 0) or vector(1, 0, 0)

		local menu_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ pos = target.Position + vector(dir_vector.x * 0.3, 0.2, 0), itemid = 20491,
			  notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.6, showoncharacter = true })

		menu_item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero
		local sprite_scale = menu_item.SpriteTransform.localScale
		menu_item.SpriteTransform.localScale = vector_util.get_0yz(sprite_scale, sprite_scale.x * dir_vector.x)
		return menu_item
	end

	local menu_items = {}

	-- 파티원 세팅
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]
		party_member.Position = party_seat[party_member].pos
		character_util.set_direction(party_member, party_seat[party_member].dir)
		character_util.set_anim(party_member, { name = 'seat' })
		local item = add_menu_item(party_member, party_seat[party_member].dir)
		table.insert(menu_items, item)
	end

	zelgadis.Position = lina_seat_pos + vector(-3, 0, 1)
	character_util.set_direction(zelgadis, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(zelgadis, { name = 'seat' })
	local item = add_menu_item(zelgadis, 'right')
	table.insert(menu_items, item)

	amelia.Position = lina_seat_pos + vector(0, 0, 1)
	character_util.set_direction(amelia, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(amelia, { name = 'seat' })
	item = add_menu_item(amelia, 'left')
	table.insert(menu_items, item)

	if self.menu_item then
		self.menu_item:ConsumeComplete()
		self.menu_item = nil
	end

	-- 주인 및 점원 세팅
	owner.Position = self.get_owner_pos()
	character_util.set_direction(owner, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.set_emotion(amelia, { name = 'smile' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	-- 아멜리아 (left, smile, seat) : 리나 언니! 저 배 터지게 먹을 준비 됐습니다!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(amelia, { key = 'short_story_lina_restaurant_5_1', skip = true })

	-- 제르가디스 (right, idle, seat) : 나는 적당한 메뉴를…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(zelgadis, { key = 'short_story_lina_restaurant_5_2', skip = true })

	if eva then
		-- 에바 (left, idle, seat) : 흠… 근육량을 늘리기 좋은 음식은…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, { key = 'short_story_lina_restaurant_5_3', skip = true })
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	-- 리나 (left, smile, seat) : 좋아! 주인장! 주문할게!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lina, { key = 'short_story_lina_restaurant_5_4', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	-- 주인 (right, idle, idle) : 이번엔 무엇을 거래하러 왔지?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(owner, { key = 'short_story_lina_restaurant_6', skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(lina, { name = 'smile' })
	-- 리나 (left, smile, seat): 골드를 잔뜩 들고 와서 거래할 건 하나지!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lina, { key = 'short_story_lina_restaurant_7', skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(gourry, { name = 'smile' })
	-- 가우리 (right, smile, seat): 역시 그것밖에 없지!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gourry, { key = 'short_story_lina_restaurant_8', skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(owner, { name = 'attack' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
	-- 주인 (right, attack, idle) : 그것이라면…?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(owner, { key = 'short_story_lina_restaurant_9', skip = true })

	-- 리나, 가우리 side, awesome, seat, shake 상태로 천천히 1초간 줌 인.
	character_util.set_emotion(lina, { name = 'awesome' })
	character_util.shake(lina, 0.04, 1)

	local move_func = function(targets, move_dist, duration)
		local start_pos = {}
		local end_pos = {}

		for _, target in pairs(targets) do
			start_pos[target] = target.Position
			end_pos[target] = target.Position + move_dist
		end

		local time_passed = 0

		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)

			for _, target in pairs(targets) do
				local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos[target], end_pos[target], progress)
				target.Position = cur_pos
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryLinaSurvivingRogueSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryLinaSurvivingRogue @
		Comment = ShortStoryLinaSurvivingRogue 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- npc
	self.get_runaway_rogue = function() return get_character('surviving_rogue') end

	-- object
	self.get_signboard = function(index) return get_field_object('surviving_rogue_signboard_' .. index) end
	self.get_tent = function(index) return get_field_object('surviving_rogue_tent_' .. index) end
	self.get_tent_fire = function(index) return get_field_object('surviving_rogue_tent_fire_' .. index) end

	-- 마커
	self.get_tent_pos = function(index) return field:GetMarker('surviving_rogue_tent_pos_' .. index).position end

	-- 이펙트
	self.get_dead_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead') end

	self.all_signboard = {}
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BurnEvent), 'on_burn_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	local left_tent = self.get_tent(1)
	local left_tent_pos = self.get_tent_pos(1)
	left_tent.Position = left_tent_pos

	local right_tent = self.get_tent(2)
	local right_tent_pos = self.get_tent_pos(2)
	right_tent.Position = right_tent_pos

	-- 해당 존에 있는 표지판 저장
	local signboard_zone = field:GetZone('get_signboard')
	local object_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(signboard_zone.Bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	for index = 0, object_list.Count - 1 do
		local signboard = object_list[index]
		signboard.Position = signboard.Position + vector(24, 0, 0)
		table.insert(self.all_signboard, signboard)
	end

	object_list:Dispose()

	return true
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_dead_effect()
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BurnEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	self.all_signboard = nil

	if self.tent_shake_sfx then
		self.tent_shake_sfx:Stop()
		self.tent_shake_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--- OnEvent
function local_class:on_event(_)
	return false
end

--- BurnEvent
function local_class:on_burn_event(e)
	for _, signboard in pairs(self.all_signboard) do
		if not self.is_burning_signboard and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, signboard) then
			self.is_burning_signboard = true

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
				party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
				field_ui_manager:Hide()

				local left_tent_center = vector_util.get_x0z(self.get_tent(1).Bounds.center)
				local target_pos = left_tent_center + vector(4.5, 0, -1.5)
				camera_util.move_async(target_pos, 1)
			end))
		end
	end

	-- 왼쪽 텐트 옆의 표지판에 불이 붙었을 때
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local signboard = self.get_signboard(i)
		if not self.is_burning_tent_1 and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, signboard) then
			self.is_burning_tent_1 = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.burn_left_tent_event, self))
		end
	end

	-- 오른쪽 텐트 옆의 표지판에 불이 붙었을 때
	for i = 3, 4 do
		local signboard = self.get_signboard(i)
		if not self.is_burning_tent_2 and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, signboard) then
			self.is_burning_tent_2 = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.burn_right_tent_event, self))
		end
	end
end

--- ZoneEnterEvent
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'surviving_rogue_cave') then
		local left_tent = self.get_tent(1)
		left_tent:Shake('left_tent_shake', 0.02, 99999)

		if not self.tent_shake_sfx then
			self.tent_shake_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
				{ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', parent = left_tent, loop = true })
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- ZoneLeaveEvent
function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, 'surviving_rogue_cave') then
		local left_tent = self.get_tent(1)
		left_tent:CancelShake('left_tent_shake')

		if self.tent_shake_sfx then
			self.tent_shake_sfx:Stop()
			self.tent_shake_sfx = nil
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryLinaTowerPreSection')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	self.lina = self.controller.get_lina()
	self.goury = self.controller.get_goury()
	self.amelia = self.controller.get_amelia()
	self.zelgadis = self.controller.get_zelgadis()
	self.xellos = self.controller.get_xellos()

	self.fx_spark = self.controller.fx_spark
	self.fx_power_on = self.controller.fx_power_on

	self.engineer = get_character('tower_engineer')

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.engineer, {name = 'eat'}, {name = 'tired'})

	character_util.set_position(self.engineer, field:GetMarker('tower_init_pos').position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0))
	character_util.add_listener(self.engineer, self.controller)
end

function local_class:renew_character_cache()
	self.lina = self.controller.get_lina()
	self.goury = self.controller.get_goury()
	self.amelia = self.controller.get_amelia()
	self.zelgadis = self.controller.get_zelgadis()
	self.xellos = self.controller.get_xellos()
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.engineer) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.pre_event_scene, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

--message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
--message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

function local_class:show_marker(name, target, immediately)
	-- 마커 관리가 시작되는 시점은 메인 프롤로그가 진행된 이후여야 한다.
	local main_qp = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(7000801)

	if main_qp == nil then
		return
	end

	if immediately then
		quest_marker_util.remove(name)
	end
	-- 서브 마커로서 관리되기 위해서는 확실하게 progress가 nil이 아니고 서브퀘스트여야 한다.
	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(name, 7000809,
			false, target)
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	local marker_name = 'lina_main_tower'

	-- 마을 거리 그리드
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'main_town') then
		self:show_marker(marker_name, self.engineer, true)

		-- 각종 실내 공간
	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'prologue_tavern') then
		self:show_marker(marker_name, get_field_object('tavern_exit'), true)

	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'slum_kid_house_grid') then
		self:show_marker(marker_name, get_field_object('slum_kid_house_exit'), true)

	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'old_woman_house_grid') then
		self:show_marker(marker_name, get_field_object('old_woman_house_exit'), true)

	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'slum_house4_grid') then
		self:show_marker(marker_name, get_field_object('slum_house4_exit'), true)

	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'slum_house3_grid') then
		self:show_marker(marker_name, get_field_object('slum_house3_exit'), true)

	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'slum_house2_grid') then
		self:show_marker(marker_name, get_field_object('slum_house2_exit'), true)

	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'slum_house1_grid') then
		self:show_marker(marker_name, get_field_object('slum_house1_exit'), true)

	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'poacher_house_grid') then
		self:show_marker(marker_name, get_field_object('pocher_house_exit'), true)

	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'clothing_store_grid') then
		self:show_marker(marker_name, get_field_object('cloth_store_exit'), true)

	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'passport_store_grid') then
		self:show_marker(marker_name, get_field_object('paper_store_exit'), true)

		-- 연구실 공간은 마커 미정
	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'secret_lab_grid') then
		quest_marker_util.remove('lina_main_tower')
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local marker_name = 'lina_main_tower'

	self:renew_character_cache()

	local slum_half_line = field:GetMarker('tower_pos_7').position + vector(-2, -1, 0)
	-- 슬럼가 그리드
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.lina, 'slum_area') then
		if user_party.Leader.Position.x < slum_half_line.x then
			self:show_marker(marker_name, get_field_object('slum_exit'), true)
		else
			self:show_marker(marker_name, get_field_object('slum_exit_B'), true)
		end
	-- 동굴 그리드
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.lina, 'cave_area') then
		self:show_marker(marker_name, get_field_object('cave_exit_c_outer'), true)

	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

	self:renew_character_cache()

	--……

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(self.lina, { name = "nod", count = 1 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

	character_util.set_emotion(self.engineer, {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.normal_jump_async(self.engineer, true)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.engineer, {key = talk_name .. 7, skip = true})
	--저기, 나를 좀 도와줄 수 있어?

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.engineer, {key = talk_name .. 8, skip = true})
	--어떤 일이길래 도와달라는 거야?
	character_util.set_anim(self.lina, {name = 'cross_arm'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = talk_name .. 9, skip = true})
	--이렇게 비활성화된 탑에 마력을 주입해서 다시 활성화시키는 거야.

	character_util.set_direction(self.engineer, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(self.engineer, {name = 'shoot'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.engineer, {key = talk_name .. 10, skip = true})
	--마력을 잘 다루면 금방 끝낼 일인데 나는 좀 서툴러서 오래 걸려…

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.engineer, {key = talk_name .. 17, skip = true})
	--사정도 딱한 거 같고 마침 돈도 필요했으니 잘 됐는걸.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.goury, {key = talk_name .. 18, skip = true})
	--좋아! 도와줄게!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.set_direction(self.lina, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(self.lina, {name = 'wink'})
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.engineer)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.engineer, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = talk_name .. 19, skip = true})
	--정말 고마워!!
	local clap_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_clap_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event'})
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.engineer, {name = 'clap'}, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.engineer, {key = talk_name .. 20, skip = true})
	--그럼 활성화하는 방법을 알려줄게.
	clap_sfx:Stop()
	clap_sfx = nil
	character_util.remove_anim(self.engineer)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lina)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.engineer, {key = talk_name .. 21, skip = true})

	--정비공 한 타일 위로 이동.
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.engineer, self.engineer.Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
			1, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'down')

	--우선 탑과 마력을 연결한 뒤, 회로 방향에 맞게 마력을 주입하면 돼.
	character_util.set_anim(self.engineer, {name = 'attack', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.engineer, {key = talk_name .. 22, skip = true})
	--순서를 알려줄 테니 한 번 해봐.
	character_util.remove_anim(self.engineer)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.engineer, {key = talk_name .. 23, skip = true})

	--리나 우측으로 1타일 이동.
	character_util.move_to_async(self.lina, self.engineer.Position + vector(0, 0, -1),
			1, nil, true, true)


	--(이후 QTE 실패 시 정비공의 실패 대사 후 여기부터 재시작.)
	local combo = { 'right', 'left', 'down'}
	local success = false
	local tower = self.controller.towers[8]

	while not success do
		--오른쪽, 왼쪽, 아래.
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lina)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.engineer, {key = talk_name .. 24, skip = true})
		--리나 (right, sleep_deep, staff_cast) 리나와 마력탑 제외하고 배경 검은 틴트.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_lina_fire_cast_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.lina, {name = 'staff_cast'}, {name = 'sleep_deep'})
		field:Tint('tower_concentrate', unity_color({0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1}), 1)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		--QTE 드래그 오른쪽, 왼쪽, 아래 순서대로 나옴.
		for i, input in ipairs(combo) do
			success = self.controller:qte_event(input, -1, i == #combo)

			coroutine.yield(nil)

			if not success then
				CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine(false)
				stage.Field:Undarken('tutorial')

				--QTE 실패 시 마력탑 짧게 진동 후 틴트 풀림, 리나(right, tired, idle)
				camera_util.shake(0.03, 0.2)
				field:RemoveTint('tower_concentrate', 1)
				wait_for_sec(1)

				--으음… 그게 아니야, 다시 말해줄 테니 잘 들어.
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lina)
				character_util.set_emotion(self.lina, {name = 'tired'})

				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.engineer, {key = talk_name .. 25, skip = true})
				break
			end
			if input == 'up' or input == 'down' then
				character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.lina, {name = 'sword_attack2', count = 1, upper = true})
			else
				character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.lina, {name = 'sword_attack_stab', count = 1, upper = true})
			end
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_lina_b_shoot_01')
			if i == #combo then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_summon_effect_02')
			end
			self.fx_spark:Instantiate(tower.Position + vector(0.5, 3.5, 0.5))
			wait_for_sec(0.2)
			tower:Shake(0.03, 0.2)

			if success and i == #combo then
				yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, 1)
			else
				CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine(false)
				--stage.Field:Undarken('tutorial')
				wait_for_sec(0.3)
			end

			--QTE 성공 시 마력탑에 푸른빛 이펙트가 잠깐 활성.(후에 이펙트 추가, 프로토타입에 반영 x)
			--character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(tower, {name = 'cast', count = 5})
			--character_util.set_anim(tower, {name = 'idle', loop = false})
		end

	end
	--character_util.set_anim(tower, {name = 'cast'})
	stage.Field:Undarken('tutorial')

	--QTE 3회 성공 시 카메라 쉐이크, 줌 인, 화이트 페이드 아웃.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_earthquake_01')
	field:RemoveTint('tower_concentrate', 1)
	camera_util.shake(0.05, 2)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 2)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(2, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	self.controller:activate_tower(8)
	--character_util.set_anim(tower, {name = 'idle', loop = true})
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lina)
	--페이드 인 시 줌과 배경 틴트 풀려있음, 마력탑 푸른빛 활성화 상태, 리나(idle) 좌측으로 한 타일 뒷걸음질.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_lights_01')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1.5, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')


	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

		{'right', 'left', 'right', 'down', 'right'},
		{'down', 'down', 'right', 'down', 'up'},
		{'up', 'down', 'up', 'up', 'left'},

function local_class:progress_to_string(progress)

	for i = 1, 8 do
		text = text .. ((progress >> (i - 1)) & 0x1)
	end

	return text
end

function local_class:start()

end

end

function local_class:on_event(e)

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		for i, tower in ipairs(self.controller.towers) do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, tower) then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.tower_activity_event, self, i)

function local_class:tower_activity_setting()
	--
	--광장 중앙 마력탑
	--우측 정렬
	--왼쪽, 왼쪽, 오른쪽, 아래, 위.

	--시장 좌측 마력탑(현재 2층 타일은 구현 x)
	--좌측 정렬
	--오른쪽, 왼쪽, 오른쪽, 아래, 오른쪽.

	--마도구 거리 마력탑
	--좌측 정렬
	--아래, 아래, 오른쪽, 아래, 위.

	--예배당 옆 마력탑
	--우측 정렬
	--위, 아래, 위, 위, 왼쪽.

	--고급 주택가 마력탑(현재 2층 타일은 구현 x)
	--우측 정렬(타일맵 수정 예정)
	--왼쪽, 위, 오른쪽, 왼쪽, 오른쪽.

	--빈민가 소코반 마력탑(현재 2층 타일은 구현 x)
	--우측 정렬
	--오른쪽, 오른쪽, 위, 왼쪽, 아래.

	--빈민가 마력탑
	--우측 정렬
	--아래, 오른쪽, 아래, 위, 위.
	--
	self.tower_progress = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, 'tower_progress')
	if self.tower_progress < 0 then
		self.tower_progress = (1 << 7)
	end

	local done = true
	for i, tower in ipairs(self.controller.towers) do
		if ((self.tower_progress >> (i - 1)) & 0x1) == 0 and i < 8 then
			tower.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
			done = false
		elseif i < 8 then
			self.controller:activate_tower(i)
		end
	end
	--
	--마력탑 7곳 전부 활성화 시 정비공(right, idle, eat)에게 마킹.
	if done then
		yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
	else
		self.engineer.Interactable.Talk = self.talk_name .. 'oneline'
	end
end

function local_class:tower_activity_event(index)
	self:renew_character_cache()

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()

	--CS.UnityEngine.Debug.Log('current tower progress : ' .. self:progress_to_string(self.tower_progress))
	local tower = self.controller.towers[index]
	local tower_pos = self.tower_pos[index]
	tower.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	--마력탑마다 마킹 x, 대신 이펙트를 통해 활성화, 비활성화 구분 가능
	--7개의 마력탑 간에 클리어 순서 정해져있지 않음.
	--마력 회로 QTE는 첫 이벤트에서만 튜토리얼처럼 QTE드래그 방향 출력해주고 이후로는 QTE드래그 화면에 띄우지 않음. 피자박스 접기 참조(https://youtu.be/TT5eMuBtjrw?t=377)
	--

	local dirv = self.tower_aligns[index] == 'right' and vector(1, 0, 0) or vector(-1, 0, 0)

	--side 정렬 방식 통일.
	party_util.align_party(tower_pos + dirv, self.tower_aligns[index], 1, 'arc')
	--
	--리나(적색) 가우리(녹색) 제로스(청색)
	--정렬 공간이 나오지 않는 마력탑은 이후 타일맵 수정 예정.
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	camera_util.move(tower_pos, 0.5)
	character_util.move_to_async(self.lina,
			self.lina.Position + direction_util.to_vector3(self.lina.Direction) * 0.5,
			0.5, nil, true, true)
	--
	local combo = self.tower_keys[index]
	local success = false
	--
	--마력탑 점검 이벤트 통일.
	--마력탑 상호작용 시 이벤트 시작, 정렬.
	--리나(eat): 어디 이 탑의 마력 회로는…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_02')
	character_util.set_anim(self.lina, {name = 'cross_arm'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 0, skip = true})
	--나레이션 박스: (고유 커맨드)
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = self.tower_key_name .. index })

	--위 나레이션 박스 뜨면서 리나 eat -> idle
	--리나(idle): 좋아! 그럼 바로 시작해볼까?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lina)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.lina, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 1, skip = true})

	while not success do
		--리나 (side, sleep_deep, staff_cast) 리나와 마력탑 제외하고 배경 검은 틴트.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_lina_fire_cast_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.lina, {name = 'staff_cast'}, {name = 'sleep_deep'})
		field:Tint('lina_tower_act', unity_color({0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1}), 1)
		wait_for_sec(1)
		--QTE 드래그 방향 화면에 띄우지 않음, 나레이션 박스에 나온 순서를 기억했다가 QTE 드래그하는 액티비티.

		for i, input in ipairs(combo) do
			success = self.controller:qte_event(input, nil, i == #combo)

			coroutine.yield(nil)

			if not success then
				CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine(false)
				stage.Field:Undarken('tutorial')

				--QTE 실패 시 마력탑 짧게 진동 후 틴트 풀림, 리나(right, tired, idle)
				camera_util.shake(0.03, 0.2)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lina)
				character_util.set_emotion(self.lina, {name = 'tired'})
				field:RemoveTint('lina_tower_act', 1)
				wait_for_sec(1)

				--제로스: (고유 커맨드)
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.xellos, {key = self.tower_key_name .. index, skip = true})

				--제로스(doyagao, question): 설마 이렇게 간단한 걸 잊은 건 아니겠죠, 리나 씨?
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.xellos, {key = self.talk_name .. 2, skip = true})

				--리나(제로스를 보며 attack, release): 그, 그럴 리 없잖아! 잘 보라고.
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
				character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.lina, {name = 'release'}, {name = 'attack'})
				character_util.set_direction(self.lina, direction_util.get_opposite(self.lina.Direction))
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 3, skip = true})
				--(마력탑을 보며 idle, idle)
				character_util.set_direction(self.lina, direction_util.get_opposite(self.lina.Direction))
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lina)

				--(이후 배경 어두워지며 재시작.)
				break
			end
			--QTE 1회씩 성공 시 마력탑에 푸른빛 이펙트가 잠깐 활성.
			--임시!!
			if input == 'up' or input == 'down' then
				character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.lina, {name = 'sword_attack2', count = 1})
			else
				character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.lina, {name = 'sword_attack_stab', count = 1})
			end
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_lina_b_shoot_01')
			if i == #combo then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_summon_effect_02')
			end
			self.fx_spark:Instantiate(tower.Position + vector(0.5, 3.5, 0.5))
			wait_for_sec(0.2)
			tower:Shake(0.03, 0.2)
			wait_for_sec(0.35)

			character_util.set_anim(self.lina, {name = "staff_cast"})

			if success and i == #combo then
				yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, 1)
			end
		end

	end

	local key_name = 'tower_progress'

	self.tower_progress = self.tower_progress | (1 << (index - 1))
	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, key_name, self.tower_progress)
	self.controller:activate_tower(index)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	--CS.UnityEngine.Debug.Log('current tower progress : ' .. self:progress_to_string(self.tower_progress))
	--QTE 5회 전부 성공 시 카메라 쉐이크, 줌 인, 화이트 페이드 아웃.

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_earthquake_01')
	field:RemoveTint('lina_tower_act', 1)
	camera_util.shake(0.05, 2)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 2)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(2, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	local amount = 1000
	local gold_table = get_or_create_global_table('stageeventcontrollers/ShortStoryLinaGold')
	gold_table:add_dollar_async(amount, false, false)

	self:apply_custom_state_immediately(key_name, self.tower_progress)

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--페이드 인 시 줌과 배경 틴트 풀려있음, 마력탑 푸른빛 활성화 상태, 리나(idle)
	--임시!!
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lina)


	--페이드 인 시 줌과 배경 틴트 풀려있음, 마력탑 푸른빛 활성화 상태, 리나(idle) 좌측으로 한 타일 뒷걸음질.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_lights_01')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1.5, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	local dest = self.lina.Position + direction_util.to_vector3(direction_util.get_opposite(self.lina.Direction)) * 0.5
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	camera_util.move(dest, 0.5, {end_target = user_party.Leader})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
	character_util.move_to_async(self.lina,
			dest,0.5, nil, false, true)


	if self:check_cleared_all() then
		--7번째 마력탑 활성화 후 가우리 대사: 끝난 건가?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.goury, {key = self.talk_name .. 6, skip = true})

		--7번째 마력탑 활성화 후 제로스 대사: 이게 마지막이군요.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.xellos, {key = self.talk_name .. 7, skip = true})

		self.engineer.Interactable.Talk = nil

		self.controller.last_tower_cache = index

		yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
	else
		--가우리: 오오! 반짝거리는데?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.goury, {key = self.talk_name .. 4, skip = true})

		--제로스: 어서 다른 탑도 찾아보도록 하죠.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.xellos, {key = self.talk_name .. 5, skip = true})
	end

	--
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(gold_table.add_dollar_directing, gold_table, amount, { pos = tower.Position }))
	--
	stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

-- 스테이지 나가지 않아도 커스텀 스테이트가 바로 저장 되도록 하기
function local_class:apply_custom_state_immediately(key_name, val)
	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.quest_id)
	local save_success = true
	local on_success = function (res)
		save_success = true
	end

	-- 먼저 custom state 를 set 한다.
	local fail_count = 0
	while true do
		local r = CS.Oak.IQuestEventControllerExtensions.SetCustomState(nil, quest_progress, key_name, val)
		coroutine.yield(r)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		-- on_error 콜백을 안받아서 CustomState 가 실제로 변경되었는지로 체크해야 한다..
		save_success = true

		if quest_progress:GetCustomState(key_name) ~= val then
			save_success = false
		end

		if not save_success then
			fail_count = fail_count + 1
			CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("ShortStoryLinaTower : SetCustomState Retry")
			wait_for_sec(5.0 + fail_count)
		else
			break
		end
	end

	fail_count = 0
	while true do
		save_success = false
		local r = CS.Oak.NetworkManager.ApiConnection:SendProgressQuest(stage.StageId, quest_progress.QuestId, quest_progress.InnerProgress, nil)
		r:Then(on_success)
		coroutine.yield(r:SuppressDefaultErrorHandler())
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		if not save_success then
			fail_count = fail_count + 1
			CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("ShortStoryLinaTower : SendProgressQuest Retry")
			wait_for_sec(5.0 + fail_count)
		else
			break
		end
	end
end

function local_class:check_cleared_all()
	local valid = true
	for i = 1, 8 do
		valid = valid and (self.tower_progress & (1 << (i-1)) ~= 0)
	end
	return valid
end

return local_class

function local_class:interact_engineer_scene()
	self:renew_character_cache()

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	quest_marker_util.remove('lina_main_tower')
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.engineer, self.controller)

	--정비공과 상호작용 시 이벤트 시작, 좌측에 정렬.
	party_util.align_to_target(self.engineer, 'left', 1, 'linear')
	character_util.set_direction(self.engineer, 'left')

	--벌써 끝내고 온 거야? 굉장하잖아!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.engineer, {key = self.talk_name .. 0, skip = true})
	--당연하지! 날 누구라고 생각하는 거야?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.lina, {name = 'victory_get', loop = false}, {name = 'wink'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 1, skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lina)

	--고마워! 덕분에 오늘은 집에 일찍 갈 수 있겠어!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.engineer, {key = self.talk_name .. 2, skip = true})
	--자, 약속했던 추가 수당이야~
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.engineer, {key = self.talk_name .. 3, skip = true})

	--수당 지급
	local gold_table = get_or_create_global_table('stageeventcontrollers/ShortStoryLinaGold')
	gold_table:add_dollar(1000, false, { pos = self.engineer.Position })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--빨리 끝내준 보답으로 특별히 이것도 줄게.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.engineer, {key = self.talk_name .. 4, skip = true})

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.engineer, {name = 'get'}, {name = 'smile'})
	--스타피스 지급
	star_piece_util.appear(get_field_object('magic_tower_star_piece'),
			self.engineer.Position + vector(0, 0.7, 0),
			self.engineer.Position + vector(0, 0, -1))

	wait_for_sec(2.75)

	--그러면 조심해서 잘 가~
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.engineer, {name = 'cast'}, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.engineer, {key = self.talk_name .. 5, skip = true})

	character_util.set_direction(self.engineer, 'right')

	--나도 이것만 마무리하고 가야지.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.engineer)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.engineer, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.engineer, {key = self.talk_name .. 6, skip = true})

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false, false)

	local main_qp = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(7000801)

	-- 메인 2섹션으로 진행하지 않고 그대로 연출 종료되는 조건
	if main_qp.InnerProgress > 0 or not self:is_all_quest_cleared() then
		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end
end

--- 3개 전부 클리어 -> 2개만 클리어해도 메인 진행으로 변경
--- 각종 버그가 발생할 여지가 있으므로 주의 요망
function local_class:is_all_quest_cleared()
	local valid = 1
	local target = {7000805, 7000806}
	for _, i in ipairs(target) do
		valid = self:quest_checker(i) and valid + 1 or valid
	end
	return valid > 1
end

function local_class:quest_checker(i)
	local qid = i
	local qp = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(qid)
	if qp == nil or not qp.IsComplete then
		return false
	end
	return true
end

return local_class

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.janitor) then
			if #self.trashes > 0 then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.first_trash_event, self)
			end
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'trash_event_restrict_zone' and not e.FullEnter
				and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.lina) and self.current_state == self.event_state.started then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.block_leave, self)
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'interacting' then
			for i, trash in ipairs(self.trashes) do
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Sender, trash.fo) then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.trash_gathered, self, trash, i))
				end
			end
		end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.janitor) then
			if self.current_state == self.state_enum.none then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.another_trash_starts, self, false))
				return true
			else
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.final_trash_event, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		if not e.FullLeave and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.lina) and self.current_state == self.state_enum.collecting then
			if e.Zone.Name == 'trash_pile_zone' then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.block_leave, self, false)
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'interacting' and self.current_state == self.state_enum.collecting then
			for i, trash in ipairs(self.trash_objs) do
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Sender, trash) then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.trash_collect, self, trash))
				end
			end

		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:trash_collect(target)
	local look_dir = 'none'

	self.trash_count = self.trash_count + 1

	if self.trash_count >= 3 then
		if self.lina.Position.x < target.Bounds.center.x then
			look_dir = 'right'
		else
			look_dir = 'left'
		end
		character_util.set_locked_dir(self.lina, look_dir)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
	self.fx_dead:Instantiate(target.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	target.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	if self.trash_count >= 3 then
		character_util.set_direction(self.lina, look_dir)
		character_util.set_locked_dir(self.lina, 'none')
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.trash_sweeper, self))
	else
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.xellos, {key = self.talk_name .. '28_' .. self.trash_count})
		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end

end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		return false
	end
	if self.qte_target == self.qte_enum.tap then
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
			self.qte_result = self.qte_enum.tap
			self.tap_count = self.tap_count + 1
			return true
		end
	elseif self.qte_target ~= self.qte_enum.none then
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
			self.qte_result = self.qte_enum.left
			return true
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
			self.qte_result = self.qte_enum.up
			return true
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
			self.qte_result = self.qte_enum.right
			return true
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
			self.qte_result = self.qte_enum.down
			return true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:final_trash_event()
	self:renew_character_cache()

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.janitor, self.controller)
	quest_marker_util.remove('lina_main_trash')

	self.current_state = self.state_enum.wagon

	local has_eva = self.has_eva()
	--
	--짐마차 옆 청소부 (left, idle, push) (초록점)
	--
	--청소부와 상호작용 시 이벤트 시작, 우측 정렬.

	party_util.align_to_target(self.janitor, 'right', 1, 'linear')
	--청소부(right): 보다시피 바퀴가 망가진 수레가 길을 막고 있어서 말이야.
	character_util.set_direction(self.janitor, 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.janitor)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.janitor, {key = self.talk_name .. 12, skip = true})
	--청소부(left, idle, push): 같이 밀어서 치워보자구!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_direction(self.janitor, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.janitor, {name = 'push'}, {name = 'attack'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.janitor, {key = self.talk_name .. 13, skip = true})
	--리나(left): 뭐야, 그런 거라면 그냥 간단하게…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 14, skip = true})

	--리나 (left, sleep_deep, staff_cast) 에너지가 모이는 듯한 이펙트(프로토 제작 시 x 후에 추가)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.lina, {name = 'staff_cast'}, {name = 'sleep_deep'})
	camera_util.move_async(self.janitor.Position, 1)

	--리나  (left, idle, staff_cast): 레비테이션!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 15, skip = true})

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	local qte_finished = false
	local level = 1

	while not qte_finished do
		character_util.set_direction(self.janitor, 'left')
		if level == 1 then
			--QTE(↑) 드래그
			self.qte_target = self.qte_enum.up
			self.qte_result = self.qte_enum.none

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_lina_fire_cast_01')
			CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe('up')

			while self.qte_result == self.qte_enum.none do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			if self.qte_result ~= self.qte_target then
				CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
				self.wagon_1:Shake(0.03, 0.5)
				wait_for_sec(0.5)
				self.dash_smoke:Instantiate(self.wagon_1.Position + vector(0, 0.01, 0))
				self.dash_smoke:Instantiate(self.wagon_1.Position + vector(2, 0.01, 0))
				wait_for_sec(0.5)
				--실패 시 수레 진동만 하고 뜨지 않음.
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lina)
				character_util.set_emotion(self.lina, {name = 'tired'})

				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.janitor)
				character_util.set_direction(self.janitor, 'right')
				--청소부(idle, question): 음? 뭘 하고 싶었던 거야?
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.janitor, {key = self.talk_name .. 16, skip = true})
				--리나(tired): 읏, 이게 아닌데…
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 18, skip = true})

				--(이후 staff_cast 모션부터 재시작.)
				character_util.set_direction(self.janitor, 'left')
				character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.janitor, {name = 'push'}, {name = 'attack'})
				character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.lina, {name = 'staff_cast'}, {name = 'sleep_deep'})

			else
				yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, 1)
				level = level + 1

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_lina_fire_shoot_01')
				--성공 시 화면 잠깐 쉐이크 후 수레가 공중에 뜸, 청소부 (left, surprise, jump 1회)
				self.wagon_1:Shake(0.03, 1)
				wait_for_sec(0.3)
				self.dash_smoke:Instantiate(self.wagon_1.Position + vector(0, 0.01, 0))
				self.dash_smoke:Instantiate(self.wagon_1.Position + vector(2, 0.01, 0))

				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.janitor)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
				character_util.normal_jump(self.janitor)
				character_util.set_emotion(self.janitor, {name = 'surprise'})

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_push_wagon_01')
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_prologue_wind_01')
				local timer = 0
				local duration = 1.5
				local init_pos = self.wagon_1.Position
				local dist = vector(0, 1.5, 0)

				while timer < duration do
					local prog = timer / duration
					local pos = init_pos + dist * (1 - math.cos(prog * math.pi)) * 0.5

					self.wagon_1.Position = pos

					timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
					coroutine.yield(nil)
				end

				self.wagon_1.Position = init_pos + dist
				wait_for_sec(0.5)
			end

		elseif level == 2 then
			--QTE(←) 드래그
			self.qte_target = self.qte_enum.left
			self.qte_result = self.qte_enum.none

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_lina_fire_cast_01')
			CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe('left')

			while self.qte_result == self.qte_enum.none do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			if self.qte_result ~= self.qte_target then
				CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
				--실패 시 수레 진동하다가 제자리에 떨어짐.
				self.wagon_1:Shake(0.05, 1)
				wait_for_sec(1)

				local timer = 0
				local duration = 0.4
				local init_pos = self.wagon_1.Position
				local dist = vector(0, -1.5, 0)

				while timer < duration do
					local prog = timer / duration
					local pos = init_pos + dist * (prog * prog)

					self.wagon_1.Position = pos

					timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
					coroutine.yield(nil)
				end

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_01')
				camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)
				self.wagon_1.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(init_pos + dist)
				self.dash_smoke:Instantiate(self.wagon_1.Position + vector(0, 0.01, 0))
				self.dash_smoke:Instantiate(self.wagon_1.Position + vector(2, 0.01, 0))
				self.dash_smoke:Instantiate(self.wagon_1.Position + vector(0, 0.01, 1))
				self.dash_smoke:Instantiate(self.wagon_1.Position + vector(2, 0.01, 1))
				self.slam:Instantiate(vector_util.get_x0z(self.wagon_1.Bounds.center, 0.01))
				character_util.normal_jump(self.janitor)
				character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.janitor, {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'surprise'})
				wait_for_sec(1)


				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lina)
				character_util.set_emotion(self.lina, {name = 'tired'})

				--청소부(surprise, jump 1회): 우왓?! 무슨 짓이야!
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.janitor, {key = self.talk_name .. 17, skip = true})
				--리나(tired): 읏, 이게 아닌데…
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 18, skip = true})
				--(이후 staff_cast 모션부터 재시작.)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.janitor)
				character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.lina, {name = 'staff_cast'}, {name = 'sleep_deep'})

				level = 1
			else
				yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, 1)
				qte_finished = true
				--성공 시 수레 공중에 뜬 채 좌측으로 3타일 이동 후 땅에 내려옴.(수레 살짝 흔들리며 흙먼지 떨어짐.)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_lina_fire_shoot_01')
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lina)
				character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.lina, {name = 'attack', count = 1})
				local timer = 0
				local duration = 0.5
				local init_pos = self.wagon_1.Position
				local xdist = -3
				local ydist = -1.5
				local nine_token = (1 / 9)

				while timer < duration do
					local prog = timer / duration
					local xpos = xdist * prog
					local ypos = ydist * (16 * nine_token * (prog - 0.25) * (prog - 0.25) - nine_token)
					local pos = init_pos + vector(xpos, ypos, 0)

					self.wagon_1.Position = pos

					timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
					coroutine.yield(nil)
				end

				self.wagon_1.Position = init_pos + vector(xdist, ydist, 0)
			end
		end
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	camera_util.shake(0.05, 0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_01')
	self.dash_smoke:Instantiate(self.wagon_1.Position + vector(0, 0.01, 0))
	self.dash_smoke:Instantiate(self.wagon_1.Position + vector(2, 0.01, 0))
	self.slam:Instantiate(vector_util.get_x0z(self.wagon_1.Bounds.center, 0.01))
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lina)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.janitor)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.janitor, {name = 'smile'})
	--청소부 좌측으로 2타일 이동하여 jump 2회 후 우측을 보며
	character_util.move_to_async(self.janitor, self.janitor.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0),
			0.7, nil, true, true)
	character_util.normal_double_jump(self.janitor, true)
	--청소부(smile, right): 너 굉장한 녀석이잖아!
	character_util.set_direction(self.janitor, 'right')
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.janitor, {key = self.talk_name .. 19, skip = true})

	--리나: 이 정도쯤이야!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 20, skip = true})

	local center_pos = field:GetMarker('trash_s1_center_pos').position


	--청소부(up): 좋아, 막혀있던 길이 열렸으니 들어가서 청소를 해볼까?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.janitor, {key = self.talk_name .. 21, skip = true})
	--리나: 아직도 청소할 게 남은 거야?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.set_emotion(self.lina, {name = 'surprise'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 22, skip = true})
	--청소부: 여기가 정말 마지막이니 너무 불평하지 말라고.
	character_util.set_emotion(self.lina, {name = 'tired'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.janitor, {key = self.talk_name .. 23, skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lina)

	--청소부 화면 위로 이동, 리나 청소부 뒤를 따라 이동.
	character_util.move_waypoint(self.janitor, {
		vector(self.janitor.Position.x, 0, center_pos.z),
		center_pos
	},4, false, nil, nil, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	local routines = {
		util.cs_generator(
				character_util.move_waypoint_async, self.lina, {
					self.wagon_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 1.5),
					center_pos + vector(0.5, 0, -2),
					center_pos + vector(1.5, 0, -2),
					center_pos + vector(1.5, 0, 0),
				}, 4, false, nil, nil, 'left'),
		util.cs_generator(
				character_util.move_waypoint_async, self.goury, {
					self.wagon_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 1.5),
					center_pos + vector(0.5, 0, -2),
					center_pos + vector(2.2, 0, -2),
					center_pos + vector(2.2, 0, 0.5),
				}, 4, false, nil, nil, 'left'),

		util.cs_generator(
				character_util.move_waypoint_async, self.xellos, {
					self.wagon_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 1.5),
					center_pos + vector(0.5, 0, -2),
					center_pos + vector(2.2, 0, -2),
					center_pos + vector(2.2, 0, -0.5),
				}, 4, false, nil, nil, 'left'),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			wait_for_sec(2)
			camera_util.resize_by_ratio(4.5, 1)
			camera_util.move(center_pos + vector(1, 0, 0), 1)
		end)
	}

	if has_eva then
		table.insert(routines, util.cs_generator(
				character_util.move_waypoint_async, self.eva, {
					self.wagon_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 1.5),
					center_pos + vector(0.5, 0, -2),
					center_pos + vector(3, 0, -2),
					center_pos + vector(3, 0, 0),
				}, 4, false, nil, nil, 'left')
		)
	end

	wait_all(routines)

	--리나가 검은 선까지 오면 카메라 위로 패닝하여 쓰레기장 전체를 보여줌.
	--카메라 돌아가지 않고 아래에서 청소부와 리나 일행 중심까지 걸어온 뒤 정렬.

	--리나 (surprise) right, up, left, down을 쳐다봄.
	character_util.set_emotion(self.lina, {name = 'surprise'})
	wait_for_sec(0.7)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(self.lina, 'down')
	wait_for_sec(0.7)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(self.lina, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.7)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(self.lina, 'up')
	wait_for_sec(0.7)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(self.lina, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--청소부 (right, idle, cross_arm) :역시 오랫동안 길이 막혀 쓰레기가 방치되어 있었군.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.janitor, {key = self.talk_name .. 24, skip = true})
	--청소부 (right, smile, clap) :그럼 나 대신 청소 잘 부탁해!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.janitor, {key = self.talk_name .. 25, skip = true})
	--리나(down, damaged, idle 진동)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	character_util.set_direction(self.lina, 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(self.lina, {name = 'damaged'})
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(self.lina, nil, 'annoyed')

	--가우리: 리나, 이건 너무 많은 것 같은데?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.goury, {key = self.talk_name .. 26, skip = true})
	--제로스: 다 치우려면 상당한 시간이 걸리겠군요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.xellos, {key = self.talk_name .. 27, skip = true})

	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
	self.current_state = self.state_enum.collecting

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lina)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.goury)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.xellos)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.goury, {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'surprise'})

	--화면 약하게 쉐이크, 점차 강해짐.

	end

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	--페이드 인 시 해당 그리드에 있던 모든 쓰레기 오브젝트와 다른 일반 오브젝트도 전부 날아가서 바닥과 벽만 남은 상태.

	wait_for_sec(1)
	if has_eva then
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.eva)
	end

		--
	--청소부 (right, damaged, prostrate)(녹)
	--리나 (down, idle, idle) (적)
	--가우리 (left, damaged, prostrate) (청)
	--리나(right, idle, idle) 가우리(left, damaged, prostrate)

	--가우리(left, damaged, prostrate) 짧은 진동 후 get으로 일어나는 가우리.
	character_util.shake_and_wakeup(self.goury, 'left', 1, nil, true)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_equip_weapon_01')

	--가우리가 일어나고 나면 우측에 제로스 (left, idle, idle) 순간이동으로 나타남.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_object_warp_01')
	self.teleport:Instantiate(self.xellos.Position)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.xellos, 1, 0.3)


	--가우리(left, tired, idle) : 리나… 쓰레기를 치우는 데 마법까지 쓸 필요는…
	character_util.set_emotion(self.goury, {name = 'tired'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.goury, {key = self.talk_name .. 33, skip = true})

	--좌,우 둘러보던 리나.
	--리나 (down, wink, idle): 불평하지마. 이걸로 금방 끝냈잖아.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(self.lina, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.7)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(self.lina, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.7)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.lina, {name = 'wink'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 34, skip = true})

	--리나 (left, idle, idle): 그럼 이제 보수를 받아볼까? 얼른 일어나라구.
	character_util.set_direction(self.lina, 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lina)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 35, skip = true})

	--청소부 (right, damaged, prostrate) 진동 후 get 하고 일어남.
	character_util.shake_and_wakeup(self.janitor, 'right', 2, 'scared', true)

	--청소부(right, scared, idle 진동) : 히익!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.janitor, {name = 'cast'}, {name = 'scared'})
	character_util.shake(self.janitor, 0.03, 9999)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.janitor, {key = self.talk_name .. 36, skip = true})


	--리나 (left, smile, idle): 또 남아있는 쓰레기 있어? 몇 방 더 날려줄 수 있는데.
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.lina, {name = 'bomb_idle'}, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 37, skip = true})

	--청소부 (right, scared, embarrassed): 도, 돈이라면 드릴 테니 제발 살려주세요!
	character_util.normal_jump_async(self.janitor, true)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_02')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.janitor, {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'cry'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.janitor, {key = self.talk_name .. 38, skip = true})

	--리나 (left, mad2, idle): 뭐?
	character_util.remove_anim(self.lina)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.lina, {name = 'mad2'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 39, skip = true})

	--청소부 (right, scared, attack 1회) goblin_thief_bag 던져줌.
	character_util.stop_shake(self.janitor)

	character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.janitor, {name = 'attack', count = 1})
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--획득 시 +5000 골드 출력.
	local gold_table = get_or_create_global_table('stageeventcontrollers/ShortStoryLinaGold')
	gold_table:add_dollar(5000, false, { pos = self.janitor.Position, target_pos = self.janitor.Position + vector(1.2, 0, 0) })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--청소부 (right, scared, idle 짧은 진동): 부디 이걸로 용서해 주세요…
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.janitor, {name = 'cast'}, {name = 'cry'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.janitor, {key = self.talk_name .. 40, skip = true})

	--청소부 (down, scared, run) 카메라 밖으로, 아래로 달려가는 청소부 시선 따라가듯 리나 일행 down
	character_util.remove_anim(self.janitor)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_01')
	character_util.move_waypoint(self.janitor, self.janitor.Position + vector(0, 0, -10), 5, true, nil, nil, 'down')
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	party_util.set_direction('down')
	wait_for_sec(1.7)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.janitor)
	character_util.set_position(self.janitor, vector(999, 0, 999))

	--리나(down, tired, idle): 뭐야, 악귀라도 본 것 같은 얼굴로.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 41, skip = true})

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lina)

	--리나 (left, idle, idle): 난 친절하게 도와줬을 뿐인데.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 42, skip = true})

	--가우리, 제로스 리나 뒤에 파티원 정렬

	--에바 합류 후 청소 퀘스트를 진행했다면 여기서 이벤트 종료, 컨트롤 풀림.

	if not has_eva then
		--제로스: 그러니 적당히 힘조절을…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.xellos, {key = self.talk_name .. 43, skip = true})

		--제로스 (left, idle, idle) (emoticon_bubble_exclamation)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(self.xellos, nil, 'notice')
		--제로스 (right) 카메라 우측으로 패닝하여 숨어 있는 검은 인영(에바) 보여줌.
		--
		--에바 합류 전 청소 퀘스트를 진행했다면 정렬 후 컨트롤 풀리기 전에 아래 이벤트 실행.
		--카메라 중심 제로스에게
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'ondemand/castletown/audio:bgm_slayers_cave', state = 'event', mix = 0})
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		character_util.set_direction(self.xellos, 'right')
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		camera_util.move_async(self.eva.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 1)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		--
		--에바 jump 1회 후 통로를 따라 달려서 퇴장하고 카메라 복귀.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_01')
		character_util.move_waypoint(self.eva, {
			self.eva.Position + vector(2.5, 0, 0),
			self.eva.Position + vector(2.5, 0, 5),
		}, 5, true)
		wait_for_sec(1)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.eva, 0, 1)

		camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		character_util.set_position(self.eva, vector(999, 0, 999))
		character_util.remove_color(self.eva, 'hidden_eva', 0)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.eva, 1, 0)

		--제로스(right): ……
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.xellos, {key = self.talk_name .. 44, skip = true})
		--리나 (right, idle, idle): 멍하니 뭐하고 있어, 제로스?
		character_util.set_direction(self.lina, 'right')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 45, skip = true})
		--제로스(left, idle, idle): 아무것도 아닙니다, 얼른 가시죠.
		character_util.set_direction(self.xellos, 'left')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.xellos, {key = self.talk_name .. 46, skip = true})
		self.eva.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
	else
		camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
	end


	--이벤트 종료, 컨트롤 풀림.
	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false, false)

	if not self:is_all_quest_cleared() then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/castletown/audio:bgm_slayers_castletown', state = 'field', mix = 1.0 })
		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end
end

function local_class:block_leave()
	--짐마차 옆 청소부에게 마킹, 다른 길은 진입 금지 트리거 존 이벤트.
	--아래의 대사가 나오며 뒷걸음질 2회.
	--가우리: 하던 일을 끝내고 보수를 받아야지.
	camera_util.move_async(self.lina.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), 0.5)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.lina, {name = 'damaged'})
	character_util.set_direction(self.lina, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(self.janitor, 'down')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.janitor, {key = self.talk_name .. 'block', skip = true})

	local bp = vector(0, 0, 0.5)

	camera_util.move(self.lina.Position, 1, { end_target = self.lina })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lina)
	character_util.set_direction(self.lina, 'down')
	character_util.move_to_async(self.lina, self.lina.Position + bp, 1, nil, false, true)
end


function local_class:is_all_quest_cleared()
	local valid = false
	local target = {7000804, 7000806}
	for _, i in ipairs(target) do
		valid = valid or self:quest_checker(i)
	end

	local main_qp = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(7000801)

	return valid and main_qp.InnerProgress == 0
end

function local_class:quest_checker(i)
	local qid = i
	local qp = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(qid)
	if qp == nil or not qp.IsComplete then
		return false
	end
	return true
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryLinaVampireGirlSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryLinaVampireGirl @

		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_vampire_girl_dad = controller.get_vampire_girl_dad
	self.get_lina = controller.get_lina
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	local vampire_girl_dad = self.get_vampire_girl_dad()
	character_util.add_listener(vampire_girl_dad, self.controller)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	local vampire_girl_dad = self.get_vampire_girl_dad()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(vampire_girl_dad, self.controller)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local vampire_girl_dad = self.get_vampire_girl_dad()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, vampire_girl_dad) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_vampire_girl_dad, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:interact_vampire_girl_dad()
	local lina = self.get_lina()
	local vampire_girl_dad = self.get_vampire_girl_dad()

	-- 으슥한 뒷골목 입구 (1회 기절 이후)
	-- 플레이어가 1회 기절 이후 시점부터 진행. (으슥한 뒷골목 규칙 참고)
	-- 서브 NPC들 사이에 카리나 아버지 NPC가 인터렉트 가능 상태로 배치
	-- 인터렉트 시 대화 이벤트 실행. 리나 일행 좌측을 바라보며 정렬.
	party_util.align_to_target(vampire_girl_dad, 'left', 1, 'linear')

	-- 카리나 아버지 (right, tired, idle) : 잠깐 놀러간다고 하더니… 이 사람들은 도대체…
	character_util.set_emotion(vampire_girl_dad, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vampire_girl_dad, { key = 'short_story_lina_vampire_girl_5', skip = true })

	-- 리나 (left, idle, idle) : 아저씨. 무슨 문제라도 있어?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lina, { key = 'short_story_lina_vampire_girl_6', skip = true })

	-- 카리나 아버지 (right, tired, idle) : …내 딸아이가 없어져서 찾고 있었다네. 이 주변에서 놓친 것 같은데…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vampire_girl_dad, { key = 'short_story_lina_vampire_girl_7', skip = true })

	-- 카리나 아버지 (right, damaged, idle) : [small] 차라리 길을 잃어버린 게 나을지 모르겠군… 설마 또 저번처럼…
	character_util.set_emotion(vampire_girl_dad, { name = 'damaged' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(vampire_girl_dad, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vampire_girl_dad, { key = 'short_story_lina_vampire_girl_8', skip = true })

	-- 카리나 아버지 (right, attack, idle) : 아! 혹시 내 딸을 찾는 걸 도와주실 수 있겠나? 물론 사례는…
	character_util.set_emotion(vampire_girl_dad, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.remove_anim(vampire_girl_dad)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vampire_girl_dad, { key = 'short_story_lina_vampire_girl_9', skip = true })

	-- 리나 (left, attack, jump 1회) : 10만 골드! 자기 딸을 찾는 건데 그정도는 괜찮지?!
	character_util.set_emotion(lina, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.normal_jump(lina, true)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lina, { key = 'short_story_lina_vampire_girl_10', skip = true })

	-- 카리나 아버지 (right, smile, idle) : 그것 뿐인가? 내 딸을 찾아주면 거기에 웃돈을 얹어주지. 괜찮나?
	character_util.set_emotion(vampire_girl_dad, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(vampire_girl_dad, { key = 'short_story_lina_vampire_girl_11', skip = true })

	-- 리나 right, surprise, jump 1회 실행.
	character_util.remove_anim(vampire_girl_dad)
	character_util.look_at(lina, user_party[1])
	character_util.set_emotion(lina, { name = 'surprise' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_twinkle_01')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(lina, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 리나 (right, attack, idle) : [small] 이건 떼돈을 벌 기회야! 목숨을 내놓을 각오로 하도록 해!
	character_util.set_emotion(lina, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(lina, { name = 'shoot' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lina, { key = 'short_story_lina_vampire_girl_12', skip = true })

	-- 가우리, 제로스 일제히 nod 2회 실행.
	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]

		if i < user_party.Count - 1 then
			character_util.set_animation_n_times(party_member, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
		else
			for _ = 1, 2 do
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
				character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(party_member, { name = 'nod' })
			end
		end
	end

	-- 리나 (left, smile, jump 1회) : 좋아! 그럼 뭘 도와주면 되는데?
	character_util.look_at(lina, vampire_girl_dad)
	character_util.set_emotion(lina, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_anim(lina, { name = 'sing' })
	character_util.normal_jump(lina, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lina, { key = 'short_story_lina_vampire_girl_13', skip = true })

	-- 카리나 아버지 (right, smile, idle) : 이 사람들을 보니 안쪽에 내 딸이 있다는 확신이 드는데… 한 번 다녀와줄 수 있겠나?

	character_util.set_anim(lina, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_twinkle_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lina, { key = 'short_story_lina_vampire_girl_64', skip = true })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(xellos, { key = 'short_story_lina_vampire_girl_65', skip = true })

			local height = 1.25
			local start_position = vampire_redstone_parent.position
			local end_position = vector_util.get_x0z(vampire_redstone_parent.position + vector(-2, 0, 0), 0.1)

			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = time_passed / duration
				local position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, end_position, progress)
				local y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height

				position.y = position.y + y
				vampire_redstone_parent.position = position

				coroutine.yield()

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			end

			vampire_redstone_parent.position = end_position

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_mining_01')
