	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lina, { key = 'short_story_lina_vampire_girl_69', skip = true })

	-- 리나 (right, mad, release) : 제로스! 그런 건 미리 말해야 할 것 아니야!
	character_util.look_at(lina, xellos)
	character_util.set_emotion(lina, { name = 'mad' })
	character_util.set_anim(lina, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lina, { key = 'short_story_lina_vampire_girl_71', skip = true })

	-- 제로스 (left, smile, idle) : 그렇게 말하셔도 말이죠…
	character_util.remove_anim(lina)
	character_util.set_emotion(xellos, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.remove_anim(xellos)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(xellos, { key = 'short_story_lina_vampire_girl_72', skip = true })

	-- 리나 (left, damaged, frustration) : 으아아앙!!! 내 일확천금의 꿈이……!
	character_util.set_emotion(lina, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_anim(lina, { name = 'frustration', loop = false })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lina, { key = 'short_story_lina_vampire_girl_73', skip = true })

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false)

	field_ui_util.play_quest_complete(self.quest_spec, self.quest_progress)
	field_ui_util.play_fame_alignment_async(user.Alignment, user.Fame, self.quest_progress.Alignment, self.quest_progress.Fame)

	-- 이후 플레이어 컨트롤 복귀. 스타피스를 향해 진행 가능.
	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryMayreelFactorySection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryMayreelFactory @
		Comment = 공장 문을 열기까지 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 이벤트 존 이름
	self.snowman_factory_zone_name = controller.snowman_factory_zone_name
	self.factory_front_zone_name = 'factory_front'
	self.factory_in_zone_name = 'snowman_factory_in'

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_snowman = controller.get_snowman
	self.get_dad = controller.get_dad

	-- 오브젝트를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_factory_door = function() return get_field_object('snowman_factory_outer') end
	self.get_refrigerator = function() return get_field_object('snowman_factory_refrigerator') end

	self.progress = {
		none = 0,
		enter_factory_front = 1,
		enter_factory = 2,
		enter_factory_in = 3,
	}
	self.current_progress = self.progress.none
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	local snowman = self.get_snowman()
	character_util.set_emotion(snowman, { name = 'tired' })

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if self.current_progress < self.progress.enter_factory_front and e.Zone.Name == self.factory_front_zone_name then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_factory_front, self))
				return true
			elseif self.current_progress < self.progress.enter_factory and e.Zone.Name == self.snowman_factory_zone_name then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_factory, self))
				return true
			elseif self.current_progress < self.progress.enter_factory_in and e.Zone.Name == self.factory_in_zone_name then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_factory_in, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:enter_factory_front()
	local dad = self.get_dad()
	local snowman = self.get_snowman()
	local factory_door = self.get_factory_door()

	-- ( ※ 플레이어의 컨트롤은 풀린 상태로 둔다 )
	self.current_progress = self.progress.enter_factory_front

	-- 플레이어 ZONE으로 접근시 공장 안에서 누군가 구조 신호를 보낸다.
	-- 꼬마 눈사람 : [shout] 누가 좀 도와주세요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_factory_1', bubble_type = 'shout', world_pos = factory_door.Position + vector(0, 0, -1) })
end

function local_class:enter_factory()
	local snowman = self.get_snowman()

	self.current_progress = self.progress.enter_factory

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--꼬마 눈사람 : 누구 아무도 없어요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_factory_2', bubble_type = 'shout', screen_pos = vector(200, 300), typespeed = 0 })
end

function local_class:enter_factory_in()
	local refrigerator = self.get_refrigerator()
	local snowman = self.get_snowman()

	self.current_progress = self.progress.enter_factory_in

	-- 메이릴이 표시된 ■ 타일로 이동. 메이릴 left, right로 좌우를 살피고선 대화 이어짐.
	if user_party.Count > 1 then
		for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
			character_util.move_waypoint(user_party[i], vector(77.5, 0, -133 - i), 4, false, nil, nil, 'left')
		end
	end
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(user_party.Leader, vector(77.5, 0, -133), 4, false, nil, nil, 'left')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	party_util.set_direction('right')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- (메이릴의 오른쪽 편에서) 꼬마 눈사람 : [shout] 여기에요, 여기!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.05, 0.2)
	party_util.set_direction('right')
	character_util.normal_jump(user_party.Leader, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_factory_5', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout', screen_pos = vector(200, 150) })

	-- 화면이 오른쪽 위로 스크롤되며 ‘냉동고’ 오브젝트에 집중된다. 냉동고 내부에는 꼬마 눈사람이 배치된 상태.
	camera_util.move_async(refrigerator.Position, 2)

	-- ( 눈사람의 대사가 나올 동안 냉동고가 shake 되는 연출 )
	-- 꼬마 눈사람 : 여기에요! 저 좀 도와주세요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_greenland_01')
	refrigerator:Shake(0.05, 1)
	character_util.shake(snowman, 0.05, 1)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_factory_6', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	--화면이 왼쪽으로 스크롤되며 다시 플레이어에게 집중된다.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(2)

	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림. 이후 방안의 퍼즐을 풀고 오른쪽 도어 오픈되면 다음으로 진행.
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryMayreelFactorySection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryMayreelFactory @
		Comment = 눈사람을 데리고 공장에서 탈출하기 까지 @
		Index = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.mini_game_name = 'XMasDodgeBrazierMiniGame'
	self.mini_game = nil

	-- 스타피스를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_star_piece = controller.get_star_piece

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_snowman = controller.get_snowman

	-- 오브젝트를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_refrigerator = function() return get_field_object('snowman_factory_refrigerator') end
	self.get_door = function(num) return get_field_object('snowman_factory_door_' .. num) end

	self.progress = {
		none = 0,
		interact_refrigerator = 1,
	}
	self.current_progress = self.progress.none
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	local refrigerator = self.get_refrigerator()
	refrigerator.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	local snowman = self.get_snowman()
	character_util.set_emotion(snowman, { name = 'tired' })

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_event')
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.mini_game then
		mini_game_manager:DisposeMiniGame(self.mini_game_name)
		self.mini_game = nil
	end

	local refrigerator = self.get_refrigerator()
	refrigerator.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_event')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent) then
		return self:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local refrigerator = self.get_refrigerator()

	if self.current_progress <= self.progress.interact_refrigerator and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, refrigerator) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_refrigerator, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name == self.mini_game_name and e.Success then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.mini_game_clear, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:interact_refrigerator()
	local refrigerator = self.get_refrigerator()
	local snowman = self.get_snowman()

	local is_first_interact = false

	if self.current_progress < self.progress.interact_refrigerator then
		is_first_interact = true
	end

	self.current_progress = self.progress.interact_refrigerator

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	party_util.align_party(vector_util.get_x0z(snowman.Position), 'down', 1, 'arc')

	if is_first_interact then
		-- 눈사람 (down, smile , jump 2회) : 감사합니다!
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'up')
		character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party.Leader, 'none')
		character_util.set_emotion(snowman, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.normal_double_jump(snowman, true)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_factory_9', skip = true })

		-- 메이릴 (up, idle, idle) : 이런데 왜 갇혀 있는 거야?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_factory_10', skip = true })

		-- 눈사람 (down, idle, idle) : 이곳은 겨울 난방을 위한 화로 공장인데, 이 냉동고에 들어가 있지 않으면 제 몸이 녹아 버리거든요.
		character_util.remove_emotion(snowman)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_factory_11', skip = true })

		-- 메이릴 (up, idle, release): 뭐? 그럼 나오면 안되잖아!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_factory_12', skip = true })

		-- 메이릴 release 행동 멈춤.
		-- 눈사람 (down, attack, idle): 아니에요. 전 반드시 이곳을 나가야 해요!
		character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
		character_util.set_emotion(snowman, { name = 'attack' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_factory_13', skip = true })

		-- 메이릴 머리위에 ? 이모지
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(user_party.Leader, nil, 'question')

		-- 눈사람 (down, tired, idle): 딸에게 줄 선물로 절 만드신 분이…
		character_util.set_emotion(snowman, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_factory_14', skip = true })

		-- 눈사람 (down, tired, idle): 녹지 않게 절 여기 넣어두고는 깜빡하셨는지 그냥 가 버리셨지 뭐예요.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_factory_15', skip = true })

		-- 눈사람 (down, tired, idle): 이대로면 분명 그분의 딸이 슬퍼할 거라…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_factory_16', skip = true })

		-- 눈사람 (down, attack, idle): 부탁이에요! 저 좀 밖으로 내 보내주세요!
		character_util.set_emotion(snowman, { name = 'attack' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_factory_17', skip = true })
	else
		-- 플레이어 거절 후, 다시 인터렉트 시
		-- 눈사람 (down, tired, idle) : 아, 혹시 절 도와주러 오신 건가요?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_factory_18', skip = true })
	end

	-- 눈사람 대화 종료되면 플레이어 선택지 출력.
	-- 도와준다. / 거절한다.
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'short_story_mayreel_factory_17_1', 'mercy' }, { 'short_story_mayreel_factory_17_2', 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 도와준다.
		-- 상단 대화에서 플레이어 ‘도와준다’ 선택할 시
		-- 메이릴 (up, idle, idle) : 알았어. 도와줄게.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_factory_19', skip = true })

		-- 눈사람 (down, smile, idle) : 감사합니다!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(snowman, { name = 'smile' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_factory_20', skip = true })

		-- 메이릴 냉동고 문을 연다. 이후 꼬마 눈사람을 들어올리는 메이릴.
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(user_party.Leader, { name = 'attack' })
		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_greenland_01')
		local refrigerator_animator = refrigerator:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
		refrigerator_animator:Play('refrigerator_xm_open')
		wait_for_sec(1)

		command_util.execute_holdup(user_party.Leader, snowman, user_party.Leader.Position)
		wait_for_sec(0.62)

		-- 입장한 도어 닫히고, 우측에 도어 열림.
		local door_1 = self.get_door(1)
		local door_2 = self.get_door(2)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(door_1.Name, false))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(door_2.Name, false))

		-- 눈사람 (right, idle, idle) : 화로들이 돌아가기 시작했어요! 서둘러 주세요!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
		character_util.set_direction(snowman, 'right')
		character_util.remove_emotion(snowman)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_factory_21', skip = true })

		refrigerator.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

		-- 플레이어 컨트롤 풀림. 액티비티 시작.
		party_util.reset_controllers()

		self.mini_game = mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate(self.mini_game_name)

		local is_mini_game_load_complete = false
		mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.mini_game_name, stage.Name, function()
			is_mini_game_load_complete = true
		end)

		while not is_mini_game_load_complete do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.mini_game_name)
		return
	else
		-- 거절한다.
		-- 메이릴 (up, idle, idle) : 미안. 지금은 좀 바빠.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_factory_22', skip = true })

		-- 눈사람 (down, tired, idle) : 네에… 이제 어쩌지…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(snowman, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_factory_23', skip = true })

		-- 플레이어 컨트롤 복귀.
	end

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:mini_game_clear()
	local snowman = self.get_snowman()
	local marker = field:GetMarker('snowman_factory_outer')

	-- 눈사람 (바라보는 방향, smile, jump 1회) : 이제 밖이에요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_direction(snowman, 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(snowman, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.normal_jump(snowman, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_factory_54_1', skip = true })

	-- 이후 플레이어 down으로 진입하며 화면 페이드 아웃.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	character_util.move_to(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -3), 1, nil, true, true)
	if user_party.Count > 1 then
		for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
			character_util.move_to(user_party[i], user_party[i].Position + vector(0, 0, -3), 1, nil, true, true)
		end
	end
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	-- 페이드 인 시 하단 진행.
	party_util.position_party(marker.position + vector(0, 0, -1), 'down', 'arc')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(snowman)
	character_util.set_anim(snowman, { name = 'idle' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_intro_shivermore_01')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 액티비티 이후 밖으로 나오면 이벤트 자동진행.
	-- 메이릴은 눈사람을 들고 화로 공장 밖으로 탈출에 성공한다.
	-- 메이릴이 ●타일 위치에 서고, 대화가 진행된다.

	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')

	-- 눈사람이 메이릴의 왼쪽편으로 점프해서 내려온다.
	local current_state = user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
	local target = current_state.HoldTarget

	command_util.execute_throw(user_party.Leader, target, direction_util.to_vector3(user_party.Leader.Direction), user_party.Leader.Position, 4, false)
	coroutine.yield()

	message_system:SendSync(snowman, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)

	character_util.normal_jump(snowman, true)
	character_util.move_to_async(snowman, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(-1, 0 , 0), 0.3, nil, true, false)

	-- 이후 눈사람은 right 방향 / 메이릴은 left 방향을 바라본다.
	character_util.set_direction(snowman, 'right')

	-- 눈사람 (right, idle, idle ) : 감사합니다! 덕분에 무사히 빠져나왔어요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_factory_56', skip = true })

	-- 눈사람 (right, idle, idle ) : 냉동고 안쪽에서 이런 걸 찾았는데, 답례로 당신께 드릴게요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_factory_57', skip = true })

	-- 눈사람은 메이릴에게 스타피스를 건넨다.
	local star_piece = self.get_star_piece()
	star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, snowman.Position)
	self.controller:detach_star_piece_hidden_effect()
	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 눈사람 (right, idle, idle ) : 더 늦기 전에 어서 아저씨한테 가봐야겠어요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_factory_58', skip = true })

	-- 눈사람  (right, smile, jump 1회) : 남은 크리스마스 잘 보내세요! 오늘은 일 년에 하루뿐인 소중한 날이니까~!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(snowman, { name = 'smile' })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_factory_60', skip = true })

	for i = 1, 5 do

		character_util.move_to_async(snowman, snowman.Position + vector(-2, 0 , 0), 0.3, nil, true, false)
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
	end

	-- 눈사람이 완전히 화면에서 사라지면, 플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false)
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryMayreelHillStarSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryMayreelHillStar @
		Comment = ShortStoryMayreelHillStar 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.progress_enum = {
		-- 기본 상태
		none = 1,
		-- 인트로
		intro = 2,
		-- 밖에 나가는 것 막기
		inside = 3,
		-- 표지판
		sign_board = 4,
		-- 바위 파괴
		rock = 5,
		-- 청홍벽
		red_blue = 6,
		-- 마지막 문
		last_door = 7,
		-- 끝
		ending = 8
	}

	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.none

	self.last_switch = {false, false}

	self.blizzard_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_SwordSlash')
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ConvertSwitchChangedEvent), 'on_convert_switch_changed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_field_object_destroyed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_switch_on_off_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BurnEvent), 'on_burn_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ConvertSwitchChangedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BurnEvent))

	if self.blizzard_sfx ~= nil then
		self.blizzard_sfx:Stop()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'hill_star_start' and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.none then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.intro
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.intro, self)

	elseif zone_name == 'hill_star_inside' and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.intro then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.inside

	elseif zone_name == 'hill_star_rock' and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.rock then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.red_blue
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.throw_bomb, self))

	elseif zone_name == 'hill_star_out' and self.current_progress >= self.progress_enum.inside then
		--저렇게 두고 갈 순 없어…
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.move_back, self, vector(-2, 0, 0),
				'short_story_mayreel_s4_hill_4')
	elseif zone_name == 'hill_star_out_2' and self.current_progress > self.progress_enum.none then
		--저렇게 두고 갈 순 없어…
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.move_back, self, vector(-2, 0, 0),
				'short_story_mayreel_s4_hill_4')
	elseif zone_name == 'hill_star_out_3' and self.current_progress > self.progress_enum.none then
		--저렇게 두고 갈 순 없어…
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.move_back, self, vector(0, 0, -2),
				'short_story_mayreel_s4_hill_4')
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_convert_switch_changed_event(e)
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.red_blue then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.last_door
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.break_obstacle, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_field_object('hill_star_board_2')) then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.sign_board
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.break_sign_board, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.last_door then
		for i = 1, 2 do
			-- 4, 5 스위치만 체크
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, get_field_object('hill_star_door_switch_' .. i + 3)) then
				self.last_switch[i] = e.IsTurningOn
			end
		end

		if self.last_switch[1] and self.last_switch[2] then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.ending
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.ending, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('hill_star')) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.complete_quest, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_burn_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('hill_star_board_1')) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.on_burn, self))
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:intro()
	-- 현 퀘스트 빼고 다 지움
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('bari_yeti_star')
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('bari_tree_star')
	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('bari_hill_star', self.quest_progress.QuestId,
			true, get_field_object('hill_star'))

	self.blizzard_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_blizzard_04', loop = true, fade_in_time = 0.5 })

	local mayreel = user_party.Leader
	local captain = get_character('captain_rabbit')
	--트리거 존(검은선)에 마킹, 진입 시 이벤트, 메이릴(빨강) 캐럴(초록) 정렬

	party_util.align_party(field:GetMarker('hill_star_start_pos').position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
			'right', 1.5, 'linear')

	--카메라 패닝하여 별 보여주고 돌아옴
	local star = get_field_object('hill_star')
	camera_util.move_async(star.Position, 3)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.set_direction(mayreel, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(captain, 'left')
	camera_util.move_async(captain.Position, 2, {end_target = captain})

	--메이릴 (left, idle, idle) : 귀찮게… 뭐 저런 높은 곳에 떨어져 있는 거야?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mayreel, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_s4_hill_1', skip = true})

	--캐럴 (left, smile, idle) : 힘을 합치면 금방 도착할 수 있을 거야!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(mayreel, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(captain, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(captain, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(captain, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_s4_hill_2', skip = true})

	--캐럴 (left, smile, attack X 2) : 내가 스위치를 찾아볼게.
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(captain, {name = 'attack', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(captain, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_s4_hill_3', skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim(captain)

	character_util.convert_to_npc(captain)

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(captain, { vector(captain.Position.x, 0, self:get_marker_pos(1).z),
												  self:get_marker_pos(1) + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)}, 4, false)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_accelerate_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(captain, {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'surprise'})
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(captain, captain.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 8, true)

	local red_blue_switch = get_field_object('red_blue_switch')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(red_blue_switch.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_ArmyGhost_End'):Instantiate(red_blue_switch.Position)
	red_blue_switch:Shake(0.04, 0.3)

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:PublishSync(
			CS.Oak.ConvertWallChangedEvent.Create(CS.Oak.ConvertSwitchFieldObjectBehaviour.ConvertSwitchState.BLUE))

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(captain, self:get_marker_pos(2) + vector(1, 0, 0), 8, true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_switch_button_01')
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent.Create(get_field_object('hill_star_door_switch_1'), true, captain))

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(captain, self:get_marker_pos(2), 8, true)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(captain)

	--문이 열리는 시점, 메이릴 jump X 1, left, smile
	--스위치 밟은 후 캐럴은 아래 이미지에 표시(빨강)된 위치로 이동해 좌우 번갈아 본 후 down, tired, question
	--캐럴 동작 관계 없이 문이 열리는 시점에 플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function ()
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(captain, self:get_marker_pos(2) + vector(-1, 0, 0), 8, true)
		wait_for_sec(1)
		character_util.set_direction(captain, 'right')
		wait_for_sec(1)
		character_util.set_direction(captain, 'left')
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(captain, captain.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 4, true)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(captain, {name = 'question', loop = false}, {name = 'tired'})
	end))

	character_util.set_direction(mayreel, 'left')
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
	character_util.set_emotion(mayreel, {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.normal_jump_async(mayreel, '01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.remove_emotion(mayreel)
	wait_for_sec(1)
end

function local_class:on_burn()
	local captain = get_character('captain_rabbit')
	character_util.set_direction(captain, 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim(captain)
	character_util.set_emotion(captain, {name = 'surprise'})
	character_util.normal_jump(captain, '01_player_jump_01')
end

function local_class:break_sign_board()
	--상단 화로는 on, 하단 화로는 off. 플레이어가 이동 화로를 이용해서 꺼진 화로에 불을 붙여주면 표지판이 불타게 되고 캐럴 쪽 길이 열림.
	--표지판 없어지면 캐럴 jumpX1 , left, smile 후 왼쪽의 2층으로 이동.
	--캐럴은 B파트의 폭탄 위쪽으로 이동해서 정렬 (up, idle)
	--캐럴의 모든 행동, 대사 시 플레이어 컨트롤 빼앗지 않음.

	local captain = get_character('captain_rabbit')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(captain)
	character_util.set_direction(captain, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(captain, {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.normal_jump(captain, '01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.mario_jump_async(captain, 'left')

	local dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', parent = captain, loop = true })
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(captain, self:get_marker_pos(2) + vector(-3.2, 0, 0), 7, true)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(captain, captain.Position + vector(-1, 1, 0), 4, true)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(captain, self:get_marker_pos(3), 7, true, nil, nil, 'up')
	dash_sfx:Stop()

	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.rock

	--이미 존 안에서 대기중이면 바로 다음이벤트 실행
	local zone = field:GetZone('hill_star_rock')
	local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(unity_class.vector3.zero, zone.Bounds)

	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
		local fo = fo_list[i]
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, user_party.Leader) then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.red_blue
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.throw_bomb, self))
			break
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()

end

function local_class:throw_bomb()
	--플레이어가 그리드를 넘어 3번 존을 엔터하면 폭탄 위쪽에 (up, idle) 상태로 대기하던 캐롤이 뒤돌아서 폭탄을 집음.
	--이후 캐롤은 왼쪽으로 2타일 이동, 4번 위치에 던짐.
	--바위 파괴될 때까지 캐롤이 정지했다가, 파괴 완료되면 캐롤 대사
	--캐롤 (up, attack x 1) : 나이스!
	--이후 캐롤은 점프대를 밟고 반대편으로 건너가서 청홍벽 앞에 정렬.
	--캐롤 : (left, idle qusestion)
	--위 이벤트 진행 중 플레이어 컨트롤 빼앗지 않음.

	local captain = get_character('captain_rabbit')
	local bomb = get_field_object('hill_star_bomb')
	character_util.set_direction(captain, 'down')
	command_util.execute_holdup(captain, bomb, captain.Position)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(captain, self:get_marker_pos(3) + vector(-1.5, 0, 0),
			4, false, nil, nil, 'up')

	command_util.execute_throw(captain, bomb, vector(0, 0, 1), captain.Position,
			6, true)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(captain, self:get_marker_pos(4),
			7, false, nil, nil, 'up')

	local jump_tile = get_field_object('hill_star_jump')
	local dir = 6 * unity_class.vector3.forward + 11 * unity_class.vector3.up
	local jump_info = CS.Oak.JumpInfo()

	jump_tile:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator)):Play('on')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_jumptile_01')

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		local blizzard_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_blizzard_01', loop = true })
		wait_for_sec(1.5)
		blizzard_sfx:FadeOut(0)
		jump_tile:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator)):Play('off')
	end))

	jump_info.jumper = captain
	jump_info.speed = dir.magnitude
	jump_info.direction = dir.normalized
	jump_info.jumpStartPos = captain.Position
	jump_info.jumpTimeScale = 1.75
	jump_info.gravity = CS.Oak.Constants.JumpGravity

	local cmd = CS.Oak.JumpCommand.Create(jump_info)
	command_util.execute_cmd(cmd)

	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.set_direction(captain, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(captain, self:get_marker_pos(5) + vector(-2, 0, 0), 4, false)
	character_util.remove_emotion(captain)
	character_util.set_anim(captain, {name = 'question', loop = false})
end

function local_class:break_obstacle()
	--플레이어가 청홍벽 스위치를 쳐서 벽을 내리면,
	local captain = get_character('captain_rabbit')
	camera_util.move_async(captain.Position, 1, {end_target = captain})

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(captain)
	character_util.set_emotion(captain, {name = 'smile'})

	--캐롤이 계단으로 내려와 작은 바위 2개를 부숴줌.(연속으로 빠르게)

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(captain, { self:get_marker_pos(6), self:get_marker_pos(6) + vector(0, 0, -1.1) }, 4, false)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(captain, { captain.Position + vector(0, -1, -1) }, 2, false)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(captain, { self:get_marker_pos(7) }, 4, false, nil, nil, 'right')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_anim(captain, {name = 'attack', sfx_name = '02_auto_slash_03', loop = false})

	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_SwordSlash'):Instantiate(captain.Position + vector(0, 1, -0.5),
			unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 180), nil)

	local zone = field:GetZone('hill_star_almost_end')
	local names = {
		'[GIMMICK]small_rock_LV1',
	}

	local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(unity_class.vector3.zero, zone.Bounds)

	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
		local fo = fo_list[i]
		if table_util.contain_value(names, fo.Name) then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick
			damage_info.sender = captain

	--캐롤 right, smile, cast

												  self:get_marker_pos(7) + vector(-3.5, 0, -1.5)},
			4, false, nil, nil, 'right')
	message_system:Send(get_field_object('hill_star_door_switch_4'), CS.Oak.FloorSwitchStepOnEvent.Create(captain))
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.normal_jump_async(captain, '01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.set_anim(captain, {name = 'cast'})

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	character_util.remove_anim(captain)

function local_class:complete_quest()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local mayreel = user_party.Leader
	local captain = get_character('captain_rabbit')

	--페이드 아웃.
	self.blizzard_sfx:FadeOut()
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	--시작 지점에서 페이드 인
	--캐럴(적), 메이릴(녹), 병사(청)

	local pos = field:GetMarker('hill_star_start_pos').position
	local soldier = get_character('star_soldier')
	soldier.Position = pos + vector(1.5, 0, 0)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(soldier)
	character_util.set_direction(soldier, 'left')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mayreel)
	mayreel.Position = pos + vector(0, 0, 0.5)
	character_util.set_direction(mayreel, 'right')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(captain)
	captain.Position = pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5)
	character_util.set_direction(captain, 'right')

	local star = get_field_object('hill_star')
	star.Position = pos + vector(0.7, 1, 0)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--병사(right, idle, salute) : 에너지원 확인! 복구 작업 진행하겠습니다!
	--병사가 별을 들고 위쪽 길로 퇴장한다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
	character_util.set_anim(soldier, {name = 'slaute', loop = false}) --todo 스파인 교체시 애니메이션 확인
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_s4_1', skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim(soldier)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_holdup_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	star.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	command_util.execute_holdup(soldier, star, soldier.Position)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.move_waypoint(soldier, { soldier.Position + vector(0, 0, 10) }, 6, false)

	wait_for_sec(2.5)

	character_util.stop(soldier)
	soldier.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	command_util.execute_throw(soldier, star, CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(soldier.Direction),
			soldier.Position, 0, false)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(captain, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(mayreel, 'down')

	quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 0)
end

--뒤로가는것 공통
function local_class:move_back(vec, key)
	local mayreel = user_party.Leader
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mayreel, { key = key, skip = true})
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(mayreel, mayreel.Position + vec, 2, false)
end

function local_class:get_marker_pos(idx)
	return field:GetMarker('hill_star_captain_' .. idx).position
end

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryMayreelHomeAloneSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryMayreelHomeAlone @
		Comment = 집 진입 ~ 폭탄 액티비티 섹션 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.bomb = {}
	self.bombing_points = {}

	self.home_alone_script = 'short_story_mayreel_home_alone_s1_'

	-- 캐릭터
	self.get_thief = function(num)
		return get_character('home_alone_thief_'..num)
	end
	self.get_kevin = function()
		return get_character('home_alone_kevin')
	end
	self.bomb_zone_name = 'home_alone_bomb_zone'
	self.scream_zone_name = 'home_alone_scream_zone'
	self.locked_zone_name = 'home_alone_locked_zone'

	self.hit_reaction_routines = {}
	self.timer_over = false
	self.throw_bombs = {}
	self.bomb_range = {}
	self.bomb_radius = 1
	self.game_duration = 15
	-- 폭탄 회피 게임 시간
	self.bombing_duration = 20
	self.bomb_table_count = 1
	self.thief_1_run_state = 0
	self.thief_2_run_state = 0
	self.user_party_state = 0
	self.current_hit_count = 0
	self.scream_zone_flag = true
	self.bomb_event_flag = true
	self.locked_event_flag = true
	self.locked_door_name = 'home_alone_locked_door'
	self.bomb_door_name = 'home_alone_bomb_door_'
	self.thief_1_run_stop = false
	self.thief_2_run_stop = false
	self.bomb_event_end_flag = false
	self.thief_1_dead_flag = true
	self.thief_2_dead_flag = true

	self.sfx_blizzard_loop = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	quest_util.load_pool_resource(
			'FX_Explosion_Bomb_new'
	)
end

function local_class:enter()
	local thief_1 = self.get_thief(1)
	local thief_2 = self.get_thief(2)
	character_util.set_position(thief_1,field:GetMarker('home_alone_locked_thief_1').position)
	character_util.set_position(thief_2,field:GetMarker('home_alone_locked_thief_2').position)
	thief_1.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
	thief_2.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	local res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	local tileset = load_util.load_prefab_async(res_holder, 'tilesets/gimmick', 'gimmick.tileset')
	local bomb = tileset.transform:Find('[GIMMICK]bomb1').gameObject
	bomb.transform:Find('mesh/bomb1/root_wick/wick/FX_BombSpark_mesh').gameObject:SetActive(false)
	for i = 1, 12 do
		self.throw_bombs[i] = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(bomb)
		self.throw_bombs[i]:SetActive(false)
		self.bomb_range[i] = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(vector(999,0,999) + unity_class.vector3.up * 0.05, self.bomb_radius)
		self.bomb_range[i]:Show()
		self.bomb_range[i].gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end
	tileset:SetActive(false)
	local diameter = 1
	local bombing_area = field:GetZone('home_alone_bomb_zone').Bounds
	local area_width = math.floor(bombing_area.size.x)
	local area_height = math.floor(bombing_area.size.z-1)
	local area_lb = vector_util.get_x0z(bombing_area.center+ vector(1,0,0))
			+ unity_class.vector3.left * (area_width / 2) + unity_class.vector3.back * (area_height / 2)
	for y = 0, area_height - 2 do
		for x = 0, area_width -2 do
			local x_offset = unity_class.vector3.right * (diameter / 2.0 + x)
			local z_offset = unity_class.vector3.forward * (diameter / 2.0 + y)
			local target_point = area_lb + x_offset + z_offset
			table.insert(self.bombing_points, target_point)
		end
	end
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	local thief_1 = self.get_thief(1)
	local thief_2 = self.get_thief(2)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent))

	thief_1.SpineController:Rotate(0, 0)
	thief_2.SpineController:Rotate(0, 0)

	if self.throw_bombs ~= nil then
		for _, bomb in pairs(self.throw_bombs) do
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(bomb.gameObject)
		end
		self.throw_bombs = nil
	end

	if self.bomb_range ~= nil then
		for _, bombs_range in pairs(self.bomb_range) do
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(bombs_range.gameObject)
		end
		self.bomb_range = nil
	end

	self:stop_blizzard_loop_sfx()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.locked_zone_name and self.locked_event_flag then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.locked_event, self)
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.scream_zone_name and self.scream_zone_flag then
			--통로 진행중에 배치된 트리거 존 진입 시 하단의 대사를 화면 중앙 기준 상단에 말꼬리 없이 출력.
			--도둑 1, 2 : [shout] 끄아아아아아아악!!!
			camera_util.shake(0.2,0.3)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_villain_scream_01')

			local sb = speech_bubble_util.generate_speech_bubble(leader,
					{ key = self.home_alone_script..52, skip = false, bubble_type = 'shout', life_time = 1, screen_pos = vector(-150, 300) })
			sb.BubbleDirection = CS.Oak.SpeechBubbleDirection.None
			speech_bubble.instance:ShowSpeechBubble(sb)
			self.scream_zone_flag = false
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.bomb_zone_name and self.bomb_event_flag then
			--폭탄 회피 액티비티 시작
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.bomb_event, self, 3))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.controller.room_bgm_zone_name then
			self:play_blizzard_loop_sfx()
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), self.controller.room_bgm_zone_name) then
		self:stop_blizzard_loop_sfx(0.5)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:play_blizzard_loop_sfx()
	self:stop_blizzard_loop_sfx()

	self.sfx_blizzard_loop = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{sfx_name = '01_blizzard_04', fade_in_time = 2, loop = true,
			 type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'default'})
end

function local_class:stop_blizzard_loop_sfx(fade_dur)
	if self.sfx_blizzard_loop then
		if fade_dur then
			self.sfx_blizzard_loop:FadeOut(fade_dur)
		else
			self.sfx_blizzard_loop:Stop()
		end
		self.sfx_blizzard_loop = nil
	end
end

		util.cs_generator(function ()

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
			character_util.mario_jump_async(thief_2, 'left')
		end)
	})
	character_util.set_anim(thief_1, {name = 'cast'})
	character_util.set_anim(thief_2, {name = 'cast'})
	character_util.shake(thief_1,0.02,1.5)
	character_util.shake(thief_2,0.02,1.5)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)
	character_util.set_anim(thief_1, {name = 'embarrassed', loop = true})
	character_util.set_anim(thief_2, {name = 'embarrassed', loop = true})
	character_util.set_emotion(thief_1, {name = 'damaged'})
	character_util.set_emotion(thief_2, {name = 'damaged'})

	thief_1.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	thief_2.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.bomb_door_name..1, false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.bomb_door_name..2, false))

	--이후 플레이어 컨트롤 복귀되고, 폭탄 회피 액티비티 진행.
	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	local bombs_rest_duration = { 0, 1.5, 0 }

	local bombs_start = {
		field:GetMarker('bomb_drop_1'),
		field:GetMarker('bomb_drop_2'),
		field:GetMarker('bomb_drop_3'),
	}

	local throw_types = {
		random = 1,
		to_player = 2
	}

	local bomb_state = {
		throwing = 1,
		rest = 2
	}

	local bomb_throw_type = { throw_types.random, throw_types.to_player, throw_types.random }
	local bomb_routines = {}
	local bomb_states = {}

	for _, bomb in pairs(bombs_start) do
		bomb_states[bomb] = bomb_state.throwing
		bomb_routines[bomb] = nil
	end

	-- 폭탄에 맞을때 불리는 콜백
	local hit_cb = function(hit_target)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_target, user_party.Leader) or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_target, user_party[1]) or
			lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_target, thief_1) or
		lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_target, thief_2)
		then
			-- 이벤트가 종료 판정이 났다면 폭탄에 맞지 않도록 함.
			if self.timer_over or self.current_hit_count >= max_hit_count then return end

			-- 폭탄을 맞아서 리액션 중 일때는 미니게임이 종료 되지 않도록 함.
			if self.hit_reaction_routines[hit_target] ~= nil and not self.hit_reaction_routines[hit_target].IsDone then return end

			-- 파티 리더가 맞았을 때만 hit count 늘림
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_target, user_party.Leader) then
				self.current_hit_count = self.current_hit_count + 1
			end
			self.hit_reaction_routines[hit_target] = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.hit_reaction, self, hit_target, self.current_hit_count, max_hit_count))
		end
	end

	timer_util.start_timer({ duration = self.bombing_duration, handler = self, callback = 'timer_finished', show_ui = false })
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.EventTimerStartEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer, true))
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_villain_scream_04')

	self.game_timer = CS.Oak.GlobalTimerServiceExtenstion.GetInGameTimer(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer)

	self.thief_1_run_stop = false
	self.thief_2_run_stop = false
	self.thief_1_dead_flag = true
	self.thief_2_dead_flag = true
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.thief_1_run, self))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.thief_2_run, self))

	while true do
		if not self.thief_1_run_stop and self.thief_1_dead_flag and self.game_timer.RemainTime < 3.2 then
			self.thief_1_run_stop = true
			self.thief_1_dead_flag = false
			self:runaway_sound(false, thief_1)
			character_util.stop(thief_1)
			character_util.set_side_direction(thief_1)
			character_util.set_emotion(thief_1, {name = 'damaged'})
			character_util.set_anim(thief_1, { name = 'dead', loop = false})
		end
		if not self.thief_2_run_stop and self.thief_2_dead_flag and self.game_timer.RemainTime < 2.5 then
			self.thief_2_run_stop = true
			self.thief_2_dead_flag = false
			self:runaway_sound(false, thief_2)
			character_util.stop(thief_2)
			character_util.set_side_direction(thief_2)
			character_util.set_emotion(thief_2, {name = 'damaged'})
			character_util.set_anim(thief_2, { name = 'dead', loop = false})
		end
			-- 이벤트 종료 판정이 났다면 플레이어 컨트롤 뺏고 이벤트 종료
		if self.current_hit_count >= max_hit_count then
			self.thief_1_run_state = 0
			self.thief_2_run_state = 0
			self.bomb_event_flag = true
			self.bomb_event_end_flag = true
			-- 타이머 종료
			timer_util.end_timer(self, true)
			wait_for_sec(1.5)
			screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
			self:runaway_sound(false, thief_1)
			self:runaway_sound(false, thief_2)
			wait_for_sec(1)
			party_util.position_party(vector(202.5, 0,-118),'left', 'arc')
			leader.SpineController:Rotate(0, 0)
			if user_party[1] ~= nil then
				message_system:SendSync(user_party[1].FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
				character_util.set_anim(user_party[1], {name = 'prostrate'})
				character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party[1], {name = 'prostrate'},{name = 'damaged'})
			end
			screen_util.fade_in(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
			party_util.shake(0.03, 0.5)
			wait_for_sec(1)

			party_util.remove_emotion()
			party_util.set_animation('get', true)
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_popup_01')

			party_util.jump(0.5, 0.25)

			wait_for_sec(0.25)
			party_util.remove_animation()
			thief_1.SpineController:Rotate(0, 0)
			thief_2.SpineController:Rotate(0, 0)

			message_system:SendSync(leader.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.bomb_door_name..1,false))
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.bomb_door_name..2,false))

			character_util.set_position(thief_1, field:GetMarker('thief_1_run_start').position)
			thief_1.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(thief_1, {name = 'prostrate'}, {name = 'confused'})

			character_util.set_position(thief_2,field:GetMarker('thief_2_run_start').position)
			thief_2.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(thief_2, {name = 'prostrate'}, {name = 'confused'})
			self.current_hit_count = 0
			return self.timer_over

		elseif self.timer_over and self.current_hit_count < max_hit_count then
			self.bomb_event_end_flag = true
			self.bomb_event_flag = false
			timer_util.end_timer(self, true)
			return self.timer_over
		end
		-- 폭탄 던지는 루틴
		for i, bomb2 in pairs(bombs_start) do
			local state = bomb_states[bomb2]
			local routine = bomb_routines[bomb2]
			local bomb = self.throw_bombs[bomb2]
			if self.throw_bombs[self.bomb_table_count] == nil then
				self.bomb_table_count = self.bomb_table_count + 1
				return
			else
				if state == bomb_state.throwing and self.game_timer.RemainTime > 2 then
					if routine == nil then
						local throw_type = bomb_throw_type[i]
						local shoot_point
						if throw_type == throw_types.to_player then
							shoot_point = user_party.Leader.Position
						else
							shoot_point = self.bombing_points[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.bombing_points)]
						end

						bomb_routines[bomb2] = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
								util.cs_generator(self.throw_bomb, self, bomb2,  shoot_point, 8, hit_cb))
						self.bomb_table_count = self.bomb_table_count + 1
					elseif routine.IsDone then
						if bombs_rest_duration[i] > 0 then
							bomb_states[bomb2] = bomb_state.rest
						end
						bomb_routines[bomb2] = nil
					end
				elseif state == bomb_state.rest then
					if routine == nil then
						bomb_routines[bomb2] = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
								util.cs_generator(wait_for_sec, bombs_rest_duration[i]))
					elseif routine.IsDone then
						bomb_states[bomb2] = bomb_state.throwing
						bomb_routines[bomb2] = nil
					end
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

-- 폭탄 한 개 던지는 루틴
function local_class:throw_bomb(bomb_start, shoot_pos, speed,explode_cb)
	self:reactive_object()
	local throw_speed = speed or 8
	local time_passed = 0
	self.throw_bombs[self.bomb_table_count].gameObject:SetActive(true)
	local bomb = self.throw_bombs[self.bomb_table_count]
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_wolf_boss_fire_01')

	local bombs_range = self.bomb_range[self.bomb_table_count]
	bombs_range.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	bombs_range.transform.position = shoot_pos + unity_class.vector3.up * 0.05

	local start_pos = bomb_start.position
	local dist = (shoot_pos - start_pos).magnitude
	local throw_duration = dist / throw_speed
	while time_passed < throw_duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / throw_duration)
		local cur_h = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * 7

		bomb.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, shoot_pos, progress) + unity_class.vector3.up * cur_h

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	bombs_range.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	bomb.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_wolf_boss_bomb_01')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Explosion_Bomb_new'):Instantiate(shoot_pos)

	-- 폭탄 맞은 캐릭터 콜 백
	local collide_objs = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(shoot_pos, self.bomb_radius)
	for i = 0, collide_objs.Count - 1 do
		local fo = collide_objs[i]
		if explode_cb ~= nil then
			explode_cb(fo)
		end
	end
	collide_objs:Dispose()
end

function local_class:hit_reaction(target, current_hit_count, max_hit_count)
	local thief_1 = self.get_thief(1)
	local thief_2 = self.get_thief(2)
	character_util.stop(target)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, thief_1) then
		self:runaway_sound(false, thief_1)
		self.thief_1_run_stop = true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(target, thief_2) then
		self:runaway_sound(false, thief_2)
		self.thief_2_run_stop = true
	end
	target.SpineController:DamageSquish(0.3)
	target.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
	character_util.set_side_direction(target)
	target:SetEmotion('damaged', true)
	target:SetAnimation('prostrate', true)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, thief_1) and self.game_timer.RemainTime < 4 then
		self.thief_1_run_state = self.thief_1_run_state + 1
		self:runaway_sound(false, thief_1)
		thief_1.SpineController:DamageSquish(0.3)
		thief_1.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
		if self.thief_1_run_state > 1 then
			return
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(target, thief_2) and self.game_timer.RemainTime < 4 then
		self.thief_2_run_state = self.thief_2_run_state + 1
		self:runaway_sound(false, thief_2)
		thief_2.SpineController:DamageSquish(0.3)
		thief_2.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
		if self.thief_2_run_state > 1 then
			return
		end
	end

	local fly_time = 0.75
	target.SpineController:Rotate(720, fly_time)
	character_util.jump(target, 2.5, fly_time)
	wait_for_sec(fly_time)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_trip_01')

	-- 게임오버가 되지 않거나 도둑이 아니면 다시 일어서도록 함.
	if self.thief_2_run_state < 1 and self.thief_1_run_state < 1 then
		if current_hit_count < max_hit_count then
			target:Shake(0.05, 0.5)
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
			target:RemoveEmotion()
			target:SetAnimation('get', true)
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_popup_01')
			character_util.jump(target, 0.5, 0.25)
			wait_for_sec(0.25)
			target:RemoveAnimation()
			target.SpineController:Rotate(0, 0)
			message_system:SendSync(target.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, thief_1) then
				self:runaway_sound(true, thief_1)
				self.thief_1_run_stop = false
			elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(target, thief_2) then
				self:runaway_sound(true, thief_2)
				self.thief_2_run_stop = false
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Acitve(false) 된 오브젝트 활성화
function local_class:reactive_object()
	if self.bomb_table_count == 9 then
		for i = 1, 6 do
			if not self.throw_bombs[i].IsActive then
				self.throw_bombs[i].transform.position = vector(999,0,999)
				self.bomb_range[i].transform.position = vector(999,0,999)
				self.throw_bombs[i].gameObject:SetActive(true)
				self.bomb_range[i].gameObject:SetActive(true)
			end
		end
		self.bomb_table_count = 1
	elseif self.bomb_table_count == 3 then
		for i = 6, 12 do
			if not self.throw_bombs[i].IsActive then
				self.throw_bombs[i].transform.position = vector(999,0,999)
				self.bomb_range[i].transform.position = vector(999,0,999)
				self.throw_bombs[i].gameObject:SetActive(true)
				self.bomb_range[i].gameObject:SetActive(true)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:thief_1_run()
	local thief_1 = self.get_thief(1)

	local thief_1_way_point = {
		field:GetMarker('thief_1_run_1').position + vector(0,0,1),
		field:GetMarker('thief_1_run_2').position + vector(0,0,1),
		field:GetMarker('thief_1_run_3').position + vector(0,0,1),
		field:GetMarker('thief_1_run_4').position + vector(0,0,1)
	}
	local target_wp_index = 1
	self:runaway_sound(true, thief_1)
	while not self.bomb_event_end_flag do
		wp_util.move_waypoint_async(thief_1,thief_1_way_point[target_wp_index],6, true, nil,
				nil, nil)

		local force_stopped = self.thief_1_run_stop

		while self.thief_1_run_stop do
			if self.bomb_event_end_flag then
				return
			end
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
		if not force_stopped then
			target_wp_index = target_wp_index % #thief_1_way_point + 1
		end
	end
end

	local thief_2 = self.get_thief(2)

		local force_stopped = self.thief_2_run_stop

		while self.thief_2_run_stop do
			if self.bomb_event_end_flag then
				return
			end
			coroutine.yield(nil)

		if not force_stopped then

function local_class:runaway_sound(sound_on, target)
	local thief_1 = self.get_thief(1)
	local thief_2 = self.get_thief(2)
	if sound_on then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, thief_1) then
			self.runaway_thief_1_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '03_runaway_01', parent = thief_1,
				loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc',
				max_distance = 3
			})
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(target, thief_2) then
			self.runaway_thief_2_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '03_runaway_01', parent = thief_2,
				loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc',
				max_distance = 3
			})
		end
	else
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, thief_1) then
			if self.runaway_thief_1_sound ~= nil then
				self.runaway_thief_1_sound:Stop()
				self.runaway_thief_1_sound = nil
			end
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(target, thief_2) then
			if self.runaway_thief_2_sound ~= nil then

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryMayreelHomeAloneSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryMayreelHomeAlone @
		Comment = ShortStoryMayreelHomeAlone 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.get_spike = function(group_num, spike_num)
		return get_field_object('home_alone_spike_' .. group_num .. '_' .. spike_num)
	end
	self.get_thief_1 = function() return get_character('home_alone_thief_1') end
	self.get_thief_2 = function() return get_character('home_alone_thief_2') end

	self.get_fx_hit = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit') end
	self.get_fx_lasthit = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit') end

	self.spike_zone_name = 'home_alone_spike_check'

	self.spike_fos = {}

	self.event_state = {
		none = 0,
		enter_spike = 1,
		before_enter_next = 2,
		done = 3,
	}
	self.current_event_state = self.event_state.none
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	quest_util.load_pool_resource('FX_hit', 'FX_lasthit')
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	local spike_check_bounds = field:GetZone(self.spike_zone_name).Bounds
	local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(spike_check_bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
		local fo = fo_list[i]

		-- 스파이크가 움직이게 하지 않기 위해서 behaviour를 캐싱해놓음
		if lua_helper.type_compare(fo.FieldObjectBehaviour, typeof(CS.Oak.SpikeBehaviour)) then
			message_system:SendSync(fo.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.SpikeStopEvent.Create(nil))

			table.insert(self.spike_fos, fo)
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()

	-- 위쪽 리스트에 추가되지 않도록 검사 먼저 하고 NPC들 옮겨줌
	local thief_1 = self.get_thief_1()
	local thief_2 = self.get_thief_2()

	thief_1.Position = self.controller.get_marker_pos('spike_thief_1_start')
	thief_1.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	character_util.set_emotion(thief_1, {name = 'attack'})

	thief_2.Position = self.controller.get_marker_pos('spike_thief_2_start')
	thief_2.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	local thief_1 = self.get_thief_1()
	local thief_2 = self.get_thief_2()

	thief_1.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
	thief_2.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil

	self.spike_fos = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'home_alone_spike_room_enter')
			and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.none then
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.enter_spike
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_spike_room, self)
		return true

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'home_alone_belt_room_enter')
			and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.before_enter_next then
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.done
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_belt_room, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

		local duration = (target_pos - start_pos).magnitude / speed
		local time_passed = 0

		while time_passed < duration do

			local cur_center_pos = start_pos * (1 - progress) + target_pos * progress

			spikes[1].Position = spike_1_offset + cur_center_pos

		Index = 2 @
		NextSections = 3 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.get_thief_1 = function() return get_character('home_alone_thief_1') end
	self.get_thief_2 = function() return get_character('home_alone_thief_2') end
	self.get_boy = function() return get_character('home_alone_kevin') end

	self.get_jump_pad = function() return get_field_object('home_alone_jump_pad') end
	self.get_room_exit = function() return get_field_object('home_alone_belt_exit') end

	self.event_state = {
		none = 0,
		room_entered = 1,
		done = 2,
	}
	self.current_event_state = self.event_state.none

	self.room_exit_interactable = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.room_exit_interactable = self.get_room_exit().Interactable
	self.get_room_exit().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	-- 이전 섹션에서 넘어온 경우
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress < 2 then
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.room_entered
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_room_scene, self)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.room_exit_interactable = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'home_alone_belt_room_enter')
			and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.none then
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.room_entered
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_room_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_room_exit())
			and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.room_entered then
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.done
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.exit_belt_room, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.get_thief = function(num)
		return get_character('home_alone_thief_'..num)
	end
	self.get_santa_thief = function(num)
		return get_character('home_alone_santa_thief_'..num)
	end
	self.get_mayreel = function()
		return get_character('mayreel_human')
	end
	self.get_kevin = function()
		return get_character('home_alone_kevin')
	end

	self.star_piece_name = 'home_alone_star_piece'
	self.home_alone_script = 'short_story_mayreel_home_alone_s4_'
	self.kevin_zone_name = 'kevin_event_zone'
	self.gift_item = 20548
	self.gift_box_1 = nil
	self.gift_box_2 = nil

end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	quest_util.load_pool_resource(
			'FX_dead'
	)
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	local kevin = self.get_kevin()

	character_util.set_position(kevin,field:GetMarker('home_alone_kevin').position)
	kevin.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 3 then
		self.controller:set_thief_after_belt()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	-- 섹션 3 프로그래스 넘길 때 해줘도 되지만, 이슈가 생겼을 때의 빠른 대응 + 섹션별 기능 분할을 위해 여기 남겨둠
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress < 3 then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'event', name = 'bgm_chasing'})
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.kevin_zone_name then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.kevin_event, self)
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.kevin_zone_name..2 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.walk4leg_event, self))

	end
	return false

	}

	self.get_bari = function() return get_character('bari') end
	self.get_mayreel = function() return get_character('mayreel') end

	self.snow_smoke_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead') end

	self.get_marker_pos = function(name) return field:GetMarker('s1_'..name).position end

	self.battlegate_name = 's1_battlegate_'
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	-- 이펙트 로드
	self.snow_smoke_effect()
end

function local_class:enter()
	self:pre_setting()
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.intro, self)
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	for i = 1, #self.npc_zone_enter_event do
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.npc_zone_enter_event[i].zone)
				and not self.npc_zone_enter_event[i].already_enter then
			self.npc_zone_enter_event[i].already_enter = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.npc_zone_enter_event[i].cb, self))
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local bari = self.get_bari()
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, bari) then
		character_util.remove_relate_event(bari, self.controller)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_bari, self))
	end
	return false
end

	self.get_mayreel_human = function() return get_character('mayreel_human') end

	self.get_snow = function(num) return get_field_object('s2_snow_' .. num) end
	self.get_tree = function(num) return get_field_object('s2_tree_' .. num) end
	self.get_snowball = function() return get_field_object('s3_snowball') end
	self.get_mayreel_human = function() return get_character('mayreel_human') end

	self.get_dead_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead') end
	self.get_hit_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit') end
	self.get_lasthit_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit') end
	self.get_snow_smoke_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_xmas_snow_smokescreen') end

	self.get_tackle_pos = function(num) return field:GetMarker('s2_qte_'.. num).position end
	self.get_snowball_path = function(num) return field:GetMarker('s2_snowball_path_'.. num).position end

	self.enter_tackle_zone = false

	self.enter_tint_zone_1 = false
	self.enter_tint_zone_2 = false

	-- QTE 변수
	self.swipe_type = ''
	self.is_qte_start = false

	self.snowball_speed = 0
	self.snowball_transform = nil

	self.tint_key_1 = 's2_tint_1'
	self.tint_key_2 = 's2_tint_2'
	self.tint_key_3 = 's2_tint_3'

	self.tint_color_1 = CS.UnityEngine.Color(0.27, 0.27, 0.57, 0.8)
	self.tint_color_2 = CS.UnityEngine.Color(0.24, 0.24, 0.54, 0.8)
	self.tint_color_3 = CS.UnityEngine.Color(0.2, 0.2, 0.5, 0.8)

	self.last_tint = 0
end

function local_class:enter()
	self:pre_setting()
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.intro, self)
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
	self.get_dead_effect()
	self.get_hit_effect()
	self.get_lasthit_effect()
	self.get_snow_smoke_effect()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	self.snowball_transform = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's2_qte_zone_2') and not self.enter_tackle_zone then
		self.enter_tackle_zone = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.tackle_event, self))
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's2_tint_zone_0') and self.last_tint ~= 0 then
		self.last_tint = 0
		field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key_1, 0.5)
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's2_tint_zone_1') and self.last_tint ~= 1 then
		self.last_tint = 1
		field:Tint(self.tint_key_1, self.tint_color_1, 0.5)
		field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key_2, 0.5)
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's2_tint_zone_2') and self.last_tint ~= 2 then
		self.last_tint = 2
		field:Tint(self.tint_key_2, self.tint_color_2, 0.5)
		field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key_3, 0.5)
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's2_tint_zone_3') and self.last_tint ~= 3 then
		self.last_tint = 3
		field:Tint(self.tint_key_3, self.tint_color_3, 0.5)
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if not self.is_qte_start then
		return false
	end

	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
		self.swipe_type = 'right'
		return true
	end

	return true
end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:qte_swipe()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe('right')

	self.swipe_type = ''
	self.is_qte_start = true

	while self.is_qte_start do
		coroutine.yield()
		if self.swipe_type == 'right' then
			yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, 0)
			break
		end
	end

	self.is_qte_start = false
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
end

function local_class:rolling_snowball_x(path, accel, rotate_angle)
	local snowball = self.get_snowball()
	local start_distance = (snowball.Position - path).magnitude
	local dir_vec = vector(1, 0, 0)
	local mayreel = self.get_mayreel()
	local play_sfx = false
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ball_01')
	while snowball.Position.x < path.x do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		self.snowball_speed = (self.snowball_speed + accel)

		snowball.Position = snowball.Position + (dir_vec * self.snowball_speed * dt)

		local progress = (start_distance - (snowball.Position - path).magnitude) / start_distance

		if progress > 0.5 and not play_sfx then
			play_sfx = true
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ball_01')
		end

		self.snowball_transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, -rotate_angle * progress)
		mayreel.Position = snowball.Position + self.snowball_transform.up + vector(0, 0.8, 0)
		character_util.spine_rotate(mayreel, -(rotate_angle * progress), 0)

		camera_util.move(snowball.Position, 0)
		coroutine.yield()
	end
	snowball.Position = path
	character_util.spine_rotate(mayreel, 0, 0)
	self.snowball_transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)
end

function local_class:rolling_snowball_z(path, accel, rotate_angle)
	local snowball = self.get_snowball()
	local start_distance = (snowball.Position - path).magnitude
	local dir_vec = vector(0, 0, -1)
	local mayreel = self.get_mayreel()
	character_util.spine_rotate(mayreel, 0, 0)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ball_01')
	while snowball.Position.z > path.z do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		self.snowball_speed = (self.snowball_speed + accel)

		snowball.Position = snowball.Position + (dir_vec * self.snowball_speed * dt)

		local progress = (start_distance - (snowball.Position - path).magnitude) / start_distance
		self.snowball_transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(-rotate_angle * progress, 0, 0)
		mayreel.Position = snowball.Position + self.snowball_transform.forward + vector(0, 0.6, 0)

		camera_util.move(snowball.Position, 0)
		coroutine.yield()
	end
	snowball.Position = path
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_snowball_hit_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_princess_stomp_02')
	self.snowball_transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)
	self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(snowball.Position + vector(0, 0.3, -0.5))
	self.get_lasthit_effect():Instantiate(snowball.Position + vector(0, 0.3, -0.5))
end

function local_class:snowball_sine_move()
	local snowball = self.get_snowball()
	local rotate_angle = 720
	local mayreel = self.get_mayreel()
	local start_pos = snowball.Position
	local target_pos = get_field_object('xmas_tree_big_center').Position + vector(0.5, 0, 3)
	local duration = 0.8
	local height = 7
	local time_passed = 0
	character_util.spine_rotate(mayreel, 0, 0)
	coroutine.yield()
	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local lerp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)
		local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height + lerp_pos.y
		local cur_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(lerp_pos, cur_y)
		snowball.Position = cur_pos
		camera_util.move(snowball.Position, 0, { ignorecameragrids = true })
 		self.snowball_transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, -rotate_angle * progress)
		character_util.spine_rotate(mayreel, -(rotate_angle * progress), 0)
		mayreel.Position = snowball.Position + self.snowball_transform.up + vector(0, 0.8, 0)

		coroutine.yield()
	end
	camera_util.move(get_field_object('xmas_tree_big_center').Position + vector(1.5, 0, 3), 0.3)
end

function local_class:snow_fall(snow)
	local snow_start_pos = snow.Position
	local fall_calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(0, 20, 10, 0)
	fall_calculator:ScaleTime(2)
	while not fall_calculator:IsDone() do
		fall_calculator:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = fall_calculator:GetDistance()
		snow.Position = vector(snow_start_pos.x, dist_y, snow_start_pos.z)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	snow.Position = vector(snow_start_pos.x, 0, snow_start_pos.z)
end

function local_class:spread_stars(angle, duration, size, height)
	local star_list = { get_field_object('display_xmas_star_1'), get_field_object('display_xmas_star_2'),
	                    get_field_object('display_xmas_star_3') }

	local star_start_pos_list = { star_list[1].Position,
	                        star_list[2].Position,
	                        star_list[3].Position }

	local star_end_pos = { star_list[1].Position + vector(0, 0 , 20),
	                        star_list[2].Position + vector(-20, 0 , -20),
	                        star_list[3].Position + vector(20, 0 , -20) }

	local rotate_dir = { -1, 1, -1 }

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local star_size = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(1, size, progress)

		for i = 1, 3 do
			local lerp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(star_start_pos_list[i], star_end_pos[i], progress)
			local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height + lerp_pos.y
			local cur_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(lerp_pos, cur_y)

			star_list[i].transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(45, 0, angle * progress * rotate_dir[i])
			star_list[i].transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * star_size
			star_list[i].Position = cur_pos
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
	star_list[1].ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	star_list[2].ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	star_list[3].ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
end

function local_class:quest_check()
	local quest_list = {7001005, 7001006, 7001007}
	local stars = {get_field_object('hill_star'),
				  get_field_object('yeti_star'),
				  get_field_object('tree_star')}

	local all_clear = true
	local cleared_quest_count = 0

	for i = 1, #quest_list do
		local quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(quest_list[i])
		local key = ('bari_' .. stars[i].Name)
		if quest == nil or not quest.IsComplete then
			all_clear = false
			self.controller:add_quest_marker(key, stars[i])
		else
			self.controller:remove_quest_marker(key)
			cleared_quest_count = cleared_quest_count + 1
		end
	end

	-- 별 달고 있는 soldier, 별 배치
	if cleared_quest_count > 0 then
		local star = get_field_object('display_xmas_star_' ..1)
		local display_pos = field:GetMarker('display_xmas_star_' .. 4).position
		star.Position = display_pos
		local display_xmas_star_soldier_1 = get_character('display_xmas_star_soldier_' .. 1)

		character_util.set_emotion(display_xmas_star_soldier_1, {name = 'idle'})
		character_util.set_anim(display_xmas_star_soldier_1, {name = 'push', loop = true})
	end
	if cleared_quest_count > 1 then
		local star = get_field_object('display_xmas_star_' ..2)

		character_util.set_position(display_xmas_star_soldier_2, field:GetMarker('display_xmas_star_soldier_2').position)
		character_util.set_direction(display_xmas_star_soldier_2, 'left')

		character_util.set_anim(display_xmas_star_soldier_2, {name = 'push', loop = true})

		character_util.set_anim(display_xmas_star_soldier_3, {name = 'push', loop = true})
	end

	return all_clear

function local_class:boss_event()
