	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 0.5 초 뒤에 미니게임 완전 해제
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	local mini_game = mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate(self.minigame_name)
	mini_game:dispose()

	-- 미니게임용 메이릴 disabled
	local mayreel = get_character('mayreel_human_minigame')
	character_util.set_active_state(mayreel, 'disabled')

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 마커 캐싱
	local enemy_tower_pos = field:GetMarker('enemy_tower').position
	local ally_tower_pos = field:GetMarker('ally_tower').position

	-- 캐릭터 캐싱
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local carol = get_character('captain_rabbit_minigame')
	local boss = get_character('minigame_boss')
	local df_tree = get_character('s8_boss_df_tree')

	character_util.set_position(leader, ally_tower_pos + vector(0, 0, -1))
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'surprise' })

	-- 아군 타워 배치
	character_util.set_position(df_tree, ally_tower_pos)
	character_util.set_anim(df_tree, { name = 'idle' })
	character_util.set_scale_factor(df_tree, 'temp_size', 2)
	df_tree.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false
	df_tree.SpineController.SpineOffset = df_tree.SpineController.SpineOffset - vector(0, 0, 0.25)

	-- 유닛 동적 생성
	local units = load_util.create_optimized_npcs_async({
		shielder_1 = 'shortstory_xm_df_shield_a',
		shielder_2 = 'shortstory_xm_df_shield_a',
		spearman_1 = 'shortstory_xm_df_spear_a',
		spearman_2 = 'shortstory_xm_df_spear_a',
		spearman_3 = 'shortstory_xm_df_spear_a',
		magician_1 = 'shortstory_xm_df_magician_a',
		archer_1 = 'shortstory_xm_df_archer_a'
	})

	-- 유닛들 인덱스 베이스 테이블로 저장
	local sheilder = { units.shielder_1, units.shielder_2 }
	local spearman = { units.spearman_1, units.spearman_2, units.spearman_3 }
	local range_unit = { units.magician_1, units.archer_1 }
	local melee_unit = { units.shielder_1, units.shielder_2, units.spearman_1, units.spearman_2, units.spearman_3}

	-- 카매라 위치 설정
	local cam_pos = ally_tower_pos + vector(6, 0, 0.5)

function local_class:set(unit_table, marker_name, dir, anim, emo)
	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(unit_table) do
		local unit = unit_table[i]
		if unit ~= nil then
			local pos = field:GetMarker(marker_name .. i).position
			character_util.set_position(unit, pos)

-- 병사들 맞고 뒤로 밀리는 연출 (EaseOutExpo로 자연스럽게)
function local_class:pushed(target, duration, distance)
	local time_passed = 0
	local original_pos = target.Position

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutExpo(unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration), 0, 1, 1)
		local cur_pos = original_pos + progress * distance

		character_util.set_position(target, cur_pos)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 이팩트 스무스 이동
function local_class:move_fx(fx, target_pos, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local original_pos = fx.transform.localPosition

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)

		local cur_pos = vector_util.lerp(original_pos, target_pos, progress)
		fx.transform.localPosition = cur_pos
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_s9_57', skip = true })

	--메이릴: [small] 그러니까… 가… 같이 할아버지한테 가자…
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_s9_58', skip = true, scale = 0.75 })

	--바리: 메이릴…!
	character_util.normal_jump(bari, true)
	character_util.set_emotion(bari, { name = 'surprise' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bari, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_s9_59', skip = true })

	--바리: 솔직하게 말해주니까 너무 기뻐요…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(bari, { name = 'cast' }, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bari, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_s9_60', skip = true })

	--바리: 카마엘 님에게도 그렇게 조금만 더 마음을 열어주면 굉장히 기뻐하실 거예요.
	character_util.remove_anim(bari)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bari, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_s9_61', skip = true })

	--메이릴: 으응…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_s9_62', skip = true })

	--바리: 고마워요, 메이릴. 그럼 이제 카마엘 님에게 가볼까요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(bari, {name = "nod", count = 1})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bari, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_s9_63', skip = true })

	camera_util.move_async(self.cam_pos, 0)

	--바리와 메이릴 화면 좌측으로 걸어감.
	local princess_walk_to_x = leader.Position.x + 1
	character_util.move_to(bari, vector(self.cam_pos.x - screen_extents_x - 2, 0, bari.Position.z),
			nil, 2, true, true)
	character_util.move_distance_async(leader, vector(-3, 0, 0), nil, 2, true, true)

	--바리는 계속 걸어서 화면 좌측으로 퇴장.
	--걸어가다가 걸음 멈추고 우측 바라보는 메이릴, 동시에 화면 우측에서 꼬마공주와 에바 달려나옴
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		wait_for_sec(1)
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
		character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
	end))

	local princess_appear_pos = carol_snowman.Position + vector(screen_extents_x + 2, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_active_state(princess, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(princess, princess_appear_pos)

	character_util.set_active_state(eva, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(eva, eva_appear_pos)

	local wait_run_progress = 0
	wait_all({

			local target_pos = vector(princess_walk_to_x, 0, princess.Position.z)
			character_util.remove_anim(princess)
			character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'smile'})
			character_util.move_waypoint(princess, target_pos, run_speed, true,
					'stop', 'floor', 'left', true, 0, function()
						character_util.remove_emotion(princess)
						wait_run_progress = wait_run_progress + 1
					end)

			while not screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(princess.Position) do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			--꼬마 공주: 와아아아~~!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_s9_64', skip = true })
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			wait_for_sec(2)
			local target_pos = vector(princess_walk_to_x + princess_eva_x_gap, 0, eva.Position.z)
			character_util.remove_anim(eva)
			character_util.set_emotion(eva, { name = 'tired'})
			character_util.move_waypoint(eva, target_pos, run_speed, true,
					'stop', 'floor', 'left',true, 0, function()
						character_util.remove_emotion(eva)
						wait_run_progress = wait_run_progress + 1
					end)

			while not screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(eva.Position) do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			--에바: 공주님! 뛰면 위험합니다!!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_s9_65', skip = true })
		end)
	})

	while wait_run_progress < 2 do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--꼬마 공주 캐럴 눈사람을 보고 surprise, 점프 1회
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.normal_jump(princess, true)

	--꼬마 공주: 누… 눈사람이 예뻐졌어…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'cast' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_s9_66', skip = true })

	--에바 (left, surprise, idle) : 정말이군요…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.set_emotion(eva, { name = 'surprise' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_s9_67', skip = true })

--- 캐릭터들에 검은색 틴트 먹이는 함수
---@param characters table 틴트 먹일 캐릭터 테이블
function local_class:tint_characters(characters)
	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(characters) do
		local character = characters[i]
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(character, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		character.SpineController:AddFadeColor(character.Name, CS.UnityEngine.Color(0, 0, 0, 0), 1, 1)
	end
end

--- 캐릭터들에 검은색 틴트 제거하는 함수
------@param characters table 틴트 제거할 캐릭터 테이블
function local_class:remove_tint_characters(characters)
	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(characters) do
		local character = characters[i]
		character.SpineController:RemoveFadeColor(character.Name, 1)
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		wait_for_sec(1)

		for i = 1, table_util.get_size(characters) do
			local character = characters[i]
			field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats, character)
		end
	end))
end

return local_class

-- 미니게임 관련 연출 중에 반복해서 불릴 수 있는 연출을 여기에 정의 하겠음
-- ex) 게임 시작전 반복 연출 (여기에 정의)
-- ex) 보스 연출 (한 번만 나오는 연출이니까 해당 섹션에 정의)
local local_class = newclass('XMDefenseGameCommonLogics')

function local_class:init(controller)
	self.controller = controller
	self.listener = self

	-- 미니게임 이름
	self.minigame_name = 'XMDefenseGame'

	self.get_snowman_soldier = function()
		return get_character('s7_8_snowman_soldier')
	end

	-- 캐럴 npc 얻기
	self.get_carol = function()
		return get_character('captain_rabbit')
	end

	-- 캐럴 npc 위치 얻기
	self.get_carol_pos = function()
		return field:GetMarker('s5_8_captain_rabbit_pos').position
	end

	--region 미니게임 관련
	self.get_laser_effect = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_s_laser_light')
	end

	self.get_fx_last_hit = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
	end

	self.get_jump_effect = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_minotaur_jump")
	end

	self.get_magic_circle = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('MagicCircle_AppearIdle')
	end

	self.tint_key = 'appear_boss'
	--endregion

	-- 미니게임 상태
	self.minigame_state = {
		-- 시작 가능
		start_available = 1,
		-- 시작 불가능
		start_unavailable = 2
	}
	self.cur_minigame_state = self.minigame_state.start_available

	-- 미니게임 시작 연출 함수 담은 테이블
	self.minigame_start_table = {
		function() self:minigame_start_a()  end,
		function() self:minigame_start_b()  end,
		function() self:minigame_start_c()  end
	}

	-- 섹션 넘어가서 자동 실행되는 시작 연출 함수 담은 테이블
	self.minigame_auto_start_table = {
		function() return self:minigame_auto_start_a() end,
		function() return self:minigame_auto_start_b()  end
	}

	-- 미니게임 실패 시 재생할 연출 함수 담은 테이블
	self.minigame_fail_table = {
		function() return self:minigame_fail_a()  end
	}

	-- 미니게임 성공 시 재생할 연출 함수 담은 테이블
	self.minigame_clear_table = {
		function() self:minigame_clear_a() end
	}

	-- 튜토리얼을 진행 하였는지?
	self.is_show_spawn_tutorial = false

	return self.listener
end

function local_class:enter()
	local carol = self.get_carol()
	character_util.add_listener(carol, self.controller)
	character_util.set_position(carol, self.get_carol_pos())
	character_util.set_direction(carol, 'down')

	-- 미니게임용 캐럴 세팅
	local minigame_carol = get_character('captain_rabbit_minigame')
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(minigame_carol, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	minigame_carol.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 1)
	minigame_carol:HideWeapon(true)
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	-- 미니게임용 이팩트 프리로드
	self:get_laser_effect()
	self:get_fx_last_hit()
	self:get_jump_effect()
	self:get_magic_circle()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.circle_effect then
		self.circle_effect:Dispose()
		self.circle_effect = nil
	end
end

--- npc와 상호작용으로 미니게임 시작 전 연출 진행하는 함수
--- @param type_num number 미니게임 시작 연출 함수 타입
function local_class:minigame_interact_start(type_num)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	self.cur_minigame_state = self.minigame_state.start_unavailable

	local carol = self.get_carol()
	self.controller:remove_quest_marker(carol.Name)
	character_util.set_direction(carol, 'right')
	party_util.align_party(carol.Position, 'right', 1)

	-- 곧 있으면 적들이 몰려올 거야.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carol, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_s6_s7_s8_1', skip = true })

	-- 메이릴, 악마를 상대할 준비는 됐어?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carol, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_s6_s7_s8_2', skip = true })

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- 당연하지!
		{ 'short_story_mayreel_s6_s7_s8_3', 'mercy' },
		-- 아직 할일이 남았다.
		{ 'short_story_mayreel_s6_s7_s8_4', 'normal' }
	})

	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 결전의 시간이야!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
		character_util.set_anim(carol, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carol, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_s6_s7_s8_27', skip = true })

		self.minigame_start_table[type_num]()
	else
		-- 그래? 준비가 되면 말해줘.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carol, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_s6_s7_s8_5', skip = true })
		self.controller:add_quest_marker(carol.Name, carol)
		self.cur_minigame_state = self.minigame_state.start_available

		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end
end

--region 실제 미니게임 시작 연출 진행하는 함수들
--- 미니게임 시작을 위한 기본 세팅해 주는 함수
---@param phase_name string 진행할 웨이브 데이터 테이블 키
---@return table 미니게임 루아 테이블
function local_class:minigame_start_base(phase_name)
	self.cur_minigame_state = self.minigame_state.start_unavailable

	-- 페이드 아웃
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.get_carol())

	local is_mini_game_load_complete = false
	mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.minigame_name, phase_name, function()
		is_mini_game_load_complete = true
	end)

	while not is_mini_game_load_complete do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 카메라 기본 위치로 이동
	local mini_game = mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate(self.minigame_name)
	local defense_pos = field:GetMarker('tower_defense_pos').position
	camera_util.move_async(defense_pos, 0.1)
	mini_game:move_camera_x_axis(-4.5, 0)
	mini_game:set_control_block(true)

	return mini_game
end

function local_class:minigame_start_a()
	local mini_game = self:minigame_start_base('short_story_xm_phase_one')

	-- 페이드 인
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_intro_shivermore_01')
	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	-- 튜토리얼 진행
	local is_play_bgm = self:minigame_tutorial(mini_game)

	-- 첫 번째 웨이브 부터 미니게임 시작
	self:start_mini_game(is_play_bgm)
end

function local_class:minigame_start_b()
	self:minigame_start_base('short_story_xm_phase_two')

	local snowman_soldier = self.get_snowman_soldier()
	character_util.set_position(snowman_soldier, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(snowman_soldier)

	-- 페이드 인
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_intro_shivermore_01')
	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	-- 또 온다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_s6_s7_s8_10'
	, skip = true, screen_pos = vector(-150, -75), bubble_direction = 'ct', scale = 1.25 })

	-- 두 번째 웨이브 부터 미니게임 시작
	self:start_mini_game(false)
end

function local_class:minigame_start_c()
	self:minigame_start_base('short_story_xm_phase_three')

	local snowman_soldier = self.get_snowman_soldier()
	character_util.set_position(snowman_soldier, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(snowman_soldier)

	-- 페이드 인
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_intro_shivermore_01')
	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	-- 온다! 조금만 더 힘내!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_s6_s7_s8_15'
	, skip = true, screen_pos = vector(-150, -75), bubble_direction = 'ct', scale = 1.25 })

	-- 두 번째 웨이브 부터 미니게임 시작
	self:start_mini_game(false)

function local_class:start_mini_game(is_play_bgm)
	if not is_play_bgm then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/short_story_xm/audio:bgm_carol_game'
		, state = 'event' })
	end

	mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.minigame_name)
end

--endregion

--region 섹션 넘어가서 자동으로 미니게임 시작전 연출 진행하는 함수
--- 미니게임 시작 선택지 연출 함수
function local_class:minigame_start_choose_event()
	local carol = self.get_carol()

	-- 메이릴, 악마를 상대할 준비는 됐어?
	character_util.set_direction(carol, 'right')
	character_util.remove_emotion(carol)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carol, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_s6_s7_s8_2', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- 당연하지!
		{ 'short_story_mayreel_s6_s7_s8_3', 'mercy' },
		-- 아직 할일이 남았다.
		{ 'short_story_mayreel_s6_s7_s8_4', 'normal' }
	})

	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 결전의 시간이야!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
		character_util.set_anim(carol, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carol, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_s6_s7_s8_27', skip = true })

		return true
	else

		field_ui_manager:Show()

--- @param atuo_start_type_num number 미니게임 시작 전 자동 연출 함수 타입
--- @param start_type_num number 미니게임 시작 연출 함수 타입
function local_class:minigame_auto_start_selector(atuo_start_type_num, start_type_num)
	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 0.5 })
	local auto_start = self.minigame_auto_start_table[atuo_start_type_num]()

	if auto_start then
		self.minigame_start_table[start_type_num]()
	end
end

function local_class:minigame_auto_start_a()
	local carol = self.get_carol()
	local snowman_soldier = self.get_snowman_soldier()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	-- 화면비 고려해 화면 밖에 배치
	local screen_extents_x = screen_util.get_world_screen_size().x / 2
	local spawn_pos = carol.Position - vector(screen_extents_x + 2, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_position(snowman_soldier, spawn_pos)

	-- 페이드 인
	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	-- 흥! 시시한 놈들이잖아?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = 'short_story_mayreel_s6_s7_s8_7', skip = true })

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(snowman_soldier,
			carol.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
			5, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'right', true)

function local_class:first_use_minigame_special_move(quest_prgress)
	local mini_game = mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate(self.minigame_name)
	mini_game:set_control_block(true)

	-- 카메라를 기지쪽으로 이동 시킨다.
	local cur_pos = mini_game.camera.Transform.localPosition
	local target_pos = vector(-5, cur_pos.y, cur_pos.z)
	local duration = (cur_pos - target_pos).magnitude / 20

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(cur_pos, target_pos, progress)
		mini_game.camera.Transform.localPosition = pos
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	mini_game.camera.Transform.localPosition = target_pos

	-- 캐럴 등장 연출
	local carol = get_character('captain_rabbit_minigame')
	self:show_minigame_carol(carol)

	-- 기지의 체력이 절반 아래로 내려가면 버튼을 눌러서 내 필살기를 사용할 수 있어.
	character_util.set_emotion(carol, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carol, { key = 'xm_defense_game_special_move_3'
	, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true, scale = 1.25, bubble_direction = 'rb' })

	-- 하지만, 한 라운드에 딱 한 번만 사용할 수 있으니까 조심해야 해!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carol, { key = 'xm_defense_game_special_move_4'
	, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true, scale = 1.25, bubble_direction = 'rb' })

	--캐롤 퇴장 연출
	self:leave_minigame_carol(carol)

	-- 커스텀 스테이트 저장
	quest_util.set_custom_state(quest_prgress, 'xm_defense_game_special_move', 1)

	-- 필살기 튜토리얼 종료
	mini_game:set_control_block(false)
	mini_game.is_special_move_tutorial = false
end

-- 미니게임 중 캐럴 등장 연출
function local_class:show_minigame_carol(carol)
	-- 캐럴이 히어로 랜딩으로 등장해서 에너지파 발사
	character_util.set_active_state(carol, 'enabled')
	local pos = field:GetMarker('ally_spawn_point').position
	local jump_height = 10
	character_util.set_anim(carol, { name = 'carol', loop = false })
	character_util.set_position(carol, pos + vector(0, jump_height, 0), true)
	character_util.set_direction(carol, 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(carol)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(carol, { name = 'walk4legs', loop = false }
	, { name = 'sleep_deep' })

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local fall_duration = 0.4
	local start_pos = carol.Position
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_duration, carol.Position.y, 0)
	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_duration do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		if start_pos.y + dist_y > 0 then
			character_util.set_position(carol, start_pos + vector(0, dist_y, 0), true)
		else
			character_util.set_position(carol, vector(start_pos.x, 0, start_pos.z))
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
	self.get_fx_last_hit():Instantiate(carol.Position)
	character_util.set_position(carol, vector(start_pos.x, 0, start_pos.z))

	local mini_game = mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate(self.minigame_name)
	mini_game:camera_shake(0.5, 0.35)

	-- 레이저 이팩트 출력
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(carol)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(carol, { name = 'gauntlet_handskill2', loop = false }
	, { name = 'attack' })
	wait_for_sec(0.6)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_light_laser_01')
	local laser_pos = carol.Position + vector(1.25, 0, -0.35)
	local laser_effect = self:get_laser_effect():Instantiate(laser_pos)
	laser_effect.transform.localScale = vector(-2.25, 2.25, 2.25)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	-- 실제 데미지주는 시점에서 xm_defense_special_move_end 호출
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'xm_defense_special_move_end' }))

	-- n초 뒤에 레이저 이팩트 dispose
	wait_for_sec(2)

	laser_effect:Dispose()
	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(carol)
end

function local_class:leave_minigame_carol(carol)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(carol, { name = 'get' }, { name = 'attack' })
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	self.get_jump_effect():Instantiate(carol.Position)

	local start_pos = carol.Position
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local fall_duration = 0.25
	local jump_height = 10

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_prologue_wind_01')
	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_duration do
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(unity_class.time.time - cur_time, 0, 1, fall_duration))
		character_util.set_position(carol, start_pos + vector(0, jump_height * progress, 0), true)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_position(carol, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_active_state(carol, 'disabled')
end

	if not result then

		mini_game:dispose_mini_game_while_playing()
	end

	return result

function local_class:minigame_tutorial(mini_game)
	local screen_pos_value = vector(-140, -110)
	local enemy_char = nil
	local is_play_bgm = false

	local first_string_key = 'short_story_mayreel_s6_tutorial_'
	if not self.is_show_spawn_tutorial then
		local mayreel = get_character('mayreel_human_minigame')

		-- 캐럴 : 이 곳이 우리가 지켜야 할 방어선이야!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader, { key = first_string_key .. 1
		, skip = true, screen_pos = screen_pos_value, bubble_direction = 'ct', scale = 1.25 })

		character_util.normal_jump(mayreel, true)
		character_util.set_emotion(mayreel, { name = 'attack' })

		-- 화면 쉐이크
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_02')
		mini_game:camera_shake(0.3, 0.75)
		wait_for_sec(0.15)

		-- 카메라를 적군 쪽으로 이동
		mini_game:move_camera_x_axis(8, 0.5)

		-- 캐럴 : 저길 봐!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader, { key = first_string_key .. 2
		, skip = true, screen_pos = screen_pos_value, bubble_direction = 'ct', scale = 1.25 })

		-- 적 스폰 및 Top UI 활성화
		is_play_bgm = true
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/short_story_xm/audio:bgm_carol_game'
		, state = 'event' })
		local enemy = mini_game:enemy_spawn(101)
		mini_game:set_top_ui_active_state(true)

		-- 2.5초간 유닛 로직 돌아가도록
		-- 이후 포탈에서 악마 1기 생성되서 걸어오는 것 보여줌
		local time_passed = 0
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		while time_passed < 2.5 do
			dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
			time_passed = time_passed + dt
			mini_game:update_unit_manager(dt)
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		enemy_char = enemy:get_unit()
		character_util.set_anim(enemy_char, { name = 'idle' })

		-- 캐럴 : 악마들이 포탈을 통해 침략하기 시작했어!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader, { key = first_string_key .. 3
		, skip = true, screen_pos = screen_pos_value, bubble_direction = 'ct', scale = 1.25 })
		character_util.remove_emotion(mayreel)

		-- 화면 좌측 거대 트리로 다시 카메라 이동
		mini_game:move_camera_x_axis(-8, 0.5)

		-- 캐럴 : 그래도 걱정하지 마, 우린 정령 병사들이 있잖아?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader, { key = first_string_key .. 4
		, skip = true, screen_pos = screen_pos_value, bubble_direction = 'ct', scale = 1.25 })

		-- 버튼 UI 활성화
		mini_game:set_bottom_ui_active_state(true)

		-- 캐럴 : 정령들을 일어나게 하려면 트리의 별빛 에너지가 필요해.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader, { key = first_string_key .. 5
		, skip = true, screen_pos = screen_pos_value, bubble_direction = 'ct', scale = 1.25 })

		-- 에너지가 2가 넘을 때까지 에너지 로직 업데이트
		while mini_game.cur_energy < 2.05 do
			dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
			mini_game:update_energy(dt)
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 캐럴 : 저 버튼을 눌러봐, 악마와 맞서 싸울 보병이 나타날 거야!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader, { key = first_string_key .. 6
		, skip = true, screen_pos = screen_pos_value, bubble_direction = 'ct', scale = 1.25 })

		-- 튜토리얼 Darken
		field:Darken('tutorial', 0.5, 0.1)

		-- 튜토리얼 손가락 활성화
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_style_guide_01')
		mini_game.ui_controller:set_spawn_tutorial_notice(true)

		-- 게임 상태를 플레이 중으로 잠시 변경
		mini_game.is_playing_game = true

		-- 에너지를 소모할 때까지 대기
		while mini_game.cur_energy > 2 do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		mini_game.is_playing_game = false

		-- 에너지를 소모했으니 1프레임 에너지 로직 업데이트
		mini_game:update_energy(unity_class.time.deltaTime)

		-- 튜토리얼 손가락 비활성화
		mini_game.ui_controller:set_spawn_tutorial_notice(false)

		-- 튜토리얼 Undarken
		field:Undarken('tutorial', 0.1)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mayreel)
		character_util.set_emotion(mayreel, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(mayreel, { name = 'release', sfx = '01_swing_01', count = 2
		, end_call_func = function() character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mayreel) end })

		-- 캐럴 : 이렇게 병사들을 지휘해 트리를 지키고 악마의 포탈을 파괴해야 해!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader, { key = first_string_key .. 7

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_snowman()) then
		if self.controller.current_step == self.controller.quest_step.snowman_fall_down then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_snowman, self)
			return true
		elseif self.controller.current_step == self.controller.quest_step.quest_end then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.get_snowman(), { key = self.event_script..74, skip = false })
			return true
		end
	end

	-- 퀘스트 종료 후 원라인
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_other_snowman(1)) then
		self:other_snowman_one_line(1, 75, 72)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_other_snowman(2)) then
		self:other_snowman_one_line(2, 76, 52)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_other_snowman(3)) then
		self:other_snowman_one_line(3, 77, 53)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_other_snowman(4)) then
		self:other_snowman_one_line(4, 78, 73)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter then return end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.crow_steal_cap_zone and self.controller.current_step == self.controller.quest_step.quest_start then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.crow_steal_cap, self))
	elseif zone_name == self.snowman_fall_down_zone then
		if self.saw_fall_down_snowman == false then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.snowman_chase_n_fall, self))
		elseif self.snowman_following == true then
			self.try_refuse_event = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.refuse_to_go_back, self)
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.check_snowman_zone then
		if self.snowman_following == true and self.start_to_be_disturbed == false then
			self.start_to_be_disturbed = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.crow_attack, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.hookshot_event_zone and self.saw_crow_steal_key_event == false then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.crow_steal_key, self)
	elseif zone_name == self.hookshot_middle_zone and
			self.controller.current_step == self.controller.quest_step.hookshot_puzzle_start then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.crow_move_middle, self))
	elseif zone_name == self.hookshot_arrival_zone and
			self.controller.current_step == self.controller.quest_step.hookshot_puzzle_middle then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.try_catch_crow, self))
	elseif zone_name == self.crow_tree_zone and
			self.controller.current_step == self.controller.quest_step.hookshot_puzzle_end then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.meet_crow, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	local reset_switch = get_field_object(self.holdable_key_reset_switch_name)

	if e.IsTurningOn and self.controller.current_step >= self.controller.quest_step.hookshot_puzzle_end then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, reset_switch) then
			local key = get_field_object(self.tree_zone_key_obj_name)

			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Stepper, user_party.Leader) and
					key.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled and not key.Holdable.IsHeld then
				message_system:SendSync(key, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)

				self.get_fx_reset():Instantiate(key.Position)

				key.Position = vector(263, 0, 10)

				self.get_fx_reset():Instantiate(key.Position)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown and
			self.controller.current_step == self.controller.quest_step.snowball_puzzle_disturbed then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.mayreel_jump_by_touch, self))
		self.tap_count = self.tap_count + 1
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
		self.is_qte_success = true
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	local crow_name = e:GetParamAt(0)
	local event_name = e:GetParamAt(1)

	local crow = get_character(crow_name)
	if crow ~= nil then
		if event_name == 'crow_disturbs' then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.crow_disturbs, self))
		elseif event_name == 'crow_attack' then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.crow_attack, self))
		elseif event_name == 'check_leader_Jump_state' then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.check_leader_Jump_state, self))
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_move_fo_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_crow())
			and (self.controller.current_step == self.controller.quest_step.hookshot_puzzle_start or
			self.controller.current_step == self.controller.quest_step.hookshot_puzzle_middle) then
		local tree_zone_key = get_field_object(self.tree_zone_key_obj_name)
		local crow = self.get_crow()
		tree_zone_key.Position = vector(crow.Position.x - 0.4, crow.Position.y - 0.55, crow.Position.z)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:move_drop_item(item, pos, height, duration)
	local start_pos = item.Position
	local end_pos = pos

	local timer = 0

	while timer < duration do
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, timer / duration)
		local cur_y = (duration * timer - timer * timer) * height

		item.Position = cur_pos + vector(0, cur_y, 0)

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	item.Position = end_pos
end

function local_class:refuse_to_go_back()
	local cap_chase_snowman = self.get_snowman()

	-- 눈사람 (left, tired, cast) : 저기… 모자 찾으러 가는 거 맞지…?

	character_util.set_anim(cap_chase_snowman, { name = 'cast' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cap_chase_snowman, { key = self.event_script..79, skip = true })

	-- 메이릴 (left, attack, idle) : …길을 잘못 들었을 뿐이야!
	character_util.look_at(user_party.Leader, cap_chase_snowman)
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader, { key = self.event_script..31, skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(cap_chase_snowman)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
	end

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.move_to(user_party[i], user_party[i].Position + vector(2,0,0),
				nil, 1.5, true, true)
	end

	character_util.move_to_async(cap_chase_snowman, cap_chase_snowman.Position + vector(2,0,0),
			nil, 1.5, true, true)

	self.try_refuse_event = false

	if self.start_to_be_disturbed == true then
		self:call_crow_attack_routine()
	end

function local_class:crow_attack()
	local crow = self.get_crow()
	local timer = 0
	local delay_start = true
	local arrival_pos = unity_class.vector3.zero
	local target_pos = unity_class.vector3.zero
	local leader_crashed = false

	while self.controller.current_step == self.controller.quest_step.snowball_puzzle do
		if delay_start == true then
			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		if self.try_refuse_event == true then
			return
		elseif user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Flying then
			self:call_check_leader_jump_state_routine()
			return
		end

		-- 캐스팅 준비 완료된 경우
		if timer >= self.crow_attack_delay then
			local rad = math.pi * CS.UnityEngine.Random.value * 2
			local x = math.cos(rad) * self.distance_between_crow_n_leader
			local z = math.sin(rad) * self.distance_between_crow_n_leader

			local crow_start_pos = user_party.Leader.Position + vector(x, 0, z)

			coroutine.yield(nil)

			-- 되돌아가는 이벤트 체크
			if self.try_refuse_event == true then
				return
			elseif user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Flying then
				self:call_check_leader_jump_state_routine()
				return
			end

			if self.controller.current_step ~= self.controller.quest_step.snowball_puzzle then
				return
			end

			-- 까마귀 공격 범위를 미리 경고해 줄 AttakRange를 설정
			local attack_range_size_x = 30
			local attack_range_size_z = 1

			local target_dir = (user_party.Leader.Position - crow_start_pos).normalized

			local rad = CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Acos(target_dir.x)
			if target_dir.z > 0 then
				rad = rad * -1
			end

			local angle = CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Rad2Deg * rad

			if self.attack_range == nil then
				self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(
						crow_start_pos + attack_range_size_x / 2 * target_dir + vector(0, 0.03, 0),
						vector(attack_range_size_x, attack_range_size_z))
			else
				self.attack_range.transform.localPosition =
					crow_start_pos + attack_range_size_x / 2 * target_dir + vector(0, 0.03, 0)
			end
			self.attack_range.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crow_01')
			self.attack_range:Show(0)

			local pre_leader_pos = vector(user_party.Leader.Position.x, 0.7, user_party.Leader.Position.z)

			-- 1초 대기 후, 공격 범위 표시는 제거하고 까마귀 이동
			wait_for_sec(1)

			coroutine.yield(nil)

			self.attack_range:Hide()

			-- 되돌아가는 이벤트 체크
			local is_return = false

			if self.try_refuse_event == true then
				is_return = true
			elseif user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Flying then
				self:call_check_leader_jump_state_routine()

				is_return = true
			elseif lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState,
					CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState) then
				is_return = true
			end

			if is_return then
				character_util.set_position(crow, vector(999, 0, 999))

				return
			end

			crow_start_pos.y = 1.5
			local vector_dist = target_dir * 50
			arrival_pos = crow_start_pos + vector_dist
			target_pos = pre_leader_pos + vector(0.3, 0, 0)

			if crow_start_pos.x < target_pos.x then
				character_util.set_locked_dir(crow, 'right')
			else
				character_util.set_locked_dir(crow, 'left')
			end

			character_util.set_position(crow, crow_start_pos, true)
			character_util.set_emotion(crow, { name = 'mad' })

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_wing_02')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crow_02')
			character_util.move_waypoint(
					crow, { target_pos }, 12, true, 'stop', 'flying')

			delay_start = false

			wait_for_sec(0.3)

			-- 타이머 초기화
			timer = 0
		else
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if crow.Position.x == arrival_pos.x and crow.Position.z == arrival_pos.z then
			delay_start = true
		end

		if delay_start == false then
			leader_crashed = self:crow_catch_mayreel(arrival_pos)

			if leader_crashed == true then
				character_util.stop(crow)

				coroutine.yield(nil)

				local return_to_default_pos = false

				if self.try_refuse_event == true then
					return_to_default_pos = true
				elseif user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Flying then
					self:call_check_leader_jump_state_routine()
					return_to_default_pos = true
				end

				if return_to_default_pos then
					character_util.move_waypoint(
							crow, { arrival_pos }, 12, true, 'stop', 'flying')
					return
				end

				local event_name = 'crow_disturbs'
				message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(crow, { self.crow_name, event_name }))
				self.controller.current_step = self.controller.quest_step.snowball_puzzle_disturbed
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:check_leader_Jump_state()
	while user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Flying do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self:call_crow_attack_routine()
end

function local_class:crow_catch_mayreel(arrival_pos)
	local crow = self.get_crow()
	local leader_crashed = false

	local collide_fos = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(
			user_party.Leader.Bounds.center, user_party.Leader.Bounds)

	if collide_fos:Contains(crow) and not leader_crashed then
		leader_crashed = true
	end

	collide_fos:Dispose()

	if leader_crashed == false then
		character_util.move_waypoint(
				crow, { arrival_pos }, 12, true, 'stop', 'flying')
	end

	return leader_crashed
end

function local_class:crow_disturbs()
	local crow = self.get_crow()
	local snowman = self.get_snowman()

	if self.try_refuse_event == true then
		return
	elseif user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Flying then
		return
	end

	-- 플레이어 캐릭터가 PushState 상태일 경우 초기화
	local current_state = get_party_leader().FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState

	if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterPushState) then
		command_util.execute_push_end(get_party_leader(), current_state.PushTarget)
	end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	if self.controller.current_step == self.controller.quest_step.snowball_puzzle then
		self.controller.current_step = self.controller.quest_step.snowball_puzzle_disturbed
	end

	if crow.Position.x < user_party.Leader.Position.x + 0.3 then
		character_util.set_locked_dir(crow, 'right')
	else
		character_util.set_locked_dir(crow, 'left')
	end

	character_util.move_to_async(crow, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0.3, 0.7, 0),
			nil, 10, true, true)

	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'damaged' })

	character_util.set_anim(snowman, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.set_emotion(snowman, { name = 'attack' })

	character_util.set_locked_dir(crow, 'left')

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	if self.try_refuse_event == true then
		return
	elseif user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Flying then
		return
	end

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTurboTap(1)
	self.swipe_type = ''
	self.tap_count = 0
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	self.turbo_tap_camera = true

	local timer = 0
	local jump_timer = 0
	local effect_timer = 0

	local cancel_duration = 3

	local origin_parent = crow.Transform.parent

	crow.Transform:SetParent(user_party.Leader.Transform:Find('spine_container'):GetChild(0).transform)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	local sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_pet_bite_loop_01', loop = true })

	while self.tap_count < 7 and timer < cancel_duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		jump_timer = jump_timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		effect_timer = effect_timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if jump_timer >= self.crow_jump_delay then
			jump_timer = 0

			if self.crow_jump_dir_left == true then
				self.crow_jump_dir_left = false

				character_util.set_locked_dir(crow, 'left')
				character_util.jump_move(crow, crow.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
						2, 0.5, true, 'right')
			else
				self.crow_jump_dir_left = true

				character_util.set_locked_dir(crow, 'right')
				character_util.jump_move(crow, crow.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
						2, 0.5, true, 'left')
			end
		else
			character_util.set_anim(crow, { name = 'attack' })
		end

		if effect_timer >= self.crow_effect_delay then
			effect_timer = 0

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crow_02')
			self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(
					user_party.Leader.Position + crow.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	sfx:Stop()

	crow.Transform:SetParent(origin_parent)

	self.crow_jump_dir_left = true
	self.mayreel_jump_dir_left = true

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	self.turbo_tap_camera = false

	local arrival_pos = crow.Position + vector(-8, 1.5, 15)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/short_story_xm/audio:bgm_carol_night', state = 'field' })

	character_util.set_locked_dir(crow, 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(crow)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_wing_02')
	character_util.move_waypoint(crow, { arrival_pos },
			10, true, 'stop', 'flying')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(snowman)

	self.controller.current_step = self.controller.quest_step.snowball_puzzle

	local event_name = 'crow_attack'
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(crow, { self.crow_name, event_name }))

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:try_catch_crow()
	local snowman = self.get_snowman()
	local crow = self.get_crow()

	self.controller.current_step = self.controller.quest_step.hookshot_puzzle_end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	--character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(-0.5,0,0), nil, 1.5, true, true)
	party_util.align_party(user_party.Leader.Position + vector(-2.2,0,0),
			'right', 0.5, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.convert_to_npc(snowman)

	-- 메이릴 (left, attack, jump 1회) : 이번엔 절대 안놓쳐!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.normal_jump(user_party.Leader)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader, { key = self.event_script..34, skip = true })

	-- QTE - left
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Mod(0.15, 'qte')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe('left')

	while self.is_qte_success == false do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, 0)
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Unmod('qte')

	if self.is_qte_success == true then
		local landing_pos = crow.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0)---0.3)
		landing_pos.y = user_party.Leader.Position.y
		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'bomb_attack', loop = false, scale = 0.3 })
		character_util.jump_move(user_party.Leader, landing_pos, 3, 1.5, false)

		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Mod(0.3, 'slow_event')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')

		local check_crow_pos_x = crow.Position.x
		local notice_dist_x = (user_party.Leader.Position.x - check_crow_pos_x) * 0.7
		local away_dist_x = (user_party.Leader.Position.x - check_crow_pos_x) * 0.4

		-- 메이릴과 까마귀 x축 거리가 처음거리보다 70% 이하일 경우, 까마귀 플레이어 인식
		while math.abs(user_party.Leader.Position.x - check_crow_pos_x) > notice_dist_x do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		character_util.set_direction(crow, 'right')

		-- 메이릴과 까마귀 x축 거리가 처음거리보다 30% 이하일 경우, 까마귀 좌상단으로 날아 도망감
		while math.abs(user_party.Leader.Position.x - check_crow_pos_x) > away_dist_x do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crow_02')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_wing_02')
		character_util.move_waypoint(crow, { vector(215.5, 3, 28) },
				8, true, 'stop', 'flying')

		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'prostrate' })
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'surprise' })

		CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Unmod('slow_event')
		CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Mod(1.5, 'fast_event')

		while (user_party.Leader.Position.x - landing_pos.x) > 0 do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Unmod('fast_event')

		camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_02')
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'damaged' })
		self.get_lasthit_effect():Instantiate(user_party.Leader.Position)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.shake(user_party.Leader, 0.05, 0.5)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		-- 메이릴 점프하며 일어남
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
		character_util.mario_jump_new(user_party.Leader, 'left')

		--self.drop_item_key.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		-- 눈사람, 파티 follow
		local snowman_waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
		snowman_waypoint_list:Add(snowman.Position + vector(0,0,1))
		snowman_waypoint_list:Add(user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0,0,1))

		character_util.move_waypoint(snowman, snowman_waypoint_list, 3,
				false, 'stop', 'floor', 'down')
		character_util.set_direction(snowman, 'down')

		-- 메이릴 (left, attack, idle) : 으으… 뭐가 저렇게 빨라?!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'attack' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(
				user_party.Leader, { key = self.event_script..35, skip = true })

		while snowman.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction ~= CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		-- 눈사람 (left, tired, idle) : 그… 잡을 수 있는 거지…?
		character_util.set_emotion(snowman, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.set_direction(snowman, 'down')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman, { key = self.event_script..36, skip = true })

		-- 메이릴 (right, mad, jump 1회) : 당연하지! 무조건 잡을 거야!
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'up')
		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'throw', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'mad' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
		character_util.normal_jump_async(user_party.Leader)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(
				user_party.Leader, { key = self.event_script..37, skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(snowman)

		-- 나무 구역 셋팅
		character_util.set_position(crow, vector(222.5, 4.2, 28), true)
		character_util.set_direction(crow, 'right')
		character_util.set_emotion(crow, { name = 'doyagao' })

		-- 모자 아이템 배치
		self.drop_item_snowman_hat = drop_item_util.create_item({
			pos = vector(222.5, 3.8, 28), lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			itemid = 20549, notforinven = true, sprscale = 1, showoncharacter = true
		})

		self.drop_item_snowman_hat.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 180, 0)

		-- 눈사람, 파티 follow
		character_util.convert_to_following_npc(snowman, user_party, false,
				CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.OutBattleZone)

		character_util.set_direction(snowman, 'down')
	end

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:meet_crow()

	camera_util.resize_to(3, 0.5)

function local_class:shake_item(item, magnitude)
	local item_pos = item.SpriteTransform.localPosition
	local shadow_pos = item.ShadowTransform.localPosition
	local shake_range = magnitude / 2

	while self.is_shake_hat do
		local cur_shake_x = unity_class.random.Range(-shake_range, shake_range)
		local cur_shake_z = unity_class.random.Range(-shake_range, shake_range)

		item.SpriteTransform.localPosition = item_pos + vector(cur_shake_x, 0, cur_shake_z)
		item.ShadowTransform.localPosition = shadow_pos + vector(cur_shake_x, 0, cur_shake_z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	item.SpriteTransform.localPosition = item_pos
	item.ShadowTransform.localPosition = shadow_pos
end

function local_class:wait_and_set_hat_layer()
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.drop_item_snowman_hat:SetSortingLayer(false)
end

function local_class:check_jump_state()
	-- 캐릭터가 점프대로 날아오는 중이면 이벤트 발생하지 않게 넘어감
	if  lua_helper.type_compare(
			user_party_leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterJumpState) then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

	self.drop_item_snowman_hat = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = vector(222.5, 3.8, 28), lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		itemid = 20549, notforinven = true, sprscale = 1, showoncharacter = true
	})

	self.drop_item_snowman_hat.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 180, 0)

	character_util.convert_to_following_npc(snowman, user_party, false,
			CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.OutBattleZone)

	self.controller.current_step = self.controller.quest_step.hookshot_puzzle_end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	if self.controller.current_step == self.controller.quest_step.hookshot_puzzle_start then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))
	end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

	drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.drop_item_snowman_hat)
	drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.drop_item_egg)
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryMayreelTreeStarSection1')

		Comment = ShortStoryMayreelTreeStar 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	--qte 체크
	self.swipe_type = ''
	self.touch_count = 0

	self.intro = false
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	self:set_environment()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'tree_star_start' and not self.intro then
		self.intro = true
		--sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.star_tree, self)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.star_tree, self))
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
		self.swipe_type = 'left'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
		self.swipe_type = 'right'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
		self.swipe_type = 'up'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
		self.swipe_type = 'down'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		self.swipe_type = 'touch_down'
		self.touch_count = self.touch_count + 1
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:set_environment()
	local star = get_field_object('tree_star')

function local_class:qte_swipe(type, count)
	self.touch_count = 0
	local default_count = lua_helper.get_or_default(count, 0)

	if type == 'touch_down' then
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTurboTap(1)
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe(type)
	end

	self.swipe_type = ''
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	while self.swipe_type ~= type or self.touch_count < default_count do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
end

return local_class

	yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
end

function local_class:move_star(transform, target_pos, duration)
	local time_passed = 0

	local start_pos = transform.position

	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

	end

	end

	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'yeti_star_greed' and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.none then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.intro
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.intro, self)

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.agro_1, self))

	elseif zone_name == 'yeti_star_out' and self.current_progress ~= self.progress_enum.none then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.go_back, self)
	end

	return false

function local_class:agro_1()
	local captain = get_character('captain_rabbit')
	--맵 수정으로 인하여 트리거 존 이상 없는지 확인 부탁드립니다.
	--존 진입 시 캐럴이 눈사람 뒤에서 우측으로 나타남
	character_util.set_with_marker(captain, field:GetMarker('yeti_star_snowman'))
	captain.Position = captain.Position + vector(0, 0, 3)
	character_util.set_direction(captain, 'down')

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(captain, captain.Position + vector(0, 0, -3), 4, true)

	--캐럴이 이동하여 3번 예티 위에서 3.5초 간격으로 돌 던지고 다시 숨음
	--3번 예티 붉은 시야 꺼지고 up 바라봄.
	--예티 돌 맞을 때 레드펄스, 돌 맞고 나서 예티 (점프 2회 + emoticon_bubble_angry)
	--3번 예티 캐럴이 다음 위치 이동해도 계속 위를 보고 있음
	--예티 별 퀘스트 클리어 후 이 장소로 재진입해도 up 방향 유지

	local change_yeti = false
	local real_yeti = get_character('star_yeti_3')
	local fake_yeti = get_character('star_yeti_3_fake')

	fake_yeti.Position = real_yeti.Position
	character_util.set_direction(fake_yeti, 'down')
	real_yeti.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	while self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.agro_1 do
		self:throw_rock_to_target(captain, fake_yeti)

		if not change_yeti then
			change_yeti = true
			character_util.set_direction(fake_yeti, 'up')
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		if self.current_progress ~= self.progress_enum.agro_1 then
			return
		end

		character_util.normal_double_jump(fake_yeti, '01_jump_01')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_die_fat_ogre_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(fake_yeti, nil, 'angry')

		wait_for_sec(0.4)

	end
end

function local_class:throw_rock_to_target(thrower, target)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	--character_util.look_at(thrower, target)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_anim(thrower, { name = 'attack', loop = false })

	local rock = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ itemid = 20019, notforinven = true, pos = thrower.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
			  target = target.Position + vector(0, 1, 0), lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.3, showoncharacter = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(thrower)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_projectile_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	-- 명중에 성공했을 경우 실행

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(target.Position + vector(0, 1, 0))

	character_util.spine_pulse_color(target, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.667)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(target, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	rock:ConsumeComplete()
end

			local real_yeti = get_character(yeti_str)
			local fake_yeti = get_character(yeti_str .. '_fake')

			if real_yeti.Position == vector(999, 0, 999) then
				real_yeti.Position = fake_yeti.Position
				if i == 2 then
					real_yeti.Position = field:GetMarker('yeti_star_yeti_6').position
				end
				fake_yeti.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			end
		end
	end

	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.intro

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	self:agro_0()

	self.is_detecting = false
end

function local_class:move_target_bezier_curve(transform, spline_list, cycle)
	local calculator = CS.Oak.BezierCurveCalculator()

	local curve_type = CS.Oak.BezierCurveType.Linear

	if #spline_list == 3 then
		curve_type = CS.Oak.BezierCurveType.Quadratic
	elseif #spline_list == 4 then
		curve_type = CS.Oak.BezierCurveType.Cubic
	end

	local list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	for i = 1, #spline_list do
		list:Add(spline_list[i])
	end

	calculator:Add(list, cycle, curve_type)

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < cycle do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local cur_pos = vector(0, 0, 0)

		calculator:UpdateFrame(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		cur_pos = calculator.CurrentPosition

		transform.position = cur_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(transform.position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
end

return local_class

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))

--[[
	ZoneEnterEvent 이벤트 처리
]]
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter or not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return false end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.innuit_runaway_zone then

		if self.current_progress >= self.progress_enum.coco_run_1 then return false end

		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.coco_run_1
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.coco_run, self, 1))

	elseif zone_name == self.blizzard_start_zone then

		if not self.heard_scream then

			self.heard_scream = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.scream_event, self)

		end

		if self.current_progress >= self.progress_enum.blizzard_event then return false end

		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.blizzard_event
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.blizzard_start, self))

	elseif zone_name == self.blizzard_end_zone then

		if self.current_progress >= self.progress_enum.see_snow_man then return false end

		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.see_snow_man
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.blizzard_end, self))

	elseif zone_name == self.inuit_and_snowman_event_zone then

		if self.current_progress >= self.progress_enum.inuit_and_snowman then return false end

		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.inuit_and_snowman
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.inuit_and_snowman, self))

	elseif zone_name == self.prince_and_general_event_zone then

		if self.current_progress >= self.progress_enum.progress_end then return false end

		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.progress_end
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.prince_and_general, self)

	elseif zone_name == self.lynch_event_zone then

		if self.lynch_routine == nil then

			local victim = get_character(self.normal_inuit_name .. 4)
			local attacker_1 = get_character(self.ice_snowman_name_3 .. 6)
			local attacker_2 = get_character(self.ice_snowman_name_3 .. 5)

			self.lynch_routine = coroutine_class.coroutine(
				util.cs_generator(self.attack_scene, self, victim, attacker_1, attacker_2, true))
		end

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, self.lynch_routine)

	elseif zone_name == self.blizzard_fight_zone then

		if self.current_progress > self.progress_enum.coco_run_2 then return false end

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.weak_blizzard_start, self))
	end

	return false
end

--[[
	ZoneLeaveEvent 이벤트 처리
]]

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not e.FullLeave or not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return false end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.blizzard_start_zone then
		-- 위치, 플래그 체킹
		if user_party_leader.Position.x < 11 or self.heard_scream then return false end

		self.heard_scream = true

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scream_event, self))

	elseif zone_name == self.lynch_event_zone then

		if self.lynch_routine == nil then return false end

		stop_coroutine(self.lynch_routine);
	end

	return false
end

	CameraGridEnterEvent 이벤트 처리

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) or e.CameraGrid.name == 'innuit_runaway_grid' then
		if self.current_progress >= self.progress_enum.coco_run_2 then return false end

		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.coco_run_2
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.coco_run, self, 2))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--[[
	시작하자 마자 만난 검은 씰루엣. 가까이 가니까 도망간다.
]]
function local_class:coco_run(index)
	local witch = get_character(self.witch_name)

	local speed = 10

	if index == 1 then
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_jump_01')
		character_util.jump(witch, 0.4, 0.3)
		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		character_util.move_waypoint_async(witch, witch.Position + vector(11, 0, 0), speed,
			false, nil, nil, nil, true)

		witch.Position = vector(7, 0, 0.5)
	else
		speed = 8
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(witch, witch.Position + vector(2, 0, 0), speed,
			false, nil, nil, nil, true)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_jump_01')
		character_util.jump(witch, 1.5, 0.5)

		character_util.move_waypoint_async(witch, witch.Position + vector(4, 0, 0), speed,
			false, nil, nil, nil, true)

		character_util.move_waypoint_async(witch, witch.Position + vector(3, 0, 0), speed,
			true, nil, nil, nil, true)

		character_util.jump(witch, 1.5, 0.5)

		character_util.move_waypoint_async(witch, witch.Position + vector(4, 0, 0), speed,
			false, nil, nil, nil, true)

		character_util.move_waypoint_async(witch, witch.Position + vector(6, 0, 0), speed,
			true, nil, nil, nil, true)

		character_util.set_position(witch, vector(99, 0, 99))
	end
end

--[[
	맵에 진입하면 눈보라가 불기 시작한다
]]
function local_class:weak_blizzard_start()
	if not self.is_blizzard_active then
		--- flag set
		self.is_blizzard_active = true

		--- blizzard start
		self.controller:blizzard_start()

		self.blizzard_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_blizzard_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2, type_priority = "event", player_priority = "player"
		})
	end
end

function local_class:blizzard_start()
	if not self.is_blizzard_active then
		--- flag set
		self.is_blizzard_active = true

		--- blizzard start
		self.controller:blizzard_start()
	end

	local fade_time = 0.5
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	--- blizzard update
	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fade_time do
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Max((unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / fade_time, 0) * 0.9

		self.controller:blizzard_update(progress)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	stage.BuffManager:AddBuff(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None,
			user_party_leader, self.blizzard_buff, 0, false, false)

	-- 플레이어 UI 꺼주기
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		stage.FieldUIManager:RemoveUI(user_party[i], CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	end

	for index = 1, self.ice_snowman_num_1 do
		local character = get_character(self.ice_snowman_name_1 .. index)
		stage.FieldUIManager:RemoveUI(character, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	end

	local witch = get_character(self.witch_name)
	stage.FieldUIManager:RemoveUI(witch, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
end

-- 설인이 얼어붙으면서 소리지르는 이벤트
function local_class:scream_event()
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "03_dialogue_negative_01", volume = 2})

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party_leader,
			{
				key = self.scream_string_key,
				bubble_type = 'shout',
				screen_pos = vector(200, 0),
				skip = true
			})

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "01_freeze_01" })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "01_fade_out_02" })
end

--[[
	얼어붙은 설인 지대에 도착하면 눈보라가 서서히 사라진다
]]
function local_class:blizzard_end()
	--- flag set
	self.is_blizzard_active = false

	--- blizzard inner param refresh
	self.controller:blizzard_color_refresh()

	--coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
	--	util.cs_generator(self.controller.scene[self.scene_name_1], self.controller.scene))

	local wait_time = 2.5
	local fade_time = 0.7
	local remove_buff_time = 1.5
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local remove_buff = false

	self.blizzard_sfx:FadeOut(wait_time)

	--- blizzard update
	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < wait_time do
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Max(1 - (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / fade_time, 0)

		if unity_class.time.time - cur_time >= remove_buff_time and not remove_buff then
			remove_buff = true

			stage.BuffManager:RemoveBuff(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None,
				user_party_leader, self.blizzard_buff)

			-- 플레이어 UI 켜주기
			for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
				stage.FieldUIManager:SetUI(user_party[i], CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
			end

			for index = 1, self.ice_snowman_num_1 do
				local character = get_character(self.ice_snowman_name_1 .. index)
				stage.FieldUIManager:SetUI(character, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
			end

			local witch = get_character(self.witch_name)
			stage.FieldUIManager:SetUI(witch, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		self.controller:blizzard_update(progress)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--- blizzard dispose
	self.controller:blizzard_dispose()
end

--[[
	세 갈래 길에 도착하자, 얼어붙은 설인으로 인해 일어난 이누이트과 설인 사이의 갈등을 보게된다
]]
function local_class:inuit_and_snowman()
	self.controller.scene[self.scene_name_2](self.controller.scene)

	local victim = get_character(self.inuit_name .. 1)
	local attacker_1 = get_character(self.snowman_name .. 1)
	local attacker_2 = get_character(self.snowman_name .. 2)

	self.attack_routine = coroutine_class.coroutine(
		util.cs_generator(self.attack_scene, self, victim, attacker_1, attacker_2, false))

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, self.attack_routine)
end

--[[
	반복해서 이누이트를 구타하는 설인들
]]
function local_class:attack_scene(victim, attacker_1, attacker_2, set_anim)
	while true do
		if not set_anim then
			set_anim = true

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.scene_set_victim, self, victim))
		end

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.scene_victim_reaction, self, attacker_1, victim, set_anim))

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.8))

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.scene_victim_reaction, self, attacker_2, victim, set_anim))

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.8))
	end
end

--[[
	맞는 이누이트들의 리액션
]]
function local_class:scene_victim_reaction(attacker, victim)
	local offset = (attacker.Bounds.center - victim.Bounds.center).x > 0 and -1 or 1

	local hit_preset = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_preset)
	local sfx_info = CS.Oak.SfxInfo()
	sfx_info.sfxName = self.hit_sfx
	sfx_info.playPosition = victim.Bounds.center

	if hit_preset == nil then
		return
	end

	attacker.SpineController:DeviateLocal(vector(0.5 * offset, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)
	character_util.set_anim(attacker, { name = 'attack', loop = false })

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))

	music_player:PlaySfx(sfx_info)
	hit_preset:Instantiate(victim.Bounds.center)

	character_util.remove_anim(attacker)

	victim:Shake(0.04, 0.2)
	victim.SpineController:DamageSquish(1)
	victim.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
	victim.SpineController:DeviateLocal(vector(0.5 * offset, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)
end

function local_class:scene_set_victim(victim)
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))

	character_util.set_anim(victim, { name = 'prostrate' })
	character_util.set_emotion(victim, { name = 'damaged' })
end

function local_class:prince_and_general()
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_boss_intro', state = 'event', mix = 2 })

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

	self.controller.scene[self.scene_name_3](self.controller.scene)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

function local_class:snowman_attack()
	local snowman_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	local inuit_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)

	for index = 1, self.snowman_num do
		snowman_list:Add(get_character(self.snowman_name .. index))
	end

	for index= 1, self.inuit_num do
		inuit_list:Add(get_character(self.inuit_name .. index))
	end

	local attacker = snowman_list[0]
	local victim = inuit_list[0]

	attacker.SpineController:DeviateLocal(vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)
	character_util.set_anim(attacker, { name = 'attack', loop = false })

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))

	local sfx_info = CS.Oak.SfxInfo()
	sfx_info.sfxName = self.hit_sfx
	sfx_info.playPosition = victim.Bounds.center
	music_player:PlaySfx(sfx_info)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_preset):Instantiate(victim.Position)

	if field:IsInSameCameraGrid(user_party_leader.Position, attacker.Position) then
		camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(attacker)

	victim.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	local knock_back_info = CS.Oak.KnockBackInfo()
	knock_back_info.type = CS.Oak.KnockBackType.Physics
	knock_back_info.stun = true
	knock_back_info.direction = vector(-1, 0, 0)
	knock_back_info.impactForce = 8800
	knock_back_info.impactTime = 0.05
	knock_back_info.muCoefficient = CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient

	local knock_back_state = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(victim, knock_back_info)
	victim.FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(knock_back_state))

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(victim, self.damaged_scream_string_key)

	character_util.set_anim(victim, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_emotion(victim, { name = 'damaged' })

	for index = 1, inuit_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_emotion(inuit_list[index], { name = 'surprise' })
		inuit_list[index].SpineController:Jump(0.5, 0.3)
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.7))

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01', parent = victim })

	victim.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
	character_util.set_anim(victim, { name = 'prostrate' })
	character_util.set_emotion(victim, { name = 'confused' })

	for index = 1, inuit_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_emotion(inuit_list[index], { name = 'tired' })
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))
end

-- 챔피언 소드 연출
function local_class:show_champ_detect_effect()
	local resholder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	local champ_detect_effect = nil

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			resholder, "effects/stage/champ_detect", "champ_detect", function(prefab)
				champ_detect_effect = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
				champ_detect_effect:SetActive(false)
			end)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 챔피언 소드 연출 시작
	user_party_leader.SpineController:SetSortingLayer("Default", 2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "01_champ_sword_01", type_priority = "event", player_priority = "npc" })

	field:Tint("snowmountain_main", unity_class.color(0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 1), 0.5)

	camera_util.shake(0.05, 0.5)

	champ_detect_effect.transform.localPosition = vector(110, 0, -22)
	champ_detect_effect:SetActive(true)

	wait_for_sec(0.75)

	stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Show()

	coroutine.yield(stage.FieldUINarrationBox:SetNarration(
			game_string:GetString('teatan_main_s4_champ_narration'), 0, 1))

	stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Hide()

	-- 챔피언 소드 연출 종료
	field:RemoveTint("snowmountain_main", 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.75)

	CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(champ_detect_effect)

	resholder:Dispose()

	user_party_leader.SpineController:SetSortingLayer("Default", 0)
end

return local_class

function local_class:throw_evidence(item, size_factor, target, thrower)
	if target == nil then
		target = get_character('snowman_reporter_a')
	end
	if thrower == nul then
		thrower = get_character('coco')
	end

	if self.current_stage_item ~= nil then
		if self.throw_ongoing then
			return
		end

		local last_it = self.current_stage_item:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.StageItem))
		last_it:CancelDrop(vector(0, 0, 0))
		self.current_stage_item:Dispose()
		self.current_stage_item = nil
	end

	character_util.set_anim(thrower, { name = "attack", loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(0.1)


	self.throw_ongoing = true

	local diff = (target.Bounds.center - thrower.Bounds.center).normalized
	local start_pos = thrower.Bounds.center + diff * 0.2
	local end_pos = target.Bounds.center
	local fly_y = 2.7
	start_pos.y = fly_y
	end_pos.y = fly_y

	local it = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('stage_item'):Instantiate(start_pos)
	local stage_item = it:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.StageItem))
	stage_item:SetItem(item)

	stage_item.ShadowActive = false
	stage_item.Item.localScale = vector(size_factor, size_factor, size_factor)

	self.current_stage_item = it

	local speed = 15
	local angle_speed = 1080
	local time_passed = 0
	local anim_reset = true
	local duration = (end_pos - start_pos).magnitude / speed
	local fall_scale = 1.5
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(4, 8, 0, 1)
	free_fall:ScaleTime(fall_scale)
	local drop_duration = free_fall:GetTotalTime() / fall_scale
	local rotation_duration = duration + drop_duration

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.camera_move, self.controller, self.marker_center, duration, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear, nil))
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "01_throw_01" })

	while true do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		time_passed = time_passed + dt

		stage_item.Item.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(90, time_passed / rotation_duration * angle_speed, 0))

		if anim_reset and time_passed >= 0.4 then
			anim_reset = false
			character_util.set_anim(thrower, { name = "idle", loop = true })
		end

		if time_passed >= duration then
			stage_item.Position = end_pos
			break
		else
			local prog = time_passed / duration
			stage_item.Position = start_pos * (1 - prog) + end_pos * prog
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	target.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
	target.SpineController:DamageSquish(target)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.damage_reaction, self, target))
	camera_util.shake(0.07, 0.15)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "01_hit_comic_01" })

	local drop_pos = end_pos - vector(0, 0, 0.85)
	local drop_time_passed = 0

	while true do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		free_fall:Proceed(dt)
		drop_time_passed = drop_time_passed + dt
		time_passed = time_passed + dt

		if time_passed >= rotation_duration then
			time_passed = rotation_duration
		end

		stage_item.Item.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(90, time_passed / rotation_duration * angle_speed, 0))

		local pos = stage_item.Position
		if drop_time_passed >= drop_duration then
			pos = drop_pos
		else
			local prog = drop_time_passed / drop_duration
			pos = end_pos * (1 - prog) + drop_pos * prog
		end

		pos.y = fly_y + free_fall:GetDistance()
		stage_item.Position = pos

		if anim_reset and time_passed >= 0.4 then
			anim_reset = false
			character_util.set_anim(thrower, { name = "idle", loop = true })
		end


		if free_fall:IsDone() then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if anim_reset then
		wait_for_sec(0.4 - time_passed)
		anim_reset = false
		character_util.set_anim(thrower, { name = "idle", loop = true })
	end

	self.throw_ongoing = false
end
