function local_class:camera_move(to_marker, duration)
	local to_pos = self.marker_center
	if to_marker == self.markers.prince then
		to_pos = self.marker_prince
	elseif to_marker == self.markers.defense then
		to_pos = self.marker_defense
	elseif to_marker == self.markers.prosecutor then
		to_pos = self.marker_prosecutor
	elseif to_marker == self.markers.innuits then
		to_pos = self.marker_innuits
	elseif to_marker == self.markers.snowmen then
		to_pos = self.marker_snowmen
	elseif to_marker == self.markers.testimony then
		to_pos = self.marker_center + vector(0, 0, 1)
	elseif to_marker == self.markers.helper	then
		to_pos = self.marker_center - vector(0, 0, 2)
	end

	if duration == nil then
		duration = 0.25
		if to_marker == self.markers.snowmen and self.current_marker ~= self.markers.prosecutor then
			duration = 0
		elseif to_marker == self.markers.innuits and self.current_marker ~= self.markers.defense then
			duration = 0
		elseif self.current_marker == self.markers.snowmen and to_marker ~= self.markers.prosecutor then
			duration = 0
		elseif self.current_marker == self.markers.innuits and to_marker ~= self.markers.defense then
			duration = 0
		end
	end

	self.current_marker = to_marker
	yield_return_func(self.controller.camera_move, self.controller, to_pos, duration, CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCubic, nil)

function local_class:show_choice_list(texts, tendencies)
	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	local wait_for_branch = true
	local choice = 0

	for i = 0, texts.Count - 1 do
		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString(texts[i]),
			Tendency = tendencies[i],
			Callback = function()
				wait_for_branch = false
				choice = i
			end
		})
	end

	local choice_state = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
	choice_state.Branchs = branches
	choice_state.Talker = user_party[0]

	ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)
	while wait_for_branch do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	self.branch_choice = choice
end

local local_class = newclass('SnowMountainMainSection12')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = SnowMountainMain @
		Comment = 재판이 끝나고 장군이 플레이어에게 감사 인사를 전한다, 설산을 떠나는 플레이어 뒤로 코코가 쫓아오며 엔딩. @
		Index = 11 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.enum = {
		--- 초기 상태
		idle = 0,
		--- 장군과 interact가 끝난 상태
		interact_finished = 1,
		--- 사건 현장으로 돌아옴
		enter_crime_room = 2,
		--- 블리자드 진행 중
		blizzard_event = 3,
		--- 종료
		section_end = 4
	}

	--- 현재 진행도
	self.progress = nil

	--- constants field
	do
		self.door_num = 2
		self.snowman_elite_guard_num = 3
		self.intaract_num_max = 3

		--- character name
		self.general_name = 'snowman_general'
		self.coco_name = 'coco'
		self.prosecutor_name = 'snowman_prosecutor'
		self.maco_name = 'maco'
		self.reporter_name = "snowman_reporter_b"
		self.snowman_elite_guard_name = 'event_snowman_elite_guard_'
		self.innuit_judge_name = "innuit_judge"

		--- tile map field object name
		self.right_door_name = 'crime_scene_door_right_'
		self.lower_door_name = 'crime_scene_door_lower_'
		self.exit_name = 'exit_next_stage'

		--- zone name
		self.crime_room_zone = 'crime_room'
		self.blizzard_start_zone = 'section_12_start_blizzard'
		self.end_zone = 'section_12_end'

		--- scene name
		self.setting_scene_name = 'setting_12'

		--- quest etc name
		self.quest_marker_name = 'snowmountain_main'
		self.tracker_name_1 = 'snowmountain_main_s12_tracker_0'
		self.tracker_name_2 = 'snowmountain_main_s12_tracker_1'
		self.tracker_name_3 = 'snowmountain_main_s12_tracker_2'

		--- string key name
		self.talk_string_key = 'snowmountain_main_s12_talk_'
		self.general_talk_string_key = 'snowmountain_main_s12_talk_general_'
		self.color_key = 'snowmountain_main_s12'

		--- buff name
		self.blizzard_buff = 'speed_cap_persistent'
	end

	self.is_blizzard_active = false

	self.interact_checker = {}

	self.interact_num = 0
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_2 then return true end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	self.progress = self.enum.idle

	self.lua_event_listener = CS.Oak.LuaIEventListener(self)

	local general = get_character(self.general_name)
	general.Interactable:AddListener(self.lua_event_listener)

	self.interact_checker[get_character(self.prosecutor_name)] = false
	self.interact_checker[get_character(self.maco_name)] = false
	self.interact_checker[get_character(self.reporter_name)] = false

	self.interact_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	self.interact_list:Add(get_character(self.prosecutor_name))
	self.interact_list:Add(get_character(self.maco_name))
	self.interact_list:Add(get_character(self.reporter_name))

	get_character(self.innuit_judge_name).Interactable.Talk = "snowmountain_main_s12_talk_3_1"

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress ~= 11 then
		self.controller.scene[self.setting_scene_name](self.controller.scene)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	local exit_tile = get_field_object(self.exit_name)

	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name_1))

	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_2 then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, exit_tile.position)
	else
		for key, _ in pairs(self.interact_checker) do
			if lua_helper.type_compare(key.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
				key.Interactable:AddListener(self.lua_event_listener)

				quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(key)

				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(
					string.format('%s%s', self.quest_marker_name, key.Name),
					self.quest_progress.QuestId, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, key)
			end
		end

		-- 다른 곳으로 빠질 여지를 막기 위해 기존 출구로 가는 문은 임시로 닫아 둠
		for index = 1, 2 do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create("crime_scene_door_lower_" .. index))
		end

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.start_event, self)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	for key, _ in pairs(self.interact_checker) do
		if lua_helper.type_compare(key.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
			key.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.lua_event_listener)
		end
	end

	local general = get_character(self.general_name)
	if general ~= nil and lua_helper.type_compare(general.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		general.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.lua_event_listener)
	end

	self.interact_checker = nil

	if self.lua_event_listener ~= nil then
		self.lua_event_listener:Dispose()
		self.lua_event_listener = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:get_musics()
	-- add section musics here
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

--[[
	InteractEvent 이벤트 처리
	]]
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local target = e.Target

	local general = get_character(self.general_name)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, general) then
		if self.interact_num >= self.intaract_num_max then
			if self.progress == self.enum.idle then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_general, self, false, false)
			else
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_general, self, true, false)
			end
		else
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_general, self, false, true)
		end
	end

	if self.interact_checker ~= nil and self.interact_checker[target] ~= nil then
		for i = 0, self.interact_list.Count - 1 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.interact_list[i]) then
				self.interact_checker[target] = true

				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_charater, self, target, i)

				break
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

--[[
	ZoneEnterEvent 이벤트 처리
	]]
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter or not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return false end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.blizzard_start_zone and self.progress < self.enum.blizzard_event then
		self.progress = self.enum.blizzard_event

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.blizzard_start, self))
	elseif zone_name == self.crime_room_zone and self.progress < self.enum.enter_crime_room then
		self.progress = self.enum.enter_crime_room
	elseif zone_name == self.end_zone and self.progress == self.enum.blizzard_event then
		self.progress = self.enum.section_end

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.ending, self)
	end

	return false
end

--[[
	ZoneLeaveEvent 이벤트 처리
	]]
function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not e.FullLeave or not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return false end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.blizzard_start_zone and self.progress == self.enum.blizzard_event then
		self.is_blizzard_active = false

		stage.BuffManager:RemoveBuff(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, user_party_leader, self.blizzard_buff)

		self.controller:blizzard_dispose()

		self.blizzard_sfx:FadeOut(0)

		self.progress = self.enum.enter_crime_room
	end

	return false
end

--[[
	맵 시작 지점에 진입하면 나오는 이벤트
	눈보라가 불기 시작함
	]]
function local_class:blizzard_start()
	--- flag set
	self.is_blizzard_active = true

	--- blizzard start
	self.controller:blizzard_start()

	self.blizzard_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_blizzard_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2, type_priority = "event", player_priority = "player"
	})

	local min_z = -8
	local max_z = -27
	local diff = math.abs(max_z - min_z)
	local apply_buff = false

	--- blizzard update
	while self.is_blizzard_active do
		local z = math.abs(user_party_leader.Position.z - max_z)
		local progress = z / (diff * 2)

		if progress > 0.3 and not apply_buff then
			apply_buff = true

			stage.BuffManager:AddBuff(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None,
					user_party_leader, self.blizzard_buff, 0, false, false)

			-- 플레이어 UI 꺼주기
			for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
				stage.FieldUIManager:RemoveUI(user_party[i], CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
			end
		elseif progress < 0.3 and apply_buff then
			apply_buff = false

			stage.BuffManager:RemoveBuff(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, user_party_leader, self.blizzard_buff)

			-- 플레이어 UI 켜주기
			for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
				stage.FieldUIManager:RemoveUI(user_party[i], CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
			end
		end

		self.controller:blizzard_update(progress)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('SnowMountainMainSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = SnowMountainMain @
		Comment = 설인 장군 살인 사건 발생, 현장에서 체포되는 마코와 플레이어 @
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.progress_enum = {
		--- 초기 상태
		idle = 0,
		--- 눈보라 이벤트
		blizzard_event = 1,
		--- 살인 사건 현장에 들어감
		enter_crime = 2,
		--- 살인 사건을 목격
		see_crime = 3
	}

	--- 현재 진행도
	self.current_progress = nil

	--- etc constants
	self.door_num = 2
	self.interact_num_max = 2
	self.event_snowman_guard_num = 4
	self.hookshot_stake_num = 2

	--- tile map character name
	self.general_name = 'corpse_general'
	self.suspect_name = 'maco'
	self.event_snowman_guard_name = "event_snowman_guard_"

	--- tile map field object name
	self.upper_door_name = 'crime_scene_door_upper_'
	self.lower_door_name = 'crime_scene_door_lower_'
	self.right_door_name = 'crime_scene_door_right_'
	self.bush_name = 'flower_bush'
	self.exit_name = 'exit_next_stage'
	self.hidden_star_piece_name = "star_piece_under"
	self.hookshot_stake_name = "onigirl_stake_"

	--- zone name
	self.blizzard_start_zone = 'section_2_start_blizzard'
	self.crime_room_zone = 'crime_room'
	self.crime_scene_zone = 'crime_scene'

	--- scene name
	self.scene_start = 'section_2_crime_scene'
	self.scene_interact = 'section_2_interact_'
		--scene_repeat_interact = 'section_2_interact_again',
	self.scene_end = 'section_2_end'

	--- buff name
	self.buff_name = 'speed_cap_persistent'

	--- marker and tracker name
	self.marker_name = 'snowmountain_main'
	self.tracker_name_1 = 'snowmountain_main_s2_tracker_0'
	self.tracker_name_2 = 'snowmountain_main_s2_tracker_1'

	--- string key name
	self.bush_talk_string_key = 'snowmountain_main_s2_bush'
	self.narration_string_key = 'snowmountain_main_s2_narration_0'

	--- 설인장군 character
	self.general = nil

	--- 용의자 character
	self.suspect = nil

	--- 코코가 숨어있는 field object
	self.bush = nil

	self.interact_num = 0

	self.interact_checker = {}

	self.is_blizzard_active = false

function local_class:enter()
	--- In stage 1
	if stage.Name == self.controller.stage_1 then
		--- event subscribe
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

		--- interable setup
		self.bush = get_field_object(self.bush_name)
		self.bush.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable()

	--- In stage 2
	elseif stage.Name == self.controller.stage_2 then
		self.lua_event_listener = CS.Oak.LuaIEventListener(self)

		--- event subscribe
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

		--- progress setup
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.idle

		--- character cache
		self.general = get_character(self.general_name)

		self.suspect = get_character(self.suspect_name)
		stage.FieldUIManager:RemoveUI(self.suspect, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

		self.interact_checker[self.general] = false
		self.interact_checker[self.suspect] = false

		-- 사건 현장 봉쇄를 위해 훅샷 말뚝 제거
		for i = 1, self.hookshot_stake_num do
			get_field_object(self.hookshot_stake_name..i).ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	--- In stage 1
	if stage.Name == self.controller.stage_1 then
		--- quest marker and tracker update
		local exit_tile = get_field_object(self.exit_name)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, exit_tile)

		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name_1))

	--- In stage 2
	elseif stage.Name == self.controller.stage_2 then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.general)

		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name_1))

		-- 숨겨진 스타피스 이펙트 가리기, 스타피스 이펙트 생성이 끝난 뒤에 진행되어야 하므로 Start()에서 실행
		get_field_object(self.hidden_star_piece_name).FieldObjectBehaviour:HideHiddenEffect()
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	--- event unsubscribe
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event');
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event');

	-- 제거했던 훅샷 말뚝 복구
	if stage.Name == self.controller.stage_2 then
		for i = 1, self.hookshot_stake_num do
			get_field_object(self.hookshot_stake_name..i).ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		end
	end

	if self.bush ~= nil then
		self.bush.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		self.bush = nil
	end

	if self.general ~= nil then
		if self.general.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
			self.general.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.lua_event_listener)
		end
		self.general = nil
	end

	if self.suspect ~= nil then
		if self.suspect.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
			self.suspect.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.lua_event_listener)
		end

		stage.FieldUIManager:SetUI(self.suspect, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		self.suspect = nil
	end

	self.interact_checker = nil

	if self.lua_event_listener ~= nil then
		self.lua_event_listener:Dispose()
		self.lua_event_listener = nil
	end
end

--[[
	AddListener로 등록한 interactable 처리
	]]
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		local target = e.Target

		if self.interact_checker ~= nil and self.interact_checker[target] ~= nil then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_object, self, target, self.interact_checker[target]))

			self.interact_checker[target] = true
		end
	end

	return false
end

--[[
	InteractEvent 이벤트 처리
	]]
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local target = e.Target

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.bush) then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(target, { key = self.bush_talk_string_key, skip = false })
	end

	return false
end

--[[
	ZoneEnterEvent 이벤트 처리
	]]
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter or not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return false end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.blizzard_start_zone then
		if self.current_progress >= self.progress_enum.blizzard_event then return false end

		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.blizzard_event
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.blizzard_start, self))
	elseif zone_name == self.crime_room_zone then
		if self.current_progress >= self.progress_enum.enter_crime then return false end

		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.enter_crime
		self:scene_enter_crime_zone()
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--[[
	맵에 진입하면 눈보라가 불기 시작한다.
	]]
function local_class:blizzard_start()
	--- flag set
	self.is_blizzard_active = true

	--- blizzard start
	self.controller:blizzard_start()

	self.blizzard_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_blizzard_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2
	})

	local minZ = -11
	local maxZ = -27
	local diff = unity_class.mathf.Abs(maxZ - minZ)
	local apply_buff = false

	--- blizzard update
	while self.is_blizzard_active do
		local progress = (minZ - user_party_leader.Position.z) / diff

		if progress > 0.5 and not apply_buff then
			apply_buff = true

			stage.BuffManager:AddBuff(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None,
				user_party_leader, self.buff_name, 0, false, false)

			-- 플레이어 UI 꺼주기
			for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
				stage.FieldUIManager:RemoveUI(user_party[i], CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
			end
		end

		self.controller:blizzard_update(progress)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.controller:blizzard_fade_max()
end

--[[
	사건 현장에 들어가면 문이 닫히고 화면을 알아 볼 수 없을 정도로 눈보라 몰아친다
	]]
function local_class:scene_enter_crime_zone()
	-- flag set
	self.is_blizzard_active = false

	for index = 1, self.door_num do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.upper_door_name .. index))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.right_door_name .. index))

		-- lower는 일반적인 상황에서 닫힌 상태이지만, 안정성을 위해 닫아줌
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.lower_door_name .. index))
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_crime, self))
end

function local_class:scene_crime()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

	-- 설인 장군 시체에 가까이 접근하거나 일정 시간 지나면 이벤트 시작
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local wait_time = 3
	local limit_distance = 2.5

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < wait_time and
			(user_party_leader.Position - self.general.Position).magnitude >= limit_distance do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	-- 넉백 등의 위치 유지 루틴이 발생하지 않도록 캐릭터 멈춘 후에도 0.3초 대기한다
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	-- 설인 장군 시체와 거리가 먼 경우 캐릭터 강제이동
	if (user_party_leader.Position - self.general.Position).magnitude >= limit_distance then
		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			character_util.set_position(user_party[i],
					vector(-0.5, 0, -34 + i * CS.Oak.Constants.DistBetweenPartyMembers))
			character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], "down")
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.see_crime

	-- 플레이어 UI 켜주기
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		stage.FieldUIManager:SetUI(user_party[i], CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2.5 })

	local msg = game_string:GetString(self.narration_string_key)
	stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Show()

	coroutine.yield(stage.FieldUINarrationBox:SetNarration(msg, 0, 1.0))

	stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Hide()

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = "surprise" })

	camera_util.move(vector(-0.5, 0, -37), 1)
	stage_camera:ResizeTo(2.5, 1)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	local is_kong_japan = CS.Foundations.GameEnvironment.IsKongJapan
	local sfx_to_play = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(is_kong_japan, 'bgm_shivermore_suspense_kong', 'bgm_shivermore_suspense')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		name = sfx_to_play, state = 'event', mix = 1
	})

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	stage.BuffManager:RemoveBuff(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, user_party_leader, self.buff_name)

	self.controller:blizzard_dispose()

	self.blizzard_sfx:FadeOut(0)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crime_scene_01' })

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 1)

	self.controller.scene[self.scene_start](self.controller.scene)

	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)

	for key in pairs(self.interact_checker) do
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name .. key.Name,
				self.quest_progress.QuestId, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, key)
	end

	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name_2))

	self.general.Interactable:AddListener(self.lua_event_listener)
	self.suspect.Interactable:AddListener(self.lua_event_listener)

	user_party:ResetControllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:interact_object(target, already_check)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.suspect) then
		character_util.align_party(target, "right")

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end

	self.controller.scene[self.scene_interact .. target.Name](self.controller.scene)

	-- 장군 시체 조사 후 다음 씬으로 넘어가지 않을 경우 카메라 복구 처리
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.general) then
		if already_check or self.interact_num ~= self.interact_num_max - 1 then
			camera_util.move_async(user_party_leader.Position, 0.5, { end_target = user_party_leader })
		end
	end

	if not already_check then
		self.interact_num = self.interact_num + 1

		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name .. target.Name)

		if self.interact_num == self.interact_num_max then
			quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

			self.controller.scene[self.scene_end](self.controller.scene)

			for index = 1, self.door_num do
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.upper_door_name .. index))
			end

			self.suspect:CancelShake()

			yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
		else
			wait_for_sec(0.3)

			user_party:ResetControllers()
			field_ui_manager:Show()
		end
	else
		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		user_party:ResetControllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end
end

end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name == self.controller.stage_1 then

		local exit_tile = get_field_object(self.exit_name)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,

	end

	end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_2 then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.twinkle_preset)

	self.lua_event_listener = CS.Oak.LuaIEventListener(self)

	self.coco = get_character(self.coco_name)
	self.general = get_character(self.general_name)
	self.suspect = get_character(self.suspect_name)
	self.reporter = get_character(self.reporter_name)
	self.witness = get_character(self.witness_name)

	self.coco.Interactable:AddListener(self.lua_event_listener)
	self.general.Interactable:AddListener(self.lua_event_listener)
	self.suspect.Interactable:AddListener(self.lua_event_listener)
	self.reporter.Interactable:AddListener(self.lua_event_listener)
	self.witness.Interactable:AddListener(self.lua_event_listener)

	self.npc_talk_dict[self.suspect] = self.npc_talk_index.suspect
	self.npc_talk_dict[self.reporter] = self.npc_talk_index.reporter

	for index = 1, self.inuit_num do
		local inuit = get_character(self.inuit_name .. index)
		inuit.Interactable:AddListener(self.lua_event_listener)

		self.npc_talk_dict[inuit] = self.npc_talk_index['inuit_' .. index]
	end

	for index = 1, self.snowman_num do
		local snowman = get_character(self.snowman_name .. index)
		snowman.Interactable:AddListener(self.lua_event_listener)

		self.npc_talk_dict[snowman] = self.npc_talk_index['snowman_' .. index]
	end

	for index = 1, self.guard_num do
		local guard = get_character(self.guard_name .. index)
		guard.Interactable:AddListener(self.lua_event_listener)

		self.npc_talk_dict[guard] = index <= self.guard_num - self.prison_gatekeeper_num
			and self.npc_talk_index.crime_zone_guard or self.npc_talk_index.prison_guard_in_prison
	end

	do --- 퀘스트 메인 동선 상호 작용 관련
		--- 코코와 만남
		self.quest_talker_dict[self.enum.idle] = { self.coco_name }
		--- 간수와 만남
		self.quest_talker_dict[self.enum.talk_with_coco] = {
			self.prison_guard_name_5, self.prison_guard_name_6
		}
		--- 용의자와 만남
		self.quest_talker_dict[self.enum.open_prison] = { self.suspect_name }
	end

	do ---- 사건 현장 조사 관련
	--- 눈더미
	local snow_drift = get_field_object(self.interact_snow_name)
		snow_drift.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

		self.interact_checker[self.general] = false
		self.interact_checker[snow_drift] = false
		self.interact_checker[self.witness] = false
	end

	-- 간수 NPC 무기 제거
	get_character("event_snowman_guard_5"):HideWeapon(true)
	get_character("event_snowman_guard_6"):HideWeapon(true)

	self.progress = self.enum.idle

	self.controller.scene:add_callback('SelectBranch', { controller = self, func = self.select_branch })
	self.controller.scene:add_callback('ShowTwinkle', { controller = self, func = self.show_twinkle })
	self.controller.scene:add_callback('RemoveTwinkle', { controller = self, func = self.remove_twinkle })

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name == self.controller.stage_1 then
		local exit_tile = get_field_object(self.exit_name)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, exit_tile)

		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name_1))

	elseif stage.Name == self.controller.stage_2 then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.main_quest_routine, self)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	for key in pairs(self.npc_talk_dict) do
		if key.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
			key.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.lua_event_listener)
		end
	end

	self.quest_talker_dict = nil
	self.npc_talk_dict = nil
	self.npc_talk_index = nil
	self.interact_checker = nil

	if self.suspect ~= nil then
		self.suspect = nil
	end

	if self.reporter ~= nil then
		if self.reporter.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
			self.reporter.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.lua_event_listener)
		end
		self.reporter = nil
	end

	if self.coco ~= nil then
		if self.coco.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
			self.coco.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.lua_event_listener)
		end
		self.coco = nil
	end

	if self.general ~= nil then
		if self.general.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
			self.general.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.lua_event_listener)
		end
		self.general = nil
	end

	if self.witness ~= nil then
		if self.witness.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
			self.witness.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.lua_event_listener)
		end
		self.witness = nil
	end

	local snow_drift = get_field_object(self.interact_snow_name)
	if snow_drift ~= nil then
		snow_drift.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end

	if self.twinkle_effect ~= nil then
		self.twinkle_effect:Dispose()
		self.twinkle_effect = nil
	end

	self.enum = nil

	if self.lua_event_listener ~= nil then
		self.lua_event_listener:Dispose()
		self.lua_event_listener = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local target = e.Target

	if self.quest_talker_dict ~= nil then
		local talker = self.quest_talker_dict[self.progress]

		if talker ~= nil then
			for index = 1, #talker do
				if target.name == talker[index] then
					if self.progress == self.enum.idle then
						self.progress = self.enum.talk_with_coco
						sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_coco_routine, self)

						return false

					elseif self.progress == self.enum.talk_with_coco then
						self.progress = self.enum.open_prison
						sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_guard_routine, self)

						return false

					elseif self.progress == self.enum.open_prison then
						self.progress = self.enum.talk_with_suspect
						sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_suspect_routine, self)

						return false
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if self.interact_checker ~= nil and self.interact_checker[target] ~= nil then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.interact_object_routine, self, target, self.interact_checker[target]))

		self.interact_checker[target] = true

		return false
	end

	if target:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.Character) and self.npc_talk_dict[target] ~= nil then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(target,
			{ key = self.talk_string_key .. self.npc_talk_dict[target] })
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter or not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) or e.Zone.Name ~= self.prison_zone then
		return false
	end

	local marker_name = self.marker_name
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(marker_name)

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name .. self.general_name)
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name .. self.interact_snow_name)
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name .. self.witness_name)

	if self.progress == self.enum.talk_with_coco then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(63.5, 0, -3))
	elseif self.progress == self.enum.open_prison then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.suspect)
	else
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(81.5, 0, -22))
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not e.FullLeave or not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) or e.Zone.Name ~= self.prison_zone then
		return false
	end

	local marker_name = self.marker_name
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(marker_name)

	if self.progress == self.enum.idle then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.coco)
	else
		local snow_drift = get_field_object(self.interact_snow_name)

		if not self.interact_checker[self.general] then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name .. self.general_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
					self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.general.Position)
		end

		if not self.interact_checker[snow_drift] then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name .. self.interact_snow_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
					self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, snow_drift)
		end

		if not self.interact_checker[self.witness] then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name .. self.witness_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
					self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.witness)
		end

		if not self.complete_investigate_suspect then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
					self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(39.5, 0, -29))
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

	self.coco = nil
	self.general = nil
	self.suspect = nil
	self.witness = nil

	self.npc_talk_dict = nil
	self.quest_talker_dict = nil
	self.interact_checker = nil
end

function local_class:talk_with_coco_routine()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.coco)

	character_util.align_party(self.coco, 'left')

	character_util.set_anim(self.coco, { name = "bomb_idle" })

	local choice = 0

		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
		Callback = function()
			choice = 0

function local_class:interact_object_routine(target, already_check)
	if not already_check then
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

		character_util.convert_to_npc(self.coco)

		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name .. target.Name)
		quest_icon.RemoveIcon(target)

		self.controller.scene[self.scene_interact .. target.Name](self.controller.scene)

		local item_placeholder = CS.Oak.ItemPlaceholder()
		item_placeholder.NotForInventory = true

		if target.Name == self.interact_snow_name then
			item_placeholder.ItemId = 20152

			coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.coroutine(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ItemGetEvent(item_placeholder,
					'snowmountain_main_s4_clue_0', 'snowmountain_main_s4_clue_1')))
		elseif target.Name == self.general_name then
			item_placeholder.ItemId = 20149

			coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.coroutine(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ItemGetEvent(item_placeholder,
					'snowmountain_main_s4_clue_2', 'snowmountain_main_s4_clue_3')))

			wait_for_sec(0.3)

			character_util.set_anim(self.coco, { name = "question", loop = false })

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.coco, { key = 'snowmountain_main_s4_39_1', skip = true, portraitname = "innuit.png" })

			character_util.remove_anim(self.coco)
		else
			item_placeholder.ItemId = self.clue_item_id

			coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.coroutine(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ItemGetEvent(item_placeholder,
					'snowmountain_main_s4_extra_2', 'snowmountain_main_s4_extra_3')))
		end

		self.interact_num = self.interact_num + 1

		if self.interact_num == self.interact_num_max then
			if not self.complete_investigate_crime_scene then
				self.complete_investigate_crime_scene = true
			end

			if self.complete_investigate_suspect then
				quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

				wait_for_sec(0.5)

				self.controller.scene[self.scene_investigate](self.controller.scene)

				yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
			else
				character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.coco, user_party)
			end
		else
			character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.coco, user_party)
		end

		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	else
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.witness) then
			field_ui_manager:Hide()
			party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

			stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Show()

			local narration_string

			if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.general) then
				narration_string = "snowmountain_main_s4_narration_8"
			elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(target, get_field_object(self.interact_snow_name)) then
				narration_string = "snowmountain_main_s4_narration_7"
			end

			coroutine.yield(stage.FieldUINarrationBox:SetNarration(game_string:GetString(narration_string), 0, 1))

			stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Hide()

			wait_for_sec(0.3)

			party_util.reset_controllers()
			field_ui_manager:Show()
		else

		end
	end

function local_class:select_branch()
	local wait_for_branch = true
	local selection = 0
	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

	local talk_branch = CS.Oak.TalkBranch()
	talk_branch.Text = game_string:GetString(self.talk_branch_1)
	talk_branch.Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy
	talk_branch.Callback = function()
		wait_for_branch = false

	branches:Add(talk_branch)

	talk_branch.Text = game_string:GetString(self.talk_branch_2)
	talk_branch.Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal
	talk_branch.Callback = function()
		wait_for_branch = false
		selection = 1
	end
	branches:Add(talk_branch)

	local choice_state = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
	choice_state.Branchs = branches
	choice_state.Talker = target

	stage.UISceneManager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)

	while wait_for_branch do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if selection == 1 then
		local leader_pos = user_party_leader.Position

		character_util.set_direction(self.coco, 'down')
		character_util.set_anim(self.coco, { name = 'attack', loop = false })

		character_util.remove_anim(self.coco)

		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(user_party_leader.Bounds.center)

		character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = 'damaged' })

		user_party_leader:Shake(0.04, 0.2)
		user_party_leader.SpineController:DamageSquish(1)
		user_party_leader.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()

		local knockback_info = character_util.knockback_info("physics", true, {0, 0, -1},
				13000, 0.05, CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

		local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(user_party_leader, knockback_info);
		user_party_leader.FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "01_trip_01" })

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.4))

		character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = "prostrate" })
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = "confused" })

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "01_player_popup_01" })

		character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)
		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)
		character_util.mario_jump_async(user_party_leader, "left")

		character_util.move_to_async(user_party_leader, leader_pos, nil, 4, true, true)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(
			self.coco, { key = self.talk_coco, skip = true, portraitname = "innuit.png" })

		character_util.set_direction(self.coco, 'left')
		character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, "left")

		character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)
		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)
	end

]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)

	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

		--- 눈보라가 불기 시작
		blizzard = 2,
		--- 눈보라가 끝남
		blizzard_end = 3,
		--- 이벤트 종료
		progress_end = 4
	}

	--- etc constants
	self.examinee_num = 4
	self.survey_complete_num = 3
	self.door_num = 3

	--- tile map character name
	self.snowman_girl_name = 'snowman_girl'
	self.inuit_boy_name = 'innuit_boy'
	self.coco_name = 'coco'
	self.examinee_name = 'innuit_examinee_'
	self.fixer_name = "fixer"

	--- tile map field object name
	self.exit_name = 'exit_next_stage'
	self.door_name = "town_door_"
	self.fixer_block_name = "fixer_block"
	self.maco_table_name = "maco_table"

	--- zone name
	self.inuit_and_snowman_zone = 'innuit_and_snowman'
	self.blizzard_zone = 'blizzard_1'
	self.meet_coco = 'meet_coco'

	--- marker and tracker name
	self.marker_name = 'snowmountain_main'
	self.tracker_name_1 = 'snowmountain_main_s5_tracker_0'
	self.tracker_name_2 = 'snowmountain_main_s5_tracker_1'
	self.tracker_name_3 = 'snowmountain_main_s5_tracker_2'

	self.snowman_girl_marker = 'snowman_girl'
	self.inuit_boy_marker = 'innuit_boy'
	self.coco_marker = 'coco_1'
	self.examinee_marker = 'innuit_examinee_'

	--- string key name
	self.talk_branch_1 = 'snowmountain_main_s5_talk_branch_0'
	self.talk_branch_2 = 'snowmountain_main_s5_talk_branch_1'

	--- buff name
	self.blizzard_buff = 'speed_cap_persistent'

	--- 설인과 이누이트 이벤트 coroutine 캐싱
	self.inuit_and_snowman_routine = nil

	-- 코코 이벤트 보았는지 저장
	self.see_coco_event = false

	--- 주민 조사 횟수
	self.examinee_investigate_num = 0

	--- 주민 조사 최대 횟수
	self.examinee_investigate_max = 3

	--- 주민 조사가 끝났는지
	self.investigate_finished = false

	--- 코코 character
	self.coco = nil

	--- 이누이트 소년 character
	self.inuit_boy = nil

	--- 설인 소녀 character
	self.snowman_girl = nil

	--- 조사할 이누이트 주민들
	self.examinees = nil

	--- 편지 아이템
	self.mail = nil

	--- 눈보라가 활성화 상태인지

	-- 마코 집에 들어갔는지
	self.is_enter_maco_house = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_3 then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')

	self.lua_event_listener = CS.Oak.LuaIEventListener(self)

	self.coco = get_character(self.coco_name)
	self.inuit_boy = get_character(self.inuit_boy_name)
	self.snowman_girl = get_character(self.snowman_girl_name)

	self.examinees = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)

	for index = 1, self.examinee_num do
		local character = get_character(self.examinee_name .. index)
		self.examinees:Add(character)
	end

	local fixer = get_character(self.fixer_name)
	character_util.set_position(fixer, vector(-70, -0.3, -111.5))
	character_util.set_direction(fixer, "down")
	character_util.set_anim(fixer, { name = "cast" })

	local maco_table = get_field_object(self.maco_table_name)
	maco_table.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	local fixer_block = get_field_object(self.fixer_block_name)
	fixer_block.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	-- 마을 사람 대화 저장 배열
	self.examinee_talk_list = create_generic_list(CS.System.Int32)

	self.progress = self.enum.idle

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name_1))

	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_3 then
		local exit_tile = get_field_object(self.exit_name)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, exit_tile)
	else
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.coco)

		local target_marker = field:GetMarker(self.coco_marker)
		character_util.set_position(self.coco, target_marker.position)
		character_util.set_direction(self.coco, target_marker.direction)

		target_marker = field:GetMarker(self.snowman_girl_marker)
		character_util.set_position(self.snowman_girl, target_marker.position)
		character_util.set_direction(self.snowman_girl, 'right')

		target_marker = field:GetMarker(self.inuit_boy_marker)
		character_util.set_position(self.inuit_boy, target_marker.position)
		character_util.set_direction(self.inuit_boy, 'left')

		for index = 0, self.examinees.Count - 1 do
			target_marker = field:GetMarker(self.examinee_marker .. index + 1)
			character_util.set_position(self.examinees[index], target_marker.position)
			character_util.set_direction(self.examinees[index], target_marker.direction)
		end

		-- 편지 책상 위에 올리기
		self.mail = drop_item_util.create_item(
				{ pos = vector(-67, 0, -114), itemid = 20151, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'})
		self.mail.Position = self.mail.Position + unity_class.vector3.up
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	if self.inuit_and_snowman_routine ~= nil then
		stop_coroutine(self.inuit_and_snowman_routine)
		self.inuit_and_snowman_routine = nil
	end

	if self.examinees ~= nil then
		for index = 0, self.examinees.Count - 1 do
			if self.examinees[index].Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
				self.examinees[index].Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.lua_event_listener)
			end
		end

		self.examinees:Clear()
		self.examinees = nil
	end

	if self.coco ~= nil then
		if self.coco.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
			self.coco.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.lua_event_listener)
		end
		self.coco = nil
	end

	self.inuit_boy = nil
	self.snowman_girl = nil

	self.mail = nil

	if self.lua_event_listener ~= nil then
		self.lua_event_listener:Dispose()
		self.lua_event_listener = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter or not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return false end

	local zone = e.Zone
	local zone_name = zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.inuit_and_snowman_zone then

		if self.progress == self.enum.idle then
			self.progress = self.enum.inuit_and_snowman

			self.inuit_and_snowman_routine = coroutine_class.coroutine(
				util.cs_generator(self.scene_inuit_and_snowman, self))

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, self.inuit_and_snowman_routine)
		elseif self.progress == self.enum.blizzard_end then
			self.progress = self.enum.progress_end

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.scene_snowman_freeze, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.blizzard_zone then
		if self.progress ~= self.enum.inuit_and_snowman then return false end

		self.progress = self.enum.blizzard

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_blizzard, self))
	elseif zone_name == self.meet_coco then
		if not self.see_coco_event then
			self.see_coco_event = true

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.coco_routine, self)
		end
	elseif zone_name == 'maco_house' then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_maco_house, self))
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not e.FullLeave or not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return false end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == "maco_house" then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(16, 0.5, -34))
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		local target = e.Target

		for index = 0, self.examinees.Count - 1 do
			if target == self.examinees[index] then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.survey_routine, self, index, target)

				return false
			end
		end

		local maco_table = get_field_object(self.maco_table_name)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, maco_table) then
			maco_table.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_with_table, self))
		end

		local fixer_block = get_field_object(self.fixer_block_name)
		local fixer = get_character(self.fixer_name)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, fixer_block) then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(fixer, "snowmountain_main_s5_21")
		end
	end

	return false
end

	self.controller = nil

	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:scene_blizzard()
	self.is_blizzard_active = true

	self.snowman_girl.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.snowman_girl)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.inuit_boy)

	stop_coroutine(self.inuit_and_snowman_routine)

	self.controller:blizzard_start()

	self.blizzard_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_blizzard_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2
	})

	stage.BuffManager:AddBuff(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None,
		user_party_leader, self.blizzard_buff, 0, false, false)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time;
	local blizzard_time = 1
	local freeze_time = 0.5
	local is_freeze = false

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < blizzard_time do
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Min((unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / blizzard_time, 1)

		self.controller:blizzard_update(progress)

		if unity_class.time.time - cur_time >= freeze_time and not is_freeze then
			is_freeze = true

			character_util.remove_emotion(self.snowman_girl)
			character_util.set_anim(self.snowman_girl, { name = 'ice_start', loop = false, scale = 2 })

			character_util.set_emotion(self.inuit_boy,  { name = 'scared' })
			character_util.set_anim(self.inuit_boy, { name = 'hurt' })

			-- 플레이어 UI 꺼주기
			for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
				stage.FieldUIManager:RemoveUI(user_party[i], CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
			end

			stage.FieldUIManager:RemoveUI(self.snowman_girl, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
			stage.FieldUIManager:RemoveUI(self.inuit_boy, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "01_freeze_01" })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "01_fade_out_02" })

	character_util.set_anim(self.snowman_girl, { name = 'ice' })

	self.controller:blizzard_color_refresh()

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.progress = self.enum.blizzard_end
	self.is_blizzard_active = false

	cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	local wait_time = 2
	local fade_time = 0.8
	local remove_buff_time = 1.5
	local remove_buff = false

	self.blizzard_sfx:FadeOut(wait_time)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < wait_time do
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Max(1 - (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / fade_time, 0)

		self.controller:blizzard_update(progress)

		if unity_class.time.time - cur_time >= remove_buff_time and not remove_buff then
			remove_buff = true

			stage.BuffManager:RemoveBuff(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None,
					user_party_leader, self.blizzard_buff)

			-- 플레이어 UI 켜주기
			for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
				stage.FieldUIManager:SetUI(user_party[i], CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
			end

			stage.FieldUIManager:SetUI(self.snowman_girl, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
			stage.FieldUIManager:SetUI(self.inuit_boy, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.controller:blizzard_dispose()
end

function local_class:survey_routine(index, target)
	if not self.investigate_finished then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name .. (index + 1))
		quest_icon.RemoveIcon(target)
	end

	character_util.align_party(target, target.Direction, 0.5, "arc")

	-- 이미 대화한 대상인지 확인
	local already_talk = false
	local talk_num = 0

	for i = 0, self.examinee_talk_list.Count - 1 do
		if index == self.examinee_talk_list[i] then
			already_talk = true
			talk_num = i

			break
		end
	end

	-- 처음 대화한 대상이면 리스트에 추가
	if not already_talk then
		self.examinee_talk_list:Add(index)

		talk_num = self.examinee_investigate_num
	end

	if talk_num == 0 then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(target, { key = 'snowmountain_main_s5_13', skip = true })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(target, { key = 'snowmountain_main_s5_14', skip = true })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(target, { key = 'snowmountain_main_s5_20', skip = true })
	elseif talk_num == 1 then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(target, { key = 'snowmountain_main_s5_15', skip = true })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(target, { key = 'snowmountain_main_s5_16', skip = true })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(target, { key = 'snowmountain_main_s5_16_1', skip = true })
	elseif talk_num == 2 then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(target, { key = 'snowmountain_main_s5_17', skip = true })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(target, { key = 'snowmountain_main_s5_18', skip = true })
	end

	if self.investigate_finished == false and not already_talk then
		self.examinee_investigate_num = self.examinee_investigate_num + 1
	end

	if self.examinee_investigate_num == self.examinee_investigate_max and self.investigate_finished == false then
		self.investigate_finished = true

		for i = 0, self.examinee_num - 1 do
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name .. i+1)

			quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.examinees[i])
		end

		quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(16, 0.5, -34))
		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name_3))
	end
end

function local_class:enter_maco_house()
	if not self.investigate_finished then
		self.investigate_finished = true

		for i = 1, self.examinee_num - 1 do
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name .. i+1)

local local_class = newclass('SnowMountainMainSection6')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = SnowMountainMain @
		Comment = 편지를 들고 도망친 해결사를 쫓아서 붙잡고 증거물을 획득하는 플레이어, 클론 코코와 전투. @
		Index = 5 @
		NextSections = 6 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	--- constants field
	do
		self.door_num = 2
		self.exit_num = 6

		self.color_key = 'coco_clone_color_key'

		--- character name
		self.fixer_name = 'fixer'
		self.coco_name = "coco"
		self.witch_name = "clone_coco"
		self.substage_npc_name = "substage_3_4_npc"

		self.boss_room_upper_door_name = 'boss_door_upper_'
		self.boss_room_right_door_name = 'boss_door_right_'
		self.exit_name = "exit_next_stage"
		self.deactivated_exit_name = "exit_entry_igloo_"
		self.deactivated_entrance_name = "entrance_gameguy_cave"

		self.run_marker_name = "fixer_runaway_"

		--- marker and tracker name
		self.marker_name = 'snowmountain_main'
		self.tracker_name_1 = 'snowmountain_main_s6_tracker_0'
		self.tracker_name_2 = 'snowmountain_main_s6_tracker_1'

		self.witch_marker_name_1 = 'clone_coco_1'
		self.witch_marker_name_2 = 'clone_coco_2'
		self.witch_marker_name_3 = 'clone_coco_3'

		--- battle group name
		self.battle_group_name = 'clone_coco'

		--- boss scene string key name
		self.boss_title = 'snowmountain_main_s6_boss_title'
		self.boss_subtitle = 'snowmountain_main_s6_boss_subtitle'
	end

	--- 사용할 프리셋
	self.preset = {}

	-- 거리 측정 UI
	self.resholder = nil
	self.distance_checker = nil

	self.runaway_routine = nil
	self.show_dist_routine = nil

	self.check_run_1_once = false
	self.is_run_1 = false
	self.is_run_2 = false
	self.is_run_3 = false
	self.end_fixer = false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_3 then return true end

	-- TODO: 컨트롤러로 이전하자
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadBossTitle()

	local preset_smoke_name = 'FX_Common_Jump_small'
	local preset_dead_name = 'FX_dead'
	local preset_ice_name = 'FX_SupportFire_IceRed'
	local preset_bounce_name = 'FX_slime_buttbounce'
	local preset_hit_effect_name = 'FX_hit'
	local preset_last_hit_effect_name = "FX_lasthit"

	self.preset.smoke = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(preset_smoke_name)
	self.preset.dead = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(preset_dead_name)
	self.preset.ice = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(preset_ice_name)
	self.preset.bounce = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(preset_bounce_name)
	self.preset.hit = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(preset_hit_effect_name)
	self.preset.last_hit = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(preset_last_hit_effect_name)

	local coco = get_character(self.coco_name)
	character_util.set_position(coco, vector(999, 0, 999))

	local coco_clone = get_character(self.witch_name)
	coco_clone.SpineController:AddColor(self.color_key, unity_color({0, 0, 0, 1}), 1, 0)
	coco_clone.SpineController:AddFadeColor(self.color_key, unity_color({0, 0, 0, 1}), 1, 0)

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')

	local fixer = get_character(self.fixer_name)
	fixer.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	local fixer_marker = field:GetMarker("fixer_runaway_1_0")

	character_util.set_position(fixer, fixer_marker.position)
	character_util.set_direction(fixer, fixer_marker.direction)

	for index = 1, 2 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.boss_room_right_door_name .. index))
	end

	-- 추격전 중에 Substage Open 이벤트 발생하는 것 방지하기 위해 NPC 비황성화
	character_util.set_active_state(get_character(self.substage_npc_name), "disabled")
	character_util.remove_emotion(get_character(self.substage_npc_name))

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.load_distance_chcker, self))

	return true
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_3 then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')

	if self.runaway_routine ~= nil then
		stop_coroutine(self.runaway_routine)
		self.runaway_routine = nil
	end

	if self.show_dist_routine ~= nil then
		stop_coroutine(self.show_dist_routine)
		self.show_dist_routine = nil
	end

	for key in pairs(self.preset) do
		self.preset[key] = nil
	end

	self.preset = nil

	-- 추격전에서 비활성화했던 NPC 다시 활성화
	character_util.set_active_state(get_character(self.substage_npc_name), "enabled")
	character_util.set_emotion(get_character(self.substage_npc_name), { name = "scared" })

	-- 추격전 종료 후 Exit 이용 가능
	for i = 1, self.exit_num do
		local cur_exit = get_field_object(self.deactivated_exit_name..i)

		if cur_exit ~= nil then
			cur_exit.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		end
	end

	local cur_entrance = get_field_object(self.deactivated_entrance_name)
	cur_entrance.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled

	CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.distance_checker.gameObject)
	self.resholder:Dispose()
end

function local_class:start()
	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name_1))

	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_3 then
		local exit_tile = get_field_object(self.exit_name)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, exit_tile)
	else
		local fixer = get_character(self.fixer_name)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, fixer)

		-- 이전 섹션에서 온 경우, 시작 이벤트는 실행하지 않음
		if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 5 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_setting, self))
		end

		-- 추격전 중에는 Exit 이용 불가
		for i = 1, self.exit_num do
			local cur_exit = get_field_object(self.deactivated_exit_name..i)

			if cur_exit ~= nil then
				cur_exit.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Visible
			end
		end

		local cur_entrance = get_field_object(self.deactivated_entrance_name)
		cur_entrance.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Visible
	end
end

-- zone enter event
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) and
		not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then
		return false
	end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == "run_fixer_1" and self.is_run_1 == false then
		self.is_run_1 = true

		if self.runaway_routine ~= nil then
			stop_coroutine(self.runaway_routine)
		end

		if self.check_run_1_once == false then
			self.check_run_1_once = true

			self.runaway_routine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.fixer_runaway_routine_1, self, false))
		else
			self.runaway_routine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.fixer_runaway_routine_1, self, true))
		end
	elseif zone_name == "run_fixer_2" and self.is_run_2 == false then
		self.is_run_2 = true

		if self.runaway_routine ~= nil then
			stop_coroutine(self.runaway_routine)
		end

		self.runaway_routine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.fixer_runaway_routine_2, self))
	elseif zone_name == "run_fixer_3" and self.is_run_3 == false then
		self.is_run_3 = true

		if self.runaway_routine ~= nil then
			stop_coroutine(self.runaway_routine)
		end

		self.runaway_routine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.fixer_runaway_routine_3, self))
	elseif zone_name == "end_fixer" and self.end_fixer == false then
		self.end_fixer = true

		if self.runaway_routine ~= nil then
			stop_coroutine(self.runaway_routine)
		end

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.catch_routine, self))
	end

	return false
end

-- 해결사와의 거리를 보여주는 루틴
function local_class:show_fixer_distance()
	local fixer = get_character(self.fixer_name)
	local dist = 0
	local warning_dist = 15
	local fail_dist = 25
	local play_warining_sfx = false

	self.distance_checker:Show(true)

	while dist < fail_dist do
		dist = (user_party_leader.Position - fixer.Position).magnitude
		int_dist = math.floor(dist)
		decimal_dist = math.floor((dist - int_dist) * 10)

		local str = tostring(int_dist).."."..tostring(decimal_dist)..game_string:GetString("snowmountain_main_s5_distance")

		if dist < warning_dist then
			play_warining_sfx = false

			self.distance_checker:SetText(str, vector(0, 0.5), 800, 32, 0, CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 255, 255, 255))
		else
			if not play_warining_sfx then
				play_warining_sfx = true

				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_bomb_count_tick_01' })
			end

			self.distance_checker:SetText(str, vector(0, 0.5), 800, 32, 0, CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 0, 0, 255))
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 일정 거리 넘어가면 재시작
	self.distance_checker:Show(false)

	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	self.is_run_2 = false

	if self.runaway_routine ~= nil then
		stop_coroutine(self.runaway_routine)
	end

	stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Show()

	coroutine.yield(stage.FieldUINarrationBox:SetNarration(game_string:GetString('snowmountain_main_s5_lost'), 0, 1.0))

	stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Hide()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 10 })

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black,  CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	local fixer_marker = field:GetMarker("fixer_runaway_1_0")

	character_util.set_position(fixer, fixer_marker.position)
	character_util.set_direction(fixer, fixer_marker.direction)
	character_util.remove_anim(fixer)

	local house_marker = field:GetMarker("entry_town_3")

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_position(user_party[i], house_marker.position +
				vector(0, 0, CS.Oak.Constants.DistBetweenPartyMembers * i))
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], "down")
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black,  CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	self.runaway_routine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.fixer_runaway_routine_1, self, true))

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	--- constants field
	do
		--- character name
		self.coco_name = 'coco'
		self.fixer_name = "fixer"

		--- tile map field object name
		self.exit_name = 'exit_next_stage'

		--- tile map zone name
		self.zone_name = 'fixer_scream'
		self.ignore_zone_name = "ignore_fixer"

		--- tile map marker name
		self.marker_name = 'coco_2'

		--- quest etc name
		self.quest_marker_name = 'snowmountain_main'
		self.tracker_name = 'snowmountain_main_s7_tracker_0'

		-- 이펙트 애셋 번들 이름
		self.distinguish_effect_name = "FX_dead"
	end

	self.see_event = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_3 then return true end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.distinguish_effect_name)

	self.lua_event_listener = CS.Oak.LuaIEventListener(self)

	local fixer = get_character(self.fixer_name)

	character_util.set_position(fixer, vector(98, 0, -114))
	character_util.set_direction(fixer, "right")
	character_util.set_anim(fixer, { name = "ice" })
	character_util.set_emotion(fixer, { name = "scared" })
	fixer.Interactable:AddListener(self.lua_event_listener)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name))

	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_3 then
		local exit_tile = get_field_object(self.exit_name)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, exit_tile)

	else
		local fixer = get_character(self.fixer_name)
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, fixer)

		-- 이전 섹션에서 도착한 경우 Blizzard 해제하는 루틴 실행
		if self.controller.starting_inner_progress ~= 6 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.dispose_blizzard, self))
		end

		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(fixer)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	local fixer = get_character(self.fixer_name)

	if stage.Name == self.controller.stage_3 and fixer ~= nil then
		fixer.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.lua_event_listener)
	end

	if self.lua_event_listener ~= nil then
		self.lua_event_listener:Dispose()
		self.lua_event_listener = nil
	end
end

	]]
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local fixer = get_character(self.fixer_name)

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, fixer) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.coco_event, self)
	end

	return false
end

--[[
	ZoneEnterEvent 이벤트 처리
	]]
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter or not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return false end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.zone_name then
		if self.see_event then return false end

		self.see_event = true

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.scream_event, self)

		return true
	elseif zone_name == self.ignore_zone_name then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.ignore_fixer_event, self)
	end

	return false
end

	self.controller = nil

function local_class:dispose_blizzard()
	local wait_time = 2
	local fade_time = 2
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	self.controller:blizzard_fade_sfx(wait_time)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < wait_time do
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Max(0.5 - (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / fade_time, 0)

		self.controller:blizzard_update(progress, progress * 0.5)

local local_class = newclass('SnowMountainMainSection8')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = SnowMountainMain @
		Comment = 설인 마을로 이동하는 플레이어와 코코, 해결사의 집에서 해결사 아들을 만나서 증거품을 획득한다. @
		Index = 7 @
		NextSections = 8 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	--- constants field
	do
		--- character name
		self.coco_name = 'coco'
		self.prince_name = 'snowman_prince'
		self.fixer_name = "fixer"
		self.gatekeeper_name = 'snowman_gatekeeper_'
		self.fixer_son_name = "fixer_son"

		--- tile map field object name
		self.exit_name = 'exit_next_stage'

		--- tile map zone name
		self.prince_zone_name_1 = 'snowman_prince_1'
		self.prince_zone_name_2 = 'snowman_prince_2'
		self.prince_zone_name_3 = 'snowman_prince_3'
		self.coco_zone_name = 'section_8_coco'
		self.fixer_house_zone_name = "fixer_house"
		self.house_inner_zone_name = "fixer_house_in"

		--- tile map marker name
		self.prince_marker_name_1 = 'snowman_prince_1'
		self.prince_marker_name_2 = 'snowman_prince_2'
		self.prince_marker_name_3 = 'snowman_prince_3'
		self.coco_marker_name = 'coco_1'

		--- quest etc name
		self.quest_marker_name = 'snowmountain_main'
		self.tracker_name_1 = 'snowmountain_main_s8_tracker_0'
		self.tracker_name_2 = 'snowmountain_main_s8_tracker_1'
	end

	-- 설인 왕자 이동하는 이벤트를 몇 번 보았는지 저장
	self.see_snowman_event = 0

	-- 이벤트 플래그
	self.see_coco_event = false
	self.see_fixer_son_event = false
	self.is_enter_fixer_house = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.lua_event_listener = CS.Oak.LuaIEventListener(self)

	if stage.Name == self.controller.stage_3 then
		local fixer = get_character(self.fixer_name)
		fixer.Interactable:AddListener(self.lua_event_listener)
	elseif stage.Name == self.controller.stage_4 then
		local coco = get_character(self.coco_name)
		local coco_marker = field:GetMarker(self.coco_marker_name)
		coco.Interactable:AddListener(self.lua_event_listener)
		character_util.set_position(coco, coco_marker.position)
		character_util.set_direction(coco, coco_marker.direction)
		character_util.set_anim(coco, { name = "cast" })
		character_util.set_emotion(coco, { name = "tired" })

		local prince = get_character(self.prince_name)
		prince.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		character_util.set_position(prince, field:GetMarker(self.prince_marker_name_1).position)
		character_util.set_direction(prince, 'down')

		local fixer_son = get_character(self.fixer_son_name)
		character_util.set_position(fixer_son, vector(55, 0, -104.5))
		character_util.set_direction(fixer_son, "left")
		character_util.set_anim(fixer_son, { name = "cast" })

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

		-- 맵 통과를 막는 게이트키퍼 위치 설정
		for i = 3, 4 do
			local gatekeeper = get_character(self.gatekeeper_name..i)

			character_util.set_position(gatekeeper, vector(54 + i, 1, -36))
			character_util.set_direction(gatekeeper, "down")
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name_1))

	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_4 then
		local exit_tile = get_field_object(self.exit_name)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, exit_tile)
	else
		local coco = get_character(self.coco_name)
		local prince = get_character(self.prince_name)

		if coco == nil or prince == nil then return end

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, coco)

		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(coco)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	local coco = get_character(self.coco_name)
	if coco ~= nil and coco.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		coco.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.lua_event_listener)
	end

	-- 맵 통과를 막는 게이트키퍼 제거
	for i = 3, 4 do
		local gatekeeper = get_character(self.gatekeeper_name..i)

		character_util.set_active_state(gatekeeper, "disabled")
	end

	if self.lua_event_listener ~= nil then
		self.lua_event_listener:Dispose()
		self.lua_event_listener = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

	-- add section musics here

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	local coco = get_character(self.coco_name)
	local fixer = get_character(self.fixer_name)

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		local target = e.Target

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, fixer) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_with_fixer, self))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(target, coco) and not self.see_coco_event then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.coco_event, self, false))
		end
	end

	return false
end

-- ZoneEnterEvent 이벤트 처리
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter or not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return false end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if self.prince_zone_name_1 ~= nil and zone_name == self.prince_zone_name_1 then
		self.prince_zone_name_1 = nil
		self.see_snowman_event = 1

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.snowman_event, self))
	elseif self.prince_zone_name_2 ~= nil and zone_name == self.prince_zone_name_2 then
		self.prince_zone_name_2 = nil
		self.see_snowman_event = 2
	elseif self.prince_zone_name_3 ~= nil and zone_name == self.prince_zone_name_3 then
		self.prince_zone_name_3 = nil
		self.see_snowman_event = 3
	elseif zone_name == self.coco_zone_name and not self.see_coco_event then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.coco_event, self, true))
	elseif zone_name == self.fixer_house_zone_name then
		local fixer_son = get_character(self.fixer_son_name)

		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, fixer_son)
	elseif zone_name == self.house_inner_zone_name and not self.see_fixer_son_event then
		self.see_fixer_son_event = true

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_fixer_son, self)
	end

	return false
end

-- ZoneLeaveEvent 이벤트 처리
function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not e.FullLeave or not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return false end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.fixer_house_zone_name then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(44, 0, -71))
	end

	return false
end
