		Index = 8 @
		NextSections = 9 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	--- current progress
	self.progress = nil

	--- constants field
	do
		--- character name
		self.coco_name = 'coco'
		self.prince_name = 'snowman_prince'
		self.fixer_son_name = "fixer_son"

		--- tile map field object name
		self.exit_name = 'exit_next_stage'

		--- tile map zone name
		self.coco_zone_name = 'section_9_coco'
		self.fixer_house_zone_name = "fixer_house"

		--- tile map marker name
		self.coco_marker_name = 'coco_3'
		self.prince_marker_name = 'snowman_prince_last'

		-- item id
		self.pendant_item_id = 20150

		-- custom state name
		self.see_prince_event = "see_prince_event"

		--- quest etc name
		self.quest_marker_name = 'snowmountain_main'
		self.tracker_name = 'snowmountain_main_s9_tracker_0'
	end

	self.see_coco_event = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_4 then return true end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	self.lua_event_listener = CS.Oak.LuaIEventListener(self)

	local coco = get_character(self.coco_name)
	local prince = get_character(self.prince_name)

	if coco == nil or prince == nil then return end

	--- 설인 왕자 위치 설정, 단 메인 퀘스트 컨트롤러에서 이미 이벤트를 보았을 경우는 취소
	if self.quest_progress:GetCustomState("see_prince_event") ~= 1 then
		character_util.set_position(prince, field:GetMarker(self.prince_marker_name).position)
		character_util.set_active_state(prince, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_direction(prince, 'right')
		character_util.set_anim(prince, { name = 'cast' })
	end

	-- 코코 위치 설정
	character_util.set_position(coco, field:GetMarker(self.coco_marker_name).position)
	character_util.set_active_state(coco, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_direction(coco, "down")

	local fixer_son = get_character(self.fixer_son_name)
	fixer_son.Interactable:AddListener(self.lua_event_listener)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_4 then
		local exit_tile = get_field_object(self.exit_name)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, exit_tile)

		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name_1))
	else
		local coco = get_character(self.coco_name)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, coco)
		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	local coco = get_character(self.coco_name)
	if coco ~= nil and coco.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		coco.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.lua_event_listener)
	end

	if self.lua_event_listener ~= nil then
		self.lua_event_listener:Dispose()
		self.lua_event_listener = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:get_musics()
	-- add section musics here
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

--[[
	InteractEvent 이벤트 처리
	]]
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local target = e.Target
	local fixer_son = get_character(self.fixer_son_name)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, fixer_son) then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(fixer_son, "snowmountain_main_s9_14_2")
	end

	return false
end

-- ZoneEnterEvent 이벤트 처리
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter or not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return false end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.coco_zone_name and not self.see_coco_event then
		self.see_coco_event = true

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.coco_event, self)
	elseif zone_name == self.fixer_house_zone_name then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(57.5, 0, -111))
	end

	return false
end

-- ZoneLeaveEvent 이벤트 처리
function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not e.FullLeave or not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return false end

	local coco = get_character(self.coco_name)
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.fixer_house_zone_name then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, coco)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
    -- 스테이지 체크
    if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_5 then
        return true
    end

    -- 이펙트 로드
    unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.red_ice)
    unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_preset)
    unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.dead_preset)

    -- 이벤트 구독
    message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
    message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
    message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')

    -- 기본 설정
    self:setting()

    return true
end

function local_class:start()
    -- 스테이지 체크
    if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_5 then
        return
    end

    -- 마커와 트래커 설정
    ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name,
            self.quest_progress.QuestId, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(49.5, 0, 55))

    quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name))

    -- 스테이지 시작 이벤트 여기서 진행
    coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.stage_intro, self))
end

function local_class:exit()
    -- 이벤트 구독 취소
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

    if lua_helper.type_compare(self.coco.Interactable:GetType(), typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable)) then
        self.coco.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
    end
    self.coco = nil

    self.coco_snowbox = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
    local event_type = e:GetType()
    if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
        self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
    elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
        self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
    elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
        self:on_interact_event(e)
    end

    return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
    if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
    if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
    local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

    if zone_name == self.ignore_coco_zone_name then
        if self.event_progress < EventProgress.meet_coco then
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ignore_coco_event, self))
        end
    elseif zone_name == self.cave_zone_name then
        ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)

        ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name,
                self.quest_progress.QuestId, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(55.5, 0, 95))
    elseif zone_name == self.see_court_zone_name then
        if self.event_progress < EventProgress.see_court then
            self.event_progress = EventProgress.see_court
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.see_court_event, self))
        end
    end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
    if not e.FullLeave then return end
    if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end

    local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

    if zone_name == self.cave_zone_name then
        ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)

        ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name,
                self.quest_progress.QuestId, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(49.5, 0, 55))
    end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
    if e.Target == self.coco and self.event_progress < EventProgress.meet_coco then
        self.event_progress = EventProgress.meet_coco
        coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.meet_coco_event, self))
    end
end

    self.coco_snowbox = get_field_object(self.coco_snowbox_name)
    self.coco_snowbox.Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.8

    field_ui_manager:Hide()
    user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

    character_util.look_at(user_party_leader, self.coco)

    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.coco, { key = 'snowmountain_main_additional_s1_42', skip = true })

    -- 코코가 플레이어 따라오지 않고 눈 박스도 해제
    self.coco:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
    self.controller:reset_snowbox_position()

    character_util.align_party(self.coco_snowbox, "right")

    wait_for_sec(1)

    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.coco, { key = 'snowmountain_main_additional_s1_43', skip = true })

    music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "01_push_snowball_01", type_priority = "event", player_priority = "npc" })

    -- 코코가 얼음에서 탈출하는 연출
    local limit_x = 0.02
    local limit_z = 0.02
    local target_pos = self.coco_snowbox.Position
    local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
    local shake_time = 1

    while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < shake_time do
        local cur_x = unity_class.random.Range(-limit_x, limit_x)
        local cur_z = unity_class.random.Range(-limit_z, limit_z)

        self.coco_snowbox.Position = target_pos + vector(cur_x, 0, cur_z)

        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "01_snowball_hit_01", type_priority = "event", player_priority = "npc" })

local local_class = newclass('SnowMountainMainAdditionalSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = SnowMountainMainAdditional @
		Comment =  수상한 동굴을 조사하다 얼어붙은 왕자를 보게 되고, 설인 리포터를 클론 코코로부터 구해주는 플레이어 일행 @
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

local EventProgress = {
    -- 초기 상태
    idle = 0,
    -- 얼어붙은 설인 왕자 보는 이벤트

    -- 설인 리포터 만나고 클론 코코와 전투하는 이벤트
    fight_with_clone_coco = 2
}

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
    self.controller = controller
    self.quest_spec = quest_spec
    self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

    -- 현재 진행도
    self.event_progress = EventProgress.idle

    self.snowman_prince = nil
    self.coco_clone = nil
    self.snowman_reporter_a = nil

    -- 화면 암전되고 끝까지 도달하면 왕자 보이는 이벤트
    self.fade_out_routine = nil

    -- 설인들이 있는 동굴 내부로 들어가서 틴트가 적용 중인지 저장
    self.is_enter_snowman_zone = false

    -- 기타 상수
    self.battle_gate_num = 2
    self.snowman_grid_center_x = 117.5

    -- 캐릭터 이름
    self.coco_name = "coco"
    self.snowman_prince_name = "snowman_prince"
    self.coco_clone_name = "coco_clone"
    self.snowman_reporter_name = "snowman_reporter_a"

    -- 필드오브젝트 이름
    self.coco_snowbox_name = "coco_snowbox"
    self.battle_gate_name = "coco_clone_battlegate_"

    -- 마커 이름
    self.default_start_marker_name = "default_start"

    -- 존 이름
    self.cave_zone_name = "section_2_cave"
    self.battle_zone_name = "section_2_battle"

    -- 카메라 그리드 이름
    self.cave_snowman_grid_name = "section_2_cave_snowman"
    self.cave_inner_grid_name = "section_2_cave_inner"

    -- 배틀 그룹 이름
    self.battle_group_name = "coco_clone"

    self.tint_key = "cave"
    self.color_key = "snowman_prince"

    self.narration_key = "snowmountain_main_additional_narration"

    -- 보스 연출 스트링 키
    self.boss_title = 'snowmountain_main_additional_s2_boss_title'
    self.boss_subtitle = 'snowmountain_main_additional_s2_boss_subtitle'

    -- 퀘스트 마커와 트래커 이름
    self.marker_name = 'snowmountain_main_additional'
    self.tracker_name_1 = 'snowmountain_main_additional_s2_tracker_0'
    self.tracker_name_2 = 'snowmountain_main_additional_s2_tracker_1'

    -- 이펙트 프리셋
    self.red_ice = "fx_red_ice"
    self.break_red_ice = "FX_break_red_ice"
    self.red_ice_hit = "Manual_RedIce_Hit"

    -- 사운드

    CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadBossTitle()
end

function local_class:enter()
    -- 스테이지 체크
    if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_5 then
        return true
    end

    -- 이펙트 로드
    unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.red_ice)
    unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.break_red_ice)
    unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.red_ice_hit)
    unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_preset)

    -- 이벤트 구독
    message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
    message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
    message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_event')
    message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
    message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
    message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')

    -- 기본 설정
    self:setting()

    return true
end

function local_class:start()
    -- 스테이지 체크
    if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_5 then
        return
    end

    -- 마커와 트래커 설정
    ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name,
            self.quest_progress.QuestId, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(96.5, 0, 69))

    quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name_1))
end

function local_class:exit()
    -- 이벤트 구독 취소
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

    self.coco = nil
    self.snowman_prince = nil
    self.coco_clone = nil
    self.snowman_reporter_a = nil

    self.fade_out_routine = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
    local event_type = e:GetType()
    if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
        self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
    elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
        self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
    elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then
        self:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
    elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent) then
        self:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
    elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
        self:on_interact_event(e)
    elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
        self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
    end

    return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
    if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
    if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
    local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

    if zone_name == self.cave_zone_name then
        ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)

        ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name,
                self.quest_progress.QuestId, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(152, 0, 124))

        coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.change_stage_music, self, "bgm_cave_main"))
    elseif zone_name == self.battle_zone_name then
        if self.event_progress < EventProgress.fight_with_clone_coco then
            self.event_progress = EventProgress.fight_with_clone_coco
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fight_with_clone_coco_event, self))
        end
    end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
    if not e.FullLeave then return end
    if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
    local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

    if zone_name == self.cave_zone_name then
        ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)

        ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name,
                self.quest_progress.QuestId, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(96.5, 0, 69))

        coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.change_stage_music, self, "bgm_shivermore_main"))
    end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
    if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) and not
            lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then
        return
    end

    if e.CameraGrid.name == self.cave_snowman_grid_name and not self.is_enter_snowman_zone then
        -- 플레이어가 그리드 왼쪽으로 이동해서 들어온 경우는 틴트 적용할 필요가 없음
        if user_party_leader.Position.x < self.snowman_grid_center_x then
            self.is_enter_snowman_zone = true

            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.tint_cave, self))
        end
    elseif e.CameraGrid.name == self.cave_inner_grid_name then
        if self.event_progress < EventProgress.see_snowman_prince then
            self.fade_out_routine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.see_snowman_prince_event, self))
        end
    end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
    if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) and not
            lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then
        return
    end

    if e.CameraGrid.name == self.cave_snowman_grid_name and self.is_enter_snowman_zone then
        -- 플레이어가 그리드 오른쪽으로 이동해서 빠져나간 경우는 틴트 계속 유지
        if user_party_leader.Position.x < self.snowman_grid_center_x then
            self.is_enter_snowman_zone = false

            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.recover_tint_cave, self))
        end
    elseif e.CameraGrid.name == self.cave_inner_grid_name then
        if self.event_progress < EventProgress.see_snowman_prince then
            stop_coroutine(self.fade_out_routine)
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.recover_fade_event, self))
        end
    end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
    if e.Target == self.snowman_prince then
        coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_with_snowman_prince, self))
    end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
    if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
        coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.defeat_coco_clone, self))
    end
end

-- 기본 설정
function local_class:setting()
    self.coco = get_character(self.coco_name)

    -- 코코가 플레이어 따라오도록 PartyFollowerNPCState로 설정
    self.coco.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
    self.coco.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

    -- 이번 섹션부터 시작한 경우, 코코 위치 설정

        local marker = field:GetMarker(self.default_start_marker_name)
        local marker_tovector = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(marker.direction)

        character_util.set_position(self.coco, marker.position - marker_tovector * CS.Oak.Constants.DistBetweenPartyMembers * user_party.Count)
        character_util.set_direction(self.coco, marker.direction)

    local clms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState.Create(self.coco, user_party, 0, 0, false)

    self.coco_clone.SpineController:AddColor(self.color_key, unity_color({0, 0, 0, 1}), 1, 0)
    self.coco_clone.SpineController:AddFadeColor(self.color_key, unity_color({0, 0, 0, 1}), 1, 0)

-- 동굴 안 쪽에서 얼어버린 설인 왕자를 보는 이벤트
function local_class:see_snowman_prince_event()
    -- 그리드 이동하는 동안 암전
    CS.Oak.FadeScreenTransition.Instance:EnableMeshRenderer(true)

    local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
    local fade_time = 0.2

    while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fade_time do
        local cur_mod = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / fade_time

        CS.Oak.FadeScreenTransition.Instance:SetFadeColor(unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, cur_mod * 0.7 }))

        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    -- 특정 x값에 도달할 때까지 컨트롤 빼앗지 않음
    local max_x = 145

    while user_party_leader.Position.x < max_x do
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    -- 퀘스트 진행 상황 저장
    self.event_progress = EventProgress.see_snowman_prince

    -- 플레이어 컨트롤 빼앗고 연출 진행
    field_ui_manager:Hide()
    user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

    self.coco:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
    self.coco.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

    coroutine.yield(nil)

    character_util.align_party(vector(147, 0, 107), "left")

    character_util.move_to_async(self.coco, vector(146, 0, 108), 1, nil, true, true)

    wait_for_sec(0.3)

    music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "01_jump_01", type_priority = "event", player_priority = "npc" })

    character_util.jump(self.coco, 1, 0.5)
    character_util.set_emotion(self.coco, { name = "smile" })

    wait_for_sec(0.5)

    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.coco, { key = 'snowmountain_main_additional_s2_0', skip = true, portraitname = "innuit.png" })

    camera_util.move(self.snowman_prince.Position, 1)

    character_util.align_party(self.snowman_prince.Position + vector(0, 0, -1), "left")

    character_util.remove_emotion(self.coco)
    character_util.move_to_async(self.coco, self.snowman_prince.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
            1, nil, true, true, true)

    character_util.set_anim(self.coco, { name = "cast" })
    character_util.set_emotion(self.coco, { name = "attack" })

    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.coco, { key = 'snowmountain_main_additional_s2_1', skip = true, portraitname = "innuit.png" })

    local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "03_equipping_01", loop = true, type_priority = "event", player_priority = "npc" })

    camera_util.resize_to(3, 2)

-- 설인 왕자 방에서 나갈 때, 페이드를 복구하는 이벤트
function local_class:recover_fade_event()
    -- 그리드 이동하는 동안 복구
    local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
    local fade_time = 0.2

    while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fade_time do
        local cur_mod =  1 - (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / fade_time

        CS.Oak.FadeScreenTransition.Instance:SetFadeColor(unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, cur_mod * 0.7 }))

        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    CS.Oak.FadeScreenTransition.Instance:EnableMeshRenderer(false)
end

function local_class:enter()
    -- 스테이지 체크
    if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_5 then
        return true
    end

    -- 이펙트 로드
    unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.red_ice)
    unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.break_red_ice)
    unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_preset)

    -- 이벤트 구독
    message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
    message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')

    -- 기본 설정
    self:setting()

    return true

function local_class:start()
    -- 스테이지 체크
    if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_5 then
        return
    end

    -- 마커와 트래커 설정
    ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name,
            self.quest_progress.QuestId, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.snowman_general)

    -- 스테이지 시작 이벤트 여기서 진행
    if self.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.skip_intro_event_custom_key_name) ~= 1 then
        coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.stage_intro, self))
    else
        coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.skip_boss_intro, self))

    -- 이벤트 구독 취소
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

    self.coco = nil
    self.reporter = nil
    self.snowman_general = nil
    self.boss_snowman_general = nil
    self.corpse_general = nil

    self.origin_party = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
    local event_type = e:GetType()
    if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
        self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
    elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
        self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
    end

    return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
    if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
    if e.FieldObject ~= self.coco then return end
    local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

    if zone_name == self.court_zone_name then
        if self.event_progress < EventProgress.enter_court_event then
            self.event_progress = EventProgress.enter_court_event
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_court_event, self))
        end
    end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
    if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
        coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.defeat_snowman_general, self))
    end
end

-- 블리자드가 서서히 사라지는 이벤트
function local_class:dispose_blizzard()
    local wait_time = 4
    local fade_time = 4
    local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

    while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < wait_time do
        local progress = unity_class.mathf.Max(0.5 - (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / fade_time, 0)

        self.controller:blizzard_update(progress * 0.5, 0)

        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    wait_for_sec(3)

    self.controller:blizzard_dispose()
end

-- 랜덤하게 이누이트, 설인 족이 돌멩이를 던져서 코코를 맞추는 이벤트
function local_class:random_throw_rock()
    -- 랜덤으로 던지는 방향, 몇 번째 NPC가 던지는지, 던지고 나서 다음 던질 때까지의 대기 시간을 설정함
    -- 해결사 아들(left index 마지막)과 마코(right index 0번)는 돌 던지면 안되므로 index에서 제외
    local rand_dir = 0
    local rand_index = 0
    local rand_delay = 0
    local thrower = nil

    while true do
        rand_dir = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(0, 2))

        if rand_dir == 0 then
            rand_index = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(0, self.extra_list_left.Count - 2))

            thrower = self.extra_list_left[rand_index]
        else
            rand_index = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(1, self.extra_list_right.Count - 1))

            thrower = self.extra_list_right[rand_index]
        end

        rand_delay = unity_class.random.Range(0.3, 0.7)

        coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.throw_rock_to_coco, self, thrower))

        wait_for_sec(rand_delay)
    end
end

-- 돌멩이가 날아와서 코코를 맞추는 이벤트
function local_class:throw_rock_to_coco(thrower)

    local fix_vector

    self.marker_name = 'snowmountain_main_additional'
    self.tracker_name = 'snowmountain_main_additional_s4_tracker_0'

    self.red_ice = "fx_red_ice"

end

function local_class:enter()
    -- 스테이지 체크
    if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_5 then
        return true
    end

    -- 이펙트 로드
    unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.red_ice)

    -- 이벤트 구독
    message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
    message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

    -- 기본 설정
    self:setting()

    return true
end

function local_class:start()
    -- 스테이지 체크
    if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_5 then
        return
    end

    -- 마커와 트래커 설정
    ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name,
            self.quest_progress.QuestId, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.coco)

    quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name))

    quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.coco)

    -- 이번 섹션부터 시작했으면 스테이지 시작 이벤트 여기서 진행
    if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 3 then
        coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.stage_intro, self))
    end
end

function local_class:exit()

    message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

    self.coco = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
    local event_type = e:GetType()
    if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
        self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
    elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
        self:on_interact_event(e)
    end

    return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
    if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
    if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
    local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

    if zone_name == self.blizzard_zone_name then
        if self.event_progress < EventProgress.blizzard_event then
            self.event_progress = EventProgress.blizzard_event
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.blizzard_event, self))
        end
    end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
    if e.Target == self.coco then

		none = 1,

	self.refugees = {}

		return true
	end

	for i = 1, 4 do
		table.insert(self.refugees, get_character('soul_voice_refugee_' .. i))
	end

end

		return true
	end

	quest_icon_util.set_substage_icon(refugee)
	character_util.add_listener(refugee, self.controller)

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.prisoner_talk_zone_1 and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then
				self.current_progress = self.event_progress.look_run_people
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.prisoner_talk, self)
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.psychic_watching_zone_1 and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.look_run_people then
				self.current_progress = self.event_progress.first_meeting_psychic
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.watching_psychic, self)
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.section_2_a_zone_name and not self.a_end then
				self.a_end = true
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.section_2_a_zone, self)
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.section_2_c_zone_name and not self.c_end then
				self.c_end = true
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.section_2_c_zone, self)
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.section_2_d_zone_name and not self.d_end then
				self.d_end = true
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.section_2_d_zone, self)
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.section_2_e_zone_name and not self.e_end then
				self.e_end = true
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.section_2_e_zone, self)
			end
		end
	end

	-- 캐릭터에게 인터렉트 체크
	-- 인베이더 크리스탈로 들어가는거 물어봄.
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.psychic) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_to_psychic, self)
			-- TODO 모든 전투 후 불리게 되는지 확인
		elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.section_2_invader_crystal) and
				self.current_progress == self.event_progress.battle_to_crystal_souls then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.ending
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.section_2_invader_crystal_destroy, self)
		end
	end

	-- 몬스터 전멸 조건 체크
	-- 배틀 그룹내 적이 다 죽은걸 확인 후 이벤트 이동
	-- 배틀그룹은 A C D E
	-- B는 중앙이다.
	-- 이후 배 배틀 종료 시 마다 카메라를 움직여 효과가 옅어지는 모습을 줄 것.

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.battle_to_crystal_souls and
				table_util.contain_value(self.crystal_battle_group_names, e.BattleGroupName) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.on_crystal_battle_over, self, e.BattleGroupName)

		elseif e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_P' and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.first_meeting_psychic then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.request_to_enter_crystal
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.BATTLE_P_end, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:choose_event()
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'steampunk_soul_voice_33', 'mercy' }, { 'steampunk_soul_voice_34', 'brutal' } })

	-- 수락한경우 수락 이벤트 실행
	if result == 1 then
		self.current_progress = self.event_progress.battle_to_crystal_souls
		character_util.remove_relate_event(self.psychic, self.controller)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.psychic, { key = 'steampunk_soul_voice_36', skip = true })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.psychic, { key = 'steampunk_soul_voice_37', skip = true })

		-- 마법진 효과
		wait_for_sec(1)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_summon_effect_01' })
		self.magic_circle_cast:Instantiate(user_party_leader.Position)
		wait_for_sec(0.35)
		self.magic_circle_cast:Dispose()
		self.magic_circle_cast = nil
		-- 플레이어 투명화
		party_util.set_direction('down')
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party.Leader, 0.5, 2)

		-- 마법진 아래로 다른 파티원을 정렬합니다. / 1명만 보내는 연출 / 내러티브가 부족하기 때문에 빠져도 되는 연출입니다.
		local member_pos_list = {
			vector(-1, 0, 24),
			vector(-2, 0, 24),
			vector(-3, 0, 24),
		}

		for i = user_party.Count - 1, 1, -1 do
			local member = user_party[i]
			character_util.convert_to_npc(member)
			wp_util.move_way_points(member, { waypoints = member_pos_list[i], speed = 3, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up })
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.35)
		self.magic_circle_appear:Instantiate(user_party_leader.Position)

		wait_for_sec(3)

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'event', name = 'bgm_cave_main', mix = 2})
		music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({state = 'field', name = 'bgm_cave_main'})

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fade_out_01' })
		screen_util.fade_out_async(0.75, unity_class.color.white, "linear")

		character_util.set_position(user_party_leader, vector(47, 0, 18))
		user_party.Leader.Direction = character_util.get_direction('left')
		user_party.Leader:SetEmotion('hurt', true)
		user_party.Leader:SetAnimation('prostrate', true)

		field:Tint(self.tint_key, CS.UnityEngine.Color(0.9, 0.1, 0.9, 0.3), 0)

		self.magic_circle_appear:Dispose()
		self.magic_circle_appear = nil

		local wanderers = {
			self.wanderer_1,
			self.wanderer_1_1,
			self.wanderer_1_2,
			self.wanderer_1_3,
			self.wanderer_2,
			self.wanderer_2_1,
			self.wanderer_2_2,
			self.wanderer_2_3,
			self.wanderer_3,
			self.wanderer_3_1,
			self.wanderer_3_2,
			self.wanderer_3_3,
			self.wanderer_4,
			self.wanderer_4_1,
			self.wanderer_4_2,
			self.wanderer_4_3
		}
		for _, wanderer in ipairs(wanderers) do
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(wanderer, 0.5, 0)
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		screen_util.fade_in_async(0.75, unity_class.color.white, "linear")

		-- 페이드 인 끝나고 정신 차리는 연출
		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_rustle_01'})
		user_party.Leader:Shake(0.05, 1.5)
		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		user_party.Leader:SetEmotion('tired', true)
		user_party.Leader:SetAnimation('seat', true)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		user_party.Leader:SetEmotion('surprise', true)
		user_party.Leader:RemoveAnimation()
		character_util.normal_jump(user_party.Leader, true)
		wait_for_sec(0.75)

		user_party.Leader.Direction = direction_util.get_opposite(user_party.Leader.Direction)
		wait_for_sec(0.75)

		user_party.Leader:RemoveEmotion()
		user_party.Leader.Direction = direction_util.get_opposite(user_party.Leader.Direction)

		-- 거절한 경우 대사만 한줄 치고 넘김
	else
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.psychic, { key = 'steampunk_soul_voice_35', skip = true })
	end

	return result
end

function local_class:fade_crystal_aura(duration)
	local start_a = #self.crystal_battle_group_names / 4.0
	local end_a = (#self.crystal_battle_group_names - 1) / 4.0

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local current_a = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_a, end_a, progress)
		self:set_alpha_to_aura(self.crystal_aura, current_a)

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self:set_alpha_to_aura(self.crystal_aura, end_a)

	if end_a == 0 then
		self.crystal_aura:Dispose()
		self.crystal_aura = nil
	end
end

function local_class:set_alpha_to_aura(aura, alpha)
	local particle = aura.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem))
	local mat = aura.transform:Find('mesh_aura'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.MeshRenderer)).material

	local glow_color = particle.main.startColor.color
	glow_color.a = alpha
	local mesh_color = mat:GetColor("_TintColor")
	mesh_color.a = alpha

	mat:SetColor("_TintColor", mesh_color)
	local ps_main = particle.main;
	ps_main.startColor = CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem.MinMaxGradient(glow_color)
end

--- 크리스탈에 들어간후 원혼들과의 싸움이 끝날떄마다 불리는 함수

		command_util.execute_extinguish(user_party_leader, self.a_brazier_0)
		command_util.execute_extinguish(user_party_leader, self.a_brazier_1)
	elseif group_name == 'BATTLE_C' then
		command_util.execute_extinguish(user_party_leader, self.c_brazier_0)
		command_util.execute_extinguish(user_party_leader, self.c_brazier_1)
	elseif group_name == 'BATTLE_D' then
		command_util.execute_extinguish(user_party_leader, self.d_brazier_0)
		command_util.execute_extinguish(user_party_leader, self.d_brazier_1)
	elseif group_name == 'BATTLE_E' then
		command_util.execute_extinguish(user_party_leader, self.e_brazier_0)
		command_util.execute_extinguish(user_party_leader, self.e_brazier_1)
	end

	camera_util.move_async(self.section_2_invader_crystal.Position, 1)

	self:fade_crystal_aura(1)

	-- 죽은 배틀그룹 제거
	for i, name in ipairs(self.crystal_battle_group_names) do

		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'break_crystal', self.section_2_invader_crystal)

function local_class:on_event(e)

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
		self:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	local list = self.pot_list
	for i=0, list.Count -1 do
		local pot = list[i]

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, pot) then
			local pot_xy = vector_util.get_x0z(pot.Position)

			self.destroy_count = self.destroy_count + 1

			self:drop_gold_everywhere(pot_xy)
			if self.destroy_count == 70 then
				self.last_pot = pot
				self.pot_house_star_piece.Position = pot.Position
				message_system:Send(self.pot_house_star_piece,
						CS.Oak.StarPieceAppearEvent.Create(pot.Position))
			end
			if not self.is_still_talking then
				self.is_still_talking = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.dont_break_my_pot, self,
								vector_util.get_x0z(pot.Position), self.nth_line))
				if self.destroy_count < 50 then
					self.nth_line = random_util.get_random_int(3, 6)
				elseif self.destroy_count >= 50 then
					if self.nth_line < 7 then
						self.nth_line = 7
					elseif self.nth_line < 10 then
						self.nth_line = self.nth_line + 1
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:drop_gold_everywhere(pot_xy)
	if self.destroy_count % 7 == 0 then
		for i=0,30 do
			local rad = math.pi * 4 * random_util.get_random_value()
			CS.Oak.DropGold.Create(pot_xy, pot_xy + (vector(math.cos(rad),
					0, math.sin(rad)) * random_util.get_random_int(0.1, 2)), 10)
		end
	end
end


function local_class:dont_break_my_pot(loc, line)
	local npc = self.pot_guy
	npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.remove_anim(npc)
	local starting_pos = npc.Position

	character_util.set_direction(npc,
			CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetSideDirection(vector_util.to_direction(loc - starting_pos)))
	if self.destroy_count == 70 then
		return
	end
	character_util.move_to_async(npc, loc,nil,
			5,true,true,true)
	local random_anim = random_util.get_random_int(1, 3)
	local random_emote = random_util.get_random_int(1, 7)
	local anim_list = {'release', 'embarrassed', 'push'}
	local emote_list = {'tired', 'mad', 'attack', 'damaged', 'blush', 'confused', 'cry'}
	local sfx_list = {'01_swing_01', '03_runaway_01'}
	local dlg_sfx_list = {'03_dialogue_sadness_01', '03_dialogue_negative_01', '03_dialogue_tipsy_01'}
	local emote_sfx = nil
	local anim_sfx = nil
	if self.nth_line == 9 then
		character_util.set_emotion(npc, {name = 'confused'})
		character_util.set_direction(npc, CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetSideDirection(vector_util.to_direction(loc - starting_pos)))
		character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'frustration', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(npc, 'pot_house_'..line)
	else
		character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = anim_list[random_anim]})
		character_util.set_direction(npc, CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetSideDirection(npc.Direction))
		character_util.set_emotion(npc, { name = emote_list[random_emote] })
		if random_anim ~= 3 then
			anim_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = sfx_list[random_anim],
			                                            play_pos = npc.Position, loop = false,
			                                            type_priority = 4000, player_priority = 900 })
		end

		if random_emote == 1 or random_emote == 4 or random_emote == 7 then
			emote_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = dlg_sfx_list[1],
			                                               play_pos = npc.Position,
			                                               type_priority = 4000, player_priority = 900 })
		elseif random_emote == 2 or random_emote == 3 then
			emote_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = dlg_sfx_list[2],
			                                         play_pos = npc.Position,
			                                         type_priority = 4000, player_priority = 900 })

		elseif random_emote == 5 or random_emote == 6 then
			emote_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = dlg_sfx_list[3],
			                                         play_pos = npc.Position,
			                                         type_priority = 4000, player_priority = 900 })
		end


		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(npc, 'pot_house_'..line)

		if emote_sfx ~= nil then

		end
		if anim_sfx ~= nil then
			anim_sfx:FadeOut(0.2)
			anim_sfx:Stop()
		end
	end

	self.is_still_talking = false
	coroutine.yield(wait_for_sec(0.3))
end

function local_class:pots_all_gone()
	local npc = self.pot_guy
	while true do
		if self.destroy_count  == 70 then
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(npc)

			character_util.move_waypoint_async(npc, vector(npc.Position.x, 0, -32),
					5, false, nil, nil, CS.Oak.Direction.Up)
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(npc, vector(144, 0, -32),
					5, false, nil, nil, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)

			character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'seat'})
			character_util.set_direction(npc, CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetSideDirection(npc.Direction))
			character_util.set_emotion(npc, { name = 'cry' })

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(npc, 'pot_house_10')
			npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

			yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass("SteampunkBorderlineSection1")
--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = SteampunkBorderline @
		Comment = 경계 구역 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.progress_enum = {
		--- 초기 상태
		begin = 0,
		--- 경계상태
		idle = 1,
		--- 근무 교대시간
		time_out = 2,
		--- 이벤트 완료 상태
		event_end
	}

	self.current_progress = nil

	self.border_soldier_name = 'line_soldier_'
	self.kanterbury_border_event_zone_name = 'kanterbury_border'
	self.border_zone_name = 'border_zone'
	self.kanterbury_border_custom_event = "kanterbury_border_line"
	self.is_discovered = false
	self.count = 0
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= 'steampunk_1_1' then
		return true
	end

	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.begin

	-- 시계 돌리는 코드 다른 맵보다 scale 줄여줌
	local clock = get_field_object('border_clock_time')
	local animator_hour = clock.transform:Find('obj_house1_6_minute'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAnimator))
	local animator_minute = clock.transform:Find('obj_house1_6_hour'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAnimator))

	animator_hour.TimeScale = 0
	animator_minute.TimeScale = 0

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.soldier_first_talk_coroutine ~= nil then
		stop_coroutine(self.soldier_first_talk_coroutine)
		self.soldier_first_talk_coroutine = nil
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.kanterbury_border_event_zone_name then
			if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.begin then
				self.soldier_first_talk_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.soldier_first_talk, self, true))
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('border_clock')) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.manipulate_clock, self))
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e.Params ~= nil and e.Params.Length == 2 then
			if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.idle and not self.is_discovered then
				self.is_discovered = true
				if e.Params[0] == self.kanterbury_border_custom_event then
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.detected_talk, self)
					return true
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- 존 처음 입장 시 경계병들 대화
function local_class:soldier_first_talk(first)
	local lu_soldier = get_character(self.border_soldier_name .. 1)
	local ru_soldier = get_character(self.border_soldier_name .. 2)
	local ld_soldier = get_character(self.border_soldier_name .. 3)
	local rd_soldier = get_character(self.border_soldier_name .. 4)

	if first then
		lu_soldier.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		ru_soldier.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		ld_soldier.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		rd_soldier.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

		lu_soldier.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.WayPointGuardCharacterController.Create(
				lu_soldier, self.kanterbury_border_custom_event, 5, 90)
		ru_soldier.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.WayPointGuardCharacterController.Create(
				ru_soldier, self.kanterbury_border_custom_event, 5, 90)
		ld_soldier.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.WayPointGuardCharacterController.Create(
				ld_soldier, self.kanterbury_border_custom_event, 5, 90)
		rd_soldier.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.WayPointGuardCharacterController.Create(
				rd_soldier, self.kanterbury_border_custom_event, 5, 90)

		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.idle

		-- 야, 시간 얼마나 지났냐?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lu_soldier,
				{ key = 'steampunk_1_border_talk_1' })
		character_util.set_direction(lu_soldier, 'down')

		while not field:IsInSameCameraGrid(user_party.Leader.Position, ru_soldier.Position) do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		-- 30분도 안 지났어.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ru_soldier,
				{ key = 'steampunk_1_border_talk_2' })

		while not field:IsInSameCameraGrid(user_party.Leader.Position, ru_soldier.Position) do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		-- 뭐?! 최소 한 시간은 지난 줄 알았는데.
		character_util.jump(rd_soldier, 0.5, 0.5)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(rd_soldier,
				{ key = 'steampunk_1_border_talk_3' })

		while not field:IsInSameCameraGrid(user_party.Leader.Position, ru_soldier.Position) do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		-- 아 배고파 죽겠네
		character_util.set_emotion(ld_soldier, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ld_soldier,
				{ key = 'steampunk_1_border_talk_4' })

		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		while not field:IsInSameCameraGrid(user_party.Leader.Position, ru_soldier.Position) do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		-- 야, 지금은 시간 얼마나 지났냐?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lu_soldier,
				{ key = 'steampunk_1_border_talk_5' })

		while not field:IsInSameCameraGrid(user_party.Leader.Position, ru_soldier.Position) do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		-- 아오 그만 물어 봐! 1분전에 물어봤잖아!
		character_util.set_emotion(ru_soldier, { name = 'mad' })
		character_util.set_anim(ru_soldier, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ru_soldier,
				{ key = 'steampunk_1_border_talk_6' })

		while not field:IsInSameCameraGrid(user_party.Leader.Position, ru_soldier.Position) do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		-- 교대 시간까지 2시간이나 남았네…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(rd_soldier,
				{ key = 'steampunk_1_border_talk_7' })

		-- 원래대로 세팅
		character_util.set_anim(ru_soldier, { name = 'idle' })

		character_util.set_emotion(lu_soldier, { name = "idle" })
		character_util.set_emotion(ru_soldier, { name = "idle" })
		character_util.set_emotion(ld_soldier, { name = "idle" })
		character_util.set_emotion(rd_soldier, { name = "idle" })
	end



	while true do
		while not field:IsInSameCameraGrid(user_party.Leader.Position, ru_soldier.Position) do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		-- 야, 시간 얼마나 지났냐?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lu_soldier,
				{ key = 'steampunk_1_border_talk_1' })

		while not field:IsInSameCameraGrid(user_party.Leader.Position, ru_soldier.Position) do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		if self.count == 0 then
			-- 2시간 남았어.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ru_soldier,
					{ key = 'steampunk_1_border_talk_2_1' })

		elseif self.count == 1 then
			-- 1시간 30분 남았어.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ru_soldier,
					{ key = 'steampunk_1_border_talk_2_2' })
		elseif self.count == 2 then
			-- 1시간 남았어.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ru_soldier,
					{ key = 'steampunk_1_border_talk_2_3' })
		elseif self.count == 3 then
			-- 30분 남았어.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ru_soldier,
					{ key = 'steampunk_1_border_talk_2_4' })
		end

		while not field:IsInSameCameraGrid(user_party.Leader.Position, ru_soldier.Position) do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		-- 아 배고파 죽겠네.
		character_util.set_emotion(rd_soldier, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(rd_soldier,
				{ key = 'steampunk_1_border_talk_4_alt_1' })

		wait_for_sec(2)

		character_util.set_emotion(lu_soldier, { name = "idle" })
		character_util.set_emotion(ru_soldier, { name = "idle" })
		character_util.set_emotion(ld_soldier, { name = "idle" })
		character_util.set_emotion(rd_soldier, { name = "idle" })

		wait_for_sec(2)
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

-- 시계를 조작
function local_class:manipulate_clock()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'attack', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_hit_dummy_02')
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_gear_01')
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)

	lever = get_field_object('border_clock')
	local animator = lever:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	animator:Play("pull", -1)

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	animator:Play("push", -1)

	wait_for_sec(0.4)
	-- 시계 돌리는 코드

	local clock = get_field_object('border_clock_time')
	local animator_hour = clock.transform:Find('obj_house1_6_minute'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAnimator))
	local animator_minute = clock.transform:Find('obj_house1_6_hour'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAnimator))

	animator_hour.TimeScale = 36
	animator_minute.TimeScale = 36

	wait_for_sec(1)

	animator_hour.TimeScale = 0
	animator_minute.TimeScale = 0

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	self.count = self.count + 1

	if self.count >= 4 and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.idle then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.time_out
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.change_time, self)
		return
	end
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

-- 경계구역을 지나갈려고 하면
function local_class:detected_talk()
	stop_coroutine(self.soldier_first_talk_coroutine)
	self.soldier_first_talk_coroutine = nil

	local lu_soldier = get_character(self.border_soldier_name .. 1)
	local ru_soldier = get_character(self.border_soldier_name .. 2)
	local ld_soldier = get_character(self.border_soldier_name .. 3)
	local rd_soldier = get_character(self.border_soldier_name .. 4)

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(lu_soldier)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(ru_soldier)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(ld_soldier)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(rd_soldier)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_runaway_01')
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.jump(user_party[i], 1, 0.5)
		character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], { name = "embarrassed" })
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], { name = "scared" })
	end

	character_util.set_emotion(lu_soldier, { name = "mad" })
	character_util.set_emotion(ru_soldier, { name = "mad" })
	character_util.set_emotion(ld_soldier, { name = "mad" })
	character_util.set_emotion(rd_soldier, { name = "mad" })

	-- 플레이어 위치에 따라 방향 변경
	local direction = (user_party_leader.Position - lu_soldier.Position):ToDirection()
	character_util.set_direction(lu_soldier, direction)

	direction = (user_party_leader.Position - ru_soldier.Position):ToDirection()
	character_util.set_direction(ru_soldier, direction)

	direction = (user_party_leader.Position - ld_soldier.Position):ToDirection()
	character_util.set_direction(ld_soldier, direction)

	direction = (user_party_leader.Position - rd_soldier.Position):ToDirection()
	character_util.set_direction(rd_soldier, direction)


	-- 침입자다!!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party_leader,
			{ key = 'steampunk_1_border_talk_8', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout', screen_pos = vector(0, -100) })

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(rd_soldier)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 원래대로
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_position(user_party[i], vector(-9.5, 0, -134))
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'down')
		character_util.remove_anim(user_party[i])
		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party[i])
	end

	character_util.set_emotion(lu_soldier, { name = "idle" })
	character_util.set_emotion(ru_soldier, { name = "idle" })
	character_util.set_emotion(ld_soldier, { name = "idle" })
	character_util.set_emotion(rd_soldier, { name = "idle" })

	character_util.set_direction(lu_soldier, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(ru_soldier, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(ld_soldier, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(rd_soldier, 'down')

	self.is_discovered = false
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	self.soldier_first_talk_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.soldier_first_talk, self, false))
end

-- 근무교대
function local_class:change_time()
	stop_coroutine(self.soldier_first_talk_coroutine)
	self.soldier_first_talk_coroutine = nil

	local lu_soldier = get_character(self.border_soldier_name .. 1)
	local ru_soldier = get_character(self.border_soldier_name .. 2)
	local ld_soldier = get_character(self.border_soldier_name .. 3)
	local rd_soldier = get_character(self.border_soldier_name .. 4)

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(lu_soldier)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(ru_soldier)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	lu_soldier.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController()
	ru_soldier.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController()
	ld_soldier.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController()
	rd_soldier.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController()

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	-- 딩~ 동~ 댕~ 동~
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_clock_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party_leader,

local local_class = newclass('SteampunkColosseumPreSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = pre @
		QuestName = SteampunkColosseum @
		Comment = 콜로세움 스테이지 해금 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.flyer_boy_name = 'flyer_boy'

	-- flyer_boy 종이 던지는 이벤트 끝냈는지
	self.tossed_paper = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.pre_section_stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.pre_section_stage_name then
		return
	end

	self:colosseum_setup()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	if type_util.is_npc_interactable(self.flyer_boy) then
		self.flyer_boy.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	self.crowd = nil
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.flyer_boy) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.colosseum_event, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'toss_paper') and not self.tossed_paper then
		self.tossed_paper = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.toss_paper_event, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:colosseum_setup()
	self.flyer_boy = get_character(self.flyer_boy_name)
	self.flyer_boy.Position = vector(151, 0, 90)
	self.flyer_boy.Direction = character_util.get_direction('up')
	self.flyer_boy.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

	self.crowd = {}
	local crowd_offsets = {
		vector(2, 0, -1.3),
		vector(2.5, 0, 0.5),
		vector(1.5, 0, 2),
		vector(-0.5, 0, 2.25),
		vector(-2, 0, 1.5),
		vector(-2.5, 0, 0)
	}

	for i, offset in ipairs(crowd_offsets) do
		self.crowd[i] = (get_character("colosseum_crowd_" .. i))

		local pos = self.flyer_boy.Position + offset
		self.crowd[i].Position = pos
	end
end

function local_class:colosseum_event()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.flyer_boy)

	party_util.align_to_target(self.flyer_boy, 'down', 1, 'arc')

	character_util.look_at(self.flyer_boy, user_party.Leader)
	character_util.set_anim(self.flyer_boy, { name = "salute", loop = false })
	--부소장님!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_twohand_stomp_jump_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.flyer_boy, { key = 'steampunk_4_colosseum_unlock_1', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(self.flyer_boy)
	--콜로세움을 안 가보셨다구요? 얼마나 재밌는데요!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.flyer_boy, { key = 'steampunk_4_colosseum_unlock_2', skip = true })

	--수용민 콜로세움에 대한 정보를 얻었다.
	stage_util.new_stage_theatre_show({
		substage_name = self.controller.unlock_stage_name,
		substage_open_string_key = 'steampunk_4_colosseum_unlock_3'
	})

	yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
end

function local_class:toss_paper_event()
	camera_util.move_async(self.flyer_boy.Position, 1)

	--제국 최고의 경기장. 콜로세움으로 오세요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_emphasize_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.flyer_boy, { key = 'steampunk_4_colosseum_unlock_4', skip = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.flyer_boy, { name = "smile", loop = true })
	character_util.set_anim(self.flyer_boy, { name = "attack", loop = false })
	character_util.jump(self.flyer_boy, 0.5, 0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_throw_01' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_paper_01' })
	local papers = {}
	for i = 1, 6 do
		papers[i] = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = self.flyer_boy.Position, target = self.crowd[i].Position, itemid = 20022, notforinven = true, lootstate = "dontfindlooter", skip_text = true })
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.remove_anim(self.flyer_boy)
	character_util.set_anim(self.flyer_boy, { name = "attack", loop = false })
	character_util.jump(self.flyer_boy, 0.5, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	for i = 1, 6 do
		papers[i].ConsumeTarget = self.crowd[i]
		character_util.set_anim(self.crowd[i], { name = "eat", loop = true })
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	for i = 1, 6 do
		character_util.remove_anim(self.crowd[i])
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)
	quest_icon.SetSubstageIcon(self.flyer_boy)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	camera_util.move_async(user_party_leader.Position, 1, { end_target = user_party_leader })

	character_util.remove_anim(self.flyer_boy)
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('SteampunkColosseumSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = SteampunkColosseum @
		Comment = 콜로세움 입장 - 첫번째 승리까지 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.event_progress = {
		none = 1,
		seen_colosseum = 2,
		refuse_request = 3,
		entry_colosseum = 4,
	}
	self.current_progress = self.event_progress.none

	self.talked_nero_fans = {}
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.unlock_stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.talked_nero_fans = nil
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, get_character('nero')) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.request_entry_colosseum, self)
	elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, get_character('soldier_1')) or type_util.is_interacted_target(e, get_character('soldier_2')) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_to_entry_soldier, self, e.Target)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'show_colosseum_battle') and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then
		self.current_progress = self.event_progress.seen_colosseum
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.show_colosseum, self)
	elseif e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and
			string_helper.start_with(e.Zone.Name, 'nero_fan') and not self.talked_nero_fans[string.sub(e.Zone.Name, 0, 10)] then
		local talker_name = string.sub(e.Zone.Name, 0, 10)
		self.talked_nero_fans[talker_name] = true

		local talker = get_character(talker_name)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(talker, { key = talker.Interactable.Talk })
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:gladiator_fight_scene()
	local gladiator1 = get_character('intro_gladiator_1')
	local gladiator2 = get_character('intro_gladiator_2')

	gladiator1:CancelShake()
	gladiator2:CancelShake()

	local center = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(gladiator1.Position, gladiator2.Position, 0.5)

	gladiator1:SetEmotion('damaged', true)
	gladiator1:SetAnimation('sword_run', true)
	gladiator2:SetEmotion('damaged', true)
	gladiator2:SetAnimation('sword_run', true)
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_way_points_async, gladiator1, { waypoints = center + unity_class.vector3.left * 0.25, speed = 3.5, run = true, play_sfx = true }),
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_way_points_async, gladiator2, { waypoints = center + unity_class.vector3.right * 0.25, speed = 3.5, run = true, play_sfx = true }),
	})

	gladiator1:SetAnimation('sword_attack', true)

	gladiator2:RemoveAnimation()

	wait_for_sec(0.175)

	gladiator1:SetAnimation('sword_idle', true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_slash_01' })
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(gladiator2.Position)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(gladiator2)
	gladiator2:SetAnimation('seat', true)
	character_util.move_to_async(gladiator2, gladiator2.Position + unity_class.vector3.right, 0.25)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	gladiator1:SetEmotion('scared', true)
	gladiator1:SetAnimation('embarrassed', true)

	gladiator2:SetAnimation('sword_run', true)
	wp_util.move_way_points_async(gladiator2, {waypoints = gladiator1.Position + unity_class.vector3.right, speed = 3.5})

	gladiator2:SetAnimation('sword_attack_stab', true)
	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	gladiator2:SetAnimation('sword_idle', true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_stab_critical_01' })
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(gladiator1.Position)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(gladiator1)
	gladiator1:SetEmotion('damaged', true)
	gladiator1:SetAnimation('seat', true)
	character_util.move_to_async(gladiator1, gladiator1.Position + unity_class.vector3.left, 0.25)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
end

function local_class:show_colosseum()
	local nero = get_character('nero')
	local gladiator1 = get_character('intro_gladiator_1')
	local gladiator2 = get_character('intro_gladiator_2')

	party_util.jump(0.5, 0.3)

	-- 와아아아아아!!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_arena_exclamation_02' })
	camera_util.shake(0.3 ,0.2)
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(camera_util.move_async, user_party.Leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 1.5, 1),
		util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, get_character('audience_1'),
				{ key = 'audience_execution_cheer_first', bubble_type = 'shout', screen_pos = vector(-50, 450) })
	})

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.75, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	gladiator1.Position = field:GetMarker('player_fight_stand').position
	character_util.look_at(gladiator1, gladiator2)
	gladiator1.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'basic_sword')
	gladiator1:SetEmotion('scared', true)
	gladiator1:SetAnimation('sword_idle', true)
	gladiator1:Shake(0.05 ,99999)

	gladiator2.Position = field:GetMarker('gladiator_fight_stand').position
	character_util.look_at(gladiator2, gladiator1)
	gladiator2.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'basic_sword')
	gladiator2:SetEmotion('scared', true)
	gladiator2:SetAnimation('sword_idle', true)
	gladiator2:Shake(0.05 ,99999)

	self.controller:audience_watch_battle()

	camera_util.resize_to(5, 0)
	camera_util.move_async(unity_class.vector3.Lerp(gladiator1.Position, gladiator2.Position, 0.5), 0)

	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.75, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 와아아아아아!!!! | 야!!! 떨지말고 화끈하게 싸우라고!! | 싸워라!! 죽여라!!
	camera_util.shake(0.05, 2)
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(self.controller.delay_speech_bubble, self.controller, get_character('audience_1'),
				{ key = 'audience_execution_cheer_1', bubble_type = 'shout', screen_pos = vector(-400, 300), override_key = 'steampunk_colosseum_intro' }, 0.25),
		util.cs_generator(self.controller.delay_speech_bubble, self.controller, get_character('audience_2'),
				{ key = 'steampunk_colosseum_7_2', bubble_type = 'shout', screen_pos = vector(200, -300), dialogue = false }, 0.5, '01_crowd_shout_06'),
		util.cs_generator(self.controller.delay_speech_bubble, self.controller, get_character('audience_3'),
				{ key = 'steampunk_colosseum_7_3', bubble_type = 'shout', screen_pos = vector(-250, -150), dialogue = false }, 0.75, '01_crowd_shout_03'),
	})

	self:gladiator_fight_scene()

	camera_util.move_async(gladiator1.Position, 1, { end_target = gladiator1 })

	-- 으으....
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01' })
	gladiator1:Shake(0.05, 999)
	gladiator1:SetEmotion('scared', true)
	gladiator1:SetAnimation('sword_idle', true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gladiator1, {key = 'steampunk_colosseum_7_4', skip = true})

	gladiator2:CancelShake()
	gladiator2:SetAnimation('embarrassed', true)

	-- 으아아아아!!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(gladiator1, { key = 'steampunk_colosseum_7_5', bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })

	camera_util.resize_to(3, 0.5)
	gladiator1:CancelShake()
	gladiator1:SetEmotion('scared', true)
	gladiator1:SetAnimation('sword_run', true)
	wp_util.move_way_points_async(gladiator1, { waypoints = gladiator2.Position + unity_class.vector3.left, speed = 3.5 })

	time_util.mod('gladiator_fight', 0.25)

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(gladiator1)

	local hit_sound_routine = function()
		wait_for_sec(0.25)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_arena_exclamation_03' })
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 2 })
	end

	local cb = function(_, _)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_sneak_blood_01' })
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(gladiator2.Position)
		gladiator2:Jump(0.75, 0.25)
		character_util.spine_rotate(gladiator2, 720, 0.25)
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(gladiator2)
		gladiator2:SetEmotion('damaged', true)
		gladiator2:SetAnimation('prostrate', true)
		character_util.move_to(gladiator2, gladiator2.Position + unity_class.vector3.right, 0.25)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(hit_sound_routine))
	end
	character_util.set_anim(gladiator1, { name = 'sword_attack_stab', loop = false, next_anim = 'sword_idle', sfx_name = cb })
	wait_for_sec(spine_util.get_animation_duration(gladiator1, 'sword_attack_stab'))

	time_util.unmod('gladiator_fight')

	camera_util.resize_to(CS.Oak.StageCamera.DefaultCameraSize * 1.5, 1)
	gladiator1:SetEmotion('scared', true)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 승자가 결정되었습니다!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_pvp_start_01' })
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nero, { key = 'colosseum_winner_decided_1', bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true, screen_pos = vector(-50, 450) })

	-- 승자는 켄터베리 시궁쥐!!!
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)
	local winner_text = game_string:Format('colosseum_winner_decided_2_dobunezumi', game_string:GetString('steampunk_colosseum_7_6'))
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nero, {
		key = winner_text,
		override_key = 'colosseum_winner_decided_2_dobunezumi',
		bubble_type = 'shout',
		skip = true,
		screen_pos = vector(-50, 450)
	})

	-- 와아아아!!!!
	camera_util.shake(0.05, 2)
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(self.controller.delay_speech_bubble, self.controller, get_character('audience_1'),
				{ key = 'audience_execution_cheer_1', bubble_type = 'shout', screen_pos = vector(-400, 300), override_key = 'audience_execution_cheer_sum' }, 0.25),

local local_class = newclass('SteampunkColosseumSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = SteampunkColosseum @
		Comment = 콜로세움 첫 전투 - 대기실로 돌아오는것 까지 @
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.gladiators = nil
	self.talked_gladiators = {}

	self.battle_gladiator = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.unlock_stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_fo_destroyed_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.unlock_stage_name then
		return
	end

	self.gladiators = self.controller.gladiators

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 1 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(stage_launch_util.default_launch_with_marker_name, 'waiting_room_start'))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))

	self.battle_gladiator = nil
	self.gladiators = nil
	self.talked_gladiators = nil
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, get_character('soldier_1')) or type_util.is_interacted_target(e, get_character('soldier_2')) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.controller.interact_to_entry_soldier, self.controller, e.Target,
				{ callback = self.choose_target_to_fight, args = { self, e.Target } })
	elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.gladiators) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_to_gladiator, self, e.Target)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:interact_to_gladiator(target)
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(target)
	party_util.align_to_target(target, 'down', 1, 'arc')

	if target.Name == 'trash' then
		self:interact_to_trash()
	elseif target.Name == 'cockroach' then
		self:interact_to_cockroach()
	elseif target.Name == 'chicken' then
		self:interact_to_chicken()
	end

	table.insert(self.talked_gladiators, target)
	if #self.talked_gladiators == #self.gladiators then
		local soldier_1 = get_character('soldier_1')
		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(soldier_1)
		soldier_1.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

		local soldier_2 = get_character('soldier_2')
		soldier_2.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end
end

function local_class:interact_to_trash()
	local trash = get_character('trash')

	character_util.look_at(trash, user_party.Leader)
	trash:RemoveAnimation()

	-- 난 죽고싶지 않아…

function local_class:choose_target_to_fight(soldier)
	-- 어떤 놈이랑 붙으실 건가요?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier, { key = 'steampunk_colosseum_30_1', skip = true })

	local branches = {}
	for _, gladiator in ipairs(self.gladiators) do
		table.insert(branches, { 'kanterbury_' .. gladiator.Name })
	end
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event(branches)

	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.controller.quest_progress, self.controller.first_battle_key, result)

	-- 알겠습니다!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier, { key = 'steampunk_colosseum_30_2', skip = true })

	-- 부소장님의 승리를 기대하겠습니다!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier, { key = 'steampunk_colosseum_50_6', skip = true })

local local_class = newclass('SteampunkColosseumSection3')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = SteampunkColosseum @
		Comment = 마지막 검투사와의 대결 - 엔딩 @
		Index = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.unlock_stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_fo_destroyed_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.unlock_stage_name then
		return
	end

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 2 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(stage_launch_util.default_launch_with_marker_name, 'waiting_room_start'))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, get_character('soldier_1')) or type_util.is_interacted_target(e, get_character('soldier_2')) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.controller.interact_to_entry_soldier,
				self.controller, e.Target, { callback = self.start_battle, args = { self, e.Target } })
	elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.controller:get_last_gladiator()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_to_gladiator, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_fo_destroyed_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.controller:get_last_gladiator()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.choose_execute_to_gladiator, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_character('nero')) then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_arena_exclamation_01' })
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.choose_execute_to_nero, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:interact_to_gladiator()
	local gladiator = self.controller:get_last_gladiator()

	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(gladiator)
	gladiator.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)

	party_util.align_to_target(gladiator, 'down', 1, 'arc')

	character_util.look_at(gladiator, user_party.Leader)
	gladiator:RemoveAnimation()

	-- 내가… 사람을 죽였어...
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_sadness_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gladiator, { key = 'steampunk_colosseum_50', skip = true })

	-- 어차피 곧 죽게 될텐데 무슨 상관이지? / 너만은 꼭 살려보겠다.
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'steampunk_colosseum_50_1', 'brutal' }, { 'steampunk_colosseum_50_2', 'mercy' } })

	-- 잔인한 놈... / 아니… 안 될거야...
	local last_talk = result == 1 and 'steampunk_colosseum_50_3' or 'steampunk_colosseum_50_4'
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gladiator, { key = last_talk, skip = true })

	local soldier1 = get_character('soldier_1')
	quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(soldier1)
	soldier1.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

	local soldier2 = get_character('soldier_2')
	soldier2.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

		self.controller:audience_execution_cheer('kill')

		local nero_jump = function()
			local duration = 0.35
			local time_passed = 0
			local start_h = 0
			local end_h = 14

			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_minotaurs_jump_01' })
			nero:SetEmotion('attack', true)
			nero:SetAnimation('cast2', true)

			while time_passed < duration do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
				local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_h, end_h, progress)
				nero.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3.up * cur_y

				coroutine.yield()
			end

			nero.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3.up * end_h
		end

		user_party.Leader:SetEmotion('surprise', true)
		gladiator:SetEmotion('scared', true)

		wait_all({
