		local nero_fall = function()
			local duration = 0.35
			local time_passed = 0
			local start_h = 8
			local end_h = 1

			while time_passed < duration do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
				local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_h, end_h, progress)
				nero.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3.up * cur_y

				coroutine.yield()
			end

			nero.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3.up * end_h

			local fly_duration = 0.25
			local start_pos = nero.Position
			local target_pos = nero.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 2 + unity_class.vector3.left

			music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '02_instant_heal_stomp_01'})
			camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(nero.Position + unity_class.vector3.up * end_h)
			character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(nero)
			character_util.spine_rotate(nero, 360, fly_duration)
			nero:SetEmotion('damaged', true)
			nero:SetAnimation('prostrate', true)

			time_passed = 0
			while time_passed < fly_duration do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / fly_duration)
				local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)
				nero.Position = cur_pos

				local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(1, 0, progress)
				nero.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3.up * cur_y

				coroutine.yield()
			end

			nero.Position = target_pos
			nero.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3.zero
		end

		local player_hold_back = function()
			camera_util.resize_to(3, 0.3)
			character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, switch.Position + unity_class.vector3.back, 0.2, nil, nil, true)

			time_util.unmod('hold_back')
		end

		wait_all({
			util.cs_generator(nero_fall),

		})

		camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
		camera_util.move_async(nero.Position, 1, {end_target = nero})

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01' })
		nero:Shake(0.05, 1)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_costume_equip_01' })
		nero.Direction = character_util.get_direction('right')
		nero:SetAnimation('seat', true)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		-- 흠... 역시...
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fade_out_03' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nero, {key = 'steampunk_colosseum_56_1_1', skip = true})

		nero:RemoveAnimation()
		wp_util.move_way_points_async(nero, { waypoints = nero.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 1.5, speed = 2 })

		-- 부소장, 네 녀석 사실 캔터베리 놈이지?
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
		character_util.look_at(nero, user_party.Leader)
		nero:SetEmotion('doyagao', true)
		nero:SetAnimation('cross_arm', true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nero, { key = 'steampunk_colosseum_56_1', skip = true })

		-- 네놈을 처음 봤을때부터 캔터베리 악취가 나더군.
		nero:SetEmotion('attack', true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nero, { key = 'steampunk_colosseum_56_2', skip = true })

		-- 부소장 행세도 이제 끝이다!! 덤벼라 위선자 녀석!!
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01' })
		camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)
		nero:SetAnimation('release', true)
		character_util.add_animation_sfx(nero, '01_swing_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nero, { key = 'steampunk_colosseum_56_3', bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })
	else
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.controller.quest_progress, self.controller.execute_store_key2, 1)

		camera_util.move_async(nero.Position, 1)

		-- 잔혹한 승리자! Player Name!
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_emphasize_01' })
		nero:SetEmotion('attack', true)
		nero:SetAnimation('cast2', true)
		local text = game_string:Format('steampunk_colosseum_49', user.Name)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nero, { key = text, override_key = 'steampunk_colosseum_49', skip = true })

		camera_util.resize_to(3, 0.5)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- ...
		nero:SetAnimation('cross_arm', true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nero, { key = 'silent_comma', override_key = 'colosseum_nero', skip = true })

		-- 사형!
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_count_final_01' })
		camera_util.shake(0.3 ,0.2)
		nero:SetEmotion('doyagao', true)
		nero:SetAnimation('release', true)
		character_util.add_animation_sfx(nero, '01_swing_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nero, { key = 'steampunk_colosseum_46', bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })

		self.controller:audience_execution_cheer('kill')

		user_party.Leader:SetEmotion('doyagao', true)
		gladiator:SetEmotion('scared', true)

		camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
		camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

		local wp = { vector(switch.Position.x, 0, user_party.Leader.Position.z), switch.Position }
		wp_util.move_way_points_async(user_party.Leader, { waypoints = wp, speed = 4, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right })

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_switch_button_01' })

		self.controller:execute_process(gladiator)

		field_ui_util.play_fame_alignment_async(self.controller.current_alignment, user.Fame, -self.controller.decrease_alignment, 0)
		self.controller.current_alignment = self.controller.current_alignment - self.controller.decrease_alignment

		camera_util.move_async(nero.Position, 1, { end_target = nero })

		-- 음하하하!
		nero.Direction = character_util.get_direction('down')
		nero:SetEmotion('doyagao', true)
		nero:SetAnimation('cast2', true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nero, { key = 'steampunk_colosseum_56', skip = true })

function local_class:nero_battle_setting()
	local gladiator_stand = field:GetMarker('gladiator_fight_stand')
	local nero = get_character('nero')
	nero.Position = gladiator_stand.position
	nero.Direction = character_util.get_direction('left')
	nero:RemoveEmotion()
	nero:RemoveAnimation()

	local player_stand = field:GetMarker('player_fight_stand')
	user_party.Leader.Position = player_stand.position
	user_party.Leader.Direction = character_util.get_direction('right')
	user_party.Leader:SetEmotion('attack', true)
	user_party.Leader:RemoveAnimation()

	local center = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(user_party.Leader.Position, nero.Position, 0.5)
	camera_util.move_async(center, 0)

	local switch = get_field_object('execution_switch')
	switch.Position = unity_class.vector3.one * 999

	for i = 1, 2 do
		local block = get_field_object('execute_block_' .. i)
		block.Position = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
	end

	local executioner = get_character('executioner')
	executioner.Position = unity_class.vector3.one * 999

	local gladiator = self.controller:get_last_gladiator()
	gladiator:RemoveEmotion()
	gladiator.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
end

function local_class:battle_to_nero()
	local nero = get_character('nero')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'event', name = 'bgm_suspense_theme', mix = 2 })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.75, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self:nero_battle_setting()

	self.controller:audience_watch_battle()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.75, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 오늘의 마지막 경기!
	nero:SetEmotion('attack', true)
	nero:SetAnimation('cast2', true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nero, { key = 'steampunk_colosseum_61', skip = true })

	-- 콜로세움의 주인!
	local drum_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_gatcha_drum_roll_01', loop = true})
	nero.Direction = character_util.get_direction('right')
	nero:SetEmotion('attack', true)
	nero:SetAnimation('victory_get', false)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nero, { key = 'steampunk_colosseum_62', skip = true })

	-- 제국의 자랑!
	nero.Direction = character_util.get_direction('left')
	nero:RemoveAnimation()
	nero:SetAnimation('victory_get', false)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nero, { key = 'steampunk_colosseum_63', skip = true })

	-- 네~~~
	camera_util.resize_to(3, 0.25)

	music_player:PlayDialogue('steampunk_colosseum_64')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(nero, { key = 'steampunk_colosseum_64', bubble_type = 'shout', dialogue = false })

	local anim_flag = false
	local sfx_cb = function(_, _)
		anim_flag = true
	end
	character_util.set_anim(nero, { name = 'jingak', loop = false, sfx_name = sfx_cb })
	while not anim_flag do coroutine.yield() end

	self.controller:audience_watch_battle()

	-- 로~~~!
	drum_sfx:Stop()
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_gatcha_spotlight_01' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_arena_exclamation_02' })
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)
	camera_util.resize_to(CS.Oak.StageCamera.DefaultCameraSize * 1.5, 1)
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(wait_for_sec, 1),
		util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble, nero, { key = 'steampunk_colosseum_65', bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true,  dialogue = false })
	})

	-- 네로 / 콜로세움의 주인
	screen_util.show_boss_title('steampunk_colosseum_65_1', 'steampunk_colosseum_65_2', 2)
	wait_for_sec(2)

	camera_util.return_to_leader()

	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({ state = 'field', name = 'bgm_colosseum' })
	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({ state = 'combat', name = 'bgm_battle_normal' })

	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()

	local weapon1_info = CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetById(9090324)
	local nero_weapon1 = weapon_util.create_monster_weapon({ spec = weapon1_info })
	nero:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, nero_weapon1)
	coroutine.yield(nero:UpdateEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, nero_weapon1))

	local weapon2_info = CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetById(9090214)
	local nero_weapon2 = weapon_util.create_monster_weapon({ spec = weapon2_info })
	nero:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2, nero_weapon2)
	coroutine.yield(nero:UpdateEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2, nero_weapon2))

	nero:RemoveEmotion()
	nero:RemoveAnimation()
	character_util.convert_to_monster(nero)
	nero.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.EtherealProstrate
	command_util.execute_monster_notice(nero, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
end

function local_class:choose_execute_to_nero()
	local executioner = get_character('executioner')
	local nero = get_character('nero')
	local switch = get_field_object('execution_switch')
	local execute_block1 = get_field_object('execute_block_1')

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.75, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.controller:setting_execute(nero)

	local last_gladiator_talk_table ={
		trash = 'last_gladiator_oneline',
		cockroach = 'last_gladiator_oneline_alt_2'
	}

	-- 마지막 검투사를 처형하지않았다면 옆에서 웃고있게 함.
	if self.controller.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.controller.execute_store_key2) ~= 1 then
		local last_gladiator = self.controller:get_last_gladiator()
		last_gladiator.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		last_gladiator.Position = execute_block1.Position + unity_class.vector3.left
		character_util.look_at(last_gladiator, nero)
		last_gladiator:SetEmotion('smile', true)
		last_gladiator:SetAnimation('success', true)
		last_gladiator.Interactable.Talk = last_gladiator_talk_table[last_gladiator.Name]
	end

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.75, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 이 패배자 쓰레기를 어떻게 하시겠습니까?
	character_util.look_at(executioner, user_party.Leader)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(executioner, { key = 'colosseum_nero_execution_1', skip = true })

	nero:Shake(0.05 ,999)

	-- 제발... 자비를...
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nero, {key = 'colosseum_nero_scream_1', skip = true})

	-- 죽기싫어...
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nero, {key = 'colosseum_nero_scream_2', skip = true})

	-- 살려만 준다면 뭐든지 할게...!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nero, {key = 'colosseum_nero_scream_3', skip = true})

	nero:CancelShake()

	-- 패배자에게 죽음을! / 콜로세움에서 더 이상 죽음은 없다!
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'steampunk_colosseum_66', 'brutal' }, { 'steampunk_colosseum_67', 'mercy' } })
	if result == 1 then
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.controller.quest_progress, self.controller.execute_store_key3, 1)

		user_party.Leader.Direction = character_util.get_direction('right')
		user_party.Leader:SetEmotion('doyagao', true)

		self.controller:audience_cheer_nero_execution()

		local wp = { vector(switch.Position.x, 0, user_party.Leader.Position.z), switch.Position }
		wp_util.move_way_points_async(user_party.Leader, { waypoints = wp, speed = 4, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right })

		self.controller:execute_process(nero)

		field_ui_util.play_fame_alignment_async(self.controller.current_alignment, user.Fame, -self.controller.decrease_alignment, 0)
		self.controller.current_alignment = self.controller.current_alignment - self.controller.decrease_alignment

		-- 파티원들은 무서워하는 모습으로 있게함.
		local origin_party = party_util.get_origin_party()
		for _, member in ipairs(origin_party) do
			if not lua_helper.reference_equals(member, user_party.Leader) then
				character_util.look_at(member, user_party.Leader)
				member:SetEmotion('scared', true)
				member:RemoveAnimation()
			end
		end
	else
		local audience = {
			get_character('audience_12'),
			get_character('audience_13'),
			get_character('audience_14'),
			get_character('audience_15'),
			get_character('audience_24'),
			get_character('audience_25'),
			get_character('audience_26'),
		}
		self.controller:audience_booing_to_near(user_party.Leader.Position, audience, 'nokill')

		-- 그럼 어떻게 처리할까요?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(executioner, { key = 'choose_save_nero_1', skip = true })

		-- 콜로세움의 돼지로 임명한다. | 콜로세움의 라운드걸로 임명한다.
		local pick = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'choose_save_nero_2', 'brutal' }, { 'choose_save_nero_3', 'brutal' } })

		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.controller.quest_progress, self.controller.nero_action_store_key, pick)

		-- 뭐?! 제발.. 그것만은....
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01' })
		character_util.normal_jump(nero)
		nero.Direction = character_util.get_direction('down')
		nero:SetEmotion('scared', true)
		nero:SetAnimation('idle', true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nero, {key = 'choose_save_nero_4', skip = true})

		wp_util.move_way_points_async(user_party.Leader, {waypoints = switch.Position + unity_class.vector3.back, speed = 3.5, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up})

		-- 으으으...
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_runaway_01' })
		character_util.normal_jump(nero)
		nero:SetAnimation('embarrassed', true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(nero, {key = 'choose_save_nero_5', skip = true})

		nero:SetEmotion('tired', true)
		nero:SetAnimation('idle', true)
		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		nero.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		if pick == 1 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.nero_be_pig, self))
		else

		character_util.set_emotion(consumed_refugee, { name = 'damaged' })
	end

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(consumed_soul, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

-- 크리스탈이 npc를 흡수함
function local_class:crystal_consume_refugee(index)
	local consumed_refugee = get_character(self.consumed_refugee_name .. index)
	local crystal_pos = field:GetMarker('consuming_crystal').position

	camera_util.move_async(crystal_pos, 1)

	-- 던져진 상태가 끝날 때까지 기다림
	while lua_helper.type_compare(consumed_refugee.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.FieldObjectThrownState) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	consumed_refugee.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance
	consumed_refugee.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	-- 흡수 되는 영혼 세팅
	local consumed_soul = get_character(self.consumed_soul_name)
	consumed_soul.Position = consumed_refugee.Position
	character_util.set_direction(consumed_soul, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim(consumed_soul, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.set_emotion(consumed_soul, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(consumed_soul, 0, 0)
	consumed_soul.SpineController:Scale(unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
	character_util.spine_rotate(consumed_soul, 0, 0)

	-- 뜨는 연출
	local flying_duration = 0.8
	local time_passed = 0

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_prologue_wind_01')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(consumed_soul, 1, flying_duration)

	while time_passed <= flying_duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0, 0.7, time_passed / flying_duration)

		consumed_soul.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(consumed_soul.Position, cur_y)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 흡수 되는 연출
	local consumed_duration = 1.2
	time_passed = 0

	consumed_soul.SpineController:Scale(unity_class.vector3.zero, consumed_duration)
	character_util.spine_rotate(consumed_soul, 360, consumed_duration)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_evil_spirit_01', loop = true,
								 fade_in_time = 1.6, fade_out_time = 1.6, duration = 3.2 })
	local aura_on_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_obj_grave_aura_switch_on')
	local aura_on_effect = aura_on_pool:Instantiate(crystal_pos + 0.48 * unity_class.vector3.up)
	aura_on_effect.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 180, 0))

	while time_passed <= consumed_duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local cur_x = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(time_passed, consumed_soul.Position.x,
			crystal_pos.x - consumed_soul.Position.x, consumed_duration)
		local cur_z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(time_passed, consumed_soul.Position.z,
			crystal_pos.z - consumed_soul.Position.z, consumed_duration)

		consumed_soul.Position = vector(cur_x, consumed_soul.Position.y, cur_z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.remove_emotion(consumed_soul)

	wait_for_sec(2)

	aura_on_effect:Dispose()
	local aura_off_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_obj_grave_aura_switch_off')
	local aura_off_effect = aura_off_pool:Instantiate(crystal_pos + 0.48 * unity_class.vector3.up)
	aura_off_effect.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 180, 0))
	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.consumed_soul_count = self.consumed_soul_count + 1

	if self.consumed_soul_count > 2 then
		-- 스타피스 드랍
		local star_piece = get_field_object(self.star_piece_name)
		star_piece.Position = star_piece.Position + 2 * unity_class.vector3.back
		message_system:Send(star_piece,
			CS.Oak.StarPieceAppearEvent.Create(star_piece.Position + 2 * unity_class.vector3.up))
		wait_for_sec(2)
	end

	camera_util.move_async(user_party_leader.Position, 1, { end_target = user_party_leader })

	if self.consumed_soul_count > 2 then
		yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
	end
end

return local_class

	if zone_name == 'believer_propagation' and not self.player_in_zone then

		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do

			-- 죽어 있으면 에바가 없다고 판담함
			local eva_dead = user_party[i].FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead

	for i = 1, self.eva_believer_count do
		local eva_believer = get_character(self.eva_believer_name .. i)
		table.insert(eva_believers, eva_believer)
	end

	local citizens = {}
	for i = 1, self.citizen_count do
		local citizen = get_character(self.citizen_name .. i)
		table.insert(citizens, citizen)
	end

	-- 에바가 중심으로 파티 정렬
	local party_pos = {
		eva_believers[1].Position + vector(0.5, 0, 1.5),
		eva_believers[1].Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 1.5),
		eva_believers[1].Position + vector(0, 0, 2)
	}

	local move_duration = 2

	character_util.move_to(user_party[eva_index], eva_believers[1].Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
		move_duration, nil, true, true)

	local party_pos_index = 1
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		if i ~= eva_index and party_pos[party_pos_index] ~= nil then
			character_util.move_to(user_party[i], party_pos[party_pos_index], move_duration,
				nil, true, true)
			party_pos_index = party_pos_index + 1
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(move_duration)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'down')
	end

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(eva_believers[1])

	character_util.remove_anim(eva_believers[1])
	character_util.set_direction(eva_believers[1], 'up')

	-- 당신도 용사교를 믿으...
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva_believers[1],
		{ key = 'steampunk_4_eva_believer_9', skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(eva_believers[1], { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.normal_jump_async(eva_believers[1], '01_jump_01')

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_positive_01')

function local_class:enter()

function local_class:start()

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
		self:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	for _, v in pairs(self.controller.pot_list) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, v) then
			self.broken_count = self.broken_count + 1

				self:toggle_girl_default_talk(false)

				if self.broken_count > 4 then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.girl_mad, self))
				else
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.girl_warning, self))
				end
			end

			break
		end
	end
end

function local_class:girl_warning()
	local girl = self.get_forest_girl()

	character_util.look_at(girl, user_party.Leader)
	character_util.set_emotion(girl, {name = 'attack'})

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(girl, {key = 'steampunk_forest_girl_10'})

	character_util.set_direction(girl, 'down')

	self:toggle_girl_default_talk(true, true)
	self.is_girl_talking = false
end

function local_class:girl_mad()
	local girl = self.get_forest_girl()

	character_util.look_at(girl, user_party.Leader)
	character_util.set_emotion(girl, {name = 'mad'})
	character_util.set_anim(girl, {name = 'victory_extra', scale = 1.3})

	if self.is_girl_mad == false then
		self.is_girl_mad = true
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	end
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(girl, {key = 'steampunk_forest_girl_11'})

	character_util.remove_anim(girl)
	character_util.set_direction(girl, 'down')

	self:toggle_girl_default_talk(true, false)
	self.is_girl_talking = false

		else

	end

end

return local_class

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	end

end

		self.is_seen_event = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_girl, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter and e.Zone.Name == 'forest_girl_room' and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and not self.is_seen_event then
		self.is_seen_event = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.girl_initiate, self)
	end
end

function local_class:girl_initiate()
	local girl = self.get_forest_girl()

	-- 저기요...!
	character_util.look_at(girl, user_party.Leader)
	character_util.look_at(user_party.Leader, girl)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(girl, {key = 'steampunk_forest_girl_1', skip = true})

	yield_return_func(self.talk_with_girl, self)
end

function local_class:talk_with_girl()
	local girl = self.get_forest_girl()
	local is_left = user_party.Leader.Position.x < girl.Position.x

	if is_left then
		character_util.set_direction(girl, 'left')
		character_util.align_party(girl, 'left', 1, 'arc')
	else
		character_util.set_direction(girl, 'right')
		character_util.align_party(girl, 'right', 1, 'arc')
	end

	--당신은….
	character_util.set_anim(girl, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(girl, {key = 'steampunk_forest_girl_2_1', skip = true})

	--그때 그 모험가님?!
	character_util.set_emotion(girl, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.remove_anim(girl)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(girl, {key = 'steampunk_forest_girl_2', skip = true})

	--정말 오랜만이에요!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(girl, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(girl, {key = 'steampunk_forest_girl_3', skip = true})

	--선택지: 누구세요? / 기억났다!
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event(
			{{'steampunk_forest_girl_branch_1', 'brutal'}, {'steampunk_forest_girl_branch_2', 'intellect'}})

	--기억 안 나세요? / 맞아요.
	if result == 1 then
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(girl)
		character_util.set_anim(girl, {name = 'question', loop = false})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(girl, {key = 'steampunk_forest_girl_4_0', skip = true})
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(girl)

		character_util.set_emotion(girl, {name = 'smile'})
	else
		character_util.set_anim(girl, {name = 'nod', loop = true})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(girl, {key = 'steampunk_forest_girl_4_1', skip = true})
	end

	--전에 캔터베리 숲에서 고블린이 훔쳐 간 가방을 되찾아 주셨잖아요!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_anim(girl, {name = 'release', loop = true, scale = 0.7, sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(girl, {key = 'steampunk_forest_girl_5', skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(girl)

	--그때 모험가 님이 아니었다면… 여기 방도 구할 수 없었을 거예요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(girl, {key = 'steampunk_forest_girl_6', skip = true})

	--앞으로도 친절한 모험가님께 행운이 있길 빌게요!
	character_util.set_emotion(girl, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(girl, {key = 'steampunk_forest_girl_9', skip = true})

	if girl.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		girl.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
		girl.Interactable.Talk = 'steampunk_forest_girl_9'
	end

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

	self.civilian_name = 'kind_civilian_'
	self.soldier_name = 'kind_soldier_'
	self.phonebooth_name = 'kind_phone_booth'
	self.move_bin_name = 'move_trash_bin'

	self.branch_name = 'steampunk_kind_civilian_branch_'
	self.narration_name = 'steampunk_kind_civilian_narration_'

	self.civilians = {}
	self.refugees = {}
	self.soldiers = {}
	self.chief = nil
	self.phonebooth = nil
	self.move_bin = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	for i = 1, 2 do
		table.insert(self.civilians, get_character(self.civilian_name .. i))
	end
	for i = 1, 4 do
		table.insert(self.refugees, get_character(self.refugee_name .. i))
	end
	for i = 1, 4 do
		table.insert(self.soldiers, get_character(self.soldier_name .. i))
	end
	self.chief = get_character(self.soldier_name .. 'chief')
	self.phonebooth = get_field_object(self.phonebooth_name)
	self.move_bin = get_field_object(self.move_bin_name)

	if not self.controller.soldier_event then
		for i = 1, 2 do
			character_util.set_active_state(self.civilians[i], 'disabled')
		end
	end

	for i = 1, 4 do
		character_util.set_active_state(self.refugees[i], 'disabled')
	end
	for i = 1, 4 do
		character_util.set_active_state(self.soldiers[i], 'disabled')
	end
	character_util.set_active_state(self.chief, 'disabled')

	self.move_bin.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	self.phonebooth.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	return true
end

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.civilians = {}
	self.refugees = {}
	self.soldiers = {}
	self.chief = nil
	self.phonebooth = nil
	self.move_bin = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.civilians[1]) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.civilians[2]) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_corpse, self)
			return true
		end
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.phonebooth) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_phone, self))
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:interact_corpse()
	--나레이션 박스
	--반응이 없다. 그냥 시체인 것 같다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = self.narration_name .. 3 })
end

function local_class:interact_phone()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	-- 공중전화 부스에 들어가는 연출
	party_util.align_to_target(self.phonebooth, 'down', 1, 'arc')
	local prev_pos = user_party.Leader.Position
	user_party.Leader:HideWeapon(true)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party[i], 0, 1)
	end
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_door_push_01')
	character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, self.phonebooth.Position, 1, nil, true, true)

	-- 부유성에 전화한다.
	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	local wait_for_branch = true
	local choice = 0

	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name .. 2),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
			choice = 0
		end
	})

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(self.phonebooth, branches)

	while wait_for_branch do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if choice == 0 then
		-- 부유성에 전화
		-- 공주님으로부터 힘내라는 응원을 받았다.
		stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Show()
		coroutine.yield(stage.FieldUINarrationBox:SetNarration(game_string:GetString(self.narration_name .. 1), 0, 1))
		stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Hide()
	end

	-- 공중전화에서 나오는 연출
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party[i], 1, 1)
	end
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_door_push_01')
	character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, prev_pos, 1, nil, true, true)

	user_party.Leader:HideWeapon(false)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

--[[QuestAttribute

		QuestName = SteampunkKindCivilian @

		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)

	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.progress_enum = {
		--- 초기 상태
		begin = 0,
		--- 외부 범위 진입 이후
		idle = 1,
		--- 내부 근접 진입 이후
		talk = 2,
		--- 시민 대화 이후
		after = 3
	}

	self.spectator_name = 'square_civilian_3'

	self.move_bin_event_zone_name = 'move_bin'

	self.move_bin_talk_name = 'steampunk_1_1_move_bin_'
	self.talk_name = 'steampunk_kind_civilian_talk_'
	self.branch_name = 'steampunk_kind_civilian_branch_'
	self.narration_name = 'steampunk_kind_civilian_narration_'

	-- 프로젝타일 이름
	self.machinegun_bullet_name = "rifle_bullet_long_dist"
	self.hit_effect_preset = "FX_hit_projectile"

	self.time_scale_key = 'steampunk_kind_civilian'

	self.current_progress = nil

	self.civilians = {}
	self.refugees = {}
	self.soldiers = {}
	self.chief = nil
	self.phonebooth = nil
	self.is_hit_first = false
	self.is_hit_second = false
	self.see_move_bin_event = false

	-- 프로젝타일 발사 보조 클래스
	self.shoot_helper_list = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.begin

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	-- 도망치는 쓰레기통 이벤트
	self.move_bin = get_field_object(self.move_bin_name)
	self.move_bin.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	for i = 1, 2 do
		table.insert(self.civilians, get_character(self.civilian_name .. i))
	end
	for i = 1, 4 do
		table.insert(self.refugees, get_character(self.refugee_name .. i))
	end
	for i = 1, 4 do
		table.insert(self.soldiers, get_character(self.soldier_name .. i))
	end
	self.chief = get_character(self.soldier_name .. 'chief')
	self.phonebooth = get_field_object(self.phonebooth_name)

	character_util.set_direction(self.refugees[1], 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(self.refugees[2], 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(self.refugees[3], 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(self.refugees[4], 'down')

	-- 프로젝타일 발사 관련 처리
	-- TODO : 찾아보니 Obsolete 된 방식이었음. 추후 개선이 필요함.
	self.projectile_data = create_generic_dictionary(CS.System.String, CS.System.Object)
	self.projectile_data:Add("Columns", CS.XLua.Cast.Int32(1))
	self.projectile_data:Add("SpreadAngle", CS.XLua.Cast.Int32(0))
	self.projectile_data:Add("Parallel", true)
	self.projectile_data:Add("Projectile", self.machinegun_bullet_name)
	self.projectile_data:Add("ShootOffset", 0.7)

	-- ShootHelper 설정
	self.shoot_helper_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.ShootHelper)

	local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.chief)
	local pattern_info = shoot_helper_util.create_custom_projectile_pattern(self.projectile_data)
	local spec = shoot_helper_util.create_custom_projectile_spec(self.projectile_data)
	self.shoot_helper_list:Add(shoot_helper_util.create_shoot_helper_by_spec(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional
	, ps, spec, pattern_info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShootWithShootOffset))

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset)
	self.gun_fire_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_Common_BasicShot_Gun")
end

-- 프로젝타일 명중 처리
function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, self.civilians[2]) then
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(self.civilians[2].Position)

		if not self.is_hit_first then
			self.is_hit_first = true

			character_util.set_direction(self.civilians[2], 'right')
			character_util.spine_deviate_local(self.civilians[2], vector(-0.3, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)
			character_util.spine_pulse_color(self.civilians[2], CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
			character_util.spine_damage_squish(self.civilians[2], 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)

			character_util.set_anim(self.civilians[2], { name = "dead", loop = false, sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01' })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.civilians[2], { name = "damaged" })
			character_util.stop_shake(self.civilians[2])

			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_linda_scream_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.civilians[2], {key = self.talk_name .. 41, skip = false,
																	  bubble_type = 'shout', life_time = 1, bubble_direction = "lt", auto_layout = true })
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, self.civilians[1]) then
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(self.civilians[1].Position)

		self.is_hit_second = true
			character_util.set_direction(self.civilians[1], 'right')
			character_util.spine_deviate_local(self.civilians[1], vector(-0.3, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)
			character_util.spine_pulse_color(self.civilians[1], CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
			character_util.spine_damage_squish(self.civilians[1], 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
			character_util.set_anim(self.civilians[1], { name = "dead", loop = false, sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01' })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.civilians[1], { name = "damaged" })
		character_util.stop_shake(self.civilians[1])

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_marty_scream_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.civilians[1], {key = self.talk_name .. 42, skip = false,
																  bubble_type = 'shout', life_time = 1, bubble_direction = "rb", auto_layout = true  })
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.current_progress = nil

	self.civilians = {}
	self.refugees = {}
	self.soldiers = {}
	self.chief = nil
	self.phonebooth = nil

	self.is_hit_first = false
	self.is_hit_second = false
	self.see_move_bin_event = false

	-- 프로젝타일 발사 보조 클래스
	self.shoot_helper_list = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.FullEnter and e.Zone.Name == self.civilian_name .. 'inner' and
				e.FieldObject == user_party.Leader and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.begin then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.idle
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.zone_enter_outer, self))
			return true
		end
		if e.FullEnter and e.Zone.Name == self.move_bin_event_zone_name and
				e.FieldObject == user_party.Leader and not self.see_move_bin_event then
			self.see_move_bin_event = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_bin_event, self))
		end
	end
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		-- 스팀펑크 시민 남자
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.civilians[1]) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.civilians[2]) then
			if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.idle then
				self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.talk
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_civilian_first, self))
			else
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_civilian, self))
			end
			return true
		end
		-- 전화부스
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.phonebooth) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_phone, self))
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- 광장에서 비밀 길로 사라지는 쓰레기통과 목격자 이벤트
function local_class:move_bin_event()
	local spectator = get_character(self.spectator_name)
	local talk_with_spectator = get_character(self.talk_with_spectator_name)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_bin_routine, self))

	character_util.set_direction(spectator, 'up')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(spectator, nil, 'question')

	character_util.set_direction(spectator, 'left')
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_02', play_pos = spectator.Position,
								loop = false, type_priority = 4000, player_priority = 900 })
	character_util.jump(spectator, 1, 0.5)

	character_util.set_anim(spectator, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.set_emotion(spectator, { name = 'surprise' })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.set_direction(spectator, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(spectator, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })

	character_util.set_anim(talk_with_spectator, { name = 'question', loop = false })

	if field:IsInSameCameraGrid(user_party.Leader.Position, spectator.Position) then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(spectator, { key = 'steampunk_1_1_move_bin_0', skip = false })
	else
		wait_for_sec(2)
	end

	character_util.set_direction(spectator, 'up')
	character_util.remove_anim(spectator)
	character_util.set_emotion(spectator)

	character_util.set_direction(talk_with_spectator, 'up')
	character_util.remove_anim(talk_with_spectator)

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.set_direction(spectator, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(spectator, { name = 'cast' })
	character_util.set_emotion(spectator, { name = 'tired' })

	character_util.set_direction(talk_with_spectator, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(talk_with_spectator, { name = 'cross_arm' })
	character_util.set_emotion(talk_with_spectator, { name = 'attack' })

	if field:IsInSameCameraGrid(user_party.Leader.Position, talk_with_spectator.Position) then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(talk_with_spectator,
				{ key = 'steampunk_1_1_move_bin_1', skip = false })
	else
		wait_for_sec(2)
	end

	character_util.set_anim(spectator, { name = 'sing' })

	if field:IsInSameCameraGrid(user_party.Leader.Position, spectator.Position) then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(spectator, { key = 'steampunk_1_1_move_bin_2', skip = false })
	end
end

function local_class:move_bin_routine()
	self.move_bin:Deviate(vector(0, 0.5, 0), 0.6, 0.4)
	local trash_bin_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_grass_slide_01',

	trash_bin_sfx:Stop()
	wait_for_sec(1.5)
	self.move_bin:Deviate(vector(0, 0.5, 0), 0.6, 0.4)
	local trash_bin_sfx2 = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_grass_slide_01',
		loop = true, parent = user_party_leader,
		type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'player'})

function local_class:ask_civilian()
	-- 강행돌파! / 때를 기다린다.
	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	local wait_for_branch = true
	local choice = 0

	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name .. 0),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Intellect,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
			choice = 0
		end
	})
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name .. 1),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
			choice = 1
		end
	})

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(self.civilians[2], branches)

	while wait_for_branch do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.civilians[1])
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.civilians[2])

	if choice == 0 then
		-- 강행돌파.
		local exitpos = field:GetMarker(self.marker_name).position
		-- 역시, 그럴 줄 알았습니다!
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_clap_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(self.civilians[1], {name = 'smile'})
		character_util.set_anim(self.civilians[1], {name = 'clap'})
		character_util.set_emotion(self.civilians[2], {name = 'tired'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.civilians[1], {key = self.talk_name .. 17, skip = true})

		-- 어쩔 수… 없죠. 당신 말에 따르겠어요.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.civilians[2], {key = self.talk_name .. 18, skip = true})

		for i = 1, 4 do
			character_util.set_direction(self.refugees[i], 'right')
		end
		-- 모두 일어나세요. 오늘 이곳을 떠나 좀 더 안전한 곳으로 이동할 겁니다.
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.civilians[1])
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.civilians[2])
		character_util.set_direction(self.civilians[1], 'left')
		character_util.set_direction(self.civilians[2], 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(self.civilians[1], {name = 'attack'})
		character_util.set_anim(self.civilians[1], {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.civilians[1], {key = self.talk_name .. 19, skip = true})

		-- 위험하지… 않을까요?
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.civilians[1])
		character_util.set_emotion(self.refugees[1], {name = 'scared'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.refugees[1], {key = self.talk_name .. 20, skip = true})

		-- 밖엔 제국병이 잔뜩있다던데.
		character_util.set_emotion(self.refugees[4], {name = 'scared'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.refugees[4], {key = self.talk_name .. 21, skip = true})

		-- 쉬운 길은 아닙니다….
		character_util.set_emotion(self.civilians[1], {name = 'sleep_deep'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.civilians[1], {key = self.talk_name .. 22, skip = true})

		-- 하지만 모두가 힘을 합치면 무사할 수 있을 거예요!
		character_util.set_emotion(self.civilians[2], {name = 'attack'})
		character_util.set_anim(self.civilians[2], {name = 'attack', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.civilians[2], {key = self.talk_name .. 23, skip = true})

		-- 괜찮을까?
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.civilians[1])
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.civilians[2])
		character_util.set_emotion(self.refugees[1], {name = 'tired'})
		character_util.set_anim(self.refugees[1], {name = 'question', loop = false})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.refugees[1], {key = self.talk_name .. 24, skip = true})

		-- 가디언님이 괜찮다 했잖아.
		character_util.set_emotion(self.refugees[3], {name = 'smile'})
		character_util.set_anim(self.refugees[3], {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.refugees[3], {key = self.talk_name .. 25, skip = true})
		character_util.remove_anim(self.refugees[3])
		character_util.set_anim(self.refugees[3], {name = 'release' })

		-- 맞아, 가디언님 말씀이잖아!!!
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.refugees[1])

function local_class:interact_phone()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	-- 공중전화 부스에 들어가는 연출
	party_util.align_to_target(self.phonebooth, 'down', 1, 'arc')
	local prev_pos = user_party.Leader.Position
	user_party.Leader:HideWeapon(true)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party[i], 0, 1)
	end
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_door_push_01')
	character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, self.phonebooth.Position, 1, nil, true, true)

	-- 부유성에 전화한다. / 제국군에 신고한다.
	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	local wait_for_branch = true
	local choice = 0

	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name .. 2),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
			choice = 0
		end
	})
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name .. 3),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
			choice = 1
		end
	})

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(self.phonebooth, branches)

	while wait_for_branch do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if choice == 0 then
		-- 부유성에 전화
		-- 공주님으로부터 힘내라는 응원을 받았다.
		stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Show()
		coroutine.yield(stage.FieldUINarrationBox:SetNarration(game_string:GetString(self.narration_name .. 1), 0, 1))
		stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Hide()
	else
		-- 제국군에 신고
		-- 제국군으로부터 바로 출동하겠다는 답변을 받았다.
		stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Show()
		coroutine.yield(stage.FieldUINarrationBox:SetNarration(game_string:GetString(self.narration_name .. 2), 0, 1))
		stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Hide()

		yield_return_func(self.call_soldiers, self)
	end

	-- 공중전화에서 나오는 연출
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party[i], 1, 1)
	end
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_door_push_01')
	character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, prev_pos, 1, nil, true, true)

	user_party.Leader:HideWeapon(false)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

local local_class = newclass('SteampunkKnightSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = SteampunkKnight @
		Comment = 스팀펑크 샤피라 영입 이벤트 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.get_steam_knight = function() return get_character('shyapira') end

	self.is_knight_moving = false

	self.princess_origin_id = 119

	self.knight_move_center_pos = vector(0.5, 0, 112)
	self.knight_move_width = 4
	self.knight_move_wp_index = 1

	self.character_card_name = 'steam_knight'
	self.character_title = 'steam_knight_character_title'
	self.character_subtitle = 'steam_knight_character_subtitle'
	self.character_description = 'steam_knight_character_description'
	self.steam_knight_id = 125
	self.steam_knight_voice_id = 125

	self.is_main_quest_clear = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	local main_quest_id = 91
	local main_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(main_quest_id)

	if main_quest ~= nil and main_quest.IsComplete then
		self.is_main_quest_clear = true
	end

	if not self.is_main_quest_clear then
		return
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self:set_knight()

	if type_util.is_npc_interactable(self.get_steam_knight()) then
		self.get_steam_knight().Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if not self.is_main_quest_clear then
		return
	end

	self:start_knight_routine()
end

function local_class:exit()
	if not self.is_main_quest_clear then
		self.controller = nil
		self.quest_spec = nil
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self:stop_knight_routine()
	self.knight_move_center_pos = nil

	if type_util.is_npc_interactable(self.get_steam_knight()) then
		self.get_steam_knight().Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_steam_knight()) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_knight, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:set_knight()
	local steam_knight = self.get_steam_knight()

	steam_knight.Position = self.knight_move_center_pos
	steam_knight.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	character_util.set_emotion(steam_knight, { name = 'tired' })
end

function local_class:start_knight_routine()
	self.is_knight_moving = true
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.knight_routine, self))
end

function local_class:stop_knight_routine()
	self.is_knight_moving = false
	character_util.stop(self.get_steam_knight())
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.get_steam_knight())
end

function local_class:knight_routine()
	local steam_knight = self.get_steam_knight()
	local knight_wp = {
		self.knight_move_center_pos + vector(-self.knight_move_width, 0, 0),
		self.knight_move_center_pos + vector(self.knight_move_width, 0, 0)
	}

	wait_for_sec(1)

	while self.is_knight_moving do
		wp_util.move_way_points_async(steam_knight, { waypoints = knight_wp[self.knight_move_wp_index], speed = 2})

		self.knight_move_wp_index = self.knight_move_wp_index == 1 and 2 or 1

		if not self.is_knight_moving then return end

		-- 황녀님 그립다….
		if field:IsInSameCameraGrid(user_party_leader.Position, steam_knight.Position) then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(steam_knight, { key = 'steampunk_knight_1' })
		end
	end
end

function local_class:talk_with_knight()
	local steam_knight = self.get_steam_knight()

	self:stop_knight_routine()

	local is_right = steam_knight.Position.x < self.knight_move_center_pos.x
	local align_dir = is_right and 'right' or 'left'
	local princess_index = self:princess_index_in_party()

	if princess_index < 0 then
		character_util.set_direction(steam_knight, align_dir)
		party_util.align_to_target(steam_knight, align_dir, 1, 'arc')

		-- 황녀님 갈굼이 부족해.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(steam_knight, { key = 'steampunk_knight_2', skip = true })

		-- 마음이 영양실조야….
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(steam_knight, { key = 'steampunk_knight_3', skip = true })

		self:start_knight_routine()
	else
		if type_util.is_npc_interactable(steam_knight) then
			steam_knight.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
		end

		local look_dir = direction_util.get_opposite(character_util.get_direction(align_dir))
		local factor = is_right and 1 or -1
		local duration = 1
		local princess = user_party[princess_index]

		local princess_pos = steam_knight.Position + 1.3 * direction_util.to_vector3(align_dir)
		local align_pos_list = {
			vector(factor * 0.5, 0, 0.5),
			vector(factor * 0.5, 0, -0.5),
			vector(factor * 1, 0, 0)
		}

		local table_index = 1
		local wait_list = {}

		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			if i == princess_index then
				table.insert(wait_list, util.cs_generator(function()
					character_util.move_to_async(princess, princess_pos,
							duration, nil, true, true)
					character_util.set_direction(princess, look_dir)
				end))
			else
				table.insert(wait_list, util.cs_generator(function(table_index)
					character_util.move_to_async(user_party[i], princess_pos + align_pos_list[table_index],
							duration, nil, true, true)
					character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], look_dir)
				end, table_index))

				table_index = table_index + 1
			end
		end

		camera_util.move(princess_pos, duration)
		wait_all(wait_list)

		-- 아이샤가 이러고 있지 말고 자신을 따라오라고 혼냄.
		-- 샤피라 갑자기 눈이 초롱초롱해지며 완전부활하고 동료가 됨.
		camera_util.shake(0.04, 0.3)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_runaway_01')
		character_util.normal_jump(steam_knight, true)
		character_util.set_emotion(steam_knight, { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.set_anim(steam_knight, { name = 'embarrassed' })

		-- 뭐 하고 있나!
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_count_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'attack' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'steampunk_knight_4', skip = true })

		character_util.look_at(steam_knight, princess)
		character_util.remove_emotion(steam_knight)
		character_util.remove_anim(steam_knight)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 화… 황녀님?
		character_util.set_emotion(steam_knight, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_anim(steam_knight, { name = 'sing' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(steam_knight, { key = 'steampunk_knight_5', skip = true })

		-- 여기서 이러고 있지 말고….
		character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'cross_arm' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'steampunk_knight_6', skip = true })

		-- 어서 날 따라와라.
		character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'steampunk_knight_7', skip = true })

		-- 네!!
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
		camera_util.shake(0.04, 0.3)
		character_util.remove_anim(princess)
		character_util.normal_jump(steam_knight, true)
		character_util.set_emotion(steam_knight, { name = 'cry' })
		character_util.set_anim(steam_knight, { name = 'cast' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(steam_knight, { key = 'steampunk_knight_8', skip = true })

		-- 황녀님이 가시는 곳이라면, 어디든 따라 가겠습니다!
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		character_util.set_anim(steam_knight, { name = 'cast2' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(steam_knight, { key = 'steampunk_knight_9', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

		character_util.set_emotion(steam_knight, { name = 'smile' })

		local steam_knight_character = steam_knight

		local is_max_party = user_party.Count >= user.Party.MaxLimitCharacterCount
		local already_has_character = user:GetCharacter(self.steam_knight_id, true) ~= nil

		local character_theatre_data = CS.Oak.CharacterTheatreData()
		character_theatre_data.Character = steam_knight_character
		character_theatre_data.CardName = self.character_card_name
		character_theatre_data.Title = game_string:GetString(self.character_title)
		character_theatre_data.Subtitle = game_string:GetString(self.character_subtitle)
		character_theatre_data.Desc = game_string:GetString(self.character_description)
		character_theatre_data.IsMaxParty = is_max_party
		character_theatre_data.AlreadyHasInParty = already_has_character
		character_theatre_data.VoiceId = self.steam_knight_voice_id
		character_theatre_data.VoiceType = CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.JoinParty

		local is_ended_threatre = false

		CS.Oak.NewCharacterTheatre.ShowThreatre(character_theatre_data, function()
			is_ended_threatre = true
		end)

		-- NewCharacterTheatre가 안 끝났다면 끝날때까지 기다린다.
		while not is_ended_threatre do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)

		yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, true, true, false)

		if not is_max_party and not already_has_character then
			local getted_character = user:GetCharacter(self.steam_knight_id)
			CS.Oak.AddHeroStageLogic.Execute(steam_knight_character, getted_character, user, user_party)
		end

		camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
	end
end

function local_class:princess_index_in_party()
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local origin_id = user_party[i].CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.OriginId
		local princess_dead = user_party[i].FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead

		if origin_id == self.princess_origin_id and not princess_dead then
			return i
		end
	end

	return -1
end

return local_class

--[[QuestAttribute

	self.awaiter_num = 8
	self.soldier_num = 6
	self.refugee_num = 8
	self.row_whole_move_dist = 26
	self.row_move_speed = 2
	self.out_of_row_limit = 0.5
	self.out_of_low_damage = 1/8

	-- 플레이어가 줄을 잘 지키는지 체크하는 데 사용되는 상수 목록
	self.keep_in_row_side_limit = 1
	self.keep_in_row_upper_limit = -0.5
	self.keep_in_row_lower_limit = -1.5

	self.gatekeeper_name = "gatekeeper_"
	self.awaiter_name = "awaiter_"
	self.soldier_name = "soldier_"
	self.refugee_name = "refugee_"
	self.refugee_partner_name = "refugee_partner"

	-- 필드오브젝트 이름
	self.event_door_name = "section_1_event_door"
	self.event_battlegate_name = "section_1_event_battlegate"

	self.caught_player_zone_name = "section_1_caught_player"
	self.in_row_zone_name = "section_1_in_row"
	self.out_row_zone_name = "section_1_out_row"
	self.prisoned_zone_name = 'section_1_prisoned'
	self.player_in_row_zone_name = 'section_1_player_in_row'

	self.refugee_runaway_zone_name = "section_1_refugee_runaway"

	self.hit_effect_preset = "FX_hit"
	self.impact_hit_effect_preset = "FX_lasthit"
	self.hit_projectile_preset = "FX_hit_projectile"

	self.machinegun_bullet_name = "rifle_bullet_long_dist_only_target"

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_1 then
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_projectile_preset)

		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')

		self.gatekeeper_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
		self.awaiter_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
		self.await_for_shot_soldier_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
		self.soldier_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
		self.refugee_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)

		for i = 1, self.gatekeeper_num do
			local cur_gatekeeper = get_character(self.gatekeeper_name..i)

			self.gatekeeper_list:Add(cur_gatekeeper)
		end

		for i = 1, self.awaiter_num do
			local cur_awaiter = get_character(self.awaiter_name..i)

			self.awaiter_list:Add(cur_awaiter)
		end

		for i = 1, self.soldier_num do
			local cur_soldier = get_character(self.soldier_name..i)

			self.soldier_list:Add(cur_soldier)
		end

		for i = 10, 13 do
			local cur_soldier = get_character(self.soldier_name..i)

			self.await_for_shot_soldier_list:Add(cur_soldier)
		end

		for i = 1, self.refugee_num do
			local cur_refugee = get_character(self.refugee_name..i)

			self.refugee_list:Add(cur_refugee)
		end

		self.refugee_partner = get_character(self.refugee_partner_name)
		self.runaway_refugee = get_character(self.refugee_name..9)

		-- 프로젝타일 발사 관련 처리
		local basic_rifle_id = 9030011;
		local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData');
		local rifle_data = item_data:GetSpec(basic_rifle_id).Data;
		local rifle_offset = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(rifle_data, 'ShootOffset', 0.5);

		self.projectile_data = create_generic_dictionary(CS.System.String, CS.System.Object)
		self.projectile_data:Add("Columns", CS.XLua.Cast.Int32(1))
		self.projectile_data:Add("SpreadAngle", CS.XLua.Cast.Int32(0))
		self.projectile_data:Add("Parallel", true)
		self.projectile_data:Add("Projectile", self.machinegun_bullet_name)
		self.projectile_data:Add("ShootOffset", rifle_offset)

		local ps_1 = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.soldier_list[2])
		local projectile_spec = shoot_helper_util.create_custom_projectile_spec(self.projectile_data)
		local pattern_info = shoot_helper_util.create_custom_projectile_pattern(self.projectile_data)
		self.shoot_helper_1 = shoot_helper_util.create_shoot_helper_by_spec(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
				ps_1, projectile_spec, pattern_info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShootWithShootOffset)

		self.shoot_helper_1 = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
				ps_1, self.projectile_data, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShootWithShootOffset)

		local ps_2 = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.soldier_list[3])
		self.shoot_helper_2 = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
				ps_2, self.projectile_data, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShootWithShootOffset)

		local ps_3 = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.await_for_shot_soldier_list[1])
		self.shoot_helper_3 = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
				ps_3, self.projectile_data, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShootWithShootOffset)

		local ps_4 = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.await_for_shot_soldier_list[3])
		self.shoot_helper_4 = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
				ps_4, self.projectile_data, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShootWithShootOffset)

		self.gun_soldier_1 = get_character(self.soldier_name..7)
		self.gun_soldier_2 = get_character(self.soldier_name..8)

		self:setting()
	end

	return true
end

-- projectile 맞았을 시 처리
function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, user_party_leader) and not self.is_retire_player then
		-- 플레이어가 줄 맞춰 이동하는 이벤트 진행 중에만 실행
		if self.event_progress == EventProgress.keep_in_row_event then
			if not self.is_reset_shoot then
				unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_projectile_preset):Instantiate(user_party_leader.Position)

				-- 만약 플레이어 HP가 데미지 값보다 적을 경우, 리셋 코루틴을 실행시킨다.
				if user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HP <=
						user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.out_of_low_damage then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.reset_keep_in_row_event, self))
				end

				character_util.spine_deviate_local(user_party_leader, vector(0.3, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)
				character_util.spine_pulse_color(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
				character_util.spine_damage_squish(user_party_leader, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
				damage_info.sender = user_party_leader
				damage_info.target = user_party_leader
				damage_info.damage = math.floor(user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.out_of_low_damage)
				damage_info.notMortal = true

				command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
			else
				CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(hit_info.target, 10000, unity_class.color.red, hit_info.target.Position);

				character_util.spine_deviate_local(user_party_leader, vector(-0.3, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)
				character_util.spine_pulse_color(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
				character_util.spine_damage_squish(user_party_leader, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
				character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = "dead", loop = false })
				character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = "damaged" })
			end
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, self.runaway_refugee) then
		CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(hit_info.target, 10000, unity_class.color.red, hit_info.target.Position);

		character_util.spine_deviate_local(self.runaway_refugee, vector(-0.3, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)
		character_util.spine_pulse_color(self.runaway_refugee, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(self.runaway_refugee, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
		character_util.set_anim(self.runaway_refugee, { name = "dead", loop = false })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.runaway_refugee, { name = "damaged" })
	else
		for i = 0, self.refugee_list.Count - 1 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, self.refugee_list[i]) then
				-- 플레이어가 줄 맞춰 이동하는 이벤트 진행 중에는 무시함
				if self.event_progress ~= EventProgress.keep_in_row_event then
					character_util.stop(self.refugee_list[i])

					CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(hit_info.target, 10000, unity_class.color.red, hit_info.target.Position)

					character_util.spine_deviate_local(self.refugee_list[i],
							hit_info.direction.normalized * 0.3, 0.3, 0.2)
					character_util.spine_pulse_color(self.refugee_list[i], CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
					character_util.spine_damage_squish(self.refugee_list[i], 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
					character_util.set_direction(self.refugee_list[i], CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetSideDirection(self.refugee_list[i].Direction))
					character_util.set_anim(self.refugee_list[i], { name = "dead", loop = false })
					character_util.set_emotion(self.refugee_list[i], { name = "damaged" })

					break
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_1 then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
				vector(77, 0, -0.5))
		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name))
	end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.gatekeeper_list = nil
	self.awaiter_list = nil
	self.soldier_list = nil
	self.await_for_shot_soldier_list = nil
	self.refugee_list = nil
	self.refugee_partner = nil
	self.runaway_refugee = nil

	self.keep_in_row_coroutine = nil

	self.confusion_routine_1 = nil
	self.confusion_routine_2 = nil

	self.shoot_helper_1 = nil
	self.shoot_helper_2 = nil
	self.shoot_helper_3 = nil
	self.shoot_helper_4 = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.caught_player_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.player_caught_event_1 then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.player_caught_event_1

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.player_caught_event_1, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.in_row_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.player_caught_event_2 then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.player_caught_event_2

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.player_caught_event_2, self, true))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.out_row_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.player_caught_event_2 then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.player_caught_event_2

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.player_caught_event_2, self, false))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.prisoned_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.prisoned then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.prisoned

			-- 배틀게이트 닫아서 플레이어가 이동 지점을 넘어가는 것을 방지
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.event_battlegate_name))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.player_in_row_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.player_in_row_event then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.player_in_row_event

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.player_enter_row, self, false))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.out_of_row_shot_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress == EventProgress.keep_in_row_event then

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.out_of_row_shot_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.refugee_runaway_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.refugee_runaway_event then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.refugee_runaway_event
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.progress_section_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.progress_section_event then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.progress_section_event

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.progress_section_event, self))
		end
	end
end

-- 섹션 입장 시 NPC 설정
function local_class:setting()
	for i = 0, self.gatekeeper_list.Count - 1 do
		if i < 2 then
			character_util.set_position(self.gatekeeper_list[i], vector(2 + i, 0, 0))
			character_util.set_direction(self.gatekeeper_list[i], "down")
		else
			local val = math.floor(i / 2)
			local mod = i % 2

			self.gatekeeper_list[i].SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'desert_hunter_rifle')
			character_util.set_position(self.gatekeeper_list[i], vector(1 + 3 * mod, 0, val))

			if mod == 0 then
				character_util.set_direction(self.gatekeeper_list[i], 'right')
			else
				character_util.set_direction(self.gatekeeper_list[i], 'left')
			end
		end

		character_util.set_anim(self.gatekeeper_list[i], { name = 'rifle_idle' })
	end

	for i = 0, self.awaiter_list.Count - 1 do
		local val = math.floor(i / 2)
		local mod = i % 2

		character_util.set_position(self.awaiter_list[i], vector(2 + mod, 0, -2 - val))
		character_util.set_direction(self.awaiter_list[i], "up")
	end

	for i = 0, self.await_for_shot_soldier_list.Count - 1 do
		local val = math.floor(i / 2)
		local mod = i % 2

		self.await_for_shot_soldier_list[i].SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'desert_hunter_rifle')
		character_util.set_position(self.await_for_shot_soldier_list[i], vector(11 + mod, 0, 3 - val * 5))

		if i < 2 then
			character_util.set_direction(self.await_for_shot_soldier_list[i], 'down')
		else
			character_util.set_direction(self.await_for_shot_soldier_list[i], 'up')
		end

		character_util.set_anim(self.await_for_shot_soldier_list[i], { name = 'rifle_idle' })
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.event_door_name))

	-- 플레이어와 제국 병사, 난민들의 위치, 애니메이션, 이모션 설정
	self:keep_in_row_setting(false)
end

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_jump_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		character_util.look_at(self.awaiter_list[7], user_party_leader)

		character_util.set_emotion(self.awaiter_list[7], { name = "attack" })

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		local dir = (self.awaiter_list[7].Position - user_party_leader.Position):ToDirection()
		party_util.set_direction(dir)
		character_util.jump(user_party_leader, 1, 0.5)

		for i = 0, self.awaiter_list.Count - 1 do
			character_util.look_at(self.awaiter_list[i], user_party_leader)
		end

		character_util.set_anim(self.awaiter_list[7], { name = "release", sfx_name = "01_swing_01" })

		character_util.remove_anim(self.awaiter_list[7])
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.awaiter_list[7])
	end

	-- 파티원 줄 섬
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local val = math.floor(i / 2)
		local mod = i % 2

		character_util.move_to(user_party[i], vector(2 + mod, 0,  -6 - val), 1, nil, true, true)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	party_util.set_direction("up")

	for i = 0, self.awaiter_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_direction(self.awaiter_list[i], "up")
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	camera_util.move_async(vector(2.5, 0, 0), 1)

	character_util.move_to(self.gatekeeper_list[0], self.gatekeeper_list[0].Position + vector(0, 0, -1),
			nil, 4, true, true)
	character_util.move_to(self.gatekeeper_list[1], self.gatekeeper_list[1].Position + vector(0, 0, -1),
			nil, 4, true, true)

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	character_util.move_to(self.gatekeeper_list[0], self.gatekeeper_list[0].Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
			nil, 4, true, true)
	character_util.move_to(self.gatekeeper_list[1], self.gatekeeper_list[1].Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
			nil, 4, true, true)

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	character_util.set_direction(self.gatekeeper_list[0], "right")
	character_util.set_direction(self.gatekeeper_list[1], "left")

	-- 한 팀씩 검문
	for i = 0, 3 do
		coroutine.yield(self:move_one_step(i))

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		character_util.set_anim(self.gatekeeper_list[0], { name = "question", loop = false })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.gatekeeper_list[0], { name = "attack" })

		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.set_anim(self.gatekeeper_list[0], { name = "get" })

		local talk_key_add = { '3', '4', '5_a', '5_b' }

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.gatekeeper_list[0], { key = 'steampunk_main_s1_'..talk_key_add[i + 1], skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim(self.gatekeeper_list[0])
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.gatekeeper_list[0])

		character_util.move_to(self.awaiter_list[i * 2], self.awaiter_list[i * 2].Position + vector(0, 0, 6),
				nil, 4, true, true)
		character_util.move_to(self.awaiter_list[i * 2 + 1], self.awaiter_list[i * 2 + 1].Position + vector(0, 0, 6),
				nil, 4, true, true)
	end

	-- 플레이어 차례
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.move_to(user_party[i], user_party[i].Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
				0.5, nil, true, true)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	character_util.set_anim(self.gatekeeper_list[0], { name = 'question', loop = false })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.gatekeeper_list[0], { name = 'tired' })

	character_util.set_anim(self.gatekeeper_list[1], { name = 'cross_arm' })

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(self.gatekeeper_list[0], nil, 'question')

	character_util.set_anim(self.gatekeeper_list[0], { name = "cast" })
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.gatekeeper_list[0])

	character_util.remove_anim(self.gatekeeper_list[1])

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.gatekeeper_list[0], { key = 'steampunk_main_s1_6', skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim(self.gatekeeper_list[0], { name = "bomb_idle" })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.gatekeeper_list[0], { name = 'doyagao' })

	character_util.set_anim(self.gatekeeper_list[1], { name = "sing" })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.gatekeeper_list[1], { name = 'doyagao' })

	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, "up")

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		if i % 2 == 0 then
			character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], "left")
		else
			character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], "right")
		end
	end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.gatekeeper_list[0], { key = 'steampunk_main_s1_7', skip = true })

	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'right')

	character_util.set_anim(self.gatekeeper_list[0], { name = 'sing' })

	character_util.set_anim(self.gatekeeper_list[1], { name = 'sing' })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.gatekeeper_list[1], { key = 'steampunk_main_s1_7_1', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(self.gatekeeper_list[0])
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.gatekeeper_list[0])

	character_util.remove_anim(self.gatekeeper_list[1])
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.gatekeeper_list[1])

	for i = 2, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], "right")
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], { name = "tired" })
	end

	if user_party.Count > 1 then
		character_util.move_to(user_party[1], user_party[1].Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
				nil, 4, true, true)
	end

	character_util.set_direction(self.gatekeeper_list[1], "up")
	character_util.move_to(self.gatekeeper_list[1], self.gatekeeper_list[1].Position + vector(0, 0, -1),
			nil, 4, false, true)

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- 남은 파티원들은 위로 이동
	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.move_to(user_party[i], user_party[i].Position + vector(0, 0, 6),
				nil, 4, true, true)
	end

	character_util.move_to_async(user_party_leader, user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -1),
			0.5, nil, true, true)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'right')

	character_util.move_to(self.gatekeeper_list[0], self.gatekeeper_list[0].Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
			nil, 4, true, true)

	character_util.move_to(self.gatekeeper_list[1], self.gatekeeper_list[1].Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
			nil, 4, true, true)

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	character_util.move_to(self.gatekeeper_list[0], self.gatekeeper_list[0].Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
			nil, 4, true, true)

	character_util.move_to(self.gatekeeper_list[1], self.gatekeeper_list[1].Position + vector(0, 0, 2),
			nil, 4, true, true)

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- awaiter 제거
	for i = 0, self.awaiter_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_active_state(self.awaiter_list[i], 'disabled')
	end

	-- 파티원 비활성화
	self.controller:deactivate_party()

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_jingak_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	for i = 0, self.gatekeeper_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_direction(self.gatekeeper_list[i], 'down')
	end

	camera_util.move_async(user_party_leader.Position, 1, { end_target = user_party_leader })

	user_party:ResetControllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

		character_util.move_to(self.awaiter_list[i], self.awaiter_list[i].Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
				0.5, nil, true, true)
