end

-- Keep in row 이벤트를 시작하기 위한 캐릭터 기본 설정
function local_class:keep_in_row_setting(initialized)
	if initialized then
		character_util.set_position(user_party_leader, vector(16, 0, -1))
		character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, "right")
	end

	for i = 0, self.refugee_list.Count - 1 do
		local val = math.floor(i / 2)
		local mod = i % 2

		if i < math.floor(self.refugee_list.Count / 2) then
			character_util.set_position(self.refugee_list[i], vector(18 - val, 0, 0 - mod))
		else
			character_util.set_position(self.refugee_list[i], vector(17 - val, 0, 0 - mod))
		end

		character_util.set_direction(self.refugee_list[i], "right")
		character_util.remove_anim(self.refugee_list[i])
		character_util.set_emotion(self.refugee_list[i], { name = "tired" })
	end

	character_util.set_position(self.refugee_partner, vector(16, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(self.refugee_partner, "right")
	character_util.remove_anim(self.refugee_partner)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.refugee_partner, { name = "tired" })

	for i = 0, self.soldier_list.Count - 1 do
		local mod = i % 2

		if i < math.floor(self.soldier_list.Count / 3) then
			character_util.set_position(self.soldier_list[i], vector(19, 0, 0 - mod))
		elseif i < math.floor(2 * self.soldier_list.Count / 3) then
			character_util.set_position(self.soldier_list[i], vector(13, 0, 0 - mod))
		else
			character_util.set_position(self.soldier_list[i], vector(16, 0, 1 - mod * 3))
		end

		character_util.set_direction(self.soldier_list[i], "right")
		character_util.remove_anim(self.soldier_list[i])
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.soldier_list[i])
	end
end

-- 난민 행렬을 지키며 이동하는 이벤트, 벗어나면 제국 병사의 사격을 받게 됨
function local_class:keep_in_row_event()
	-- 잠시 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 난민들과 병사들 이동시킴
	for i = 0, self.refugee_list.Count - 1 do
		local refugee_waypoint_list = {}
		table.insert(refugee_waypoint_list,
				self.refugee_list[i].Position + vector(self.row_whole_move_dist, 0, 0))

		character_util.move_waypoint(self.refugee_list[i], refugee_waypoint_list, self.row_move_speed, false,
				"stop", "floor", CS.Oak.Direction.Right)

		character_util.set_anim(self.refugee_list[i], { name = "walk" })

		-- 난민이 총알과 플레이어 이동을 막지 않도록 임시로 EtherealCrashBehaviour로 설정함
		self.refugee_list[i].CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end

	for i = 0, self.soldier_list.Count - 1 do
		local soldier_waypoint_list = {}
		table.insert(soldier_waypoint_list,
				self.soldier_list[i].Position + vector(self.row_whole_move_dist, 0, 0))

		character_util.set_anim(self.soldier_list[i], { name = "rifle_walk" })
		character_util.move_waypoint(self.soldier_list[i], soldier_waypoint_list, self.row_move_speed, false,
				"stop", "floor", CS.Oak.Direction.Right)

		-- 병사가 총알과 플레이어 이동을 막지 않도록 임시로 EtherealCrashBehaviour로 설정함
		self.soldier_list[i].CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end

	local refugee_waypoint_list = {}
	table.insert(refugee_waypoint_list,
			self.refugee_partner.Position + vector(self.row_whole_move_dist, 0, 0))

	character_util.move_waypoint(self.refugee_partner, refugee_waypoint_list, self.row_move_speed, false,
			"stop", "floor", CS.Oak.Direction.Right)
	character_util.set_anim(self.refugee_partner, { name = "walk" })

	self.refugee_partner.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	-- 프로젝타일 데미지의 notMortal 값이 true이긴 하지만 혹시라도 플레이어가 죽으면 처리가 곤란하므로 무적으로 설정
	character_util.set_immortal(user_party_leader, true)

	local out_of_row = false
	local out_of_row_timer = 0.5

	self.keep_in_row_player_x = user_party_leader.Position.x

	while (self.event_progress == EventProgress.keep_in_row_event) do
		-- 플레이어가 현재 있어야 할 x 위치 결정
		self.keep_in_row_player_x = self.keep_in_row_player_x + unity_class.time.deltaTime * self.row_move_speed

		-- 행렬 벗어났는지 확인
		if unity_class.mathf.Abs(user_party_leader.Position.x - self.keep_in_row_player_x) > self.keep_in_row_side_limit or
				user_party_leader.Position.z < self.keep_in_row_lower_limit or
				user_party_leader.Position.z > self.keep_in_row_upper_limit then
			out_of_row = true
		elseif out_of_row then
			out_of_row = false
			out_of_row_timer = 0

			character_util.set_direction(self.soldier_list[2], "right")
			character_util.remove_anim(self.soldier_list[2], true)
			character_util.remove_emotion(self.soldier_list[2])

			character_util.set_direction(self.soldier_list[3], "right")
			character_util.remove_anim(self.soldier_list[3], true)
			character_util.remove_emotion(self.soldier_list[3])
		end

		if out_of_row and not self.is_reset_shoot then
			out_of_row_timer = out_of_row_timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if out_of_row_timer >= self.out_of_row_limit then
				out_of_row_timer = 0

				-- 행렬 벗어났을 경우, 뒤에 있던 제국 병사가 플레이어를 향해 발포
				local rand = random_util.get_random_int(0, 1)

				if rand == 0 then
					self.shoot_helper_1:ShootTargetObject(user_party_leader, vector(0, 0, 0.3), -1, true, 0)

					local target_dir = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetSideDirection(
							(user_party_leader.Position - self.soldier_list[2].Position):ToDirection())

					character_util.set_direction(self.soldier_list[2], target_dir)
					character_util.set_anim(self.soldier_list[2], { name = "rifle_shoot", upper = true })
					character_util.set_emotion(self.soldier_list[2], { name = "attack" })

					character_util.set_direction(self.soldier_list[3], "right")
					character_util.remove_anim(self.soldier_list[3], true)
					character_util.remove_emotion(self.soldier_list[3])

					speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.soldier_list[2], "steampunk_main_s1_15")
				else
					self.shoot_helper_2:ShootTargetObject(user_party_leader, vector(0, 0, 0.3), -1, true, 0)

					local target_dir = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetSideDirection(
							(user_party_leader.Position - self.soldier_list[2].Position):ToDirection())

					character_util.set_direction(self.soldier_list[2], target_dir)
					character_util.set_anim(self.soldier_list[3], { name = "rifle_shoot", upper = true })
					character_util.set_emotion(self.soldier_list[3], { name = "attack" })

					character_util.set_direction(self.soldier_list[2], "right")
					character_util.remove_anim(self.soldier_list[2], true)
					character_util.remove_emotion(self.soldier_list[2])

					speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.soldier_list[3], "steampunk_main_s1_16")
				end
			end
		end

		-- NPC들 이동 끝났으면 애니메이션 해제
		if self.refugee_partner.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped then
			-- npc 애니메이션 초기화
			for i = 0, self.refugee_list.Count - 1 do
				character_util.remove_anim(self.refugee_list[i])
			end

			for i = 0, self.soldier_list.Count - 1 do
				character_util.set_anim(self.soldier_list[i], { name = 'rifle_idle' })
				character_util.remove_anim(self.soldier_list[i], true)
			end

			character_util.remove_anim(self.refugee_partner)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- while 문을 벗어났다는 것은 플레이어가 다음 지역에 진입했다는 의미이므로 이동하던 캐릭터들이 이동이 끝날 때까지 대기한 뒤,
	-- 다음 이벤트를 진행한다.

	-- 플레이어 컨트롤 빼앗음
	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton, user_party.Leader)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	-- 플레이어는 최종 위치까지 마저 이동함
	character_util.move_to(user_party_leader, vector(42, 0, -1), nil, self.row_move_speed, true, true)

	-- 모든 NPC들이 동일 시점에 동일 거리를 이동하므로 일단 특정 NPC 하나의 상태만 확인해서 대기해도 전체 이동이 끝나는 시점까지 대기가 가능
	while self.refugee_partner.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction ~= CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- npc 애니메이션 초기화
	for i = 0, self.refugee_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim(self.refugee_list[i])
	end

	for i = 0, self.soldier_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_direction(self.soldier_list[i], 'right')
		character_util.remove_anim(self.soldier_list[i])
		character_util.remove_anim(self.soldier_list[i], true)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(self.refugee_partner)

	-- 총 발사하는 병사들의 무기 제거
	for i = 0, self.soldier_list.Count - 1 do
		self.soldier_list[i].SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')
	end

	-- 플레이어 이동이 끝나지 않았을 수 있으므로 대기
	while user_party_leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction ~= CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 시간차에 따라 일부 NPC 이동이 끝나지 않았을 수 있고, 연출 상 지연 시간이 필요해서 0.3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 다음 이벤트 진행
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.refugee_runaway_event, self))
end

-- Keep in row 이벤트를 리셋시키고 처음부터 다시 시작하는 이벤트
function local_class:reset_keep_in_row_event()
	self.is_retire_player = true

	-- Keep in row 이벤트 종료
	stop_coroutine(self.keep_in_row_coroutine)

	-- 캐릭터들 이동 중단
	for i = 0, self.refugee_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.stop(self.refugee_list[i])
		character_util.remove_anim(self.refugee_list[i])
	end

	for i = 0, self.soldier_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.stop(self.soldier_list[i])

		if i ~= 2 and i ~= 3 then
			character_util.remove_anim(self.soldier_list[i])
		else
			character_util.set_anim(self.soldier_list[i], { name = "rifle_idle" })
		end
	end

	character_util.stop(self.refugee_partner)
	character_util.remove_anim(self.refugee_partner)

	-- 캐릭터 정지까지 기다려야 하므로 1프레임 대기
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 총 발사 중인 병사들 초기화 작업
	character_util.set_direction(self.soldier_list[2], "right")
	character_util.remove_anim(self.soldier_list[2], true)
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.soldier_list[2])

	character_util.set_direction(self.soldier_list[3], "right")
	character_util.remove_anim(self.soldier_list[3], true)
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.soldier_list[3])

	for i = 0, self.await_for_shot_soldier_list.Count - 1 do
		if i < 2 then
			character_util.set_direction(self.await_for_shot_soldier_list[i], 'down')
		else
			character_util.set_direction(self.await_for_shot_soldier_list[i], 'up')
		end

		character_util.remove_emotion(self.await_for_shot_soldier_list[i])
	end

	-- 플레이어 컨트롤 빼앗음
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	-- 플레이어 카메라 확대해서 보여준 뒤, 쓰러지는 연출과 페이드 아웃
	camera_util.resize_to(3, 0.5)

	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetSideDirection(user_party_leader.Direction))
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = "dead", loop = false })
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = "damaged" })

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_drown_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	screen_util.fade_out_circular(1, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)
	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)

	-- 플레이어 체력 원상복구
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.sender = nil
	heal_info.target = user_party_leader
	heal_info.heal = user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP

	command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)

	self:keep_in_row_setting(true)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.is_retire_player = false

	-- Keep in row 이벤트 재개
	self.keep_in_row_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.keep_in_row_event, self))

	user_party:ResetControllers()
	-- 캐릭터 Reset이 바로 되지 않으므로 기다림
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	--6성 리더 스킬 버튼 추가에 따른, 필요한 UI만 출력하도록 수정.
	field_ui_util.show_target_ui({
		show_target = field_ui_type.dpad | field_ui_type.action_button | field_ui_type.party_state,
		show_minimap = true,
		show_navigation_bar = true,
		show_ui_quest_marker = true
	})
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_3 then
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')

		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset)

		if self.controller.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.fight_with_mecha) ~= -1 then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.blocked_door

			self.already_see_boss_event = true
		end

		self:setting()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_3 then
		if self.already_see_boss_event then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(
					self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(21, 0,55))
			quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_1))
		else
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.scrap)
			quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_1))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.ishya = nil
	self.shyapira = nil
	self.boss = nil
	self.guide_kid_boy = nil
	self.guide_kid_girl = nil

	self.soldier_list = nil
	self.refugee_list = nil
	self.guide_male_list = nil
	self.guide_female_list = nil

	self.train_scrap_list = nil
	self.rotate_rail_lever_list = nil
	self.rotate_rail_list = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		self:on_touch_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.guide_zone_name_1 then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.guide_1 then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.guide_1

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.guide_event_1, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.guide_zone_name_2 then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.guide_2 then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.guide_2

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.guide_event_2, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.guide_zone_name_3 then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.guide_3 then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.guide_3

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.guide_event_3, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.guide_zone_name_4 then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.guide_4 then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.guide_4

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.guide_event_4, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.guide_zone_name_6 then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.guide_6 then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.guide_6

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.guide_event_6, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.block_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.blocked_door then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.blocked_door

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.blocked_door_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.boss_battle_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.boss_battle_event then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.boss_battle_event

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fight_with_boss_event, self))
		end
	elseif e.Zone.Name == self.battle_zone_name then
		if not self.see_boy_talk and not self.already_see_boss_event then
			self.see_boy_talk = true

			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.guide_kid_boy, { key = 'steampunk_main_s11_1' })
		end
	elseif e.Zone.Name == self.marker_zone_name_1 then
		self:set_marker(1)
	elseif e.Zone.Name == self.marker_zone_name_2 then
		self:set_marker(2)
	elseif e.Zone.Name == self.marker_zone_name_3 then
		self:set_marker(3)
	elseif e.Zone.Name == self.marker_zone_name_4 then
		self:set_marker(4)
	elseif e.Zone.Name == self.marker_zone_name_5 then
		self:set_marker(5)
	elseif e.Zone.Name == self.underground_zone_name then
		self:resume_marker_in_cave()
	elseif e.Zone.Name == self.house_area_zone_name then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave and e.FieldObject == user_party_leader then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.underground_zone_name then
			self:resume_marker_out_cave()
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.house_area_zone_name then
			self:resume_marker_out_house()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.scrap) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_with_scrap_event, self))
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.blocked_block) then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.guide_1_help then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.guide_1_help

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_with_block_event, self))
		end
	end

	for i = 0, self.train_scrap_list.Count - 1 do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.train_scrap_list[i]) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_with_train_scrap_event, self, i))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name_1 and not self.already_see_boss_event then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.defeat_battle_1, self))
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name_2 and not self.already_see_boss_event then
		self:defeat_battle_2()
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name_3 and not self.already_see_boss_event then
		self:defeat_battle_3()
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == self.boss_battle_group_name then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.defeat_boss, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft and not self.qte_success then
		self.qte_success = true
	end
end

-- 섹션 입장 시 NPC 설정
function local_class:setting()
	self.soldier_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	for i = 1, self.soldier_num do
		local cur_soldier = get_character(self.soldier_name..i)

		local val = math.floor((i-1) / 2)
		local mod = (i-1) % 2

		if self.controller.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.fight_with_mecha) == -1 then
			if i > 2 and i <= 6 then
				character_util.set_position(cur_soldier, vector(61 + (val - 1), 0, 108 - mod))
				character_util.set_direction(cur_soldier, 'right')
			elseif i <= 8 then
				character_util.set_position(cur_soldier, vector(66, 0, 108 - mod))
				character_util.set_direction(cur_soldier, 'left')
			end
		end

		self.soldier_list:Add(cur_soldier)
	end

	self.refugee_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	for i = 1, self.refugee_num do
		self.refugee_list:Add(get_character(self.refugee_name..i))
	end

	self.ishya = get_character(self.ishya_name)
	self.shyapira = get_character(self.shyapira_name)

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 10 then
		character_util.set_position(self.ishya,
				user_party_leader.Position - CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(
						CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetOpposite(user_party_leader.Direction)) * user_party.Count)
		character_util.set_direction(self.ishya, 'right')
		character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.ishya, user_party, true)

		character_util.set_position(self.shyapira,
				user_party_leader.Position - CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(
						CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetOpposite(user_party_leader.Direction)) * (user_party.Count + 1))
		character_util.set_direction(self.shyapira, 'right')
		character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.shyapira, user_party, true)
	end

	self.boss = get_character(self.boss_name)
	character_util.set_position(self.boss, vector(64.5, 0, 107))
	character_util.set_direction(self.boss, 'left')

	if not self.already_see_boss_event then
		character_util.set_anim(self.boss, { name = 'off' })
	end

	self.guide_male_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	for i = 1, self.refugee_guide_male_num do
		local cur_guide = get_character(self.guide_male_name..i)
		cur_guide.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

		self.guide_male_list:Add(cur_guide)
	end

	self.guide_female_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	for i = 1, self.refugee_guide_female_num do
		local cur_guide = get_character(self.guide_female_name..i)
		cur_guide.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

		self.guide_female_list:Add(cur_guide)
	end

	self.guide_kid_boy = get_character(self.guide_kid_boy_name)
	self.guide_kid_boy.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	if not self.already_see_boss_event then
		character_util.set_position(self.guide_kid_boy, vector(18, 0, 28))
		character_util.set_direction(self.guide_kid_boy, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim(self.guide_kid_boy, { name = 'cast' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.guide_kid_boy, { name = 'damaged' })

		-- 가이드 인원 배치
		character_util.set_position(self.guide_male_list[1], vector(20, 0, 55))
		character_util.set_direction(self.guide_male_list[1], 'down')
		character_util.set_anim(self.guide_male_list[1], { name = 'cast2' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.guide_male_list[1], { name = 'attack' })

		-- 몬스터 위치 설정
		local battle_1_monster_1 = get_character('battle_1_5')
		local battle_1_monster_2 = get_character('battle_1_6')

		character_util.set_position(battle_1_monster_1, vector(18, 0, 27))
		character_util.set_direction(battle_1_monster_1, 'left')

		character_util.set_position(battle_1_monster_2, vector(18, 0, 29))
		character_util.set_direction(battle_1_monster_2, 'left')
	end

	self.guide_kid_girl = get_character(self.guide_kid_girl_name)
	self.guide_kid_girl.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	-- 필드오브젝트 설정
	self.scrap = get_field_object(self.scrap_name)
	self.scrap.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	self.blocked_block = get_field_object(self.blocked_block_name)
	self.blocked_block.Pushable = CS.Oak.NonPushable.Instance

	if self.already_see_boss_event then
		self.blocked_block.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	end

	self.blocked_rock = get_field_object(self.blocked_rock_name)

	self.train_scrap_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.FieldObject)
	for i = 1, self.train_scrap_num do
		self.train_scrap_list:Add(get_field_object(self.train_scrap_name..i))
	end

	self.rotate_rail_lever_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.FieldObject)
	for i = 1, self.rotate_rail_lever_num do
		self.rotate_rail_lever_list:Add(get_field_object(self.rotate_rail_lever_name..i))
	end

	self.rotate_rail_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.FieldObject)
	for i = 1, self.rotate_rail_num do
		self.rotate_rail_list:Add(get_field_object(self.rotate_rail_name..i))
	end

	-- 문 열리도록 설정
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.blocked_door_name))

	-- 필드오브젝트 설정
	if self.already_see_boss_event then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.town_door_name_1))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.town_door_name_2))

		for i = 0, self.train_scrap_list.Count - 1 do
			self.train_scrap_list[i].ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
		end
	else
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.town_door_name_1))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.town_door_name_2))
	end
end

-- 특정 지점마다 갱신되는 퀘스트 마커 처리
function local_class:set_marker(index)
	if self.marker_index ~= index then
		self.marker_index = index

		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

		if index == 1 then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(
					self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(159, 1,98))
		elseif index == 2 then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(
					self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(14, 0,70))
		elseif index == 3 then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(
					self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(13.5, 0,86.5))
		elseif index == 4 then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(
					self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(23, 0,107.5))
		elseif index == 5 then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(
					self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(62, 0,107))
		end
	end
end

-- 동굴로 들어갈 때 퀘스트 마커 처리
function local_class:resume_marker_in_cave()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

	-- 마커 처리 중이지 않을 때는 추가하지 않음
	if self.marker_index == 0 then
		return
	end

	if self.marker_index < 4 then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(
				self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(159, 1,98))
	else
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(
				self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(110, 1,127))
	end
end

-- 쓰레기더미와 상호작용하는 이벤트
function local_class:interact_with_scrap_event()
	if self.event_progress == EventProgress.idle then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
	end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_04', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local up = false
	local start_pos = nil
	local end_pos = nil

	if user_party_leader.Position.z < 6 then
		up = true
		start_pos = vector(15.5, 0, 7)
		end_pos = vector(15.5, 0, 8)
	else
		start_pos = vector(15.5, -0.5, 6)
		end_pos = vector(15.5, 0, 5)
	end

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], { name = 'walk4legs' })
	end

	local move_time = 1

	camera_util.move(vector(15.5, 0, 6), move_time)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party[i], 0, move_time / 3 * 2)
		character_util.move_to(user_party[i], vector(15.5, -1, 6.5),
				move_time, nil, true, false)
	end

	wait_for_sec(move_time + 0.5)

	if up then
		camera_util.move(end_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.7), move_time, { end_target = user_party_leader })
	else
		camera_util.move(end_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.7), move_time, { end_target = user_party_leader })
	end

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party[i], 1, move_time)
		character_util.set_position(user_party[i], start_pos)

		if i == 0 then
			if up then
				character_util.move_to(user_party[i], end_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.7),
						move_time, nil, true, false)
			else
				character_util.move_to(user_party[i], end_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.7),
						move_time, nil, true, false)
			end
		else
			character_util.move_to(user_party[i], end_pos, move_time, nil, true, false)
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(move_time)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim(user_party[i])
	end

	if self.event_progress == EventProgress.idle then
		self.event_progress = EventProgress.interact_with_scrap

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(
				self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(14.5, 0,29.5))
	end

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

-- 배틀 그룹 1 적들을 전부 퇴치한 뒤 나오는 이벤트
function local_class:defeat_battle_1()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(
			self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(21, 0,55))

	character_util.remove_anim(self.guide_kid_boy)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.guide_kid_boy, { name = 'attack' })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.guide_kid_boy, { key = 'steampunk_main_s11_4', skip = false })

	self.guide_kid_boy.Interactable.Talk = 'steampunk_main_s11_4'
	self.guide_kid_boy.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
end

-- 가이드 1번 이벤트
function local_class:guide_event_1()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

-- 블록과 상호작용하는 이벤트
function local_class:interact_with_block_event()
	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.ishya)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.shyapira)

	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.blocked_block)

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	camera_util.move(vector(20, 0, 53), 1)

	-- 플레이어 파티 블록에 붙도록 이동
	local push_block_char_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)

	push_block_char_list:Add(self.ishya)

	push_block_char_list:Add(self.shyapira)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		push_block_char_list:Add(user_party[i])
	end

	local push_block_char_num = push_block_char_list.Count

	local push_block_pos_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	for i = 0, push_block_char_list.Count - 1 do
		local val = math.floor(i / 2)
		local mod = i % 2

		push_block_pos_list:Add(vector(19.3 - 0.5 * val, 0, 53 - mod))
	end

	for i = 0, push_block_char_list.Count - 1 do
		local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

		if push_block_char_list[i].Position.x > push_block_pos_list[i].x then
			waypoint_list:Add(vector(push_block_pos_list[i].x, 0, push_block_char_list[i].Position.z))
		end

		waypoint_list:Add(push_block_pos_list[i])

		character_util.move_waypoint(push_block_char_list[i], waypoint_list, 2, false, 'stop',
				'floor', CS.Oak.Direction.Right)
	end

	local waited = 0

	while waited ~= push_block_char_list.Count do
		waited = 0

		for i = 0, push_block_char_list.Count - 1 do
			if push_block_char_list[i].CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped then
				waited = waited + 1
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	for i = 0, push_block_char_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_anim(push_block_char_list[i], { name = 'push' })
	end

-- 숨어 있던 난민들이 등장하는 이벤트
function local_class:come_out_refugee()
	for i = 0, 7 do
		if i == 0 or i == 1 or i == 4 or i == 5 then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.refugee_list[i], 0, 0)
		end
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.come_out_from_house,
			self, self.refugee_list[0], vector(13, 0, 54), vector(13, 0, 53)))

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.come_out_from_house,
			self, self.refugee_list[1], vector(15.5, 0, 54), vector(15.5, 0, 53)))

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.jump_from_upper,
			self, self.refugee_list[2], vector(12.5, 3, 57), vector(12.5, 3, 54), 1))

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.jump_from_upper,
			self, self.refugee_list[3], vector(19, 3, 57), vector(19, 3, 54), 1))

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.come_out_from_house,
			self, self.refugee_list[4], vector(18, 2, 53.5), vector(17, 2, 53.5)))

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.come_out_from_house,
			self, self.refugee_list[5], vector(12, 2, 53.5), vector(11, 2, 53.5)))

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.jump_from_upper,
			self, self.refugee_list[6], vector(18, 3, 57), vector(18, 3, 54), 1))

	character_util.set_position(self.refugee_list[7], vector(16, 0, 47))
	character_util.set_anim(self.refugee_list[7], { name = 'run' })
	character_util.move_to_async(self.refugee_list[7], self.refugee_list[7].Position + vector(0, 0, 5),
			1, nil, true, false, true)

	character_util.set_direction(self.refugee_list[7], 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim(self.refugee_list[7])
end

-- 집에서 난민이 등장하는 연출
function local_class:come_out_from_house(character, start_pos, end_pos)
	character_util.set_position(character, start_pos)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(character, 0, 0)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	local move_duration = 1

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(character, 1, move_duration)
	character_util.move_to_async(character, end_pos, move_duration, nil, true, true)

	character_util.look_at(character, self.ishya)
end

-- 위쪽에서 난민이 점프해서 등장하는 연출
function local_class:jump_from_upper(character, start_pos, end_pos, move_duration)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_jump_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	character_util.set_position(character, start_pos)

	character_util.jump(character, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.set_anim(character, { name = 'get' })
	character_util.move_to_async(character, end_pos, move_duration, nil, true, false)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_land_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	character_util.remove_anim(character)
end

-- 난민들이 블록 위치로 이동하는 연출
function local_class:refugee_move_to_block(pos_list)
	-- 건물 위에 있는 NPC들 내려와야 함
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.jump_from_upper,
			self, self.refugee_list[2], self.refugee_list[2].Position, vector(11, 2, 54), 0.5))

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.jump_from_upper,
			self, self.refugee_list[4], self.refugee_list[4].Position, vector(17, 0, 53), 0.5))

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.jump_from_upper,
			self, self.refugee_list[5], self.refugee_list[5].Position, vector(11, 0, 53), 0.5))

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.jump_from_upper,
			self, self.refugee_list[6], self.refugee_list[6].Position, vector(17, 2, 54), 0.5))

	-- 일반 이동 처리
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
			stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_to_shortest_pos, self, self.refugee_list[0], pos_list))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
			stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_to_shortest_pos, self, self.refugee_list[1], pos_list))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
			stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_to_shortest_pos, self, self.refugee_list[7], pos_list))

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 건물 위에 있는 NPC 계속 내려옴
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.jump_from_upper,
			self, self.refugee_list[2], self.refugee_list[2].Position, vector(11, 0, 53), 0.5))

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.jump_from_upper,
			self, self.refugee_list[3], self.refugee_list[3].Position, vector(17, 2, 54), 0.5))

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.jump_from_upper,
			self, self.refugee_list[6], self.refugee_list[6].Position, vector(17, 0, 53), 0.5))

	-- 일반 이동 처리

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
			stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_to_shortest_pos, self, self.refugee_list[5], pos_list))

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(

-- 리스트 중 가장 가까운 거리로 이동
function local_class:move_to_shortest_pos(character, pos_list)
	local shortest = 999
	local index = 0

	for i = 0, pos_list.Count - 1 do
		if shortest > (character.Position - pos_list[i]).magnitude then
			index = i
		end
	end

	local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	waypoint_list:Add(pos_list[index])

	character_util.set_anim(character, { name = 'walk' })
	character_util.move_waypoint(character, pos_list[index], 4, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right', false)

	pos_list:Remove(pos_list[index])

	while character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction ~= CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(character)
end

-- 병사들 도망치는 이벤트
function local_class:runaway_soldiers()
	for i = 2, 7 do
		character_util.set_anim(self.soldier_list[i], { name = 'run' })

		local val = math.floor(i / 2)
		local mod = i % 2

		local cur_waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

		if i < 6 then
			if mod == 0 then
				if val == 1 then
					cur_waypoint_list:Add(vector(62, 0, 108))
				end

				cur_waypoint_list:Add(vector(62, 0, 109))
				cur_waypoint_list:Add(vector(66, 0, 109))
				cur_waypoint_list:Add(vector(66, 0, 108))
				cur_waypoint_list:Add(vector(75, 0, 108))

				character_util.move_waypoint(self.soldier_list[i], cur_waypoint_list, 6, true,
						'stop', 'floor', 'right', true)
			else
				if val == 1 then
					cur_waypoint_list:Add(vector(62, 0, 107))
				end

				cur_waypoint_list:Add(vector(62, 0, 106))
				cur_waypoint_list:Add(vector(66, 0, 106))
				cur_waypoint_list:Add(vector(66, 0, 107))
				cur_waypoint_list:Add(vector(75, 0, 107))

				character_util.move_waypoint(self.soldier_list[i], cur_waypoint_list, 6, true,
						'stop', 'floor', 'right', true)
			end
		else
			cur_waypoint_list:Add(vector(75, 0, 108 - mod))

			character_util.move_waypoint(self.soldier_list[i], cur_waypoint_list, 6, true,
					'stop', 'floor', 'right', true)
		end
	end

	-- 일정 시간 대기 후 NPC 초기화
	wait_for_sec(3)

	for i = 2, 7 do
		character_util.set_position(self.soldier_list[i], vector(999, 0, 999))
		character_util.remove_anim(self.soldier_list[i])
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.soldier_list[i])
	end
end

function local_class:soldier_move_to_surround()
	for i = 0, self.soldier_list.Count - 1 do
		local val = math.floor(i / 2)
		local mod = i % 2

		local cur_waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
		cur_waypoint_list:Add(vector(66, 0, 108 - mod))

		if i < self.soldier_list.Count - 2 then
			if mod == 0 then
				cur_waypoint_list:Add(vector(66, 0, 110))
				cur_waypoint_list:Add(vector(60 + val, 0, 110))

				character_util.move_waypoint(self.soldier_list[i], cur_waypoint_list, 6, true,
						'stop', 'floor', 'down', true)
			else
				cur_waypoint_list:Add(vector(66, 0, 105))
				cur_waypoint_list:Add(vector(60 + val, 0, 105))

				character_util.move_waypoint(self.soldier_list[i], cur_waypoint_list, 6, true,
						'stop', 'floor', 'up', true)
			end
		else
			cur_waypoint_list:Add(vector(64, 0, 108 - mod))

			character_util.move_waypoint(self.soldier_list[i], cur_waypoint_list, 6, true,
					'stop', 'floor', 'left', true)
		end
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 8, 9 index의 병사들 이동 거리는 같으므로 1명만 확인해서 대기
	while self.soldier_list[8].CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction ~= CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_jingak_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	self.soldier_list[8].SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'desert_hunter_rifle')
	character_util.set_anim(self.soldier_list[8], { name = 'rifle_idle' })

	character_util.set_anim(self.soldier_list[9], { name = 'rifle_idle' })

	-- 0 ~ 7 index의 병사들 이동 거리는 전부 같으므로 1명만 확인해서 대기
	while self.soldier_list[0].CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction ~= CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_jingak_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	for i = 0, self.soldier_list.Count - 1 do

-- 난민들이 달려가서 병사들을 막아섬
function local_class:refugee_attack(refugee, target, pos_list, dir)
	character_util.move_waypoint(refugee, pos_list, 6, true,
			'stop', 'floor', dir, true)

	while refugee.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction ~= CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	-- 병사를 막는 난민
	character_util.shake(refugee, 0.04, 9999)
	character_util.set_anim(refugee, { name = 'push', upper = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(refugee, { name = 'damaged' })

	character_util.move_to(refugee, refugee.Position + CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(refugee.Direction),
			1, nil, true, false)

	-- 난민들에 밀리는 병사들
	character_util.shake(target, 0.04, 9999)

	character_util.set_direction(target, CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetOpposite(refugee.Direction))
	character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'rifle_idle', upper = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(target, { name = 'damaged' })

	character_util.move_to(target, target.Position + CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(refugee.Direction),
			1, nil, false, false)
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

	self.shyapira = nil

		self.twinkle_effect:Dispose()

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.progress_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.progress_section then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.progress_section

			self:progress_event()
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.shyapira_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.leave_shyapira then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.leave_shyapira

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.leave_shyapira_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.gas_room_zone_name then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })

		self.crystal_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_magic_circle_active_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

		-- 1, 2번 마커가 떠 있을 수는 없겠지만...에러 발생 미연에 방지
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name..1)
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name..2)

		if self.interact_check_table[1] and self.interact_check_table[2] then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(
					self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.ishya)
		else
			if not self.interact_check_table[1] then
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(
						self.quest_marker_name..1, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.dead_body_list[3])
			end

			if not self.interact_check_table[2] then
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(
						self.quest_marker_name..2, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.dead_body_list[9])
			end

			if not self.enter_gas_room_first then
				self.enter_gas_room_first = true

				quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.dead_body_list[3])
				quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.dead_body_list[9])
			end
		end
	elseif e.Zone.Name == self.underground_zone_name then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
	elseif e.Zone.Name == self.house_area_zone_name then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.gas_room_zone_name then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 2 })

		if self.crystal_sfx ~= nil then
			self.crystal_sfx:FadeOut()

		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name..1)
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name..2)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(
				self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(38.5, 0 ,2))
	elseif e.Zone.Name == self.underground_zone_name then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

		if self.event_progress == EventProgress.idle then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(
					self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(58.5, 0 ,-0.5))
		else
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(
					self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(38.5, 0 ,2))
		end
	elseif e.Zone.Name == self.house_area_zone_name then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

		if self.event_progress == EventProgress.idle then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(
					self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(58.5, 0 ,-0.5))
		else
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(
					self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(38.5, 0 ,2))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.ishya) then
		if self.interact_check_table[1] and self.interact_check_table[2] then

-- 프로젝타일 명중 처리
function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, self.shyapira) then
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_projectile_preset):Instantiate(self.shyapira.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

		CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(hit_info.target, 1, unity_class.color.red, hit_info.target.Position)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, user_party_leader) then
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_projectile_preset):Instantiate(user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

		character_util.spine_pulse_color(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(user_party_leader, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)

		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
		damage_info.sender = user_party_leader
		damage_info.target = user_party_leader
		damage_info.damage = math.floor(user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 0.05)

		command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
	end

-- 샤피라 기차 이벤트 세팅
function local_class:setting_shyapira_event()
	self.refugee_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	for i = 1, self.refugee_num do
		self.refugee_list:Add(get_character(self.refugee_name..i))
	end

	for i = 0, self.refugee_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.stop_shake(self.refugee_list[i])
		character_util.set_position(self.refugee_list[i], vector(999, 0, 999))
		character_util.remove_anim(self.refugee_list[i], true)
		character_util.remove_anim(self.refugee_list[i])
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.refugee_list[i])
	end

	self.soldier_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)

	local soldier_pos_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

	for i = 0, self.event_soldier_num - 1 do
		local val = math.floor(i / 4)
		local mod = i % 4

		soldier_pos_list:Add(vector(57 + val, 0, 1 - mod))
	end

	local soldier_dir_list = create_generic_list(CS.System.String)

	for i = 0, self.event_soldier_num - 1 do
		soldier_dir_list:Add('right')
	end

	self.shoot_helper_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.ShootHelper)

	-- 프로젝타일 발사 관련 처리
	local basic_rifle_id = 9030011;
	local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData');
	local rifle_data = item_data:GetSpec(basic_rifle_id).Data;
	local rifle_offset = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(rifle_data, 'ShootOffset', 0.5);

	self.projectile_data = create_generic_dictionary(CS.System.String, CS.System.Object)
	self.projectile_data:Add("Columns", CS.XLua.Cast.Int32(1))
	self.projectile_data:Add("SpreadAngle", CS.XLua.Cast.Int32(0))
	self.projectile_data:Add("Parallel", true)
	self.projectile_data:Add("Projectile", self.machinegun_bullet_name)
	self.projectile_data:Add("ShootOffset", rifle_offset)

	local pattern_info = shoot_helper_util.create_custom_projectile_pattern(self.projectile_data)
	local spec = shoot_helper_util.create_custom_projectile_spec(self.projectile_data)

	for i = 1, self.soldier_num do
		local cur_soldier = get_character(self.soldier_name..i)

		if i <= self.event_soldier_num then
			cur_soldier.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'desert_hunter_rifle')
			character_util.stop_shake(cur_soldier)
			character_util.set_position(cur_soldier, soldier_pos_list[i-1])
			character_util.set_direction(cur_soldier, soldier_dir_list[i-1])
			character_util.remove_anim(cur_soldier, true)
			character_util.set_anim(cur_soldier, { name = 'rifle_idle' })
			character_util.set_emotion(cur_soldier, { name = 'attack' })

			local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, cur_soldier)
			self.shoot_helper_list:Add(shoot_helper_util.create_shoot_helper_by_spec(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional
			, ps, spec, pattern_info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShootWithShootOffset))
		end

		self.soldier_list:Add(cur_soldier)
	end
end

	dead_body_pos_list:Add(vector(40.9, 0, -18.5))
	dead_body_pos_list:Add(vector(41.5, 0, -18.5))
	dead_body_pos_list:Add(vector(40.5, 0.5, -18.5))
	dead_body_pos_list:Add(vector(41.2, 0.5, -18.5))
	dead_body_pos_list:Add(vector(40.8, 1, -18.5))

		self.dead_body_list[i].Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
		self.dead_body_list[i].CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
		character_util.set_position(self.dead_body_list[i], dead_body_pos_list[i])

		if mod == 0 then
			character_util.set_direction(self.dead_body_list[i], 'left')
		else
			character_util.set_direction(self.dead_body_list[i], 'right')
		end

		self.dead_body_list[i].SpineController:AddColor(self.color_key, unity_color({0.5, 0.7, 0.7, 0.5}), 1, 0)
		character_util.set_anim(self.dead_body_list[i], { name = 'prostrate' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.dead_body_list[i], { name = 'damaged' })

		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.dead_body_list[i], CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	end
end

-- 샤피라에게 발포하는 병사들 이벤트
function local_class:shoot_to_shyapira()
	local timer = 1
	local is_animation_clear = false
	local animation_clear_delay = 0.5
	local shoot_delay = 1

	while self.event_progress ~= EventProgress.enter_gas_room do
		if timer >= shoot_delay then
			timer = 0
			is_animation_clear = false

			for i = 0, self.shoot_helper_list.Count - 1 do
				character_util.set_anim(self.soldier_list[i], { name = 'rifle_shoot', loop = false })
				self.shoot_helper_list[i]:ShootTargetObject(self.shyapira, vector(0, 0, 0.3), -1, true, 0)
			end
		else
			if is_animation_clear == false and timer >= animation_clear_delay then
				is_animation_clear = true

				for i = 0, self.shoot_helper_list.Count - 1 do
					character_util.set_anim(self.soldier_list[i], { name = 'rifle_idle' })
				end
			end

			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(self.shyapira)
end

local local_class = newclass('SteampunkMainSection13')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = SteampunkMain @
		Comment = 더 험악해진 수용소 분위기, 아이샤는 플레이어에게 할 일을 하라며 떠난다. @
		Index = 12 @
		NextSections = 13 @
]]

local EventProgress = {
	idle = 0,
	see_grave_event = 1,
	talk_with_ishya = 2
}

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name_4 = 'steampunk_1_4'

	self.event_progress = EventProgress.idle

	self.ishya = nil

	self.shyapira = nil

	self.refugee_list = nil

	self.penny_brother = nil

	-- 프로젝타일 발사 보조 클래스
	self.shoot_helper_1 = nil
	self.shoot_helper_2 = nil

	-- 기타 상수
	self.soldier_num = 6
	self.refugee_num = 8
	self.frontyard_door_num = 2

	-- NPC 이름
	self.ishya_name = 'ishya'
	self.shyapira_name = 'shyapira'
	self.premier_name = 'premier'
	self.soldier_name = 'soldier_'
	self.refugee_name = 'refugee_'
	self.penny_brother_name = 'refugee_penny_brother'

	-- 필드오브젝트 이름
	self.frontyard_door_name = 'frontyard_door_'

	-- 존 이름
	self.grave_event_zone_name = 'section_13_grave'

	-- 마커 이름
	self.start_marker_name = 'default_start'

	-- 퀘스트 마커와 트래커 이름
	self.quest_marker_name = "steampunk_main"
	self.quest_tracker_name = "steampunk_main_s13_tracker_0"

	-- 이벤트 키 이름
	self.on_off_interact_event_key = 'section_14'

	-- 오브젝트 풀 이름
	self.hit_effect_preset = "FX_hit"
	self.impact_hit_effect_preset = "FX_lasthit"

	-- 프로젝타일 이름
	self.machinegun_bullet_name = "rifle_bullet_long_dist_only_target"

	quest_icon.PreLoad()
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_4 then
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset)

		self:setting()
	end

	return true
end

-- projectile 맞았을 시 처리
function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	for i = 0, self.refugee_list.Count - 1 do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, self.refugee_list[i]) then
			CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(hit_info.target, 10000, unity_class.color.red, hit_info.target.Position);

			character_util.spine_deviate_local(self.refugee_list[i], vector(-0.3, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)
			character_util.spine_pulse_color(self.refugee_list[i], CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
			character_util.spine_damage_squish(self.refugee_list[i], 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
			character_util.set_direction(self.refugee_list[i], CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetSideDirection(self.refugee_list[i].Direction))
			character_util.set_anim(self.refugee_list[i], { name = "dead", loop = false })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.refugee_list[i], { name = "damaged" })
		end
	end
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_4 then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.ishya)
		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name))

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_event, self))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_4 then
		self.ishya.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	self.ishya = nil

	self.shyapira = nil
	self.penny_brother = nil

	self.refugee_list = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then
		return
	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then
		return
	end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.grave_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.see_grave_event then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.see_grave_event

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.grave_event, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.ishya) then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.talk_with_ishya then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.talk_with_ishya

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_ishya_event, self))
		end
	end
end

-- 섹션 입장 시 NPC 설정

-- projectile 맞았을 시 처리
function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	local battle_char_1 = get_character(self.battle_npc_name_1)
	local battle_char_2 = get_character(self.battle_npc_name_2)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, battle_char_1) or
			lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, battle_char_2) then
		CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(hit_info.target, 10000, unity_class.color.red, hit_info.target.Position)

		local cur_target = hit_info.target
		cast(cur_target, typeof(CS.Oak.Character))

		character_util.spine_pulse_color(cur_target, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(cur_target, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
		character_util.set_direction(cur_target, CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetSideDirection(cur_target.Direction))
		character_util.set_anim(cur_target, { name = 'dead', loop = false })
		character_util.set_emotion(cur_target, { name = "damaged" })

		return true
	else
		return false
	end
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_4 then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(
				self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.ishya)
		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name))

		self.hard_crystal:Shake(0.04, 0.5)
		self.hard_crystal.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BurnEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	self.ishya = nil
	self.shyapira = nil
	self.hard_crystal_refugee = nil

	self.soldier_list = nil
	self.refugee_list = nil
	self.cold_refugee_list = nil

	if self.hard_crystal ~= nil then
		self.hard_crystal:CancelShake()
		self.hard_crystal.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		self.hard_crystal = nil
	end

	self.campfire = nil

	self.shoot_helper_list = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BurnEvent) then
		self:on_burn_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		self:on_touch_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.labor_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.see_labor_event then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.see_labor_event

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.labor_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.escapist_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.see_escapist_event then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.see_escapist_event

			local talker = get_character('battle_1_1')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(talker, { key = 'steampunk_main_s14_4', bubble_type = 'shout' })

			character_util.set_death_type(get_character(self.battle_npc_name_1), "prostrate")
			character_util.set_death_type(get_character(self.battle_npc_name_2), "prostrate")
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.desertion_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.see_desertion_event then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.see_desertion_event

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.desertion_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.cliff_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.see_cliff_event then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.see_cliff_event

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.cliff_event, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.hard_crystal) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.mine_hard_crystal_event, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_burn_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.campfire) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.burn_on_campfire_event, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.see_capture_escapist_event then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.see_capture_escapist_event

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.chase_event, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown and self.time_since_last_tap_count > 0.3 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.attack_hard_rock, self))
	end
end

				character_util.set_direction(cur_refugee, 'left')
			end
		end

		character_util.set_anim(cur_refugee, { name = 'twohand_attack2' })
		character_util.set_emotion(cur_refugee, { name = 'tired' })

		self.cold_refugee_list:Add(cur_refugee)
	end

	-- 프로젝타일 발사 관련 처리
	local basic_rifle_id = 9030011;
	local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData');
	local rifle_data = item_data:GetSpec(basic_rifle_id).Data;
	local rifle_offset = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(rifle_data, 'ShootOffset', 0.5);

	self.projectile_data = create_generic_dictionary(CS.System.String, CS.System.Object)
	self.projectile_data:Add("Columns", CS.XLua.Cast.Int32(1))
	self.projectile_data:Add("SpreadAngle", CS.XLua.Cast.Int32(0))
	self.projectile_data:Add("Parallel", true)
	self.projectile_data:Add("Projectile", self.machinegun_bullet_name)
	self.projectile_data:Add("ShootOffset", rifle_offset)

	local pattern_info = shoot_helper_util.create_custom_projectile_pattern(self.projectile_data)
	local spec = shoot_helper_util.create_custom_projectile_spec(self.projectile_data)

	-- ShootHelper 설정
	self.shoot_helper_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.ShootHelper)

	local shoot_helper_index_list = create_generic_list(CS.System.Int32)
	shoot_helper_index_list:Add(4)
	shoot_helper_index_list:Add(5)

	for i = 0, self.shoot_helper_num - 1 do
		local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.soldier_list[shoot_helper_index_list[i]])
		self.shoot_helper_list:Add(shoot_helper_util.create_shoot_helper_by_spec(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional
		, ps, spec, pattern_info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShootWithShootOffset))
	end

	-- NPC들이 채굴하는 광석은 못 캐도록 설정
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.InteractableOnOffEvent.Create(self.on_off_interact_event_key, false))
end

function local_class:mine_hard_crystal_event()

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	user_party.Leader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'pickaxe_bronze_sword')
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'twohand_idle' })

	character_util.look_at(self.ishya, self.hard_crystal)

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_event')

	field:Darken('qte', 0.5, 0.3)

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTurboTap(1)

	while self.touch_count < self.qte_touch_max do
		self.time_since_last_tap_count = self.time_since_last_tap_count + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	field:Undarken('qte', 0)

	character_util.look_at(user_party.Leader, self.hard_crystal_refugee)
	character_util.jump(user_party.Leader, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)

	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	local shadow_sprite = dropped_gun.ShadowTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local fade_time = 1

	local start_color = drop_item_sprite.TintColor
	local start_shadow_color = shadow_sprite.TintColor

	local end_color = unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 0 })
	local end_shadow_color = unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 0 })

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fade_time do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / fade_time

		drop_item_sprite.TintColor = unity_class.color.Lerp(start_color, end_color, normalized)
		shadow_sprite.TintColor = unity_class.color.Lerp(start_shadow_color, end_shadow_color, normalized)

		drop_item_sprite:Rebuild(true)
		shadow_sprite:Rebuild(true)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	drop_item_sprite.TintColor = start_color
	shadow_sprite.TintColor = start_shadow_color

	dropped_gun:ConsumeComplete()

-- 군중들의 랜덤 돌던지기
function local_class:random_throw_rock(target, delay_min, delay_max)
	local thrower_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)

	for i = 0, self.refugee_trio_list.Count - 1 do
		thrower_list:Add(self.refugee_trio_list[i])
	end

	for i = 0, self.refugee_list.Count - 1 do
		thrower_list:Add(self.refugee_list[i])
	end

	-- 랜덤으로 던지는 방향, 몇 번째 NPC가 던지는지, 던지고 나서 다음 던질 때까지의 대기 시간을 설정함
	local rand_index = 0
	local rand_delay = 0
	local thrower = nil

	while true do
		rand_index = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(0, thrower_list.Count))
		thrower = thrower_list[rand_index]

		rand_delay = unity_class.random.Range(delay_min, delay_max)

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.throw_rock, self, thrower, target))

		wait_for_sec(rand_delay)
	end
end

-- 돌멩이가 날아오는 이벤트
function local_class:throw_rock(thrower, target)
	local target_pos

	if target ~= nil then
		target_pos = target.Position
	else
		local rand_dist = unity_class.random.Range(4, 6)

		target_pos = thrower.Position + vector(-rand_dist, 0, 0)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "01_swing_01", type_priority = "event", player_priority = "npc" })

	character_util.set_anim(thrower, { name = "attack", loop = false })

	local rock = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ itemid = self.rock_item_id, notforinven = true, pos = thrower.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.3),
			  target = target_pos, lootstate = "dontfindlooter", sprscale = 0.3, showoncharacter = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if target ~= nil then
		character_util.remove_anim(thrower)

		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "02_hit_projectile_01", type_priority = "event", player_priority = "npc" })
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "01_hit_npc_01", type_priority = "event", player_priority = "npc" })

		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(target.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

		character_util.spine_pulse_color(target, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.667)

		wait_for_sec(0.1)

		rock:ConsumeComplete()
	else
		character_util.set_anim(thrower, { name = 'victory_extra' })

		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		rock:ConsumeComplete()
	end
end

-- 군중들이 당황하는 이벤트
function local_class:embarrassed_crowd(cur_soldier_list, cur_refugee_list)
	-- 이모티콘 띄워줌
	for i = 0, cur_soldier_list.Count - 1 do
		local mod = i % 3

		if mod == 1 then
			character_util.show_emoticon(cur_soldier_list[i], nil, 'question')
		end
	end

	for i = 0, cur_refugee_list.Count - 1 do
		local mod = i % 3

		if mod == 2 then
			character_util.show_emoticon(cur_refugee_list[i], nil, 'question')
		end
	end

	-- 군중들의 방향 전환
	for n = 0, 5 do
		for i = 0, cur_soldier_list.Count - 1 do
			local rand_dir = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(0, 4))

			self:set_rand_dir(cur_soldier_list[i], rand_dir)
		end

		for i = 0, cur_refugee_list.Count - 1 do
			local rand_dir = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(0, 4))

			self:set_rand_dir(cur_refugee_list[i], rand_dir)
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end

	-- 방향 복구
	for i = 0, cur_soldier_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_direction(cur_soldier_list[i], 'up')
	end

	for i = 0, cur_refugee_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_direction(cur_refugee_list[i], 'up')
	end
end

-- 랜덤 Int 값으로 Direction을 구해서 적용함
function local_class:set_rand_dir(character, rand_dir)
	if rand_dir == 0 then
		character_util.set_direction(character, 'up')

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent) then
		self:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.battle_zone_name_1 then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.battle_1 then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.battle_1

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.battle_1_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.battle_zone_name_2 then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.battle_2 then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.battle_2

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.battle_2_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.battle_zone_name_3 then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.battle_3 then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.battle_3

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.battle_3_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.laser_turret_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.battle_4 then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.battle_4

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.battle_4_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.turret_range_zone_name_1 or zone_name == self.turret_range_zone_name_2 then
		if self.event_progress >= EventProgress.bombard_start and not self.missile_aim_player and
				self.event_progress < EventProgress.ending then
			self.missile_aim_player = true

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.bombard_shot_to_player, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.battle_zone_name_2 then
		if self.event_progress == EventProgress.battle_2 then
			-- 플레이어 파티 전투하도록 수정
			for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
				user_party[i].FieldObjectController.DontFight = false
			end
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.turret_range_zone_name_1 or zone_name == self.turret_range_zone_name_2 then
		if self.missile_aim_player then
			self.missile_aim_player = false
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.ishya) then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.talk_with_ishya then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.talk_with_ishya

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_ishya_event, self))
		else
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.ishya, { key = 'steampunk_main_s16_33' })
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.laser_turret) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_with_turret, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	if e.IsTurningOn and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, get_field_object(self.brazier_switch_name)) and
			not self.brazier_switch_on then
		self.brazier_switch_on = true

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.event_battlegate_name..2))
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name_1 then
		-- 배틀게이트 염
		for i = 1, self.event_battlegate_num_1 do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.event_battlegate_name..i))
		end
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name_3 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.defeat_battle_3_event, self))
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name_4 then
		self.event_progress = EventProgress.ending

		self:defeat_battle_4_event()
	end
end

-- 수평 카메라 진동
function local_class:horizontal_camera_shake()
	local timer = 1
	local shake_time = 1

	while self.is_horizontal_camera_shake do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= shake_time then
			timer = 0

			local shake_info = CS.Oak.ShakeInfo(nil, vector(1, 0, 0), 0.08, shake_time, false, false, 10)
			stage_camera:Shake(shake_info)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end
