-- 문을 공성추로 공격하는 이벤트
function local_class:attack_battering_ram(attacker_list, is_shake)
	local gate_animator = self.main_gate:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	-- 공성추를 뒤로 당김
	for i = 0, attacker_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.move_to(attacker_list[i], attacker_list[i].Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5),
				0.5, nil, false, false)
	end

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local move_time = 0.5
	local start_pos = self.battering_ram.Position
	local end_pos = start_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < move_time do
		local cur_z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_pos.z, -0.5, move_time)

		self.battering_ram.Position = vector(self.battering_ram.Position.x, 0, cur_z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.battering_ram.Position = end_pos

	-- 공성추로 문 공격
	for i = 0, attacker_list.Count - 1 do
		if attacker_list[i].Direction ~= CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
			character_util.spine_deviate_local(attacker_list[i], vector(0, 0, 0.8), 0.3, 0.2)
		else
			character_util.spine_deviate_local(attacker_list[i], vector(0, 0, 0.5), 0.3, 0.2)
		end

		character_util.move_to(attacker_list[i], attacker_list[i].Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
				0.3, nil, false, false)
	end

	cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	move_time = 0.3
	start_pos = self.battering_ram.Position
	end_pos = start_pos + vector(0, 0, 1)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < move_time do
		local cur_z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_pos.z, 1, move_time)

		self.battering_ram.Position = vector(self.battering_ram.Position.x, 0, cur_z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_stomp_big_01', parent = self.battering_ram, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	self.battering_ram.Position = end_pos

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(vector(0.5, 1.5, 44))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(vector(0.5, 1.5, 44))

	if is_shake then
		camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.2)
	end

	gate_animator:Play('damaged')

	cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	move_time = 0.2
	start_pos = self.battering_ram.Position
	end_pos = start_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < move_time do
		local cur_z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_pos.z, -0.5, move_time)

		self.battering_ram.Position = vector(self.battering_ram.Position.x, 0, cur_z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.battering_ram.Position = end_pos

	self.is_cancel_attack_battering_ram = true

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	gate_animator:Play('idle')

	self.is_cancel_attack_battering_ram = false
end

-- 문을 공성추로 공격하는 이벤트 반복
function local_class:attack_battering_ram_repeat()
	local origin_pos = self.battering_ram.Position

	local attacker_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	local attacker_origin_pos_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

	attacker_list:Add(self.shyapira)
	attacker_origin_pos_list:Add(self.shyapira.Position)

	for i = 0, self.soldier_list.Count - 1 do
		attacker_list:Add(self.soldier_list[i])
		attacker_origin_pos_list:Add(self.soldier_list[i].Position)
	end

	for i = 0, self.refugee_trio_list.Count - 1 do
		attacker_list:Add(self.refugee_trio_list[i])
		attacker_origin_pos_list:Add(self.refugee_trio_list[i].Position)
	end

	for i = 0, self.refugee_list.Count - 1 do
		attacker_list:Add(self.refugee_list[i])
		attacker_origin_pos_list:Add(self.refugee_list[i].Position)
	end

	attacker_list:Add(self.ishya)
	attacker_origin_pos_list:Add(self.ishya.Position)

	-- 반복 공격
	while self.stop_attack_battering_ram == false do
		-- 중단 시 1프레임씩 대기만 함
		if self.pause_attack_battering_ram then
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		else
			-- 아이샤가 공격 멤버에 포함되어 있지 않을 경우 제거
			if not self.ishya_attack_with_battering_ram then
				attacker_list:Remove(self.ishya)
				-- 아이샤가 공격 멤버에 포함되었는데 리스트에서 빠진 경우 추가
			elseif self.ishya_attack_with_battering_ram and not attacker_list:Contains(self.ishya) then
				attacker_list:Add(self.ishya)
			end

			coroutine.yield(self:attack_battering_ram(attacker_list, false))
		end
	end

	-- 반복 종료 시 초기화
	self.battering_ram.Position = origin_pos

	for i = 0, attacker_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_position(attacker_list[i], attacker_origin_pos_list[i])
	end
end

-- 위치, 타겟 지정 포격 루틴
function local_class:bombard_shot_to_target(pos, target, target_is_dead)
	coroutine.yield(self:bombard_shot(pos))

	if target ~= nil then
		if target_is_dead then
			self:character_air_spin(target, vector(1, 0, 0))
		else
			character_util.spine_pulse_color(target, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
			character_util.spine_damage_squish(target, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)

			CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(target, self.bombard_damage, unity_class.color.red, target.Position)
		end
	end
end

-- 공용 포격 루틴
function local_class:bombard_shot(pos)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_dark_magician_shoot_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local missile_height = 15
	local cur_y = stage_util.get_height(pos)

	local bombard_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(vector(pos.x, cur_y, pos.z), self.attack_radius)

	bombard_range:Show()

	local missile = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.dark_missile_preset):Instantiate(
			pos + vector(0, missile_height, 0))

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local fall_time = 1
	local freefall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_time, missile_height, 0)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_time do
		freefall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		missile.transform.position = pos + vector(0, missile_height + freefall:GetDistance(), 0)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_explosion_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	missile:Dispose()

	camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.15)

	local explosion = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.dark_missile_explosion_preset):Instantiate(pos)
	explosion.transform.localScale = vector(1.5, 1.5, 1.5)

	bombard_range:Hide()

	-- 공격 범위에 Rock 오브젝트가 존재할 경우 데미지를 줘서 폭파시킴
	local collide_objs = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(pos, self.attack_radius)

	for i = 0, collide_objs.Count - 1 do
		local fo = collide_objs[i]

		if lua_helper.type_compare(fo.DamagedBehaviour, CS.Oak.RockDamagedBehaviour) then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick
			damage_info.sender = self.laser_turret
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.damage = 100

			command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
end

-- 지정된 위치 리스트에서 캐릭터로부터 가장 가까운 곳을 바라봄
function local_class:look_shortest_pos(character, target_pos_list)
	local dist = 999
	local index = 0

	for n = 0, target_pos_list.Count - 1 do
		local cur_dist = (target_pos_list[n] - character.Position).magnitude
		if cur_dist < dist then
			index = n
			dist = cur_dist
		end
	end

	character_util.set_direction(character,
			(target_pos_list[index] - character.Position):ToDirection())
end

-- 공성추 든 NPC들 이동 설정
function local_class:set_npcs_with_battering_ram(character_list)
	for i = 0, character_list.Count - 1 do
		if character_list[i].Position.x < -0.1 then
			character_util.set_direction(character_list[i], 'right')
		elseif character_list[i].Position.x > 1.1 then
			character_util.set_direction(character_list[i], 'left')
		else
			character_util.set_direction(character_list[i], 'up')
		end

		character_util.shake(character_list[i], 0.04, 9999)
		character_util.set_anim(character_list[i], { name = 'push', upper = true })
		character_util.set_emotion(character_list[i], { name = 'damaged' })
	end
end

-- 플레이어 조준 포격 루틴
function local_class:bombard_shot_to_player()
	local timer = 0

	while self.missile_aim_player do
		if timer >= self.player_aim_bombard_delay then
			timer = 0
			local target_pos = user_party_leader.Position

			coroutine.yield(self:bombard_shot(target_pos))

			if (user_party_leader.Position - target_pos).magnitude < self.attack_radius then
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
				damage_info.sender = user_party_leader
				damage_info.target = user_party_leader
				damage_info.damage = math.floor(user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.bombard_damage_per_hp)

				command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
			end
		else
			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

		self.time_since_last_tap_count = 0

		self.touch_count = self.touch_count + 1

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.touch_attack, self, touch_pos))

		if not self.is_tutorial then
			self.is_tutorial = true

-- 문을 공성추로 공격하는 이벤트
function local_class:attack_battering_ram(attacker_list, is_shake, is_last)
	local gate_animator = self.main_gate:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	-- 공성추를 뒤로 당김
	for i = 0, attacker_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.move_to(attacker_list[i], attacker_list[i].Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5),
				0.5, nil, false, false)
	end

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local move_time = 0.5
	local start_pos = self.battering_ram.Position
	local end_pos = start_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < move_time do
		local cur_z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_pos.z, -0.5, move_time)

		self.battering_ram.Position = vector(self.battering_ram.Position.x, 0, cur_z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.battering_ram.Position = end_pos

	-- 공성추로 문 공격
	for i = 0, attacker_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.spine_deviate_local(attacker_list[i], vector(0, 0, 1), 0.3, 0.2)
		character_util.move_to(attacker_list[i], attacker_list[i].Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
				0.3, nil, false, false)
	end

	cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	move_time = 0.3
	start_pos = self.battering_ram.Position
	end_pos = start_pos + vector(0, 0, 1)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < move_time do
		local cur_z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_pos.z, 1, move_time)

		self.battering_ram.Position = vector(self.battering_ram.Position.x, 0, cur_z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_stomp_big_01', parent = self.battering_ram, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	self.battering_ram.Position = end_pos

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(vector(0.5, 1.5, 44))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(vector(0.5, 1.5, 44))

	if is_shake then
		camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.2)
	end

	if not is_last then
		gate_animator:Play('damaged')
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_twohand_stomp_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_ficklelady_stomp_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_gate_open_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		self.main_gate:CancelShake()

		camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.5)

		local gate_animator = self.main_gate:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
		gate_animator:Play('crash')
	end

	cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	move_time = 0.2
	start_pos = self.battering_ram.Position
	end_pos = start_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < move_time do
		local cur_z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_pos.z, -0.5, move_time)

		self.battering_ram.Position = vector(self.battering_ram.Position.x, 0, cur_z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.battering_ram.Position = end_pos

	self.is_cancel_attack_battering_ram = true

	if not is_last then
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		gate_animator:Play('idle')

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end

	self.is_cancel_attack_battering_ram = false
end

-- 문을 공성추로 공격하는 이벤트 반복
function local_class:attack_battering_ram_repeat()
	local origin_pos = self.battering_ram.Position

	local attacker_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	local attacker_origin_pos_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

	attacker_list:Add(self.shyapira)
	attacker_origin_pos_list:Add(self.shyapira.Position)

	for i = 0, self.soldier_list.Count - 3 do
		attacker_list:Add(self.soldier_list[i])
		attacker_origin_pos_list:Add(self.soldier_list[i].Position)
	end

	for i = 0, self.refugee_trio_list.Count - 1 do
		attacker_list:Add(self.refugee_trio_list[i])
		attacker_origin_pos_list:Add(self.refugee_trio_list[i].Position)
	end

	for i = 0, self.refugee_list.Count - 1 do
		attacker_list:Add(self.refugee_list[i])
		attacker_origin_pos_list:Add(self.refugee_list[i].Position)
	end

	attacker_list:Add(self.ishya)
	attacker_origin_pos_list:Add(self.ishya.Position)

	-- 반복 공격
	while self.stop_attack_battering_ram == false do
		-- 아이샤가 공격 멤버에 포함되어 있지 않을 경우 제거
		if not self.ishya_attack_with_battering_ram then
			attacker_list:Remove(self.ishya)
			-- 아이샤가 공격 멤버에 포함되었는데 리스트에서 빠진 경우 추가
		elseif self.ishya_attack_with_battering_ram and not attacker_list:Contains(self.ishya) then
			attacker_list:Add(self.ishya)
		end

		coroutine.yield(self:attack_battering_ram(attacker_list, false))
	end

	-- 반복 종료 시 초기화
	self.battering_ram.Position = origin_pos

	for i = 0, attacker_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_position(attacker_list[i], attacker_origin_pos_list[i])
	end
end

-- 화면에서 빗발치는 포격 루틴
function local_class:bombard_repeat()
	-- 맵을 4분면으로 나눠서 포격 가능한 범위 설정
	local upper_right_min = vector(1, 0, 42)
	local upper_right_max = vector(6, 0, 44)

	local lower_right_min = vector(1, 0, 40)
	local lower_right_max = vector(6, 0, 42)

	local upper_left_min = vector(0, 0, 42)
	local upper_left_max = vector(-5, 0, 44)

	local lower_left_min = vector(0, 0, 40)
	local lower_left_max = vector(-5, 0, 42)

	local min_max_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	min_max_list:Add(upper_right_min)
	min_max_list:Add(upper_right_max)
	min_max_list:Add(lower_right_min)
	min_max_list:Add(lower_right_max)
	min_max_list:Add(lower_left_min)
	min_max_list:Add(lower_left_max)
	min_max_list:Add(upper_left_min)
	min_max_list:Add(upper_left_max)

	local quadrant_list = create_generic_list(CS.System.Single)
	quadrant_list:Add(1)
	quadrant_list:Add(2)
	quadrant_list:Add(3)
	quadrant_list:Add(4)

	local delay_min = 0.1
	local delay_max = 0.5

	while not self.is_stop_bombard do
		-- 사분면 전부 폭격 완료된 경우, 다시 리셋시킴
		if quadrant_list.Count == 0 then
			quadrant_list:Add(1)
			quadrant_list:Add(2)
			quadrant_list:Add(3)
			quadrant_list:Add(4)
		end

		-- 사분면에서 하나를 골라 포격, 선택된 사분면은 제거해서 같은 범위에 두 번 사격하지 않도록 함
		local cur_index = math.floor(CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, quadrant_list.Count))

		local cur_quadrant = quadrant_list[cur_index] - 1
		quadrant_list:RemoveAt(cur_index)

		local cur_min_x = min_max_list[cur_quadrant * 2].x
		local cur_min_z = min_max_list[cur_quadrant * 2].z
		local cur_max_x = min_max_list[cur_quadrant * 2 + 1].x
		local cur_max_z = min_max_list[cur_quadrant * 2 + 1].z

		local cur_x = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(cur_min_x, cur_max_x)
		local cur_z = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(cur_min_z, cur_max_z)

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
				self.bombard_shot_with_damage, self, vector(cur_x, 0, cur_z)))

		local cur_delay = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(delay_min, delay_max)

		wait_for_sec(cur_delay)
	end
end

-- NPC 공격 포격 루틴
function local_class:bombard_shot_with_damage(pos)
	coroutine.yield(self:bombard_shot(pos))

	-- 공격 범위에 캐릭터가 존재할 경우 데미지 받는 연출
	local collide_objs = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(pos, self.attack_radius_for_event)

	for i = 0, collide_objs.Count - 1 do
		local fo = collide_objs[i]

		if lua_helper.type_compare(fo.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController) then
			character_util.spine_pulse_color(fo, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
			character_util.spine_damage_squish(fo, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)

			CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(fo, self.bombard_damage, unity_class.color.red, fo.Position)
		end
	end
end

-- 공용 포격 루틴
function local_class:bombard_shot(pos)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_dark_magician_shoot_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local missile_height = 15
	local cur_y = stage_util.get_height(pos)

	local bombard_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(vector(pos.x, cur_y + 0.1, pos.z), self.attack_radius_for_event)

	bombard_range:Show()

	local missile = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.dark_missile_preset):Instantiate(
			pos + vector(0, missile_height, 0))

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local fall_time = 1
	local freefall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_time, missile_height, 0)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_time do
		freefall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		missile.transform.position = pos + vector(0, missile_height + freefall:GetDistance(), 0)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_explosion_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	missile:Dispose()

	camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.15)

	local explosion = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.dark_missile_explosion_preset):Instantiate(pos)
	explosion.transform.localScale = vector(1.5, 1.5, 1.5)

	bombard_range:Hide()
end

			heal_info.heal = self.robot_knight_list[i].FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP

			command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_count_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_count_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString('steampunk_main_s17_game_start'), 2.1)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.respawn_robot_knight, self))

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.soldier_shoot, self))

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.refugee_help, self))

	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_event')

	if not self.is_tutorial then
		field:Darken('qte', 0.5, 0.3)

		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTurboTap(1)

		-- 터보탭 위치 변경하는 코드
		local go = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Find('tutorial_spine(Clone)')
		if go ~= nil then
			go.transform.position = -1 * go.transform.position
			go.transform.eulerAngles = vector(0, 180, 0)
		end
	end

	local clear = false
	local win_robot_knight = nil

	while not clear and not self.is_game_over do

		for i = 0, self.robot_knight_list.Count - 1 do
			if self.robot_knight_list[i].Position.x >= self.robot_knight_limit_x then
				win_robot_knight = self.robot_knight_list[i]

				character_util.set_immortal(win_robot_knight, true)

				break
			end

			if self.robot_knight_list[i].ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
				defeat_num = defeat_num + 1
			end
		end

		if defeat_num == self.robot_knight_list.Count then
			clear = true
		end

		self.time_since_last_tap_count = self.time_since_last_tap_count + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	if clear then
		self.is_game_over = true

		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()

		for i = 0, self.victim_list.Count - 1 do

		for i = 0, self.victim_list.Count - 1 do

			character_util.remove_anim(self.victim_list[i])
			character_util.remove_emotion(self.victim_list[i])
		end

		camera_util.move(vector(-40, 0, win_robot_knight.Position.z + 2), 0.5)
		camera_util.resize_to(3, 0.5)

		character_util.set_anim(win_robot_knight, { name = 'idle' })

		for i = 0, self.victim_list.Count - 1 do

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		camera_util.move(vector(-45, 0, win_robot_knight.Position.z + 2), 0.5)

		screen_util.fade_out_async(0.3, unity_class.color.red, 'linear')

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 무적 해제
		character_util.set_immortal(win_robot_knight, false)

		coroutine.yield(self:minigame(true))

function local_class:respawn_robot_knight()
	local z_pos_list = create_generic_list(CS.System.Single)
	z_pos_list:Add(57)
	z_pos_list:Add(61)
	z_pos_list:Add(53)
	z_pos_list:Add(56)
	z_pos_list:Add(58)
	z_pos_list:Add(54)
	z_pos_list:Add(60)
	z_pos_list:Add(55)
	z_pos_list:Add(57)
	z_pos_list:Add(59)
	z_pos_list:Add(55)
	z_pos_list:Add(58)

	local delay_list = create_generic_list(CS.System.Single)
	delay_list:Add(0)
	delay_list:Add(1)
	delay_list:Add(1)
	delay_list:Add(0.7)
	delay_list:Add(1)
	delay_list:Add(0.7)
	delay_list:Add(0.7)
	delay_list:Add(0.3)
	delay_list:Add(0.3)
	delay_list:Add(0.3)
	delay_list:Add(0.3)
	delay_list:Add(0.2)

	for i = 0, self.robot_knight_list.Count - 1 do
		local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
		local wait_time = delay_list[i]

		-- 게임 오버되었는지 딜레이 시간 동안 확인
		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < wait_time do
			if self.is_game_over then
				break
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		-- 게임 오버 된 경우, 리스폰 중단
		if self.is_game_over then
			break
		end

		character_util.set_position(
				self.robot_knight_list[i], vector(-60, 0, z_pos_list[i]))
		character_util.set_direction(self.robot_knight_list[i], 'right')
		character_util.set_anim(self.robot_knight_list[i], { name = 'walk' })

		local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
		waypoint_list:Add(vector(self.robot_knight_limit_x, 0, self.robot_knight_list[i].Position.z))

		character_util.move_waypoint(self.robot_knight_list[i], waypoint_list, 2.5, false,
				'stop', 'floor')
	end

	-- 게임 오버인 경우, 적들 이동 중단
	if self.is_game_over then
		for i = 0, self.robot_knight_list.Count - 1 do
			character_util.stop(self.robot_knight_list[i])
		end
	end
end

-- 군인들이 총 쏘는 이벤트
function local_class:soldier_shoot()
	local timer = 0
	local shoot_time = 1

	while not self.is_game_over do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= shoot_time then
			timer = 0

			for i = 0, math.floor(self.victim_list.Count / 2) - 1 do
				character_util.set_anim(self.victim_list[i],
						{ name = 'rifle_shoot', loop = false, next_anim = 'rifle_idle' })
				self.shoot_helper_list[i]:ShootFront(unity_class.vector3.zero, -1, nil, false)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 난민들이 제국병을 도와주는 이벤트
function local_class:refugee_help()
	local timer = 0
	local help_time = 0.5

	for i = math.floor(self.victim_list.Count / 2), self.victim_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_direction(self.victim_list[i], 'right')
		character_util.set_anim(self.victim_list[i], { name = 'eat' })
	end

	while not self.is_game_over do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= help_time then
			timer = 0

			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_throw_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

			local half_count = math.floor(self.victim_list.Count / 2)
			local drop_item_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.DropItem)

			for i = half_count, self.victim_list.Count - 1 do
				character_util.set_direction(self.victim_list[i], 'left')
				character_util.set_anim(self.victim_list[i],
						{ name = 'throw', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' })

				if i % 3 ~= 1 then
					drop_item_list:Add(drop_item_util.create_item(
							{ pos = self.victim_list[i].Position, target = self.victim_list[i].Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
							  itemid = self.potion_item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true }))
				else
					drop_item_list:Add(drop_item_util.create_item(
							{ pos = self.victim_list[i].Position, target = self.victim_list[i].Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
							  itemid = self.apple_item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true }))
				end
			end

			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			for i = half_count, self.victim_list.Count - 1 do
				character_util.set_direction(self.victim_list[i], 'right')
				character_util.set_anim(self.victim_list[i], { name = 'eat' })
			end

			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			for i = 0, drop_item_list.Count - 1 do
				drop_item_list[i].ConsumeTarget = self.victim_list[i]
				drop_item_list[i]:Fly()
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 터치 시 이펙트와 함께 공격
function local_class:touch_attack(touch_pos)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_fire_slash_02', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_dark_magician_shoot_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local missile_height = 15

	local bombard_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(vector(touch_pos.x, 0.1, touch_pos.z), self.attack_radius)

	bombard_range:Show()

	local missile = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.dark_missile_preset):Instantiate(
			touch_pos + vector(0, missile_height, 0))

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local fall_time = 1
	local freefall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_time, missile_height, 0)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_time do
		freefall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		missile.transform.position = touch_pos + vector(0, missile_height + freefall:GetDistance(), 0)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_explosion_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	missile:Dispose()

	camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.15)

	local explosion = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.dark_missile_explosion_preset):Instantiate(touch_pos)
	explosion.transform.localScale = vector(1.5, 1.5, 1.5)

	bombard_range:Hide()

	-- 범위 내에 적이 있었을 경우, 데미지 줌
	local collide_objs = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(touch_pos, self.attack_radius)

	for i = 0, collide_objs.Count - 1 do
		local fo = collide_objs[i]

		for n = 0, self.robot_knight_list.Count - 1 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.robot_knight_list[n]) then
				self:damage_control(self.robot_knight_list[n])
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 적에게 미사일이 명중한 경우, 데미지 처리
function local_class:damage_control(target)
	if target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HP <=
			target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.bombard_damage_per_hp then
		-- 현재 HP가 데미지보다 적게 남은 경우, 죽어야 하므로 정지
		character_util.stop(target)

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.damage_effect, self, target, true))
	else
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.damage_effect, self, target, false))
	end
end

-- 데미지 이펙트 연출
function local_class:damage_effect(target, is_dead)
	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
	damage_info.sender = target
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.damage = math.floor(target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.bombard_damage_per_hp)

	command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)

	if not is_dead then
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.boss_explosion_preset):Instantiate(
				target.Position + vector(-1, 1, 0))

		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.boss_explosion_preset):Instantiate(
				target.Position + vector(1, 0, 0))

		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.boss_explosion_preset):Instantiate(
				target.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0))

		wait_for_sec(0.2)
	end
end

-- 공성추 든 NPC들 이동 설정
function local_class:set_npcs_with_battering_ram(character_list, use_anim)
	for i = 0, character_list.Count - 1 do
		if character_list[i].Position.x < -0.1 then
			character_util.set_direction(character_list[i], 'right')
		elseif character_list[i].Position.x > 1.1 then
			character_util.set_direction(character_list[i], 'left')
		else
			character_util.set_direction(character_list[i], 'up')
		end

		if use_anim then
			character_util.set_anim(character_list[i], { name = 'success' })
			character_util.set_emotion(character_list[i], { name = 'smile' })
		end
	end
end

-- NPC들 달려가는 이벤트
function local_class:npc_rush(character_list)
	for i = 0, character_list.Count - 1 do
		local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

		if i == 0 then
			waypoint_list:Add(vector(character_list[i].Position.x, 0, 53))
		elseif character_list[i].Position.x < 0.5 then
			waypoint_list:Add(character_list[i].Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0))
			waypoint_list:Add(vector(character_list[i].Position.x + 0.5, 0, 53))
		else
			waypoint_list:Add(character_list[i].Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0))
			waypoint_list:Add(vector(character_list[i].Position.x - 0.5, 0, 53))
		end

		character_util.move_waypoint(character_list[i], waypoint_list, 6, true, 'stop',
				'floor', 'up', true)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')

		self.audiosource_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.AudioSourceHolder)

		self:setting()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_5 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_event, self))

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(
				self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(0.5, 0, 70))
		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_1))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.ishya = nil
	self.shyapira = nil
	self.premier = nil
	self.boss = nil

	self.soldier_list = nil
	self.refugee_trio_list = nil
	self.refugee_list = nil
	self.premier_soldier_list = nil

	self.shoot_helper_list = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.meet_ishya_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.meet_ishya then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.meet_ishya

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.meet_ishya_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.boss_battle_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.boss_battle then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.boss_battle

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.boss_battle_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.sound_zone_name then
		if not self.is_play_sound then
			self.is_play_sound = true

			self.audiosource_list:Add(music_player_util.play_sfx(
					{ sfx_name = '01_rummaging_01', loop = true,type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' }))
			self.audiosource_list:Add(music_player_util.play_sfx(
					{ sfx_name = '01_amb_toil_01', loop = true,type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' }))
			self.audiosource_list:Add(music_player_util.play_sfx(
					{ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_01', loop = true,type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' }))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave and e.FieldObject == user_party_leader then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.sound_zone_name then
			if self.is_play_sound then
				self.is_play_sound = false

				for i = 0, self.audiosource_list.Count - 1 do
					self.audiosource_list[i]:FadeOut()
				end

				self.audiosource_list:Clear()
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.boss_battle_group_name then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ending_event, self))
	end
end

-- 이 섹션에서 게임 시작 시 실행되는 이벤트
function local_class:start_event()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	local stage_start_at_this_section = self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 17

	if stage_start_at_this_section then
		screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	end

	party_util.align_party(vector(0.5, 0, 43), 'down', 0)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if stage_start_at_this_section then
		screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, 'linear')

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.DirectionalStageEntry, user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
				CS.Oak.Direction.Up, game_string:GetString(stage.Name))
	else
		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	end

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()

	-- 5스테이지는 Progress 15에서부터 시작되는데 15에서는 해당 이벤트를 발행함
	-- 16은 풀연출이라 해당 이벤트를 쏘지 않으므로 16부터 시작할 경우 여기서 쏴줘야함
	if stage_start_at_this_section or self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 16 then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
	end

	-- 난전 이벤트
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.hand_to_hand_combat, self))
end

-- 치고 받는 싸움 연출 1
function local_class:fight_repeat_1(char_1, char_2)
	while self.event_progress < EventProgress.boss_battle do
		coroutine.yield(self:attack_each_other_1(char_1, char_2))

		coroutine.yield(self:attack_each_other_1(char_2, char_1))
	end
end

-- 치고 받는 싸움 연출 2
function local_class:fight_repeat_2(char_1, char_2)
	local dir_1 = (char_2.Position - char_1.Position).normalized
	local dir_2 = (char_1.Position - char_2.Position).normalized

	character_util.shake(char_1, 0.04, 9999)
	character_util.set_anim(char_1, { name = 'push' })
	character_util.set_emotion(char_1, { name = 'attack' })

	character_util.shake(char_2, 0.04, 9999)
	character_util.set_anim(char_2, { name = 'push' })
	character_util.set_emotion(char_2, { name = 'damaged' })

	character_util.move_to_async(char_1, char_1.Position + dir_1 * 0.5,
			0.1, nil, false, false)

	while self.event_progress < EventProgress.boss_battle do
		character_util.move_to(char_1, char_1.Position + dir_1 * 0.3,
				1, nil, false, false)

		character_util.move_to(char_2, char_2.Position + dir_1 * 0.3,
				1, nil, false, false)

		wait_for_sec(2)

		character_util.move_to(char_1, char_1.Position + dir_2 * 0.3,
				1, nil, false, false)

		character_util.move_to(char_2, char_2.Position + dir_2 * 0.3,
				1, nil, false, false)

		wait_for_sec(2)
	end
end

-- 치고 받는 싸움 연출 3
function local_class:fight_repeat_3(char_1, char_2)
	while self.event_progress < EventProgress.boss_battle do
		coroutine.yield(self:attack_each_other_2(char_1, char_2))

		coroutine.yield(self:attack_each_other_2(char_1, char_2))

		coroutine.yield(self:attack_each_other_3(char_2, char_1))
	end
end

-- 단순 공격 연출 1
function local_class:attack_each_other_1(char_1, char_2)
	local dir = (char_2.Position - char_1.Position).normalized

	character_util.spine_deviate_local(char_1, dir * 0.7, 0.3, 0.2)
	character_util.set_anim(char_1, { name = 'attack', loop = false })

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(char_2.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(char_2.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	character_util.spine_deviate_local(char_2, dir * 0.5, 0.3, 0.2)
	character_util.set_anim(char_2, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_emotion(char_2, { name = 'damaged' })

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	character_util.remove_anim(char_1)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	character_util.remove_anim(char_2)
	character_util.set_emotion(char_2, { name = 'attack' })
end

-- 단순 공격 연출 3
function local_class:attack_each_other_3(char_1, char_2)
	local dir = (char_2.Position - char_1.Position).normalized
	local origin_pos = char_2.Position

	character_util.spine_deviate_local(char_1, dir, 0.3, 0.2)
	character_util.set_anim(char_1, { name = 'attack', loop = false })

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(char_2.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(char_2.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info('physics', true, dir,
			15000, 0.05, CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

	command_util.publish_knock_back(user_party_leader.Owner, char_2, knock_back_info, nil)

	character_util.set_anim(char_2, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_emotion(char_2, { name = 'damaged' })

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	character_util.remove_anim(char_1)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_anim(char_2, { name = 'prostrate' })
	character_util.set_emotion(char_2, { name = 'confused' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.shake(char_2, 0.04, 1)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim(char_2)

-- 재상이 몬스터로 변하는 과정의 사이클론 이펙트
function local_class:show_premier_cyclone_effect()
	local dark_cyclone_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.premier_awaken_effect_preset):Instantiate(
			self.premier.Position + vector(0, 1, -0.5))
	dark_cyclone_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local effect_time = 1
	local start_scale = 0
	local end_scale = 3

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < effect_time do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / effect_time

		dark_cyclone_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * normalized * (end_scale - start_scale)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	effect_time = 1
	start_scale = 3
	end_scale = 0

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < effect_time do
		local normalized = 1 - ((unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / effect_time)

		dark_cyclone_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * normalized * (start_scale - end_scale)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	dark_cyclone_effect:Dispose()
end

-- 재상이 몬스터로 변하는 과정의 번개 이펙트
function local_class:show_premier_thunder_effect()
	local effect_num = 10
	local rand_max = vector(1.5, 2, 0)
	local delay = 0.2

	for i = 0, effect_num - 1 do
		local cur_rand_x = unity_class.random.Range(-rand_max.x, rand_max.x)
		local cur_rand_y = unity_class.random.Range(0, rand_max.y)

		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.premier_thunder_effect_preset):Instantiate(
				self.premier.Position + vector(cur_rand_x, cur_rand_y, 0))

		wait_for_sec(delay)
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_5 then
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.blockaura_effect_preset)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.teleport_effect_preset)

		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

		self:setting()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_5 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_event, self))

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(
				self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(0.5, 0, 147.5))
		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.ishya = nil
	self.shyapira = nil
	self.penny = nil

	self.soldier_list = nil
	self.refugee_trio_list = nil
	self.refugee_list = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.ending_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.enter_penny_zone then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.enter_penny_zone

			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 1 })

			field:Tint(self.tint_key_name, unity_color({0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 1}), 1)

			local cur_color = 0.3 * 255

			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SetBackgroundColorEvent.Create(CS.UnityEngine.Color32(cur_color, cur_color, cur_color, 255), 1))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.ending_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress == EventProgress.enter_penny_zone then
			if user_party_leader.Position.z < 135 then
				self.event_progress = EventProgress.idle

				music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_heroic_moment', state = 'event', mix = 1 })

				field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key_name, 1)

				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SetBackgroundColorEvent.Create(CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 255, 255, 255), 1))
			else
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ignore_event, self))
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.penny) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ending_event, self, false))
	end
end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	screen_util.fade_out_async(2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.penny)

	camera_util.move(vector(0.5, 0, 142), 0)

	party_util.align_party(self.penny, 'down', 0, 'arc')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	coroutine.yield(self:ending_event(true))
end

-- 파티원들을 정해진 속도로 회전시킴
function local_class:rotate_party(pivot, duration)
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local angle = 360

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		local cur_angle = angle * unity_class.time.deltaTime * (1 / duration)

		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			self:rotate_character_from_point(user_party[i], pivot, vector(0, cur_angle, 0))
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 해당 캐릭터를 특정 점에 대하여 일정 각도만큼 회전시킴
function local_class:rotate_character_from_point(character, pivot, angle)
	local dir = character.Position -  pivot
	dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(angle) * dir
	local cur_point = dir + pivot

	character_util.set_position(character, cur_point, true)
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

		character_util.set_direction(self.refugee_partner, 'left')
		character_util.spine_deviate_local(self.refugee_partner, vector(0, 0, 0.3), 0.3, 0.2)
		character_util.spine_pulse_color(self.refugee_partner, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(self.refugee_partner, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
		character_util.set_anim(self.refugee_partner, { name = "dead", loop = false })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.refugee_partner, { name = "damaged" })

		CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(hit_info.target, 10000, unity_class.color.red, hit_info.target.Position)
	end
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_1 then
		-- 이 섹션부터 시작한 경우, 입장 처리는 여기서 해준다.
		if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 1 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_event, self))
		else
			-- 이전 섹션에서 달려가던 열혈 청년 처리
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.control_passionate_guy, self))
		end

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
				vector(77.5, 0, -10))
		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_1))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.gatekeeper_list = nil
	self.awaiter_list = nil
	self.soldier_list = nil
	self.refugee_list = nil
	self.refugee_partner = nil
	self.runaway_refugee = nil

	self.shoot_helper_1 = nil
	self.shoot_helper_2 = nil

	self.soldier_patrol_routine = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent) then
		self:on_move_field_object_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.chase_player_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.chase_player_event then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.chase_player_event

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.chase_player_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.block_zone_name then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.block_event, self))
	elseif zone_name == self.block_box_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress == EventProgress.chase_player_event then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.block_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.paper_box_end_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.paper_box_end_event then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.paper_box_end_event

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.paper_box_end_event, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.refugee_partner) then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.chase_player_event then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.refugee_partner, { key = 'steampunk_main_s2_3', skip = false })
		else
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.refugee_partner, { key = 'steampunk_main_s2_5', skip = false })
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.hide_box_1) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.hide_in_box_event, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_move_field_object_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) and self.set_box_position then
		self:set_box_position_player_func()
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.refugee_partner) and self.set_box_position then
		self:set_box_position_refugee_func()
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e.Params ~= nil and e.Params.Length == 2 then
		if not self.is_discovered then
			self.is_discovered = true

			if e.Params[0] == self.discovered_upper_custom_event then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.discovered_upper, self, e.Sender))
			elseif e.Params[0] == self.discovered_custom_event then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.discovered, self, e.Params[0], e.Sender, 1))
			elseif e.Params[0] == self.discovered_custom_event_2 then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.discovered, self, e.Params[0], e.Sender, 2))
			elseif e.Params[0] == self.discovered_custom_event_3 then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.discovered, self, e.Params[0], e.Sender, 3))
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 이 섹션에서 게임 시작 시 실행되는 이벤트

			game_string:GetString(stage.Name))

-- 달려가는 열혈 청년 처리
function local_class:control_passionate_guy()
	-- 열혈 청년 이동이 끝날 때까지 대기
	while self.refugee_partner.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction ~= CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 상자에 들어가는 플레이어와 난민
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.rotate_box, self, self.hide_box_2, 90, 0.5))

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_anim(self.refugee_partner, { name = "walk4legs" })
	character_util.move_to_async(self.refugee_partner, self.hide_box_2.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.3),
			0.5, nil, false, false, true)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.refugee_partner, 0, 0.3)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.rotate_box, self, self.hide_box_2, -90, 0.3))

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_direction(self.refugee_partner, "down")
	character_util.remove_anim(self.refugee_partner)
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.refugee_partner)
end

-- 병사들이 플레이어가 있는 구역을 전체적으로 순찰하는 이벤트
-- FieldObjectController를 유지하면서 이동시켜야 하기 때문에 Position을 직접 여기서 바꿔주는 방식으로 진행
function local_class:soldier_patrol_event()
	self.soldier_patrol_pause = false

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_soldiers_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local soldier_pos_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	local soldier_target_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

	for i = 0, self.first_event_soldier_num - 1 do
		character_util.set_anim(self.soldier_list[i], { name = "walk" })

		soldier_pos_list:Add(self.soldier_list[i].Position)
		soldier_target_list:Add(self.soldier_list[i].Position + vector(0, 0, 13))
	end

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local move_time = 6.5

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < move_time do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / move_time

		for i = 0, self.first_event_soldier_num - 1 do
			local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(soldier_pos_list[i], soldier_target_list[i], normalized)

			self.soldier_list[i].Position = cur_pos
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for i = 0, self.first_event_soldier_num - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim(self.soldier_list[i])

		character_util.set_position(self.soldier_list[i], soldier_target_list[i])
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	self.soldier_patrol_pause = true
end

-- 이벤트 제국 병사에게 발각되는 이벤트
function local_class:discovered_upper(detector)
	-- 병사들이 순찰하는 이벤트 종료
	stop_coroutine(self.soldier_patrol_routine)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "03_dialogue_negative_01", type_priority = "event", player_priority = "npc" })

	character_util.jump(user_party_leader, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = "embarrassed" })
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = "scared" })

	-- 걸린 NPC 이외에도 이벤트 병사들이 주인공 바라보고 정지
	for i = 0, self.first_event_soldier_num - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim(self.soldier_list[i])
		character_util.stop(self.soldier_list[i])

		local dir = (user_party_leader.Position - self.soldier_list[i].Position):ToDirection()
		character_util.set_direction(self.soldier_list[i], dir)
		character_util.set_emotion(self.soldier_list[i], { name = "mad" })
	end

	camera_util.move(detector.Position, 0.5, { ignorecameragrids = true })

	character_util.jump(detector, 0.5, 0.3)
	character_util.set_anim(detector, { name = "release", sfx_name = "01_swing_01" })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(detector, { key = "steampunk_main_s2_1", skip = true })

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	local marker = field:GetMarker(self.upper_reset_marker_name)

	character_util.set_position(user_party_leader, marker.position)
	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, marker.direction)
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)
	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)

	character_util.remove_anim(detector)
	character_util.remove_emotion(detector)

	stage_camera:SetTarget(user_party_leader)

	for i = 0, self.first_event_soldier_num - 1 do
		character_util.set_position(self.soldier_list[i], vector(76 + i, 0, -15))
		character_util.set_direction(self.soldier_list[i], "up")
		character_util.remove_anim(self.soldier_list[i])
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.soldier_list[i])

		local waypoint_character_controller = CS.Oak.WayPointGuardCharacterController.Create(
				self.soldier_list[i], self.discovered_upper_custom_event, 5, 90)
		self.soldier_list[i].FieldObjectController = waypoint_character_controller
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	self.is_discovered = false

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	-- 병사들이 순찰하는 이벤트 시작
	self.soldier_patrol_routine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
			stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.soldier_patrol_event, self))

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

-- 이전 맵으로 돌아가지 못하게 막는 이벤트
function local_class:block_event()
	self.on_block_event = true

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Show()

	coroutine.yield(stage.FieldUINarrationBox:SetNarration(game_string:GetString(self.narration_key_1), 0, 1))

	stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Hide()

	character_util.move_to_async(user_party_leader, user_party_leader.Position + vector(2, 0, 0),
			nil, 3, true, true)

	user_party:ResetControllers()
	-- 박스에 들어간 상태라면 다시 스킬 액션 막아둠
	-- 캐릭터 Reset이 바로 되지 않으므로 기다림
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	if self.event_progress == EventProgress.chase_player_event then
		--6성 리더 스킬 버튼 추가에 따른, 필요한 UI만 출력하도록 수정.
		field_ui_util.show_target_ui({
			show_target = field_ui_type.dpad | field_ui_type.action_button | field_ui_type.party_state,
			show_minimap = true,
			show_navigation_bar = true,
			show_ui_quest_marker = true
		})
	end

	self.on_block_event = false
end

-- 상자에 숨어서 병사들을 따돌리는 이벤트
function local_class:hide_in_box_event()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
	stage.QuestTracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	-- 캐릭터 ActionState를 CharacterInfiltrationState(잠입)으로 변경
	message_system:Send(user_party_leader.CharacterBehaviour,
			CS.Oak.ActionStateChangeEvent.Create(CS.Oak.CharacterInfiltrationState.Create(user_party_leader)))

	local dir = (self.hide_box_1.Position - user_party_leader.Position):ToDirection()
	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, dir)

	coroutine.yield(self:rotate_box(self.hide_box_1, 90, 0.5))

	-- 상자에 들어가는 플레이어
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'walk4legs' })
	character_util.move_to_async(user_party_leader, self.hide_box_1.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.3), 0.5, nil)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(user_party_leader, 0, 0.3)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	coroutine.yield(self:rotate_box(self.hide_box_1, -90, 0.3))

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	camera_util.move_async(vector(77, 0, 0), 1)

	-- 병사들이 상자 앞으로 다가올 때까지 대기
	while self.soldier_patrol_pause == false do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 병사들이 순찰하는 이벤트 종료
	stop_coroutine(self.soldier_patrol_routine)

	-- Controller Reset
	for i = 0, self.first_event_soldier_num - 1 do
		self.soldier_list[i]:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
		self.soldier_list[i].FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController()
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	character_util.set_direction(self.soldier_list[0], "left")

	character_util.set_direction(self.soldier_list[3], "right")

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	for i = 0, self.first_event_soldier_num - 1 do
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.soldier_list[i])
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

-- 상자에 들어가고 나올 때 살짝 들리는 연출
function local_class:rotate_box(box, rotation, duration)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_gatcha_box_remove_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local start_rotation = box.Transform.localRotation.eulerAngles.x

	local start_y = box.Transform.localPosition.y
	local end_y

	if rotation > 0 then
		end_y = 0.5
	else
		end_y = 0
	end

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		local cur_rotation = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(
				unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_rotation, rotation, duration)

		box.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(cur_rotation, 0, 0))

		local cur_y = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(
				unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_y, end_y - start_y, duration)

		box.Transform.localPosition = vector(box.Transform.localPosition.x, cur_y, box.Transform.localPosition.z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	box.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(start_rotation + rotation, 0, 0))
	box.Transform.localPosition = vector(box.Transform.localPosition.x, end_y, box.Transform.localPosition.z)
end

-- 경비병에게 들켰을 경우 발생하는 이벤트, 플레이어를 리셋 위치로 되돌려준다.
function local_class:discovered(event_name, detector, type)
	-- 캐릭터 ActionState를 기본값으로 변경
	message_system:Send(user_party_leader.CharacterBehaviour, CS.Oak.ActionStateChangeEvent.Create(nil))

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "03_dialogue_negative_01", type_priority = "event", player_priority = "npc" })

	-- ! 아이콘 머리위에 띄움
	CS.Oak.NoticeIcon.SetBattleStart(detector)

	character_util.jump(detector, 0.5, 0.3)
	character_util.set_anim(detector, { name = "release", sfx_name = "01_swing_01" })
	character_util.set_emotion(detector, { name = "mad" })

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.jump_box, self))

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(detector, { key = "steampunk_main_s2_25", skip = true })

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	-- 캐릭터 ActionState를 CharacterInfiltrationState(잠입)으로 변경
	message_system:Send(user_party_leader.CharacterBehaviour,
			CS.Oak.ActionStateChangeEvent.Create(CS.Oak.CharacterInfiltrationState.Create(user_party_leader)))

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(detector, { "reset", event_name }))

	local marker_name = ''

	if type == 1 then
		marker_name = self.reset_marker_name
	elseif type == 2 then
		marker_name = self.reset_marker_name_2
	else
		marker_name = self.reset_marker_name_3
	end

	local marker = field:GetMarker(marker_name)
	local marker_dir = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetOpposite(marker.direction)
	local marker_tovector = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(marker_dir)
	local constants = CS.Oak.Constants

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_position(user_party[i], marker.position + marker_tovector * constants.DistBetweenPartyMembers * i)
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], marker.direction)
		user_party[i]:RemoveAnimation()
		user_party[i]:RemoveEmotion()
	end

	self.hide_box_1.Position = user_party_leader.Position
	self.hide_box_2.Position = self.refugee_partner.Position

	detector:RemoveAnimation()
	detector:RemoveEmotion()

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	self.is_discovered = false

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	user_party:ResetControllers()
	-- 캐릭터 Reset이 바로 되지 않으므로 기다림
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	--6성 리더 스킬 버튼 추가에 따른, 필요한 UI만 출력하도록 수정.
	field_ui_util.show_target_ui({
		show_target = field_ui_type.dpad | field_ui_type.action_button | field_ui_type.party_state,
		show_minimap = true,
		show_navigation_bar = true,
		show_ui_quest_marker = true
	})
end

-- 박스가 점프하는 것처럼 연출
function local_class:jump_box()
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local jump_time = 0.5
	local jump_height = 1

	local hide_box_1_position = self.hide_box_1.Position
	local hide_box_2_position = self.hide_box_2.Position

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < jump_time do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / jump_time

		-- 점프에 사인 곡선 사용
		local cur_sin = math.sin(math.rad(normalized * 180))

		self.hide_box_1.Position = hide_box_1_position + vector(0, jump_height * cur_sin, 0)
		self.hide_box_2.Position = hide_box_2_position + vector(0, jump_height * cur_sin, 0)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.hide_box_1.Position = hide_box_1_position
	self.hide_box_2.Position = hide_box_2_position
end

function local_class:knockback_player_box()
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_player_hit_wall_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	-- 플레이어 위치 설정

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(self.hide_box_1.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	-- 박스 x, y축 움직임 설정
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local move_time = 0.7
	local jump_height = 2

	local knockback_x = -6

	local rotate = 180

	local hide_box_1_position = self.hide_box_1.Position

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < move_time do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / move_time

		-- 점프에 사인 곡선 사용
		local cur_sin = math.sin(math.rad(normalized * 180))

		-- x축 이동은 EaseOutQuad 사용
		local cur_x = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuad(
				unity_class.time.time - cur_time, hide_box_1_position.x, knockback_x, move_time)

		-- 회전은 linear
		local cur_rotate = normalized * rotate

		self.hide_box_1.Position = vector(cur_x, jump_height * cur_sin, hide_box_1_position.z)
		self.hide_box_1.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, cur_rotate, 0)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_wolf_boss_bomb_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.small_explosion_preset):Instantiate(self.hide_box_1.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(self.hide_box_1.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = "prostrate" })
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = "confused" })
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(user_party_leader, 1, 0)

		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.escape_train) then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.escape_by_train then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.escape_by_train
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.escape_by_train_event, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_door_opened_event(e)
	if e.DoorHandleName == self.kid_door_name and self.event_progress == EventProgress.kid_event then

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.door_opened_event, self))
	end
end

-- [PS-7502] 라-캔터베리 국경에서 블럭을 이용해 npc를 통과할 수 있는 문제 관련 수정.
function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	-- 눌린 버튼이 리셋 스위치
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, get_field_object('square_block_reset_switch')) then
		self.is_square_block_on_switch = false
		return true
	end

	-- 스퀘어 블록을 밀어 스위치를 누름.
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Stepper, get_field_object('square_block')) then
		self.is_square_block_on_switch = e.IsTurningOn
		return true
	-- 플레이어가 버튼을 누른 경우.
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Stepper, user_party.Leader) then
		-- 꼬마 이벤트용 스위치 버튼인지 확인
		local switch_name_prefix = 'kid_door_switch_'
		local stepped_switch_name = e.SwitchObject.Name
		if string.find(stepped_switch_name, switch_name_prefix) ~= nil then
			if self.is_square_block_on_switch then
				local square_block = get_field_object('square_block_reset_switch')
				-- 연출이 진행되는 동안은 리셋이 진행되지 않도록 처리.
				square_block.FieldObjectBehaviour.CanResetGimmick = false
				return true
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 소녀의 밀고로 샤피라에게 발각되는 이벤트, 추격전 시작
function local_class:discovered_by_shyapira()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 샤피라의 내려찍기 공격
	coroutine.yield(self:shyapira_power_attack())

	-- NPC 비활성화
	character_util.set_position(self.bad_girl, vector(999, 0, 999))

	for i = 0, self.kid_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_position(self.kid_list[i], vector(999, 0, 999))
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	character_util.shake(user_party_leader, 0.04, 1)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_player_popup_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)
	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)

	character_util.mario_jump_async(user_party_leader, "right")

	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, "up")

	character_util.set_direction(self.shyapira, "down")
	character_util.jump(self.shyapira, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.set_anim(self.shyapira, { name = "cast2" })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.shyapira, { name = 'attack' })

	camera_util.move_async(self.shyapira.Position, 0.5)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_run', state = 'event', mix = 2 })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.shyapira, { key = "steampunk_main_s3_8", skip = true })

	camera_util.shake(0.02, 0.5)

	character_util.set_anim(self.shyapira, { name = "throw", sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.shyapira, { key = "steampunk_main_s3_11", skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(self.shyapira)
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.shyapira)

	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, "down")

	camera_util.move_async(user_party_leader.Position, 0.5, { end_target = user_party_leader })

	-- 추격전 기본 설정
	self:set_run_puzzle()

	-- 캐릭터 죽으면 이벤트 꼬이니 죽지 않도록 설정
	character_util.set_immortal(user_party_leader, true)

	-- 문 닫아서 플레이어 빠져나가는 것 방지
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.kid_door_name))

	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.escape_train)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()

	-- 플레이어에게 컨트롤 돌려준 뒤, 0.3초 뒤에 샤피라도 움직임
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))

	self.shyapira.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.FollowEventCharacterController.Create(self.shyapira,
			self.crash_event_name, self.crash_target_name)
	self.shyapira.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.6, 1, 0.5))

	self.check_shyapira_distance_event = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
			self.check_shyapira_distance, self))

	buff_manager:AddBuff(self.shyapira, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.shyapira, "speed_down_persistent", 70, false, false)

	-- 추격전 리셋 시 필요한 제국병들의 위치와 방향 저장
	self.soldier_pos_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	self.soldier_dir_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Direction)

	for i = 0, self.soldier_list.Count - 1 do
		self.soldier_pos_list:Add(self.soldier_list[i].Position)
		self.soldier_dir_list:Add(self.soldier_list[i].Direction)

		self.soldier_list[i].CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end
end

-- 샤피라가 공중으로 도약해서 플레이어를 향해 내려찍는 이벤트 (연출용)
function local_class:shyapira_power_attack()
	local target = user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5)

	character_util.set_direction(self.shyapira, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
	character_util.set_anim(self.shyapira, { name = 'bomb_attack', loop = false, scale = 0.5 })
	character_util.set_position(self.shyapira, vector(target.x, 10, target.z))

	local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(target, 2)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local fall_time = 0.5
	local shyapira_pos = self.shyapira.Position
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_time, 10, 0)

	while (unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_time) do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		character_util.set_position(self.shyapira, vector(target.x, shyapira_pos.y + dist_y, target.z), true)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_stomp_fire_02', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	attack_range:Hide()

	character_util.set_position(self.shyapira, vector(self.shyapira.Position.x, 0, self.shyapira.Position.z))

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.shyapira_skill_effect_preset):Instantiate(self.shyapira.Position)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.shyapira_crack_effect_preset):Instantiate(self.shyapira.Position)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.shyapira_rebound_effect_preset):Instantiate(self.shyapira.Position)

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)

	character_util.set_position(self.shyapira, end_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(self.shyapira, "down")
	character_util.remove_anim(self.shyapira)

	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, "right")
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = "prostrate" })
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = "damaged" })

	cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local friction_time = 0.7

	local player_crashbehaviour = user_party_leader.CrashBehaviour
	user_party_leader.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	local player_pos = user_party_leader.Position

	local friction = CS.CalculatorFrictionPush(0, user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.FieldObjectSpec.Mass,
			CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient, 24000, 0.05)

	if (user_party_leader.CharacterInfo ~= nil) then
		music_player:PlayVoice(user_party_leader.CharacterInfo, CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Damaged1)
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_hit_wall_01')
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_trip_01')

	while (unity_class.time.time - cur_time < friction_time) do
		friction:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_z = friction:GetDistance()

		character_util.set_position(user_party_leader, player_pos + vector(0, 0, -1) * dist_z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	user_party_leader.CrashBehaviour = player_crashbehaviour
end

-- 샤피라가 공중으로 도약해서 내려 찍는 스킬 공격 사용

-- 샤피라와 플레이어 사이의 거리를 체크하여 플레이어가 붙잡혔는지 확인
function local_class:check_shyapira_distance()
	while ((user_party_leader.Position - self.shyapira.Position).magnitude >= self.shyapira_distance_limit) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_slowmotion_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	camera_util.resize_to(2.5, 0.3)

	field:Tint(self.tint_key_name, unity_color({0, 0, 0, 1}), 0.3)

	-- 캐릭터가 죽어서 이벤트 꼬이는 일을 막기 위해 무적으로 설정
	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader,
			(self.shyapira.Position - user_party_leader.Position):ToDirection())

	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = "embarrassed" })
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = "scared" })

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_stab_critical_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_instant_heal_stomp_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local stab_dir = (self.shyapira.Position - user_party_leader.Position).normalized

	local stab_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.shaypira_stab_effect_preset):Instantiate(
			self.shyapira.Position + vector(0, 0.5, -0.3) + stab_dir * -3)

	stab_effect.transform.rotation =
	unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(self.shyapira.Position - user_party_leader.Position)

	character_util.set_direction(self.shyapira,
			(user_party_leader.Position - self.shyapira.Position):ToDirection())
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(self.shyapira,
			0.7 * CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(self.shyapira.Direction), 0.3, 0.1)

	character_util.set_anim(self.shyapira, { name = "katana_attack3" })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.shyapira, { name = "attack" })

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.1))

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(
			user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 0.5, -0.3))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(
			user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 0.5, -0.3))

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)

	field:Tint(self.tint_key_name, unity_color({1, 0, 0, 1}), 0.3)

	character_util.spine_deviate_local(user_party_leader,
			0.3 * CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(user_party_leader.Direction), 0.2, 0.1)

	character_util.remove_anim(self.shyapira)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	coroutine.yield(self:retire_player())
end

-- 플레이어가 샤피라에게 잡혔을 때, 추격전 재시작
function local_class:retire_player()
	local player_current_state = user_party_leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState

	if player_current_state ~= nil and player_current_state.HoldTarget ~= nil then
		command_util.execute_throw(user_party_leader, player_current_state.HoldTarget,
				CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetOpposite(user_party_leader.Direction)),
				user_party_leader.Position, 6, false)
	end

	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetSideDirection(user_party_leader.Direction))
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = "dead", loop = false})
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, {name = "damaged"})

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.7))

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1.3))

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_drown_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, "linear")

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key_name)

	coroutine.yield(self:reset_run_puzzle())

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.5, "linear")

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))

	character_util.remove_anim(self.shyapira)

	self.check_shyapira_distance_event = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
			self.check_shyapira_distance, self))

	self.is_discovered = false

	self.shyapira:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
end

-- 플레이어 위치와 추격전 기본 설정을 초기화시킴
function local_class:reset_run_puzzle()
	self.event_progress = EventProgress.discovered_by_shyapira

	-- 그리드 넘어가면 오브젝트가 재생성되는 것을 이용해서 잠시 다른 그리드로 옮겼다 돌려준다.
	character_util.set_position(user_party_leader, vector(0, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, stage.Field:GetMarker(self.player_reset_marker_name_2).direction)
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)
	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)

	character_util.set_position(self.shyapira, stage.Field:GetMarker(self.shyapira_reset_marker_name).position)
	character_util.set_direction(self.shyapira, stage.Field:GetMarker(self.shyapira_reset_marker_name).direction)
	character_util.remove_anim(self.shyapira)
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.shyapira)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	for i = 0, self.soldier_list.Count - 1 do
		self.soldier_list[i].ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled

		character_util.set_position(self.soldier_list[i], self.soldier_pos_list[i])
		character_util.set_direction(self.soldier_list[i], self.soldier_dir_list[i])

		character_util.set_anim(self.soldier_list[i], { name = "bomb_idle" })
		character_util.remove_anim(self.soldier_list[i])
	end

	for i = 1, self.brazier_num do
		local target = get_field_object(string.format("%s%d", self.brazier_name, i))
		local cs = CS.Oak.LuaICombustibleBehaviour()

		cs:GetExtinguishedBy(target, nil)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 오브젝트 재생성되었으니 원래 위치로 돌려줌
	character_util.set_position(user_party_leader, stage.Field:GetMarker(self.player_reset_marker_name_2).position)
end

-- 특정 지점 도착 시, 샤피라가 스킬을 사용해 공격해오는 이벤트
function local_class:shyapira_attack_event()
	stop_coroutine(self.check_shyapira_distance_event)

	character_util.stop(self.shyapira)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shyapira_skill, self))

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	local attack_pos = user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 0.5, -0.3)
	local attack_radius = 2

	local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(attack_pos, attack_radius)

	attack_range:Show()

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	attack_range:Hide()

	if (attack_pos - user_party_leader.Position).magnitude < attack_radius then
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

		coroutine.yield(self:retire_player())
	else
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))

		self.check_shyapira_distance_event = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
				self.check_shyapira_distance, self))

		self.shyapira:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
	end
end

-- 성공적으로 기차 타고 탈출
function local_class:escape_by_train_event()
	-- 다시 갈 일은 없지만 문 열어줌
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.kid_door_name))

	-- 거리 계산 루틴 중단
	stop_coroutine(self.check_shyapira_distance_event)

	-- 샤피라 초기화
	buff_manager:RemoveBuff(self.shyapira, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.shyapira, "speed_down_persistent")

	self.shyapira.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController()
	self.shyapira.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_1 then

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_event, self))
		end

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,

	self.bin_2 = nil
	self.bin_3 = nil
