	self.shyapira_attack_event = nil
	self.shockwave_move_event = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.SNSTouchPoppedEvent) then
		self:on_sns_touch_popped_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.discovered_by_shyapira_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.discovered_by_shyapira_event then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.discovered_by_shyapira_event
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.discovered_by_shyapira_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.shyapira_stop_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.shyapira_stop_event then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.shyapira_stop_event
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shyapira_stop_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.hide_in_bin_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.hide_in_bin_event then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.hide_in_bin_event
			self:hide_in_bin_event()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local bin_1 = get_field_object(self.bin_name_1)
	local bin_2 = get_field_object(self.bin_name_2)
	local bin_3 = get_field_object(self.bin_name_3)
	local train = get_character(self.escape_train_name)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, bin_1) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, bin_2)
			or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, bin_3) then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.shyapira_go_back_event then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.shyapira_go_back_event

			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, bin_1) then
				self.hide_bin = bin_1
			elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, bin_2) then
				self.hide_bin = bin_2
			elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, bin_3) then
				self.hide_bin = bin_3
			end

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shyapira_go_back_event, self))
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, train) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_with_train, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_sns_touch_popped_event(e)
	self.wait_for_sns = false
end

-- 섹션 입장 시 NPC 설정

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 3 then
		local start_marker = field:GetMarker(self.start_marker_name)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular(0.5, 'linear')

-- 기차에 Interact하면 나오는 이벤트

	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	coroutine.yield(stage.FieldUINarrationBox:SetNarration(game_string:GetString('steampunk_main_s2_narration_0'), 0, 1.0))

-- 다시 한 번 샤피라에게 발각되서 쫓기는 이벤트
function local_class:discovered_by_shyapira_event()
	stage.QuestTracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	camera_util.move(user_party_leader.Position, 0)

	camera_util.shake(0.07, 1)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 샤피라 하늘에서 떨어지면서 공격
	coroutine.yield(self:shyapira_power_attack())

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	character_util.set_anim(self.shyapira, { name = "shoot" })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.shyapira, { name = "mad" })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.shyapira, { key = "steampunk_main_s4_0", bubble_type = "shout", skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_run', state = 'event', mix = 2 })

	character_util.remove_anim(self.shyapira)
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.shyapira)

	camera_util.move_async(user_party_leader.Position, 0.5, { end_target = user_party_leader })

	-- 캐릭터 죽으면 이벤트 꼬이니 죽지 않도록 설정
	character_util.set_immortal(user_party_leader, true)

	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, "right")
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)
	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)

	-- 플레이어가 추격전 구간 빠져나가지 못하게 배틀게이트 닫음
	for i = 1, self.battle_gate_num do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(
				string.format("%s%d", self.battle_gate_name, i )))
	end

	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_2))

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()

	-- 플레이어에게 컨트롤 돌려준 뒤, 0.3초 뒤에 샤피라도 움직임
	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))

	self.shyapira.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.FollowEventCharacterController.Create(self.shyapira,
			self.crash_event_name, self.crash_target_name)
	self.shyapira.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.6, 1, 0.5))

	self.check_shyapira_distance_event = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
			self.check_shyapira_distance, self))
	self.shyapira_attack_event = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
			self.shockwave_attack, self))

	buff_manager:AddBuff(self.shyapira, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.shyapira,
			"speed_down_persistent", 50, false, false)
end

-- 샤피라가 공중으로 도약해서 플레이어를 향해 내려찍는 이벤트 (연출용)
function local_class:shyapira_power_attack()
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 1 })

	local target = user_party_leader.Position - vector(0.5, 0, 0)

	character_util.set_direction(self.shyapira, CS.Oak.Direction.Right)
	character_util.set_anim(self.shyapira, { name = 'cast2' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.shyapira, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_position(self.shyapira, vector(target.x, 10, target.z))

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local fall_time = 0.5
	local shyapira_pos = self.shyapira.Position
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_time, 10, 0)

	while (unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_time) do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		character_util.set_position(self.shyapira, vector(target.x, shyapira_pos.y + dist_y, target.z), true)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_position(self.shyapira, vector(self.shyapira.Position.x, 0, self.shyapira.Position.z))

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	local earthquake_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_02', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_stomp_fire_02', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_dark_projectile_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.shyapira_skill_effect_preset):Instantiate(self.shyapira.Position)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.shyapira_crack_effect_preset):Instantiate(self.shyapira.Position)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.shyapira_rebound_effect_preset):Instantiate(self.shyapira.Position)

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(self.shyapira)

	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = "damaged" })
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = "damaged" })

	local friction_time = 0.7

	local player_pos = user_party_leader.Position

	local friction = CS.CalculatorFrictionPush(0, user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.FieldObjectSpec.Mass,
			CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient, 3400, 0.3)
	friction:Proceed(friction_time)

	if (user_party_leader.CharacterInfo ~= nil) then
		music_player:PlayVoice(user_party_leader.CharacterInfo, CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Damaged1)
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_hit_wall_01')
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_trip_01')

	while (unity_class.time.time - cur_time < friction_time) do
		friction:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_x = friction:GetDistance()

		character_util.set_position(user_party_leader,
				player_pos + vector(1, 0, 0) * dist_x)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	earthquake_sfx:FadeOut()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, "left")
	character_util.jump(user_party_leader, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = "embarrassed" })
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = "scared" })
end

-- 샤피라와 플레이어 사이의 거리를 체크하여 플레이어가 붙잡혔는지 확인
function local_class:check_shyapira_distance()
	while ((user_party_leader.Position - self.shyapira.Position).magnitude >= self.shyapira_distance_limit) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 샤피라 동작 정지
	character_util.stop(self.shyapira)

	-- 진행 중이던 루틴 전부 초기화
	stop_coroutine(self.shyapira_attack_event)
	stop_coroutine(self.shockwave_move_event)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	-- 공격 범위 표시기, 충격파 오브젝트 비활성화
	if self.attack_range ~= null then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
	end

	self.shockwave_object.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	self.shockwave_object.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	user_party_leader.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

-- 플레이어가 샤피라에게 잡혔을 때, 추격전 재시작
function local_class:retire_player()
	if user_party_leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState ~= nil and
			lua_helper.type_compare(user_party_leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		character_util.release_hold_object(user_party_leader, user_party_leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget)
	end

	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetSideDirection(user_party_leader.Direction))
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = "dead", loop = false})
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, {name = "damaged"})

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.7))

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1.3))

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_drown_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, "linear")

	-- 전체적인 초기화 작업
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key_name)

	if self.attack_range ~= null then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
	end

	self.shockwave_object.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	self.shockwave_object.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	user_party_leader.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.DefaultCrashBehaviour.Instance

	character_util.set_position(user_party_leader, vector(0, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, stage.Field:GetMarker(self.player_reset_marker_name).direction)
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)
	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)

	character_util.set_position(self.shyapira, stage.Field:GetMarker(self.shyapira_reset_marker_name).position)
	character_util.set_direction(self.shyapira, stage.Field:GetMarker(self.shyapira_reset_marker_name).direction)
	character_util.remove_anim(self.shyapira)
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.shyapira)

	-- 바위 재생
	for i = 1, self.run_puzzle_rock_num do
		local cur_rock = get_field_object(self.run_puzzle_rock_name..i)

		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.sender = nil
		heal_info.target = cur_rock
		heal_info.heal = cur_rock.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		heal_info.isRevive = true

		command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))

	character_util.set_position(user_party_leader, stage.Field:GetMarker(self.player_reset_marker_name).position)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.2))

	CS.Oak.CircularScreenTransition.Instance:FadeIn(0.5, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	self.hit_by_shockwave = false

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))

	self.shyapira:RemoveAnimation()

	self.check_shyapira_distance_event = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
			self.check_shyapira_distance, self))
	self.shyapira_attack_event = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
			self.shockwave_attack, self))

	self.shyapira:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
end

-- 샤피라가 플레이어를 향해 충격파를 날리는 루틴
function local_class:shockwave_attack()
	local timer = 2

	-- 플레이어가 충격파에 맞지 않은 경우 계속해서 반복
	while (self.hit_by_shockwave == false) do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 충격파 딜레이가 끝나서 캐스팅 준비 완료된 경우
		if timer >= self.shockwave_cast_delay then
			character_util.stop(self.shyapira)

			character_util.set_anim(self.shyapira, { name = "cast" })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.shyapira, { name = "attack" })

			-- 충격파 범위를 미리 경고해 줄 AttakRange를 설정
			local attack_range_size_x = 30
			local attack_range_size_z = 1.5

			local target_dir = (user_party_leader.Position - self.shyapira.Position).normalized

			local rad = CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Acos(target_dir.x)
			if target_dir.z > 0 then
				rad = rad * -1
			end

			local angle = CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Rad2Deg * rad

			self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(
					self.shyapira.Position + attack_range_size_x / 2 * target_dir + vector(0, 0.03, 0),
					vector(attack_range_size_x, attack_range_size_z))
			self.attack_range:Show()
			self.attack_range.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up)

			-- 1초 대기 후, 공격 범위 표시는 제거하고 실제 충격파 발사
			coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

			self.attack_range:Hide()

			-- 충격파가 이동하는 루틴 실행
			self.shockwave_move_event = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
					self.move_shockwave_object, self, target_dir, angle))

			character_util.set_anim(self.shyapira, { name = "attack", loop = false })

			coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))

			-- 타이머, 샤피라 초기화
			timer = 0

			character_util.remove_anim(self.shyapira)

			self.shyapira:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
		else
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	-- 플레이어가 충격파에 명중해서 위 While문을 넘어온 경우
	if self.hit_by_shockwave == true then
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_dark_projectile_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		-- 명중 이펙트 표시
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.shyapira_rebound_effect_preset):Instantiate(user_party_leader.Position)

		stop_coroutine(self.check_shyapira_distance_event)

		user_party_leader.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

		character_util.stop(self.shyapira)

		-- 리타이어 이벤트 실행
		coroutine.yield(self:retire_player())
	end
end

-- 샤피라가 날린 충격파가 실제로 이동하는 루틴
function local_class:move_shockwave_object(target_dir, angle)
	local timer = 0

	-- 실제 위치를 정해 줄 가상 오브젝트 설정
	self.shockwave_object.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
	self.shockwave_object.Position = self.shyapira.Position

	self.shockwave_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.shockwave_effect_preset):Instantiate(self.shockwave_object.Position)
	self.shockwave_effect.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_wave_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	-- 충격파의 생명주기동안 정해진 방향으로 계속 움직인다.
	while (timer < self.shockwave_lifetime) do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(
				self.shockwave_object, target_dir, self.shockwave_speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime)

		self.shockwave_effect.transform.localPosition = self.shockwave_object.Position

		-- 만약 플레이어와 가상 오브젝트의 거리가 일정 이하가 되면 충돌했음을 알리는 플래그를 켜준다.
		-- TODO: 여기서 retire_player까지 호출하는 게 맞지 않을까?
		if (self.shockwave_object.Position - user_party_leader.Position).magnitude < self.shockwave_crash_distance and
				self.hit_by_shockwave == false then
			self.hit_by_shockwave = true

			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 생명 주기가 끝난 충격파 오브젝트와 이펙트를 비활성화시킨다.
	self.shockwave_object.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	self.shockwave_effect:Dispose()
end

-- 플레이어가 일정 위치까지 도망치면 샤피라가 멈춘다. 이벤트가 꼬이는 것을 방지하기 위함
function local_class:shyapira_stop_event()
	character_util.stop(self.shyapira)

	stop_coroutine(self.check_shyapira_distance_event)
	stop_coroutine(self.shyapira_attack_event)
	stop_coroutine(self.shockwave_move_event)

	if self.attack_range ~= null then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
	end

	self.shockwave_object.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	self.shockwave_object.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	self.shockwave_effect:Dispose()

	buff_manager:RemoveBuff(self.shyapira, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.shyapira, "speed_down_persistent")

	self.shyapira.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController()
	self.shyapira.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

	-- 무적 해제
	character_util.set_immortal(user_party_leader, false)
end

-- 상자에 들어가고 나올 때 살짝 들리는 연출
function local_class:rotate_box(box, rotation, duration)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_gatcha_box_remove_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local start_rotation = box.Transform.localRotation.eulerAngles.x

	local start_y = box.Transform.localPosition.y
	local end_y

	if rotation > 0 then
		end_y = 0.5
	else
		end_y = 0
	end

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		local cur_rotation = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(
				unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_rotation, rotation, duration)

		box.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(cur_rotation, 0, 0))

		local cur_y = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(
				unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_y, end_y - start_y, duration)

		box.Transform.localPosition = vector(box.Transform.localPosition.x, cur_y, box.Transform.localPosition.z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	box.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(start_rotation + rotation, 0, 0))
	box.Transform.localPosition = vector(box.Transform.localPosition.x, end_y, box.Transform.localPosition.z)
end

function local_class:break_scrap()
	local timer = 0
	local move_time = 1.5
	local is_break = false
	local break_time = 0.85

	self.shockwave_object.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
	self.shockwave_object.Position = vector(44, 0, -96)

	self.shockwave_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.shockwave_effect_preset):Instantiate(self.shockwave_object.Position)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_wave_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	-- 충격파 이동 (추격전과 동일한 루틴이지만 충돌 처리는 따로 하지 않고 그냥 일정 시간 지나면 파괴)
	while (timer < move_time) do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(
				self.shockwave_object, vector(1, 0, 0), self.shockwave_speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime)

		self.shockwave_effect.transform.localPosition = self.shockwave_object.Position

		if is_break == false and timer >= break_time then
			is_break = true

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.break_scarp_routine, self))
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 충격파 초기화
	self.shockwave_object.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	self.shockwave_object.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	self.shockwave_effect:Dispose()
end

	self.soccer_ball.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(self.soccer_ball.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(self.soccer_ball.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	character_util.spine_deviate_local(self.officer, vector(-0.3, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(self.officer, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor,
			1, 0.3, 0.5)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(self.officer, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
	character_util.set_direction(self.officer, 'right')

	local clap_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_clap_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'clap' })
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = 'smile' })

	for i = 0, self.soldier_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.look_at(self.soldier_list[i], self.officer)
		character_util.set_anim(self.soldier_list[i], { name = 'cast' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.soldier_list[i], { name = 'attack' })
	end

	cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local knockback_time = 0.3
	freefall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(knockback_time, self.soccer_ball.Position.y, 0)
	local friction = CS.CalculatorFrictionPush(0, self.soccer_ball.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.FieldObjectSpec.Mass,
			CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient, 4000, 0.3)
	start_pos = self.soccer_ball.Position

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < knockback_time do
		friction:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_x = friction:GetDistance()

		freefall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = freefall:GetDistance()

		self.soccer_ball.Position = start_pos + vector(dist_x, dist_y, 0)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.soccer_ball.Position = vector(self.soccer_ball.Position.x, 0, self.soccer_ball.Position.z)

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(self.officer, nil, 'silence')

	clap_sfx:FadeOut()

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_twohand_stomp_jump_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	character_util.set_anim(self.officer, { name = 'cast2' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.officer, { name = 'mad' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local solider_move_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	solider_move_list:Add(vector(82, 0, -47))
	solider_move_list:Add(vector(81, 0, -47))
	solider_move_list:Add(vector(79, 0, -49))
	solider_move_list:Add(vector(79, 0, -48))
	solider_move_list:Add(vector(79, 0, -47))
	solider_move_list:Add(vector(80, 0, -47))
	solider_move_list:Add(vector(78, 0, -49))
	solider_move_list:Add(vector(78, 0, -48))
	solider_move_list:Add(vector(81, 0, -50))
	solider_move_list:Add(vector(80, 0, -50))
	solider_move_list:Add(vector(79, 0, -50))
	solider_move_list:Add(vector(82, 0, -50))

	for i = 0, self.soldier_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_anim(self.soldier_list[i], { name = 'rifle_run' })
		character_util.move_to(self.soldier_list[i], solider_move_list[i],
				1, nil, true, false, true)
	end

	camera_util.move_async(user_party_leader.Position, 1, { end_target = user_party_leader })

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	for i = 0, self.soldier_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.look_at(self.soldier_list[i], user_party_leader)
		character_util.set_anim(self.soldier_list[i], { name = 'rifle_shoot', loop = false })
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shoot_soldiers, self))

	wait_for_sec(2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_sadness_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, "linear")

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_stage_clear_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)

	-- 다음 스테이지로 이동
	CS.Oak.Game.Instance:StageToWorldmap("exit_next_stage", "passage_9_1", nil, true, nil)
end

function local_class:setting_soldiers()
	self.officer = get_character(self.officer_name)
	character_util.set_position(self.officer, vector(74.5, 0, -48.5))
	character_util.set_direction(self.officer, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(self.officer, { name = 'release' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.officer, { name = 'attack' })

	self.soldier_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)

	for i = 1, self.soldier_num do
		local cur_soldier = get_character(self.soldier_name..i)

		character_util.remove_anim(cur_soldier)
		character_util.remove_emotion(cur_soldier)

		self.soldier_list:Add(cur_soldier)
	end

	local soldier_pos_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	soldier_pos_list:Add(vector(73.5, 0, -47))
	soldier_pos_list:Add(vector(73.5, 0, -48))
	soldier_pos_list:Add(vector(73.5, 0, -49))
	soldier_pos_list:Add(vector(72.5, 0, -48.5))
	soldier_pos_list:Add(vector(71.25, 0, -47.75))
	soldier_pos_list:Add(vector(72.25, 0, -47.25))
	soldier_pos_list:Add(vector(71.25, 0, -49.5))
	soldier_pos_list:Add(vector(70.5, 0, -48))
	soldier_pos_list:Add(vector(70.5, 0, -49))
	soldier_pos_list:Add(vector(69.5, 0, -48.5))
	soldier_pos_list:Add(vector(72.25, 0, -49.25))
	soldier_pos_list:Add(vector(73.5, 0, -50))

	local soldier_dir_list = create_generic_list(CS.System.String)
	soldier_dir_list:Add('left')
	soldier_dir_list:Add('left')
	soldier_dir_list:Add('left')
	soldier_dir_list:Add('right')
	soldier_dir_list:Add('right')
	soldier_dir_list:Add('right')
	soldier_dir_list:Add('right')
	soldier_dir_list:Add('right')
	soldier_dir_list:Add('right')
	soldier_dir_list:Add('right')
	soldier_dir_list:Add('right')
	soldier_dir_list:Add('left')

	-- 프로젝타일 발사 관련 처리
	local basic_rifle_id = 9030011;
	local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData');
	local rifle_data = item_data:GetSpec(basic_rifle_id).Data;
	local rifle_offset = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(rifle_data, 'ShootOffset', 0.5);

	self.projectile_data = create_generic_dictionary(CS.System.String, CS.System.Object)
	self.projectile_data:Add("Columns", CS.XLua.Cast.Int32(1))
	self.projectile_data:Add("SpreadAngle", CS.XLua.Cast.Int32(0))
	self.projectile_data:Add("Parallel", true)
	self.projectile_data:Add("Projectile", self.machinegun_bullet_name)
	self.projectile_data:Add("ShootOffset", rifle_offset)

	local pattern_info = shoot_helper_util.create_custom_projectile_pattern(self.projectile_data)
	local spec = shoot_helper_util.create_custom_projectile_spec(self.projectile_data)

	self.shoot_helper_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.ShootHelper)

	-- 제국병 NPC 설정
	for i = 0, self.soldier_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_position(self.soldier_list[i], soldier_pos_list[i])
		character_util.set_direction(self.soldier_list[i], soldier_dir_list[i])

		self.soldier_list[i].CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.soldier_list[i].SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'desert_hunter_rifle')

		local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.soldier_list[i])
		self.shoot_helper_list:Add(shoot_helper_util.create_shoot_helper_by_spec(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional
		, ps, spec, pattern_info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShootWithShootOffset))

		if i == 0 or i == 1 or i == 2 or i == 11 then
			character_util.set_anim(self.soldier_list[i], { name = 'shoot' })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.soldier_list[i], { name = 'attack' })
		elseif i == 4 or i == 6 or i == 7 or i == 8 then
			character_util.set_anim(self.soldier_list[i], { name = 'success' })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.soldier_list[i], { name = 'attack' })
		elseif i == 5 or i == 9 or i == 10 then
			character_util.set_anim(self.soldier_list[i], { name = 'cast' })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.soldier_list[i], { name = 'attack' })
		elseif i == 3 then
			character_util.set_anim(self.soldier_list[i], { name = 'cast' })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.soldier_list[i], { name = 'tired' })
		end
	end

	-- 축구공 설정
	self.is_soccer_ball_move = true

	self.soccer_ball.Position = vector(70, 0, -48.5)
end

function local_class:shoot_soldiers()
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 1.5)

	for n = 0, 3 do
		for i = 0, self.soldier_list.Count - 1 do
			self.shoot_helper_list[i]:ShootTargetObject(user_party_leader, vector(0, 0, 0.3), -1, true, 0)

			if i % 4 == 3 then
				wait_for_sec(0.1)
			end
		end
	end
end

end
